###### Rashi on Psalms 21:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/21:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/21:14:1)


**רוּמָה ה׳ בְּעֻזֶּךָ.** עַל הַקָּמִים, וְ**נָשִׁירָה וּנְזַמְּרָה** (ספרים אחרי אינו):


**Exalt Yourself, O Lord, with Your strength** over those who rise up [against You], and let us sing and chant.



## Chapter 22


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:1:1)


**אַיֶּלֶת הַשַּׁחַר.** שֵׁם כְּלִי שִׁיר. דָּבָר אַחֵר: עַל כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהִיא ״אַיֶּלֶת אֲהָבִים״ (משלי ה:יט) ״הַנִּשְׁקָפָה כְּמוֹ שַׁחַר״ (שיר השירים ו:י); וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ (מגילה טו:) דְּרָשׁוּהוּ בְּאֶסְתֵּר. וּמְנַחֵם פָּתַר **אַיֶּלֶת** – לְשׁוֹן מָעוֹז, כְּמוֹ **אֱיָלוּתִי לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה**:


**ayeleth hashachar** The name of a musical instrument. Another explanation: Concerning the nation of Israel, which is a beloved hind (אילת אהבים), who looks forth like the dawn (שחר) (Song 6:10). Our Sages, however, interpreted it as referring to Esther (Mid. Ps. 22:1, Meg. 15b). Menachem (p. 22) interprets אילת as an expression of strength, as (verse 20): “My strength (אילותי), hasten to my assistance.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:1:2)


**הַשָּׁחַר.** לְשׁוֹן שַׁחֲרִית, וּמְנַחֵם פָּתַר לְשׁוֹן בִּקּוּר, כְּמוֹ ״שֹׁחֵר טוֹב יְבַקֵּשׁ רָצוֹן״ (משלי יא:כז), וּכְמוֹ ״לְשַׁחֵר פָּנֶיךָ״ (משלי ז:טו):


השחר is an expression of dawn, but Menachem (p. 172) interprets it as an expression of seeking, as (in Prov. 11:27): “He who desires (שֹׁחֵר) good etc.” and as (ibid. 7:15) “to look (לשחר) for you.”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:2:1)


**לָמָּה עֲזַבְתָּנִי.** עֲתִידָה הִיא לָלֶכֶת בַּגּוֹלָה, וְאָמַר דָּוִד תְּפִלָּה זוֹ עַל הֶעָתִיד:


**why have You forsaken me?** They are destined to go into exile, and David recited this prayer for the future.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:2:2)


**רָחוֹק מִישׁוּעָתִי.** וּמִדִּבְרֵי שַׁאֲגָתִי:


**far from my salvation** and from the words of my moaning.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:3:1)


**אֶקְרָא יוֹמָם.** אֲנִי קוֹרֵא לְךָ מִיּוֹם אֶל יוֹם, וְאֵינְךָ עוֹנֶה:


**I call out by day** I call out to You every day, and You do not answer.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:4:1)


**וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ.** וְיוֹשֵׁב לִשְׁמֹעַ **תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל** מִיָּמִים קַדְמוֹנִים:


**But You are holy** and You wait to hear the praises of Israel from time immemorial.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:7:1)


**וְאָנֹכִי תוֹלַעַת.** כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְכַנֶּה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד:


**But I am a worm** He refers to all Israel as one man.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:8:1)


**יִפְטִירוּ.** יִפְתְּחוּ, כְּמוֹ פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם וּפֶטֶר חֲמוֹר (שמות יג:יב), ״פּוֹטֵר מַיִם״ (משלי יז:יד):


**they will open** Heb. יפטירו, they open, as (in Exod. 13:12, 13): “all that open (פטר) the womb,...and firstling (ופטר) of a donkey.” [Also] (in Prov. 17: 14): “like letting out (פוטר) water.”



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:9:1)


**גֹּל אֶל ה׳.** כְּמוֹ לָגוֹל, יֵשׁ לָאָדָם לְגוֹלֵל יְהָבוֹ וּמַשָּׂאוֹ לְיוֹצְרוֹ לְמַעַן **יְפַלְּטֵהוּ**:


**One should cast his trust upon the Lord** Heb. גֹּל like לגל, lit. to roll. A person should roll his burden and his load upon His Creator so that He rescue him.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:10:1)


**גּוֹחִי.** מוֹצִיאִי מוֹשְׁכִי, כְּמוֹ ״יָגִיחַ יַרְדֵּן אֶל פִּיהוּ״ (איוב מ:כג):


**drew me** Heb. גחי, who took me out and drew me out, as (in Job 40:23): “he will draw (יגיח) the Jordan into his mouth.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:10:2)


**מַבְטִיחִי עַל שְׁדֵי אִמִּי.** זִמַּנְתָּ לָאָדָם שָׁדַיִם לִישָּׁעֵן עֲלֵיהֶם לְמִחְיָה:


**You made me secure on my mother’s breast** You prepared breasts for a person, upon which to rely for sustenance.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:11:1)


**עָלֶיךָ הָשְׁלַכְתִּי מֵרָחֶם.** נִשְׁלַכְתִּי מֵרֶחֶם מֵאָז הוֹצֵאתַנִי מֵרֶחֶם, כְּמָה דְאַתְּ אָמַר (ישעיהו מו:ג) ״עֲמוּסִים מִנִּי בֶטֶן״ – מֵאָז נוֹלְדוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים נְשָׂאָם וְנִהֲלָם:


**Upon You, I was cast from birth** I was cast from birth since You took me out of the womb, as Scripture states (in Isa. 46:3): “who are carried from birth.” From the time the tribes were born, He carried them and led them.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:13:1)


**פָּרִים רַבִּים.** מַלְכֻיּוֹת חֲזָקִים:


**Great bulls** Mighty kingdoms.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:13:2)


**אַבִּירֵי בָשָׁן.** גַּם הוּא לְשׁוֹן פָּרִים בַּבָּשָׁן, שֶׁהֵם שְׁמֵנִים:


**the mighty ones of Bashan** That too is an expression of the bulls of Bashan, which are fat.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:13:3)


**כִּתְּרוּנִי.** סְבָבוּנִי כְּכֶתֶר הַמַּקֶּפֶת אֶת הָרֹאשׁ:


**encompassed me** Heb. כתרוני. They encompassed me like a crown (כתר), which encompasses the head.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:14:1)


**אַרְיֵה טֹרֵף.** נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר (מגילה יא.):


**a tearing lion** Nebuchadnezzar.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:15:1)


**כַּדּוֹנָג.** שַׁעֲוָה הַנִּמּוֹחָה מֵחוֹם הָאֵשׁ:


**like wax** Wax, which melts from the heat of the fire.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:16:1)


**מַלְקוֹחָי.** הֵם הַחֲנִיכַיִם שֶׁקּוֹרִין פאליי״ש בְּלַעַ״ז, כְּשֶׁאָדָם מֵיצֵר אֵין רוֹק מָצוּי בְּפִיו. וּמְנַחֵם פֵּתַר מַלְקוֹחָי אנטיילא״ש בְּלַעַ״ז, כְּמוֹ ״בַּמֶּלְקָחַיִם לָקַח״ (ישעיה ו:ו) וְהַמַּלְקוֹחַ הֵן הַשִּׁנַּיִם אֲשֶׁר דּוֹמוֹת לְמַלְקְחֵי חָרָשִׁים (ס״א אינו):


**my palate** Heb. מלקוחי. This is the palate which is called palayc (palais) in Old French, gaumen in German. When a person is distressed, he has no saliva in his mouth. Menachem, however, interprets מלקוחי as etenayles in Old French (tongs), like (Isa. 6:6): “with tongs (במלקחים) he had taken it.” And the מלקוח is the teeth, which resemble a smith’s tongs. (The quotation from Menachem appears only in the Salonika edition of Rashi printed in 1515.)


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:16:2)


**וְלַעֲפַר מָוֶת.** לְדַכְּאוֹת מִיתָה:


**and in the dust of death** To the crushing of death.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:16:3)


**תִּשְׁפְּתֵנִי.** אַתָּה תּוֹשִׁיבֵנִי, לְשׁוֹן שְׁפִיתַת קְדֵרָה, ״שְׁפֹת הַסִּיר״ (יחזקאל כד:ג), וּמְנַחֵם פָּתַר כָּל לְשׁוֹן שְׁפִיתָה לְשׁוֹן שִׂימָה:


**You set me down** Heb. תשפתני You set me down, an expression of setting a pot, as (in Ezek. 24:3, II Kings 4:38): “set on (שפת) the pot.” Menachem (p.179) interprets every expression of שפיתה as an expression of placing.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:17:1)


**כָּאֲרִי יָדַי וְרַגְלָי.** כְּאִלּוּ הֵם מְדֻכָּאִים בְּפִי אֲרִי, וְכֵן אָמַר חִזְקִיָּה ״כָּאֲרִי כֵּן יְשַׁבֵּר כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי״ (ישעיהו לח:יג):


**like a lion, my hands and feet** As though they are crushed in a lion’s mouth, and so did Hezekiah say (in Isa. 38:13): “like a lion, so it would break all my bones.”



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:18:1)


**אֲסַפֵּר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָי.** כְּאֵב עֲצָמַי:


**I tell about all my bones** The pain of my bones.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:18:2)


**הֵמָּה יַבִּיטוּ.** שְׂמֵחִים לְאֵידִי:


**They look** They rejoice at my misfortune.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:19:1)


**וְעַל לְבוּשִׁי יַפִּילוּ גוֹרָל.** בּוֹזְזִים אֶת נְכָסַי:


**and cast lots for my raiment** They plunder our property.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:20:1)


**אֱיָלוּתִי.** כֹּחִי, כְּמוֹ ״הָיִיתִי כְּגֶבֶר אֵין אַיָּל״ (תהלים פח:ה), וּכְמוֹ ״יֵשׁ לְאֵל יָדִי״ (בראשית לא:כט):


**my strength** Heb. אילותי, my strength, as (below 88:5): “I was as a man without strength (איל),” and as (Gen. 31:29): “It is within the power (לאל) of my hand.”



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:22:1)


**הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּי אַרְיֵה.** כַּאֲשֶׁר **מִקַּרְנֵי רֵאמִים עֲנִיתָנִי**, זֶה הָאֱמוֹרִי, אֲשֶׁר ״כְּגֹבַהּ אֲרָזִים גָּבְהוֹ״ (עמוס ב:ט) שְׁלֹשִׁים וְאֶחָד מְלָכִים (יהושע יב:ט-כד):


**Save me from the lion’s mouth** as You answered me from the horns of the wild oxen. This is the Amorite, “whose height is as the height of the cedar trees” (Amos 2:9); the thirty-one kings.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:23:1)


**אֲסַפְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לְאֶחָי.** בְּהִתְאַסֵּף כָּל כְּנֵסִיּוֹתַי, וְכֵן אוֹמֵר לָהֶם: **יִרְאֵי ה׳ הַלְלוּהוּ**. אֵלּוּ הַגֵּרִים (תהלים כב:כט), וְכָל זֶרַע יַעֲקֹב:


**I will tell Your name to my brothers** when any of my assemblies gathers, and so I will say to them, “You who fear the Lord, praise Him.” This refers to the proselytes, and “all the seed of Jacob.”



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:24:1)


**וְגוּרוּ.** לְשׁוֹן יִרְאָה:


**and fear** Heb. וגורו, an expression of fear.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:25:1)


**עֱנוּת עָנִי.** צַעֲקַת דַּל, כָּל עֲנִיָּה שֶׁבַּמִּקְרָא לְשׁוֹן צְעָקָה. וְעוֹד יֵשׁ לִפְתּוֹר עֱנוּת לְשׁוֹן הַכְנָעָה, כְּמוֹ ״לַעֲנֹת מִפָּנַי״ (שמות י:ג), שֶׁהוּא נִכְנָע וּמִתְפַּלֵּל לְפָנֶיךָ:


**the cry of the poor** Every [expression of] עניה in Scripture is an expression of a cry. ענות can also be interpreted as an expression of humility, as (in Exod. 10:3): “to humble yourself (לענת),” because he (the poor man) humbles himself and prays before You.



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:27:1)


**יֹאכְלוּ עֲנָוִים.** לְעֵת הַגְּאֻלָּה, לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ:


**The humble shall eat** at the time of our redemption in the days of our Messiah.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:27:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:27:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:27:2)


**יְחִי לְבַבְכֶם לָעַד.** כָּל זֶה אוֹמֵר לִפְנֵיהֶם:


**your hearts shall live forever** I will say all this before them.



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:28:1)


**יִזְכְּרוּ וְיָשׁוּבוּ אֶל ה׳.** יִזְכְּרוּ הָאוּמּוֹת הָרָעָה שֶׁמְּצָאַתְנוּ כְּשֶׁיִּרְאוּ אֶת הַטּוֹבָה, וְיָשׁוּבוּ אֶל ה׳:


**shall remember and return to the Lord** The nations shall remember the evil that befell us when they see the good and return to the Lord.



### Verse 29

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:29:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:29:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:29:1)


**כִּי לַה׳ הַמְּלוּכָה.** כִּי יִרְאוּ שֶׁחוֹזֶרֶת לְךָ הַמְּלוּכָה וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה:


**For the kingship is the Lord’s** For they will see that the kingship and the rule has returned to You.



### Verse 30

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:30:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:30:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:30:1)


**אָכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ כָּל דִּשְׁנֵי אֶרֶץ.** הֲרֵי זֶה מִקְרָא מְסֹרָס: אָכְלוּ עֲנָוִים כָּל דִּשְׁנֵי אֶרֶץ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַה׳ בְּהַלֵּל וְהוֹדָאָה עַל הַטּוֹבָה, **דִּשְׁנֵי אֶרֶץ** טוּב חֵלֶב הָאָרֶץ. כָּל זֶה יִרְאוּ אַפְסֵי הָאָרֶץ וְיָשׁוּבוּ אֶל ה׳:


**They shall eat all the best of the earth and prostrate themselves** Lit. they shall eat and prostrate themselves all the best of the earth. This is a transposed verse. The humble shall eat all the best of the earth and prostrate themselves to the Lord with praise and thanksgiving for the good. דשני means the good, the fat of the earth. [People at] all the ends of the earth will see all this and return to the Lord.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:30:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:30:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:30:2)


**לְפָנָיו יִכְרְעוּ.** אָז כָּל מֵתֵי הָרְשָׁעִים מִתּוֹךְ גֵּיהִנֹּם, וְלֹא יְרַחֵם עֲלֵיהֶם לְחַיּוֹת אֶת נַפְשָׁם מִגֵּיהִנֹּם:


**before Him shall...kneel** Then all the dead of nations [will kneel] from Gehinnom but He will not have mercy upon them to revive their souls from Gehinnom.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:30:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:30:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:30:3)


**וְנַפְשׁוֹ.** שֶׁל כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד:


**his soul** [The soul] of each one.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:30:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:30:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:30:4)


**לֹא חִיָּה.** לֹא יְחַיֶּה. רַבּוֹתֵינוּ דָּרְשׁוּ מִן הַמִּקְרָא הַזֶּה, שֶׁהַמֵּתִים לִפְנֵי מִיתָתָם, בְּשָׁעַת נְטִילַת נְשָׁמָה, רוֹאִין פְּנֵי שְׁכִינָה:


**He will not quicken** Lit. He did not quicken. Our Sages (Mid. Ps. 22:32) derived from this verse that the dead, before their death, at the time their soul is taken, see the countenance of the Shechinah.



### Verse 31

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:31:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:31:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:31:1)


**זֶרַע יַעַבְדֶנּוּ וְגוֹ׳.** זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר תָּמִיד עוֹבְדִים אוֹתוֹ:


**The seed that worships Him** The seed of Israel, who constantly worship Him.


###### Rashi on Psalms 22:31:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:31:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:31:2)


**יְסֻפַּר לַאדֹנָי לַדּוֹר.** סָרֵס הַמִּקְרָא וְדָרְשֵׁהוּ: יְסֻפַּר לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן לְשֵׁם ה׳ וּלְשַׁבְּחוֹ, אֶת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְאוֹתוֹ זֶרַע:


**it shall be told to the generation concerning the Lord** Transpose the verse and explain it thus: It shall be told to the last generation in the name of the Lord and in His praise what He did for that seed.



### Verse 32

###### Rashi on Psalms 22:32:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:32:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/22:32:1)


**יָבֹאוּ.** הָרִאשׁוֹנִים **וְיַגִּידוּ צִדְקָתוֹ לְעַם הַנּוֹלָד, כִּי עָשָׂה** לָהֶם צְדָקָה:


**They shall come** The first ones shall come and tell His righteousness to the newborn people, for He performed righteous deeds for them.



## Chapter 23


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 23:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:1:1)


**מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד.** אָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ : כָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד״, מְנַגֵּן וְאַחַר כָּךְ שׁוֹרָה עָלָיו שְׁכִינָה. מִזְמוֹר, לְהָבִיא רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְדָוִד. וְכָל שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בּוֹ ״לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר״, שָׁרְתָה עָלָיו שְׁכִינָה וְאַחַר כָּךְ אָמַר שִׁירָה:


**A song of David** The Rabbis said: Wherever it says: “A song of David,” he would play [his musical instrument] and afterwards the Shechinah would rest on him. It is a song to bring the holy spirit upon David. And, wherever it says: “Of David, a song,” the Shechinah rested on him [first] and then he recited a song.


###### Rashi on Psalms 23:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:1:2)


**ה׳ רוֹעִי.** בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה שֶׁאֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ בּוֹ בָּטוּחַ אֲנִי, שֶׁ**לֹּא אֶחְסַר** כְּלוּם:


**The Lord is my shepherd** In this desert where I am going, [therefore] I am confident that I will lack nothing.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 23:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:2:1)


**בִּנְאוֹת דֶּשֶׁא.** בִּנְוֵה דְּשָׁאִין, לְפִי שֶׁהִתְחִיל לְדַמּוֹת מְזוֹנוֹתָיו לְמִרְעֵה בְּהֵמָה שֶׁאָמַר **ה׳ רוֹעִי**, נוֹפֵל עַל הַלָּשׁוֹן שֶׁל ה׳ רוֹעִי **נְאוֹת דֶּשֶׁא.** וּמִזְמוֹר זֶה אָמַר דָּוִד בְּיַעַר חֲרֵת (שמואל א כב:ה). לָמָּה נִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יַעַר חֲרֵת? שֶׁהָיָה מְנֻגָּב כַּחֶרֶס וְהִרְטִיבוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מִטּוּב שֶׁל הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא (מדרש תהלים כג:ו):


**in green pasture** In grassy pastures. Since he commences to compare his sustenance to the pasture of an animal by saying, “The Lord is my shepherd,” “green pastures” is appropriate for the expression, “the Lord is my shepherd.” David recited this psalm in the forest of Hereth (I Sam. 22:5). Why was it called Hereth? Because it was as dry as a potsherd (חרס) and the Holy One, blessed be He, moistened it with the good of the world to come (Mid. Ps. 23:6).



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 23:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:3:1)


**נַפְשִׁי יְשׁוֹבֵב.** רוּחִי, שֶׁהוּפַג בַּצָּרוֹת וּבַמְּנוּסָה, יְשׁוֹבֵב לְקַדְמוּתוֹ:


**He restores my soul** My spirit, which has been weakened by troubles and haste, He will restore to its previous status.


###### Rashi on Psalms 23:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:3:2)


**בְּמַעְגְּלֵי צֶדֶק.** בְּדַרְכֵי מִישׁוֹר, שֶׁלֹּא אֶפּוֹל בְּיַד אוֹיְבִי:


**in paths of righteousness** In straight paths, so that I should not fall into the hands of my enemies.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 23:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:4:1)


**בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת.** בְּאֶרֶץ חֹשֶׁךְ, וְעַל מִדְבַּר זִיף אָמַר (שמואל א כג:יג,כח). כָּל צַלְמָוֶת לְשׁוֹן חֹשֶׁךְ פֵּרְשׁוֹ דוּנַשׁ בֶּן לַבְרַט:


**in the valley of darkness** Heb. צלמות, in a land of darkness. He alludes to the desert of Ziph (I Sam. 23:13 28). Every [mention of] צלמות is an expression of darkness. Dunash ben Labrat defined it [in this manner].


###### Rashi on Psalms 23:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:4:2)


**שִׁבְטְךָ וּמִשְׁעַנְתֶּךָ.** יִסּוּרִים שֶׁבָּאוּ עָלַי וּמִשְׁעָן שֶׁאֲנִי בָּטוּחַ עַל חַסְדְּךָ, שְׁנֵיהֶם **יְנַחֲמוּנִי** – שֶׁיִּהְיוּ לִי לִסְלֹחַ עָוֹן; וּבָטוּחַ אֲנִי, שֶׁ**תַּעֲרֹךְ לְפָנַי שֻׁלְחָן** – הִיא הַמַּלְכוּת:


**Your rod and Your staff** The pains that came upon me, and the support, that I rely upon Your loving kindnessboth of them will comfort me, for they will serve to expiate my iniquity, and I am confident that You will set a table before me. That is the throne.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 23:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:5:1)


**דִּשַּׁנְתָּ בַשֶּׁמֶן רֹאשִׁי.** כְּבָר נִמְשַׁחְתִּי עַל פִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ:


**You anointed my head with oil** I have already been anointed king by Your orders.


###### Rashi on Psalms 23:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/23:5:2)


**כּוֹסִי רְוָיָה.** לְשׁוֹן שֹׂבַע:


**my cup overflows** Heb. רויה, an expression of fullness.



## Chapter 24


### Verse 1

**לַה׳ הָאָרֶץ.** אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**The land...are the Lord’s** The land of Israel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 24:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:1:2)


**תֵּבֵל.** שְׁאָר אֲרָצוֹת:


**the world** The other lands.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 24:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:2:1)


**עַל יַמִּים יְסָדָהּ.** שִׁבְעָה יַמִּים מַקִּיפִין אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַרְבַּע נְהָרוֹת, יַרְדֵּן, וְיַרְמוּךְ, קַרְמִיוֹן, וּפוּגָה :


**founded it upon seas** Seven seas surrounded Eretz Yisroel and four rivers: the Jordan, Yarmuk, Karmion, and Pigah.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 24:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:3:1)


**מִי יַעֲלֶה בְהַר ה׳.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל שֶׁלּוֹ, אֵין הַכֹּל כְּדַאי לִיקָרֵב אֵלָיו, אֶלָּא **נְקִי כַפַּיִם וְגוֹמֵר**:


**Who will ascend upon the Lord’s mount** Although all the inhabitants of the world are His, not everyone deserves to come near to Him, except these: he who has clean hands, etc.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 24:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:4:1)


**לֹא נָשָׂא לַשָּׁוְא נַפְשִׁי.** לֹא נִשְׁבַּע בִּשְׁמִי וּבְנַפְשִׁי לַשָּׁוְא. מָצִינוּ לְשׁוֹן שְׁבוּעָה נוֹפֵל עַל נֶפֶשׁ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״נִשְׁבַּע ה׳ צְבָאוֹת בְּנַפְשׁוֹ״ (ירמיהו נא:יד):


**who has not taken My name in vain** Who has not sworn with My name and My soul in vain. We find an expression of an oath used with the soul (נפש), as it is stated (in Amos 6:8): “The Lord God swore by Himself (בנפשו).”



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 24:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:6:1)


**זֶה.** שֶׁכָּךְ מַעֲשָׂיו, הוּא **דּוֹר דֹּרְשָׁיו**:


**This** [generation,] whose deeds are such - this is the generation of those who seek him.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 24:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/24:7:1)


**שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם.** בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בְּנוֹ, כְּשֶׁבָּא לְהַכְנִיס אָרוֹן לְבֵית קָדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים, וְדָבְקוּ שְׁעָרִים זוֹ בְּזוֹ, אָמַר עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע רְנָנוֹת וְלֹא נַעֲנָה, עַד שֶׁאָמַר: ״אַל תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ זָכְרָה לְחַסְדֵי דָּוִיד עַבְדֶּךָ״ (דברי הימים ב ו:מב):


**[You] gates, lift your heads** In the days of Solomon his son, when he comes to bring the Ark into the Holy of Holies and the gates cling to each other, he [Solomon] recited twenty-four praises, but he was not answered until he said (II Chron. 6:42): “Do not turn back the face of Your anointed; remember the kind deeds of David, Your servant.”



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 24:9:1

**everlasting portals** Portals whose sanctity is everlasting.

### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:1:1

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:3:1

**הַבּוֹגְדִים רֵיקָם.** הַגַּזְלָנִים הַחַמְסָנִים הַמּוֹשִׁיבִים אֶת הָעֲנִיִּים רֵיקָם מִנִּכְסֵיהֶם, כְּמוֹ ״וָאֲחַלְּצָה צוֹרְרִי רֵיקָם״ (תהלים ז:ה):


**those who betray [to the extent of] destitution** Robbers and impounders, who leave the poor destitute of their property, as (above 7:5): “and I stripped my adversary into emptiness (ריקם).”

**הַדְרִיכֵנִי.** אַדְרִיצִימוֹ״י בְּלַעַ״ז:


**Direct me** Heb. הדריבני, adreza moy in Old French.


###### Rashi on Psalms 25:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:5:2)


**אוֹתְךָ קִוִּיתִי כָּל הַיּוֹם.** הוּא הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה, שֶׁהוּא יוֹם לָאֻמּוֹת וְלַיְלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:


**I hope for You all day long** That is this world, which is day for the nations of the world and night for Israel.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:6:1)


**כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה.** מִימוֹת אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן, שֶׁאָמַרְתָּ לוֹ: ״בְּיוֹם אֲכָלְךָ מִמֶּנּוּ מוֹת תָּמוּת״ (בראשית ב:יז), וְנָתַתָּ לוֹ יוֹם מִשֶּׁלְּךָ, שֶׁהוּא אֶלֶף שָׁנִים:


**for they have been since time immemorial** Since the days of Adam, to whom You said, (Gen. 2: 17), “for on the day that you eat from it you must die,” but You gave him Your day, which is a thousand years.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:7:1)


**כְּחַסְדְּךָ זְכָר לִי.** הָרָאוּי לְחַסְדְּךָ זְכוֹר לִי, אֵלּוּ מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים שֶׁבְּיָדִי:


**what is worthy of Your kindness, You remember for me** What is deserving of Your kindness remember for me. These are the good deeds on my record.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:8:1)


**טוֹב וְיָשָׁר ה׳.** וְחָפֵץ לְהַצְדִּיק בְּרִיּוֹתָיו:


**The Lord is good and upright** and wishes to exonerate His creatures.


###### Rashi on Psalms 25:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:8:2)


**עַל כֵּן יוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים בַּדָּרֶךְ.** תְּשׁוּבָה. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **יוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים** הָרוֹצְחִים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״תָּכִין לְךָ הַדֶּרֶךְ וְגוֹ׳״ (דברים יט:ג). מִקְלָט מִקְלָט הָיָה כָּתוּב עַל פָּרָשַׁת דְּרָכִים וְכוּ׳, כִּדְאִיתָא בְּמַכּוֹת (מכות י.-י:):


**therefore, He leads sinners on the road** of repentance. Another explanation: He leads sinners, meaning murderers [who flee to the cities of refuge], as it is said (in Deut. 19:3): “You shall prepare for yourself the road, etc.” Refuge, refuge,” was written at the crossroads, etc., as is stated in Makkoth, chapter 2 (10b).



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:11:1)


**לְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ.** הָרַב סְלַח </b>לַעֲוֹנִי</b>:


**For Your name’s sake** [For the sake of Your] great [name], forgive my iniquity...


###### Rashi on Psalms 25:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:11:2)


**כִּי רַב הוּא.** כִּי נָאֶה לָרַב לִסְלֹחַ עָוֹן רַב:


**for it is great** For it is fitting for a great One to forgive great iniquity.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:12:1)


**מִי זֶה הָאִישׁ יְרֵא ה׳.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא יוֹרֶנּוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁהוּא יִבְחַר, הוּא דֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹב:


**Who is this man who fears the Lord?** The Holy One, blessed be He, will guide him on the road that he chooses; that is the good road.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:13:1)


**נַפְשׁוֹ בְּטוֹב תָּלִין.** כְּשֶׁיָּלִין בַּקֶּבֶר, תָּלִין בְּטוֹבָה נַפְשׁוֹ:


**His soul shall abide in prosperity** When he abides in the grave, his soul shall abide in prosperity.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:16:1)


**כִּי יָחִיד וְעָנִי אָנִי.** וַעֲוֹן רַבִּים תָּלוּי בִּי, וּלְנֶגְדָּן אֲנִי יָחִיד. לְפִיכָךְ **פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי**, כִּי תְפִלָּתִי צְרִיכָה לִתְשׁוּעַת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**for I am alone and poor** and the eyes of the public are directed toward me, and compared to them, I am a single person. Therefore, turn to me and be gracious to me because my prayer is necessary for the salvation of all Israel.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/25:18:1)


**רְאֵה עָנְיִי וַעֲמָלִי.** וְעַל יְדֵיהֶם **שָׂא לְכָל חַטֹּאותָי**:


**See my affliction and my toil** and through them, forgive all my sins.

###### Rashi on Psalms 25:19:1

**וְשִׂנְאַת חָמָס.** שֶׁלֹּא כַּדִּין:

## Chapter 26


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 26:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:1:1)


**שָׁפְטֵנִי ה׳.** וּבְמָקוֹם אַחֵר הוּא אוֹמֵר: ״אַל תָּבֹא בְמִשְׁפָּט וְגוֹ׳״ (תהלים קמג:ב). אָמַר דָּוִד: כְּשֶׁאַתָּה דָּן אֶת הָרְשָׁעִים, **שָׁפְטֵנִי**, כִּי לְפִי הָרְשָׁעִים אֲנִי צַדִּיק, וּכְשֶׁאַתָּה דָּן אֶת הַצַּדִּיקִים, אַל תְּבִיאֵנִי בְמִשְׁפָּט:


**Judge me** And elsewhere (143:2) he says, “You shall not enter judgment [with Your servant].” Said David: When You judge the wicked, judge me, for compared to the wicked, I am a righteous man, but when You judge the righteous, do not bring me into judgment.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 26:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:4:1)


**וְעִם נַעֲלָמִים.** הַנִּכְנָסִין בַּסֵּתֶר, לַעֲשׂוֹת בַּמַּחְשָׁךְ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם (ישעיה כט:טו):


**and...with hypocrites** who go into hidden places to do their deeds in the dark.


###### Rashi on Psalms 26:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:4:2)


**לֹא אָבוֹא.** אֵינִי רָגִיל לָבוֹא וְלִיכָּנֵס בִּמְקַהֲלָם:


**neither did I go** I am not accustomed to come and enter their assembly.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 26:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:6:1)


**בְּנִקָּיוֹן.** שֶׁאֵין גָּזֵל בַּמִּצְווֹת שֶׁאֲנִי מְקַיֵּם. לוּלָב הַגָּזוּל פָּסוּל (סוכה ג.):


**with cleanliness** For there is no robbery [involved] in my fulfillment of the commandments.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 26:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:7:1)


**לִשְׁמֹעַ.** כְּמוֹ לְהַשְׁמִיעַ:


**To proclaim** Heb. לַשְׁמִעַ, like לְהַשְׁמִיעַ.


###### Rashi on Psalms 26:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:7:2)


**כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ.** זֶה הַלֵּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ לְשֶׁעָבַר, וְיֵשׁ בּוֹ לְגוֹג, וְיֵשׁ בּוֹ לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ, וְיֵשׁ בּוֹ לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא:


**all Your wonders** This refers to Hallel, which contains mention of the past, mention of Gog and Magog, mention of the Messianic era, and mention of the future.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 26:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/26:10:1)


**זִמָּה.** כָּל זִמָּה שֶׁבַּמִּקְרָא לְשׁוֹן מַחֲשָׁבָה, יֵשׁ לְטוֹבָה וְיֵשׁ לְרָעָה:


**plots** Heb. זמה. Every זמה in Scripture is an expression of a plan, some for good and some for evil.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 26:12:1
