**וּפְדֵנוּ לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ.** אֵין אָנוּ בָּאִים בְּכֹחַ מַעֲשֵׂינוּ, אֶלָּא לְמַעַן חַסְדְּךָ עֲשֵׂה:


**and redeem us for the sake of Your kindness** We do not come with the power of our deeds, but do [this] for the sake of Your kindness.



## Chapter 45


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:1:1)


**עַל שׁוֹשַׁנִּים.** לִכְבוֹד תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים יִסְּדוּ הַשִּׁיר הַזֶּה, שֶׁהֵם רַכִּים כְּשׁוֹשַׁנִּים וְנָאִים כְּשׁוֹשַׁנִּים, וּמַרְטִיבִים מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים כְּשׁוֹשַׁנִּים (שיר השירים ב:ג):


**on shoshannim** They founded this psalm in honor of the Torah scholars, who are as tender as roses and as beautiful as roses, and perform good deeds as fresh as roses.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:1:2)


**מַשְׂכִּיל.** עַל יְדֵי תּוּרְגְּמָן (פסחים קיז.):


**a maskil** Through an interpreter.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:1:3)


**שִׁיר יְדִידוֹת.** שִׁיר אֲהוּבִים, שִׁיר שֶׁל שֶׁבַח לָהֶם, לְהַאֲהִיבָם עַל הַבְּרִיּוֹת וּלְהַאֲהִיב תּוֹרָתָם עֲלֵיהֶם:


**a song of loves** Heb. שיר ידידות, a song of loves, a song of praise for them [the Torah scholars] to endear them to the people and to endear their Torah to them [the people].



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:2:1)


**רָחַשׁ לִבִּי.** כָּךְ הִתְחִיל הַמְשׁוֹרֵר בְּשִׁירוֹ: הִשְׁרִיץ לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי דָּבָר טוֹב בְּשִׁבְחֲךָ אַתָּה, תַּלְמִיד חָכָם;


**My heart is astir** In this manner, the Psalmist commenced his song: My heart caused a good theme to swarm within me in your praise, O Torah scholar.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:2:2)


**רָחַשׁ.** לְשׁוֹן נַעֲנוּעַ, וְכֵן כָּל לְשׁוֹן שִׁירוּץ וְרִיחוּשׁ:


**is astir** Heb. רחש, an expression of moving, and so is every expression of swarming and crawling.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:2:3)


**אוֹמֵר אֲנִי מַעֲשַׂי לַמֶּלֶךְ.** הַשִּׁיר הַזֶּה שֶׁיִּסַּדְתִּי וְעָשִׂיתִי, אֲנִי אוֹמְרוֹ לַמֶּלֶךְ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (משלי ח:טו) ״בִּי מְלָכִים יִמְלֹכוּ״:


**I say, “My works are for a king”** This song, which I have founded and composed, I say to one who is fit to be a king, as it is stated (Prov. 8:15): “Kings reign with me.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:2:4)


**לְשׁוֹנִי.** צַח בְּשִׁירִים כְּעֵט **סוֹפֵר מָהִיר**. רָאִיתִי בִּיסוֹדוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי מֹשֶׁה הַדַּרְשָׁן: **מָהִיר** בִּלְשׁוֹן עֲרָבִי בָּקִי:


**my tongue is** as poetic as the pen of an expert scribe. I saw in the commentary of Rabbi Moses the Preacher: מָהִיר in Arabic means expert.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:3:1)


**יָפְיָפִיתָ מִבְּנֵי אָדָם.** הָעוֹסְקִים בִּמְלֶאכֶת חַיֵּי שָׁעָה, לָמָּה? לְפִי שֶׁ**הוּצַק חֵן בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֶיךָ** לְהוֹרוֹת כַּהֲלָכָה. **הוּצַק** – כְּמוֹ נִשְׁפַּךְ, כְּמוֹ ״מוּצָקוֹת״ (זכריה ד:ב), ״וַיִּצֹק עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן״ (ויקרא ב:א):


**You are more handsome than [other] men** who engage in the work of transitory life. Why? Because charm is poured into your lips to instruct according to the halachah. הוּצַק means “poured,” as (Exod. 38:27): “to cast (לצקת)”; (Gen. 28:18), “and he poured (ויצק) oil.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:3:2)


**עַל כֵּן בֵּרַכְךָ.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״ה׳ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן״, וּמַה שְּׂכָרָן? ״ה׳ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם״ (תהלים כט:יא):


**Therefore...blessed you** as it is stated (below 29:11): “The Lord shall grant strength to His people.” And what is their reward? “The Lord shall bless His people with peace.”



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:4:1)


**חֲגוֹר חַרְבְּךָ עַל יָרֵךְ.** לְהִלָּחֵם מִלְחַמְתָּהּ שֶׁל תּוֹרָה, וְהוּא הוֹדְךָ וְהוּא הֲדָרֶךָ:


**Gird a sword on your thigh** to wage the war of Torah, and that is your majesty and that is your glory.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:5:1)


**עַל דְּבַר אֱמֶת.** לְהוֹרוֹת כַּדָּת, וּלְהִתְנַהֵג בְּעַנְוַת צֶדֶק:


**for the sake of truth** To instruct according to the law and to behave with righteous humility.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:5:2)


**וְתוֹרְךָ.** הַתּוֹרָה וּדְבַר הָאֱמֶת שֶׁתַּעֲסֹק בּוֹ, הִיא תוֹרֶה אוֹתְךָ טַכְסִיסֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה לַעֲשׂוֹת **יְמִינֶךָ נוֹרָאוֹת.** לְפִי שֶׁהִזְכִּיר תַּלְמוּד תּוֹרָה בִּלְשׁוֹן מִלְחָמָה, נוֹפֵל בּוֹ לְשׁוֹן יָמִין הַמְיֻמֶּנֶת לְהִלָּחֵם, (כְּלוֹמַר הֶסְדֵּר לְהִלָּחֵם בְּיַד יָמִין):


**and it shall instruct you** The Torah and the matter of truth in which you shall engage shall teach you tactics of war so that your right should perform awesome things. Since he mentions the study of Torah in an expression of war, the expression of the right hand, prepared to fight, is appropriate (i.e., it is customary to fight with the right hand).



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:6:1)


**חִצֶּיךָ שְׁנוּנִים בְּלֵב אוֹיְבֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ.** שְׁנוּנִים אֲגִיֵּישׁוֹ״ץ בְּלַעַ״ז, וַהֲרֵי זֶה מִקְרָא מְסֹרָס. מָצִינוּ שֶׁהַתַּלְמִידִים קְרוּיִים חִצִּים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״כְּחִצִּים בְּיַד גִּבּוֹר כֵּן בְּנֵי הַנְּעוּרִים״ (תהלים קכז:ד). וְתַלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים (הַמְּזֻיָּנִים) בַּהֲלָכָה קְרוּיִים אוֹיְבִים זֶה לָזֶה לְפִי שָׁעָה, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״לֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי יְדַבְּרוּ אֶת אוֹיְבִים בַּשָּׁעַר״ (תהלים קכז:ה):


**Your arrows are sharpened, etc., in the heart of the king’s enemies** Heb. שְּׁנוּנִים, is aiguises in French, sharpened. This is a transposed verse. We find that the disciples are called arrows, as it is stated (above 127:4): “As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.” And Torah scholars who argue with each other about halachah are called enemies to each other for the time, as it is stated: “they will not be ashamed when they speak with the enemies in the gate.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:6:2)


**עַמִּים תַּחְתֶּיךָ יִפְּלוּ.** בִּשְׂכַר הַתּוֹרָה יִפְּלוּ הָעוֹבְדֵי גִּלּוּלִים תַּחְתֵּיהֶם שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**nations shall fall under you** As a reward for Torah, nations shall fall under Israel.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:7:1)


**כִּסְאֲךָ אֱלֹהִים.** כִּסְאֲךָ, שַׂר וְשׁוֹפֵט, לְ**עוֹלָם וָעֶד**; כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״נְתַתִּיךָ אֱלֹהִים לְפַרְעֹה״ (שמות ז:א). וְלָמָּה? בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁ**שֵּׁבֶט מִישׁוֹר שֵׁבֶט מַלְכוּתֶךָ.** שֶׁמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ אֱמֶת וְרָאוּי אַתָּה לִמְלוֹךְ:


**Your throne, O judge** Your throne, O prince and judge, shall exist forever and ever, as the matter that is stated (Exod. 7:1): “I have made you a judge (נתתיך אלהים) over Pharaoh.” And why? Because “a scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom,” that your judgments are true, and you are fit to govern.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:8:1)


**מְשָׁחֲךָ וְגוֹ׳ שֶׁמֶן שָׂשׂוֹן.** כָּל לְשׁוֹן גְּדֻלָּה נוֹפֵל עָלֶיהָ לְשׁוֹן מְשִׁיחַת שֶׁמֶן, כְּדַת הַמְּלָכִים:


**anointed you...with oil of joy** Every expression of greatness is depicted by the anointment of oil, as is the custom of the kings.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:9:1)


**מֹר וַאֲהָלוֹת קְצִיעוֹת.** ״קִדָּה״ (שמות ל:כד) מְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״קְצִיעֲתָא״:


**Myrrh and aloes and cassia** Heb. קדה (Exod. 30:24) is translated קציעתא, cassia.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:9:2)


**כָּל בִּגְדוֹתֶיךָ.** כָּל בְּגָדֶיךָ מְרִיחִים כְּרֵיחַ בְּשָׂמִים, וּמִדְרָשׁוֹ (ירושלמי פאה א, א): כָּל בְּגִידוֹתֶיךָ וְסִרְחוֹנֶיךָ מִתְכַּפְּרִים וּמְרִיחִים רֵיחַ עָרֵב:


**all your garments** All your garments smell with the fragrance of spices. Its midrashic interpretation is: All your betrayals (בגידותיך) and sins are expiated and smell of a fragrant scent.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:9:3)


**מִן הֵיכְלֵי שֵׁן מִנִּי שִׂמְּחוּךָ.** יוֹתֵר מֵהֵיכְלֵי שֵׁן מְשֻׁבָּחִים הַהֵיכָלוֹת הַמְּתֻקָּנִים לְךָ בְּגַן עֵדֶן לְשַׂמֵּחֲךָ בָּהֶם. **שֵׁן** אִיבוֹיְיר״א בְּלַעַ״ז:


**more than ivory palaces, those that are Mine will cause you to rejoice** More than the best ivory palaces, are the palaces that are prepared for you in Paradise to cause you to rejoice with them. שֵּׁן is ivoire in French, ivory.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:9:4)


**מִנִּי שִׂמְּחוּךָ.** הֵיכָלוֹת אֲשֶׁר מִנִּי, הֵם שִׂמְּחוּךָ, הַנּוֹתְנִים שְׂכָרְךָ:


**those that are Mine will cause you to rejoice** The palaces that are Mine they will make you rejoice, those that give you your reward.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:10:1)


**בְּנוֹת מְלָכִים.** יִהְיוּ מְבַקְּרוֹת אוֹתְךָ, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְשָׂרוֹתֵיהֶם מֵינִיקוֹתַיִךְ״ (ישעיהו מט:כג):


**The daughters of kings** will visit you, as the matter that is stated (Isa. 49:23): “and their princesses your wet nurses.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:10:2)


**בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶיךָ.** קוֹ״ף דָּגוּשׁ, לְפִי שֶׁהוּא לְשׁוֹן בִּקּוּר, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכָּתוּב יוֹ״ד לְפָנֶיהָ. רָאִיתִי בְּנִקּוּד רַב סְעַדְיָה תֵּיבָה זוֹ סְדוּרָה עִם ״מִי נָתַן לִמְשִׁיסָּה יַעֲקֹב״ (ישעיהו מב:כד), שֶׁכָּתוּב בּוֹ יוֹ״ד וְהַסָּמֶ״ךְ מֻדְגֶּשֶׁת. וּמְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ לְשׁוֹן יוֹקֶר, כְּמוֹ ״יְקָר מִכְּלִי פָז״ (איוב כח:יז) (ס״א אינו):


**will visit you** lit. your visitors. Heb. ביקרותיך. The “kaph” is punctuated with a “dagesh” because it is an expression of visiting, although it is preceded by a “yud.” I saw in Rav Saadia’s punctuation that this word is arranged with (Isa. 42:24), “Who subjected Jacob to plunder (למשיסה),” which is written with a “yud” although the “sammech” is punctuated with a “dagesh.” Menachem, however, associated it as an expression of value, as (Job 28:16): “with precious (יקר) onyx.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:10:3)


**שֵׁגַל.** מַלְכָּה, כְּמוֹ ״וְהַשֵּׁגַל יוֹשֶׁבֶת אֶצְלוֹ״ (נחמיה ב:ו), ״וְיִשְׁתּוֹן בְּהוֹן מַלְכָּא רַבְרְבָנוֹהִי שֵׁגְלָתֵיהּ וּלְחֵינָתֵיהּ״ (דניאל ה:ב). אִשְׁתְּךָ תִּתְיַצֵּב **לִימִינְךָ**:


**the queen** Heb. שגל, the queen, as (Neh. 2:6): “and the queen (השגל) was sitting beside him”; (Dan. 5:2), “and they shall drink with them, the king and his nobles, his queen (שגלתה) and his concubines.” Your wife will stand at your right.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:10:4)


**בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר.** בִּקְבוּצַת עֲדִי זָהָב הַבָּא מֵאוֹפִיר:


**with golden jewelry from Ophir** with a collection of golden ornaments that comes from Ophir.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:11:1)


**שִׁמְעִי בַת וּרְאִי.** שִׁמְעִי כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וּרְאִי דֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹב (שיר השירים רבה א:ג):


**Hearken, daughter, and see** Hearken, O nation of Israel, and see the good way.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:11:2)


**וְהַטִּי אָזְנֵךְ.** לַתּוֹרָה:


**and incline your ear** to the Torah.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:11:3)


**וְשִׁכְחִי עַמֵּךְ.** מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר שֶׁאַתְּ גְּדֵלָה בֵּינֵיהֶם:


**and forget your people** The nations among whom you were raised.


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:11:4)


**וּבֵית אָבִיךְ.** עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה שֶׁעָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֶיךָ בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר (יהושע כד:ב):


**and your father’s house** The idolatry that your fathers worshipped on the other side of the river.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:12:1)


**וְיִתְאָו הַמֶּלֶךְ יָפְיֵךְ.** וְאִם תַּעֲשִׂי כֵּן, יִתְאַוֶּה הַמֶּלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְנוֹיֵי מַעֲשַׂיִךְ:


**And the King shall desire your beauty** And if you do this, the King, the Holy One, blessed be He, will desire the beauty of your deeds.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:13:1)


**וּבַת צֹר בְּמִנְחָה פָּנַיִךְ יְחַלּוּ.** כְּמוֹ ״וַיְחַל מֹשֶׁה״ (שמות לב:יא), וּבִשְׂכַר זֶה תִּזְכּוּ שֶׁיָּבִיאוּ לְךָ אֲשְׁכָּרִים וְדוֹרוֹן אוֹתָם שֶׁהֵם עַכְשָׁיו **עֲשִׁירֵי עָם**:


**And the daughter of Tyre shall seek your presence with tribute** Heb. יחלו, as (Exod. 32: 11): “And Moses prayed (ויחל).” And as reward for this, you will merit that those who are now the richest of the people will bring you tribute and gifts.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:14:1)


**כָּל כְּבוּדָּה בַת מֶלֶךְ פְּנִימָה וְגוֹ׳.** אוֹתָם שֶׁכָּל כָּבוֹד תָּלוּי בָּהֶם, וְהֵם כְּנֵסִיּוֹת שֶׁל מֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נָהֲגוּ עַצְמָם בִּצְנִיעוּת, עַתָּה בִּגְדֵיהֶם חֲשׁוּבִים **מִמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב** שֶׁל כֹּהֲנִים גְּדוֹלִים (תנחומא, וישלח ו). **מִשְׁבְּצוֹת** קָאטוֹנ״שׁ בְּלַעַ״ז:


**All honor [awaits] the King’s daughter who is within, etc.** Those who deserve all honor, and they are the nation of the King, who behaved with modesty now their garments will be more esteemed than the settings of gold of the High Priests. משבצוֹת is chatons in French, settings.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:15:1)


**לִרְקָמוֹת תּוּבַל לַמֶּלֶךְ.** בְּבִגְדֵי רִקְמָה יְבִיאוּם מִנְחָה לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ. **רְקָמוֹת** אברודי״ץ בְּלַעַ״ז, זֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְהֵבִיאוּ אֶת כָּל אֲחֵיכֶם מִכָּל הַגּוֹיִם מִנְחָה וְגוֹ׳״ (ישעיהו סו:כ):


**With embroidered garments, she will be brought to the King** In embroidered garments, they will bring her as a gift to the King of all the earth. רקמוֹת is a broderies in French. This is what is stated (Isa. 66:20): “And they shall bring all your brethren from all the nations as a tribute, etc.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:15:2)


**בְּתוּלוֹת אַחֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶיהָ.** יֵלְכוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (זכריה ח:כג) ״וְהֶחֱזִיקוּ בִּכְנַף אִישׁ יְהוּדִי וְגוֹ׳ לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה עִמָּכֶם כִּי שָׁמַעְנוּ אֱלֹהִים עִמָּכֶם״:


**virgins in her train who are her companions** Some of the idolatrous nations will follow them, as the matter that is stated (Zech. 8:23): “shall take hold of the skirt of a Jewish man, saying, ‘Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’ “


###### Rashi on Psalms 45:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:15:3)


**מוּבָאוֹת לָךְ.** כְּלַפֵּי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אָמַר הַמְשׁוֹרֵר:


**will be brought to You** The Psalmist addresses the Holy One, blessed be He.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:17:1)


**תַּחַת אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְגוֹ׳.** לְכָל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל אָמַר:


**Instead of your forefathers, etc.** He addresses each Israelite.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 45:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/45:18:1)


**אַזְכִּירָה שִׁמְךָ.** כְּלַפֵּי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אָמַר הַמְשׁוֹרֵר:


**I will mention Your name** The Psalmist addresses the Holy One, blessed be He.



## Chapter 46


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:1:1)


**עַל עֲלָמוֹת.** שֵׁם שֶׁל כְּלִי שִׁיר בְּדִבְרֵי הַיָּמִים (דברי הימים א טו:כ):


**on alamoth** The name of a musical instrument in Chronicles (I Chron. 15:20).



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:3:1)


**בְּהָמִיר אָרֶץ.** לֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא, בַּיּוֹם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְהָאָרֶץ כַּבֶּגֶד תִּבְלֶה״ (ישעיה נא:ו). רָאוּ בְּנֵי קֹרַח נֵס שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה לָהֶם, שֶׁנִּבְלְעוּ כָּל סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וְהֵם עָמְדוּ בָּאֲוִיר, וְאָמְרוּ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ, שֶׁדּוּגְמַת הַנֵּס הַזֶּה יִהְיֶה עָשׂוּי לָהֶם לֶעָתִיד (סנהדרין קי.):


**when the earth changes** in the future, on the day concerning which Scripture states (Isa. 51: 6): “and the earth shall rot away like a garment.” The sons of Korah saw the miracle that was performed for them, that all those around them were swallowed up while they [the sons of Korah] stood in the air and said to Israel, through the holy spirit, that a similar miracle would be performed for them in the future.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:4:1)


**יֶהֱמוּ יֶחְמְרוּ מֵימָיו.** יְגָרְשׁוּ רֶפֶשׁ וְחֹמֶר וָטִיט (ישעיהו נז:כ) כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם, וּמְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ כְּמוֹ ״מֵעַי חֳמַרְמָרוּ״, (איכה א:כ) רגורזרונ״ט בְּלַעַ״ז:


**His waters shall stir and be muddied** Heb. יחמרו, they shall cast up mud, clay (חמר), and dirt as is their wont. Menachem (pp. 90f.), however, associated it with (Lam. 1:20), “my reins have shriveled (חמרמרו),” regrezeliront in Old French, have shriveled.


###### Rashi on Psalms 46:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:4:2)


**יִרְעֲשׁוּ הָרִים בְּגַאֲוָתוֹ.** שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, שֶׁנִּזְכָּר בְּרֹאשׁ הַמִּזְמוֹר (תהלים מו:ב):


**mountains shall quake from His pride** [The pride] of the Holy One, blessed be He, Who is mentioned in the beginning of the psalm (verse 2).



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:5:1)


**נָהָר פְּלָגָיו.** שׁוֹשְׁרוֹיִישִׁיל״שׁ בְּלַעַ״ז:


**But as for the river its rivulets** Heb. פלגיו, ses ruisseaux in French, its rivulets.


###### Rashi on Psalms 46:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:5:2)


**נָהָר.** גַּן עֵדֶן (בראשית ב:י):


**the river** of Paradise.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:6:1)


**לִפְנוֹת בֹּקֶר.** לְקֵץ הַגְּאֻלָּה:


**as morning approaches** at the end of the redemption.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:7:1)


**הָמוּ גוֹיִם.** לְשׁוֹן ״הוֹמֶה״ (מלכים א א:מא):


**Nations have stirred** Heb. המו, an expression of stirring.


###### Rashi on Psalms 46:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:7:2)


**תָּמוּג.** תָּמֵס, כֵּן פָּתַר מְנַחֵם (שמות טו:טו) ״נָמֹגוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי כְנָעַן״, וְכֵן (יחזקאל כא:כ) ״לָמוּג לֵב״, אֲבָל דּוּנָשׁ פָּתַר אוֹתָם לְשׁוֹן הֲנָעָה, וְכֵן (שמואל א יד:טז) ״הֶהָמוֹן נָמוֹג וַיֵּלֶךְ וַהֲלֹם״ וְכֵן כֻּלָּם:


**shall melt** Shall melt - so explained Menachem, similar to (Exod. 15:15), “all the inhabitants of Canaan melted (נמוגו),” and to (Ezek. 21: 12), “every heart will melt (למוג).” But Dunash explained it as an expression of movement, as in (I Sam. 14:16), “the multitude was wandering (נמוג), and it was coming closer,” and so in every instance.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:9:1)


**אֲשֶׁר שָׂם שַׁמּוֹת.** אֲשֶׁר שָׂם אַרְצוֹת הַגּוֹיִם שְׁמָמָה:


**that He has wrought devastation** That He has made the lands of the nations desolate.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:10:1)


**מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת.** מֵעָלֵינוּ:


**He puts a stop to wars** from upon us.


###### Rashi on Psalms 46:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:10:2)


**עַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ.** שֶׁכָּל אַרְצוֹת הַגּוֹיִם יִהְיוּ עִמָּנוּ בְּשָׁלוֹם:


**until the end of the earth** that all the lands of the nations shall be at peace with us.


###### Rashi on Psalms 46:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:10:3)


**קֶשֶׁת.** הַגּוֹיִם יְשַׁבֵּר:


**the bow** of the nations He shall break.


###### Rashi on Psalms 46:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:10:4)


**עֲגָלוֹת יִשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ.** רִכְבֵי מִלְחָמוֹת:


**wagons He will burn with fire** The war chariots of the nations of the world. [The war chariots of the star worshippers.]



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 46:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:11:1)


**הַרְפּוּ.** עַצְמְכֶם מִלָּבוֹא עוֹד עַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם:


**Desist** all nations from further marching upon Jerusalem.


###### Rashi on Psalms 46:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:11:2)


**וּדְעוּ כִּי אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהִים.** שֶׁאֶעֱשֶׂה דִּין בָּכֶם:


**and know that I am God** That I will execute judgment upon you.


###### Rashi on Psalms 46:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/46:11:3)


**אָרוּם בָּאָרֶץ.** אֶתְרוֹמֵם בְּנִקְמָתִי אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂה בַּגּוֹיִם:


**I will be exalted among the nations** I will be exalted with My vengeance which I will wreak upon those nations.



## Chapter 47


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 47:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:2:1)


**תִּקְעוּ כָף.** הִתְעָרְבוּ יַחַד זֶה עִם זֶה לְהָרִיעַ לֵאלֹהִים **בְּקוֹל רִנָּה**:


**clap hands** Join together with one another to shout to God with a voice of praise.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 47:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:4:1)


**יַדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּינוּ.** יִתֵּן דֶּבֶר בָּעוֹבְדֵי כוֹכָבִים תַּחַת נַפְשֵׁנוּ, לִהְיוֹת חֲמָתוֹ מִתְקָרֶרֶת בָּהֶם וְאֵלּוּ נִצּוֹלִים, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְנָתַתִּי כָפְרְךָ מִצְרַיִם וְגוֹ׳״ (ישעיהו מג:ג). וּמְנַחֵם חִבֵּר יַדְבֵּר לְשׁוֹן הַנְהָגָה:


**He shall plague peoples in our stead** Heb. ידבר עמים תחתינו, He shall afflict the peoples with a plague (דבר) instead of our soul(s) so that His wrath will subside through them, and we will be saved, as the matter that is stated (Isa. 43:3): “I have given Egypt as your ransom, etc.” Menachem, however, associated it with an expression of leading (p. 61).



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 47:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:5:1)


**יִבְחַר לָנוּ וְגוֹ׳.** וְיַחֲזִירֵנוּ לְתוֹכָהּ, וְאָז יִתְעַלֶּה בִּתְרוּעָה וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר – שֶׁנִּתְקַע לְפָנָיו בְּשִׁיר עַל עוֹלוֹת וְזִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים, וְנֹאמַר: **זַמְּרוּ אֱלֹהִים וְגוֹ׳**:


**He shall choose...for us** and restore us to its midst. Then He will be exalted with the trumpet blast and the sound of the shofar that we will sound before Him over the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, and we will say, “Sing to God, etc.”



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 47:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:9:1)


**מָלַךְ אֱלֹהִים עַל גּוֹיִם.** כָּךְ יֹאמְרוּ הַכֹּל:


**God has reigned over nations** So will everyone say.


###### Rashi on Psalms 47:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:9:2)


**יָשַׁב עַל כִּסֵּא קָדְשׁוֹ.** עַכְשָׁיו הַכִּסֵּא שָׁלֵם וּבִגְדוּלָּה נִכֶּרֶת (פסיקתא רבתי ג:טז), וְיַגִּידוּ כִּי נֶאֶסְפוּ לְעִירוֹ:


**God has sat upon His holy throne** Now the throne is complete and the greatness is recognized, and they will declare that the volunteers of the people have gathered to His city.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 47:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:10:1)


**נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים.** שֶׁהִתְנַדְּבוּ עַצְמָם לִטְבֹּחַ וְלַהֲרֹג עַל קְדֻשַּׁת שְׁמוֹ:


**The volunteers of the peoples** Who offered themselves to the slaughter, to be slain for the sanctity of His name.


###### Rashi on Psalms 47:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/47:10:2)


**עַם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם.** שֶׁהָיָה נְדִיב לֵב הָרִאשׁוֹן תְּחִלָּה לַגֵּרִים (סוכה מט:). עַתָּה נוֹדַע **כִּי לֵאלֹהִים מָגִנֵּי אֶרֶץ** הַיְכֹלֶת בְּיָדוֹ לִהְיוֹת לְמָגֵן עַל כָּל הַבּוֹטְחִים בּוֹ:


**the people of the God of Abraham** who was the first volunteer, the first of the proselytes [he was the first to volunteer himself to proselytize]. Now it is known that **God has the shields of the earth** and He has the power to be a shield for all who trust in Him.



## Chapter 48


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:2:1)


**בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ.** לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא, כְּשֶׁיִּבְנֶה אֶת עִירוֹ, יִהְיֶה בִּשְׁבִילָהּ **גָּדוֹל וּמְהֻלָּל**:


**in the city of our God** In the future, when He builds His city, He will be great and praised because of it.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:3:1)


**יְפֵה נוֹף.** עִיר שֶׁהוּא נוֹף יָפֶה, לְשׁוֹן נוֹף שֶׁל אִילָן. דָּבָר אַחֵר: כַּלַּת שֶׁל יוֹפִי, שֶׁכֵּן קוֹרִין בְּכַרְכֵּי הַיָּם לְכַלָּה נִינְפִי (ראש השנה כו.). וּמְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ כְּמוֹ ״שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַנָּפֶת״ (יהושע יז:יא), קוֹנְטְרִיאָ״ה בְּלַעַ״ז. אֲבָל דּוֹנָשׁ פָּתַר אוֹתוֹ לְשׁוֹן נוֹף שֶׁל אִילָן, וְנִקְרָא **הַר צִיּוֹן, יְפֵה נוֹף** כִּי הוּא הַר הַזֵּיתִים (ס״א אינו):


**The fairest of branches** Heb. יפר נוף, a city that is a fair branch; an expression of the branches (נוף) of a tree. Another explanation: A fair bride, for in the coastal cities they call a bride ninfe (nymphe in Greek) (R. H. 26a). Menachem (p. 124) associated it with (Josh. 17:11) “the three regions (הנפת)” (i. e., there [on Joshua] he explains that it means regions; as Rashi explains there: contree in French, a region. In this manner, Rashi explains in Joshua 11:3,) but Dunash (p. 34) defined it as an expression of a branch of a tree, and Mt. Zion was called “the fairest of branches” because it is (near—Shem Ephraim) the Mount of Olives.


###### Rashi on Psalms 48:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:3:2)


**מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ.** וּמַה הִיא מְשׂוֹשָׂהּ? **יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן**, אַנְגְלָ״שׁ בְּלַעַ״ז, ״יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפוֹנָה״ (ויקרא א:יא) שֶׁשָּׁם שׁוֹחֲטִין חַטָּאוֹת וַאֲשָׁמוֹת, וּמִי שֶׁהָיָה עָצֵב עַל עֲבֵרוֹת שֶׁבְּיָדוֹ מֵבִיא חַטָּאוֹת וַאֲשָׁמוֹת וּמִתְכַּפֵּר לוֹ, וְהוּא יוֹצֵא מִשָּׁם שָׂמֵחַ; וְעַל יְדֵי הַקָּרְבָּנוֹת טוֹבָה בָּאָה:


**the joy of the entire earth** Now what is its joy? The north side, angles in French, angle, corner. Redak (Shorashim) also defines it as corners, and so in Ezekiel (46:21). The northern side of the altar [was] where sin offerings and guilt offerings were slaughtered, and whoever was grieved because of the sins he had committed would bring a sin offering or a guilt offering, and he would be forgiven. He would then emerge happy, and the sacrifices would benefit the entire world.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:4:1)


**נוֹדַע לְמִשְׂגָּב.** כְּשֶׁיִּשְׁכֹּן בָּהּ לֶעָתִיד, יֹאמְרוּ כֵּן:


**He is known as a stronghold** When He will dwell therein in the future, they will say this [will call Him thus].



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:5:1)


**הַמְּלָכִים נוֹעֲדוּ.** לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ בְּמִלְחֶמֶת גּוֹג וּמָגוֹג (יחזקאל לח:א-ג):


**the kings have assembled** to wage war against it in the wars of Gog and Magog.


###### Rashi on Psalms 48:5:2

**עָבְרוּ יַחְדָּו.** לַמִּלְחָמָה:


**they have passed together** to war.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:6:1)


**הֵמָּה רָאוּ.** אֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא יוֹצֵא וְנִלְחָם בַּגּוֹיִם הָהֵם, **כֵּן תָּמָהוּ**:


**They saw** the Holy One, blessed be He, going forth and waging war against those nations, so they wondered.


###### Rashi on Psalms 48:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:6:2)


**נֶחְפָּזוּ.** פוֹרְנְ״ט אָטוֹרְדִי״ץ בְּלַעַ״ז, כְּמוֹ ״וּבְפַחֲזוּתָם״ (ירמיהו כג:לב):


**they were bewildered** Feront etourdis in French, were stunned, as (Jer. 23:32): “and their bewilderment (ובפחזותם).”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:8:1)


**בְּרוּחַ קָדִים.** הוּא לְשׁוֹן פּוּרְעָנוּת, שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא נִפְרָע בּוֹ מִן הָרְשָׁעִים, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וַיּוֹלֶךְ ה׳ אֶת הַיָּם בְּרוּחַ קָדִים וְגוֹ׳״ (שמות יד:כא). וְכֵן בְּצוֹר: ״רוּחַ הַקָּדִים שִׁבְּרֵךְ בְּלֵב יַמִּים״ (יחזקאל כז:כו). ״כְּרוּחַ קָדִים אֲפִיצֵם לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב״ (ירמיהו יח:יז):


**With an east wind** That is an expression of retribution, with which the Holy One, blessed be He, recompenses the wicked, as it is stated (Exod. 14:21): “and the Lord led the sea with a strong east wind, etc.” Similarly (Ezek. 16:27, 26): “The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas”; (Jer. 18:17), “Like an east wind, I will scatter you before the enemy.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 48:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:8:2)


**אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ.** הֵם שְׁכֵינֵי צוֹר, הִיא אַפְרִיקָא, וּמֵאֱדוֹם הִיא:


**the ships of Tarshish** They are the neighbors of Tyre, which is Africa, and it is of Edom.

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:9:1)


**כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ.** הַנֶּחָמוֹת מִפִּי הַנְּבִיאִים **כֵּן רָאִינוּ**:


**As we have heard** the consolations from the mouth of the prophets, so have we seen [them].



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:10:1)


**דִּמִּינוּ אֱלֹהִים חַסְדֶּךָ.** הַנָּבִיא חוֹזֵר וּמִתְפַּלֵּל לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וְאוֹמֵר: דִּמִּינוּ וְקִוִּינוּ אֶל חַסְדֶּךָ, לִרְאוֹת תְּשׁוּעָתְךָ זוֹ **בְּקֶרֶב הֵיכָלֶךָ.** וּמְנַחֵם פָּתַר אוֹתוֹ לְשׁוֹן מַחֲשָׁבָה, כְּמוֹ ״אַל תְּדַמִּי בְנַפְשֵׁךְ״ (אסתר ד:יג):


**We have hoped, O Lord, for Your kindness** The prophet repeatedly prays to the Holy One, blessed be He, and says, “We hoped and waited for Your kindness, to see this Your salvation in the midst of Your Temple. Menachem (p. 65) interpreted it as an expression of thought, as (Esther 4: 13): “Do not think (אל תדמי).”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:11:1

**As is Your name, O God, so is Your praise** Just as Your name is great, so is Your praise great in everyone’s mouth.

**תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה.** כָּל שְׁאָר עָרֵי יְהוּדָה הֵם לְצִיּוֹן בָּנוֹת, כְּמוֹ ״וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת קְנָת וְאֶת בְּנֹתֶיהָ״ (במדבר לב:מב):


**the daughters of Judah shall exult** All the other cities of Judah are as daughters to Zion, as (Num. 32:42): “and he captured Kenath and its daughters.”

**for the sake of Your judgments** That You perform judgment upon the nations.

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:13:2

**count** Heb. ספרו, an expression of counting. You should know how many towers it requires.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:14:1

**to its walls** Heb. לחילה, to its walls, as (Lam. 2:8): “rampart (חיל) and wall.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 48:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:14:2)


**פַּסְּגוּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ.** הַגְבִּיהוּ בִּירְנִיּוֹתֶיהָ, כְּמוֹ ״אַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה״ (דברים ג:יז) דִּמְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״רָמָתָא״:


**raise its palaces** Heb. פסגו, raise its palaces, as (Deut. 3:17): “beneath the rapids of the elevation,” which is translated רָמָתָא, the high place.


###### Rashi on Psalms 48:14:3
