**לְמַעַן תְּסַפְּרוּ.** אֶת גָּבְהָהּ וְאֶת יָפְיָהּ **לְדוֹר** שֶׁאַחֲרֵיכֶם:


**in order that you may tell** its height and its beauty to the generation after you.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 48:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/48:15:1)


**עַלְמוּת.** כְּאָדָם הַמַּנְהִיג אֶת בְּנוֹ קָטָן לְאַט, וּמְנַחֵם פָּתַר אוֹתוֹ לְשׁוֹן עוֹלָם, וְכֵן פִּתְרוֹנוֹ **יְנַהֲגֵנוּ** לְעוֹלָמִים:


**as in youth** Heb. על-מות, as a man who leads his young son slowly. Menachem (p. 133) interpreted it as an expression of eternity, and so is its interpretation: will lead us to eternity.



## Chapter 49


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:2:1)


**שִׁמְעוּ זֹאת כָּל הָעַמִּים.** לְפִי שֶׁמִּזְמוֹר זֶה מְיֻסָּד עַל בְּנֵי אָדָם הַבּוֹטְחִים בְּעָשְׁרָם, אָמַר: **כָּל הָעַמִּים**, שֶׁכֻּלָּם צְרִיכִים יִסּוּר:


**Hear this, all you peoples** Because this psalm is based on people who rely on their riches, he says, “all you peoples,” for they all require admonition.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:2:2)


**חָלֶד.** הִיא הָאָרֶץ, עַל שֵׁם שֶׁהִיא נוֹשֶׁנֶת וַחֲלוּדָה, רדוייל״ייא בְּלַעַ״ז; וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּ (חולין קכז.): עַל שֵׁם הַחוּלְדָּה, שֶׁהִיא בַּיַּבָּשָׁה וְאֵינָהּ בַּיָּם; דְּתָנוּ רַבָּנָן (חולין קכז.): כָּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ בַּיַּבָּשָׁה יֵשׁ בַּיָּם, חוּץ מִן הַחוּלְדָּה:


**earth** Heb. חלוד. That [term] is [used to describe] the earth because it is old and rusty (חלודה), rodile in Old French, rust, rouille in modern French. But our Sages explained that it is because of the weasel (חֻלְדָה), which frequents the dry land but is not found in the sea, for the Rabbis taught (Hul. 127a): Whatever is on the dry land is found in the sea, except the weasel.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:3:1)


**גַּם בְּנֵי אָדָם.** בְּנֵי אַבְרָהָם, שֶׁנִּקְרָא ״הָאָדָם הַגָּדוֹל בָּעֲנָקִים״ (יהושע יד:טו): בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל וּבְנֵי קְטוּרָה:


**Both the sons of “adam”** The sons of Abraham, who was called (Josh. 14:15): “the greatest man (האדם) among the giants”; the sons of Ishmael and the sons of Keturah.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:3:2)


**גַּם בְּנֵי אִישׁ.** בְּנֵי נֹחַ, שֶׁנִּקְרָא ״אִישׁ צַדִּיק״ (בראשית ו:ט):


**and the sons of “ish”** The sons of Noah, who was called (Gen. 6:9): “a righteous man (איש צדיק).”



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:4:1)


**וְהָגוּת לִבִּי.** מַחְשְׁבוֹת לִבִּי, **תְּבוּנוֹת** הֵם:


**and the thoughts of my heart are understanding** The thoughts of my heart are understanding.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:5:1)


**אַטֶּה לְמָשָׁל אָזְנִי.** לְדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה, שֶׁנִּקְרֵאת ״מְשַׁל הַקַּדְמוֹנִי״ (שמואל א כד:יג):


**I will bend my ear to a parable** To the words of Torah, which is called (I Sam. 24:13), “the parable of the Ancient One.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:5:2)


**אֶפְתַּח.** לָכֶם **חִידָתִי** זֹאת **בְּכִנּוֹר**, וְזוֹ הִיא הַחִידָה: **לָמָּה** אֲנִי צָרִיךְ לִירָא **בִּימֵי רָע** בְּיוֹם פְּקֻדַּת עָוֹן? לְפִי שֶׁ**עֲוֹן עֲקֵבַי יְסוּבֵּנִי**. עֲוֹנוֹת שֶׁאֲנִי דָּשׁ בֶּעָקֵב, שֶׁאֲנִי מְזַלְזֵל בָּהֶם, שֶׁהֵם בְּעֵינַי עֲבֵרוֹת קַלּוֹת – הֵם מַרְשִׁיעוֹת אוֹתִי בַּדִּין. וְכָל שֶׁכֵּן הָעֲשִׁירִים:


**I will solve** this my riddle for you with a lyre. And this is the riddle: Why must I fear in days of misfortune, on the day of the visitation for iniquity? Because the iniquity of my heels surrounds me. The iniquities that I tread with my heels, that I treat lightly, that I view as minor sinsthey condemn me in judgment, and surely the wealthy.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:7:1)


**הַבּוֹטְחִים עַל חֵילָם.** וּמָה בֶּצַע בְּמָמוֹנָם, הֲלֹא:


**Those who rely on their possessions** Of what use is their money? Is it not so that...



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:8:1)


**אָח.** לֹא יוּכַל לִפְדּוֹת אֶת אָחִיו בְּמָמוֹנוֹ, לְפִי שֶׁאִם בָּאִים לִפְדּוֹת אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו יִתְיַקֵּר פִּדְיוֹן נַפְשָׁם מִכָּל הוֹן. לְפִיכָךְ עַל כָּרְחוֹ חָדֵל הוּא לְעוֹלָם מִלְּפַדּוֹתוֹ:


**A brother** cannot ransom his brother with money because the ransom of their soul is dearer than any possession. Therefore, perforce, his redemption is forever unattainable.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:9:1)


**וְיֵקַר.** (שֶׁיִּחְיֶה לָנֶצַח וְלֹא יִרְאֶה הַשַּׁחַת) וּמְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ לְשׁוֹן מְנִיעָה כְּמוֹ ״אוֹקִיר אֱנוֹשׁ מִפָּז״ (ישעיה יג:יב), ״וְהָלַכְתִּי עִמָּכֶם בַּחֲמַת קֶרִי״ (ויקרא כו:כח), כְּלוֹמַר וְיִמָּנַע **פִּדְיוֹן נַפְשָׁם**:


**will be too dear** that he will live forever and not see the Pit. Menachem (p. 158) associated it as an expression of withholding, as (Isa. 13:12): “I will make mortal man dearer (אוקיר) than fine gold”; (Lev. 26:21), “I will go with them with wrath of withdrawal (קיר)” i.e., the ransom of their soul will be withheld.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:11:1)


**כִּי יִרְאֶה חֲכָמִים יָמוּתוּ.** וְאֵין נִצּוֹלִין מִן הַמָּוֶת, לְפִיכָךְ עַל כָּרְחוֹ הוּא חָדֵל לִיגַע וְלִטְרֹחַ עַל פִּדְיוֹן אָחִיו:


**For he sees that wise men die** and are not saved from death. So, perforce, he stops wearying himself and toiling for his brother’s ransom.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:11:2)


**חֵילָם.** מָמוֹנָם. בַּחֲכָמִים נֶאֱמַר מִיתָה, שֶׁאֵינָם מֵתִים בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה אֶלָּא הַגּוּף בִּלְבַד, וּבִכְסִיל וּבַעַר נֶאֱמַר אֲבֵדָה:


**their possessions** Heb. חילם, their money. Death is mentioned in reference to the wise men, because in this world they die only in the body, whereas concerning the fool and the boorish man, perishing is mentioned, because both body and soul perish.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:12:1)


**קִרְבָּם בָּתֵּימוֹ לְעוֹלָם.** מַחְשְׁבוֹתָם לִבְנוֹת לָהֶם בָּתִּים שֶׁיִּתְקַיְּמוּ לְעוֹלָם:


**In their heart, their houses are forever** Their thoughts are to build for themselves houses that will exist forever.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:12:2)


**קָרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹתָם.** אֶת בָּתֵּיהֶם שֶׁהֵם בּוֹנִים לְמַעַן יִהְיֶה לָהֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן, ״וְיִקְרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר כְּשֵׁם בְּנוֹ חֲנוֹךְ״ (בראשית ד:יז). אַנְטִיוֹכוּס בָּנָה אַנְטוֹכִיָא, סְלִיקוּס בָּנָה סְלִיקִיָא:


**they call by their names** their houses that they build so that they will have a memorial. (Gen. 4:17): “and named the city after his son Enoch.” Antiochus built Antioch; Seleucus built Seleucia.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:13:1)


**בִּיקָר.** לְשׁוֹן יְקָר וְתִפְאֶרֶת (ס״א אינו):


**in his glory** Heb. ביקר, an expression of glory and majesty.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:13:2)


**נִמְשַׁל.** לְשׁוֹן מָשָׁל:


**he is compared** Heb. נמשל, an expression of a parable (משל).


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:13:3)


**נִדְמוּ.** לְשׁוֹן דְּמָמָה:


**silenced** Heb. נדמו, an expression of silence.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:14:1)


**כֵּסֶל.** שִׁטּוּת:


**folly** Heb. כסל, madness.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:14:2)


**וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּפִיהֶם יִרְצוּ סֶלָה.** וְהַבָּאִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם יְדַבְּרוּ בָהֶם וִיסַפְּרוּ בְּפִיהֶם מַה אֵרַע לָרִאשׁוֹנִים:


**and after them they will tell with their mouth forever** And those who come after them will speak of them and tell with their mouth what happened to the earlier ones.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:14:3)


**יִרְצוּ.** לְשׁוֹן הַרְצָאַת דְּבָרִים, רטרירונ״ש בְּלַעַ״ז, וַחֲזַ״ל פֵּרְשׁוּ (שבת לא:): זֶה דַּרְכָּם שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים שֶׁסּוֹפָם אֲבוּדִים, אֲבָל **כֵּסֶל לָמוֹ** – חֵלֶב יֵשׁ לָהֶם עַל כִּסְלֵיהֶם וּמְכַסּוֹת אֶת כִּלְיוֹתֵיהֶם וְאֵינָן יוֹעֲצוֹת אוֹתָם לָשׁוּב מֵרָעָתָם. וְשֶׁמָּא תֹּאמַר שִׁכְחָה הִיא לָהֶם עַל שֶׁשָּׁכְחוּ שֶׁסּוֹפָם לָמוּת? תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר: **וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּפִיהֶם יִרְצוּ**, כְּלוֹמַר: יוֹם אַחֲרִיתָם תָּמִיד בְּפִיהֶם, וְאֵין חֲרֵדִים מִמֶּנּוּ:


**will tell** Heb. ירצו, an expression of narration, retreyront in Old French, But our Sages (Shab. 32b) explained: This is the way of the wicked: they perish in the end but כֶסֶל is theirs. They have fat on their flanks (כסליהם), which covers their kidneys, and they [their kidneys] do not advise them to repent of their evil. Perhaps you will say that it is forgetfulness, that they have forgotten that ultimately they will die? Scripture therefore states: and their end they tell with their mouth; i.e., the day of their end is constantly in their mouth and they are not afraid of it.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:1)


**כַּצֹּאן לִשְׁאוֹל שַׁתּוּ.** כַּצֹּאן הַמִּתְאַסֵּף לַדִּיר כֵּן הֵם לִשְׁאוֹל:


**Like sheep, they are destined to the grave** Like sheep that are gathered to the shed, so are they into the grave.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:2)


**שַׁתּוּ.** דְּגוּשׁוֹת הַתָּי״ו בִּמְקוֹם תָּי״ו שְׁנִיָּה: לִשְׁאוֹל שׁוֹתְתוּ, לְשׁוֹן שְׁתוּתֶיהָ שֶׁל שְׁאוֹל, לַמַּדְרֵגָה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה. וְכֵן ״שַׁתּוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם״ (תהלים עג:ט), גַּם הוּא לְשׁוֹן שְׁתוּת: קָבְעוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם, לְשׁוֹנָם הָרָע:


**they are destined** Heb. שתו. The “tav” is punctuated with a “dagesh,” in place of the second “tav.” שּׁוֹתתוּ into the midst of the foundations (שתותיה) of the nether world, to the lowest level. Likewise (above 73:9): “They have set their mouth against heaven,” is also an expression of foundations; they set their mouth in heaven; their slander.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:3)


**מָוֶת יִרְעֵם.** מַלְאַךְ הַמָּוֶת יֹאכְלֵם, וְאַל תִּתְמַהּ עַל לְשׁוֹן אֲכִילָה זוֹ, שֶׁכֵּן מָצִינוּ בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר ״יֹאכַל בַּדָּיו בְּכוֹר מָוֶת״ (איוב יח:יג). לָשׁוֹן אַחֵר: לְשׁוֹן רְצִיצָה, כְּמוֹ ״הֲיָרֹעַ בַּרְזֶל״ (ירמיה טו:יב):


**death will devour them** Heb. ירעם. The angel of death will devour them. Do not wonder about this expression of eating because we find elsewhere (Job 18:13): “the prince of death shall devour his branches.” Another explanation: [It is] an expression of breaking, as (Jer. 15:12): “Will iron break (הירע)?”


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:15:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:4)


**וַיִּרְדּוּ בָם יְשָׁרִים לַבֹּקֶר.** לְיוֹם הַגְּאֻלָּה, כְּשֶׁיִּזְרַח בָּקְרָם שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיוּ רוֹדִים בָּהֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְעַסּוֹתֶם רְשָׁעִים וְגוֹ׳״ (מלאכי ג:כא):


**and the upright will rule over them in the morning** On the day of the redemption, when the morning of Israel shines, they will rule over them, as it is stated (Malachi 3:21): “And You shall crush the wicked, etc.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:15:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:5)


**וְצוּרָם לְבַלּוֹת שְׁאוֹל.** צוּרָתָם שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים תְּבַלֶּה אֶת הַשְּׁאוֹל, גֵּיהִנֹּם כָּלֶה וְהֵם אֵינָם כָּלִים:


**and their form will outlast the grave** The form of the wicked will outlast the grave. Gehinnom will end, but they will not end.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:15:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:15:6)


**מִזְּבֻל לוֹ.** מִהְיוֹת לָהֶם מָדוֹר; וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מוֹצִיא חַמָּה מִנַּרְתִּיקָהּ וּמְלַהֶטֶת אוֹתָם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְלִהַט אֹתָם הַיּוֹם הַבָּא״ (מלאכי ג:יט). וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּ **מִזְּבֻל לוֹ** עַל שֶׁפָּשְׁטוּ יְדֵיהֶם בַּזְּבוּל, שֶׁהֶחֱרִיבוּ אֶת בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ (מדרש תהלים מט:ג):


**as his dwelling place** From being a dwelling place for them. And the Holy One, blessed be He, takes the sun out of its case, and it will burn them up, as it is stated (Mal. 3:19, Ned. 8b). Our Sages, however, explained מִזְבֻל לוֹ to mean that because they stretched out their hand on His dwelling place, they destroyed the Temple (Mid. Ps. 49:3).



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:16:1)


**אַךְ אֱלֹהִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי.** אֲבָל אֲנִי, שֶׁהִטֵּיתִי לְמָשָׁל אָזְנִי (תהלים מט:ה), אֱלֹהִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי שֶׁלֹּא אֵלֵךְ אֶל שְׁאוֹל, **כִּי יִקָּחֵנִי** בְּחַיַּי לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו:


**But God will redeem my soul** But I, who have bent my ear to the parable—God will redeem my soul so that I do not go to the grave, because He will take me in my lifetime to go in His ways.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:19:1)


**כִּי נַפְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּיו יְבָרֵךְ.** הָרָשָׁע מְבָרֵךְ אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּיו וְאוֹמֵר: שָׁלוֹם עָלֶיךָ נַפְשִׁי (תנחומא, משפטים ב), לֹא יְאֻנְךָ לָךְ שׁוּם רָעָה. אֲבָל אֲחֵרִים אֵין אוֹמְרִים עָלָיו כֵּן:


**Because in his lifetime he blesses himself** The wicked man blesses himself during his lifetime and says, “All will be well with you, my soul. No harm will befall you.” But others do not say so about him.


###### Rashi on Psalms 49:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:19:2)


**וְיוֹדוּךָ כִּי תֵיטִיב לָךְ.** וְאַתָּה, אִם תִּשְׁמַע לִדְבָרַי, הַכֹּל יוֹדוּךָ, כִּי תֵיטִיב לְנַפְשְׁךָ לְיַשֵּׁר אֶת דְּרָכֶיךָ:


**but [all] will praise you, for you will benefit yourself** But you, if you hearken to my words, all will praise you, for you will benefit your soul by straightening your way.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:20:1)


**תָּבוֹא עַד דּוֹר אֲבוֹתָיו.** כְּשֶׁתַּשְׁלִים יָמֶיךָ וְתָמוּת, תָּבֹא וְתִרְאֶה אֶת דּוֹר הָרְשָׁעִים אֲבוֹתָיו שֶׁל רָשָׁע נִדּוֹנִים בַּגֵּיהִנֹּם (סנהדרין קד:), אֲשֶׁר **עַד נֵצַח לֹא יִרְאוּ אוֹר**:


**You shall come to the generation of his forefathers** When you complete your days and die, you will come and see the generation of the wicked man being judged in Gehinnom, so that they will not see light to eternity.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Psalms 49:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/49:21:1)


**אָדָם בִּיקָר וְלֹא יָבִין.** דֶּרֶךְ הַחַיִּים נְתוּנָה לְפָנָיו, שֶׁאִם יֵלֵךְ בָּהּ הֲרֵי נִכְבָּד, אֵינוֹ מֵבִין אֶת הַטּוֹב:


**Man is in his glory but he does not understand** The way of life is placed before him; if he follows it, he will be honored, but he does not understand the good [resulting therefrom].



## Chapter 50


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:1:1)


**אֵל אֱלֹהִים ה׳.** אֶקְרָא (אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים ה׳ שְׁמוֹ):


**God of gods is the Lord** I shall call (the God of gods—YHWH is His name).


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:1:2)


**דִּבֶּר וַיִּקְרָא אָרֶץ.** וְהוּא הוֹפִיעַ מִצִּיּוֹן שֶׁהוּא מִכְלַל יֹפִי:


**spoke and called to the earth** The entire earth, but He appeared from Zion, which is the adornment of beauty.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:2:1)


**מִכְלַל.** שֵׁם דָּבָר, פְּרַמְנְ״ט בְּלַעַ״ז:


מִכְלַל is a noun, parement in Old French, adornment. He [Asaph] prophesies concerning the future redemption.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:3:1)


**יָבֹא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַל יֶחֱרַשׁ.** עוֹד עַל דַּם עֲבָדָיו הַשָּׁפוּךְ (תהלים עט:י):


**Our God shall come and not be silent** any longer concerning the spilt blood of His servants.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:4:1)


**יִקְרָא אֶל הַשָּׁמַיִם.** לִפְקֹד עַל שַׂר הָאֻמּוֹת שֶׁבַּמָּרוֹם:


**He shall call to the heavens** to visit upon the celestial princes of the peoples.


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:4:2)


**וְאֶל הָאָרֶץ.** לִפְקֹד עַל מַלְכֵי מִצְרַיִם (ישעיהו כד:כא):


**and to the earth** to visit upon the kings of the earth.


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:4:3)


**לָדִין עַמּוֹ.** לִנְקֹם נִקְמַת עַמּוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״כִּי יָדִין עַמּוֹ״ וְ״דַם עֲבָדָיו יִקּוֹם״ (דברים לב:לו, מג):


**to avenge His people** Heb. לדין, to avenge the vengeance of His people, as (Deut. 32:36): “For the Lord shall judge His people, and He shall avenge the blood of His servants.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:5:1)


**אִסְפוּ לִי חֲסִידָי.** וְעוֹד יִקְרָא לַשָּׁמַיִם וְלָאָרֶץ שֶׁיַּאַסְפוּ לוֹ הַגָּלֻיּוֹת, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״עוּרִי צָפוֹן וּבֹאִי תֵימָן״ (שיר השירים ד:טז):


**Gather to Me My devoted ones** And He will further call to the heavens and the earth that they gather the exiles to Him, as the matter that is stated (Song 4:16): “Awake, O north wind, and come, O south wind.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:5:2)


**כֹּרְתֵי בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי זָבַח.** שֶׁקִּבְּלוּ אֶת הַתּוֹרָה בִּבְרִית וְזֶבַח, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״הִנֵּה דַם הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת ה׳ וְגוֹמֵר״ (שמות כד:ח):


**who made a covenant with Me over a sacrifice** Who received the Torah with a covenant and a sacrifice, as it is stated (Exod. 24:8): “Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord has made with you.”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:8:1)


**לֹא עַל זְבָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶךָ.** אִם אֵינְךָ מֵבִיא לִי זְבָחֶיךָ וְלֹא עוֹלֹתֶיךָ נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד, אֵינִי שָׂם עֵינִי וְלִבִּי עַל כָּךְ:


**I will not reprove you concerning your sacrifices** If you do not bring Me sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are not before Me constantly. I do not set My eyes and My heart on that.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:9:1)


**לֹא אֶקַּח מִבֵּיתְךָ פָר.** לֹא שֶׁלְּךָ הֵם, אֶלָּא שֶׁלִּי:


**I will not take from your household a bull** They are not yours but Mine.


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:9:2)


**מִמִּכְלְאֹתֶיךָ.** הוּא דִּיר הַצֹּאן, כְּמוֹ ״גָּזַר מִמִּכְלָה צֹאן״ (חבקוק ג:יז), פַּאר״ק בְּלַעַ״ז:


**from your pens** Heb. ממכלאתיך. That is a sheepfold, as (Habakkuk 3:17): “the flock shall be cut off from the fold (ממכלה) .” Parc in French, pen.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:10:1)


**בְּהֵמוֹת בְּהַרְרֵי אָלֶף.** הוּא (שׁוֹר) שֶׁהוּא רוֹעֶה אֶלֶף הָרִים לְיוֹם, וְכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם הֵם צוֹמְחִים. יֵשׁ מְפָרְשִׁים אֶלֶף הָרִים אוֹ אֶלֶף פַּרְסָאוֹת אוֹ שֵׁם אֶלֶף פָּרִים, וְיֵשׁ מְפָרְשִׁים שֶׁהוּא כְּמוֹ ״שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ״ (דברים ז:יג), כְּלוֹמַר הָרִים מְלֵאִים בָּקָר בַּעֲבוּר שֶׁהִזְכִּיר **לֹא אֶקַּח מִבֵּיתְךָ פָר**:


**the behemoth of the thousand mountains** That is (the bull) destined for the future feast [of the righteous], which grazes on a thousand mountains daily, and every day they grow back. Others explain this to mean one thousand mountains or one thousand parasangs (i.e., one mountain that is 1,000 parasangs long, or perhaps it should read: 1,000 bulls. The plural “mountains” indicates that there were many mountains of that type.[Shem Ephraim]) Others explain that this is like (Deut. 7:13): “the litter of your cattle (אלפיך).” i.e., mountains full of cattle, because he says, “I will not take from your household a bull.”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:11:1)


**וְזִיז שָׂדַי עִמָּדִי.** רֶמֶשׂ הַשָּׂדֶה. זִיז, עַל שֶׁהֵם זָזִים מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם. אישמובימנ״ט בְּלַעַ״ז:


**and the creeping things of the field are with me** Heb. זיז, the creeping things of the field. They are called זִיז because they move (זזים) from place to place; esmoubemant in Old French, movement.


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:11:2)


**עִמָּדִי.** אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ אֶת כֻּלָּם:


**with Me** I know them all.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:13:1)


**הַאוֹכַל בְּשַׂר אַבִּירִים.** לֹא אָמַרְתִּי לְךָ לְהָבִיא זֶבַח שֶׁאֲנִי צָרִיךְ לַאֲכִילָה, אֶלָּא נַחַת רוּחַ לְפָנַי, שֶׁאָמַרְתִּי וְנַעֲשָׂה רְצוֹנִי:


**Will I eat the flesh of bulls** I did not order you to bring a sacrifice because I need to eat, but it is My pleasure that I spoke and My will was performed.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:14:1)


**זְבַח לֵאלֹהִים תּוֹדָה.** הִתְוַדֵּה עַל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְשׁוּב אֵלַי, זֶהוּ זֶבַח שֶׁאֲנִי חָפֵץ בּוֹ; וְאַחַר כָּךְ **שַׁלֵּם לְעֶלְיוֹן נְדָרֶיךָ**, כִּי אָז יִתְקַבְּלוּ לְרָצוֹן:


**Slaughter for God a confession** Confess your deeds and return to Me. That is the sacrifice that I desire, and afterwards pay the Most High your vows, for then they will be accepted willingly.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:15:1)


**וּתְכַבְּדֵנִי.** שֶׁזֶּה הוּא כְּבוֹדִי, שֶׁאוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת הַבּוֹטְחִים בִּי:


**and you will honor Me** For this is My honor, that I will save those who trust in Me.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:16:1)


**וְתִשָּׂא בְרִיתִי.** תּוֹרָתִי:


**and bring up My covenant on your mouth** My Torah.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:18:1)


**וַתִּרֶץ עִמּוֹ.** נִתְרַצֵּיתָ לָלֶכֶת עִמּוֹ:


**you agreed** You agreed to go with him.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:19:1)


**תַּצְמִיד מִרְמָה.** תַּרְגִּיל אֶצְלְךָ רְמִיָּה לְדַבֵּר רָעָה, תַּצְמִיד אגוטא״ש בְּלַעַ״ז, כְּמוֹ (במדבר יט:טו) ״צָמִיד פָּתִיל״ (ס״א אינו):


**you accustomed your tongue to deceit** Heb. תצמיד. You accustom deceit to be with you; to speak evil. תצמיד is ajouter in French, to join, as (Num. 19:15): “a cover (צמיד) bound.”



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:20:1)


**תֵּשֵׁב.** בְּמוֹשַׁב לֵצִים:


**You sit** in the company of the scorners.


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:20:2)


**בְּבֶן אִמְּךָ.** שֶׁאֵין לְךָ דִּין וְרִיב עִמּוֹ, שֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹרֵשׁ עִמְּךָ:


**your mother’s son** with whom you have no [legal] quarrel, since he does not inherit with you.


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:20:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:20:3)


**דּוֹפִי.** דָּבָר גְּנַאי לִדְחוֹתוֹ, לְשׁוֹן ״יֶהְדֳּפֶנּוּ״ (במדבר לה:כ):


**slander** Heb. דפי, defamation to cast him off, an expression of (Num. 35:20): “he pushes him off (יהדפנו).”



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:21:1)


**דִּמִּיתָ.** סָבוּר אַתָּה שֶׁאֶהְיֶה כָמוֹךָ, לְהִתְרַצּוֹת בְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ הָרָעִים. (וְיֵשׁ מְפָרְשִׁים דִּמִּיתָ כִּי אֵינֶנִּי יוֹדֵעַ הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת):


**you thought** You thought that I would be like you, to condone your evil deeds; (and others explain: you thought that I do not know what is hidden.)



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Psalms 50:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:23:1)


**זוֹבֵחַ תּוֹדָה.** הַמֵּבִיא לִי זֶבַח שֶׁל תְּשׁוּבָה וְהוֹדָאָה עַל עֲווֹנוֹתָיו, הוּא **יְכַבְּדָנְנִי**:


**One who slaughters a confession sacrifice** [One] who brings Me a sacrifice of repentance and confession for his iniquities, honors Me.


###### Rashi on Psalms 50:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/50:23:2)


**וְשָׂם דֶּרֶךְ.** הַשָּׁב אֵלַי אֲנִי מְלַמֵּד וְשָׂם דֶּרֶךְ לַחוֹטְאִים לָשׁוּב אֵלַי, אֲנִי אַרְאֶנּוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי:


**and [I will] prepare the way** for the one who returns to Me. I teach and prepare the way for sinners to return to Me (and he who returns to Me—Shem Ephraim), I will show him My salvation.



## Chapter 51


### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:5:1)


**וְחַטָּאתִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד.** מִתּוֹךְ שֶׁאֲנִי מִתְחָרֵט וְדוֹאֵג עָלָיו, דּוֹמֶה לִי כְּאִלּוּ הוּא לְפָנַי תָּמִיד כָּל שָׁעָה:


**and my sin is always before me** Since I regret [my sin] and worry about it, it is as though it is constantly before me, always.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:6:1)


**לְךָ לְבַדְּךָ חָטָאתִי.** לְפִיכָךְ בְּיָדְךָ לִסְלֹחַ, וְאַף מַה שֶׁהֲרֵעוֹתִי לְאוּרִיָּה (שמואל ב יא) לֹא חָטָאתִי אֶלָּא לְךָ, שֶׁהִזְהַרְתָּ עַל הַדָּבָר:


**Against You alone have I sinned** Therefore, it is in Your power to forgive [me]. Even in my sin against Uriah, I sinned against You, for You warned against the matter.


###### Rashi on Psalms 51:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:6:2)


**לְמַעַן תִּצְדַּק בְּדָבְרֶךָ.** כְּמוֹ בְּמִנְהָגְךָ (ס״א אינו), כֹּחַ הָיָה לִי לְהִתְגַּבֵּר עַל יִצְרִי אֶלָּא שֶׁלֹּא יֹאמְרוּ הָעֶבֶד נִצַּח אֶת רַבּוֹ, שֶׁאָמַרְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ בְּחָנֵנִי וְנַסֵּנִי (תהלים כו:ב) וּבְחַנְתַּנִי וְלֹא נִמְצֵאתִי שָׁלֵם כְּדֵי שֶׁתִּצְדַּק אַתָּה וְלֹא אֲנִי (סנהדרין קז.). דָּבָר אַחֵר **לְמַעַן תִּצְדַּק בְּדָבְרֶךָ,** אִם תִּמְחֹל לִי, תִּצְדַּק בְּדִינְךָ לְנֹכַח כָּל הָרְשָׁעִים שֶׁאֵינָם שָׁבִים, שֶׁלֹּא יוּכְלוּ לוֹמַר כְּאִלּוּ עָשִׂינוּ תְּשׁוּבָה לֹא הוֹעַלְנוּ:


**in order that You be justified in Your conduct** like במנהגך, in Your conduct. I had the strength to overpower my evil inclination, but, so that they should not say, “The servant overpowered his master,”for I said to You (Ps. 26: 2), “Test me, O Lord, and try me,” and You tested me and I was not found perfect, in order that You should be justified and not I (Sanh. 107a). Another explanation: **in order that You be justified in Your conduct** If You forgive me, You will be justified in Your judgment against all the wicked who do not repent, so that they will not be able to say, “If we had repented, it would not have availed us.”



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:7:1)


**הֵן בְּעָווֹן חוֹלָלְתִּי.** וְאֵיךְ לֹא אֶחֱטָא וְעִקַּר יְצִירָתִי עַל יְדֵי תַשְׁמִישׁ הוּא, שֶׁכַּמָּה עֲוֹנוֹת בָּאִים עַל יָדוֹ (ויקרא רבה יד:ה). דָּבָר אַחֵר: עִקַּר יְצִירָתִי מִזָּכָר וּנְקֵבָה, שֶׁכֻּלָּם מְלֵאִים עָוֹן. יֵשׁ מִדְרָשִׁים לְמִקְרָא זֶה, וְאֵינָם מִתְיַשְּׁבִים לְפִי עִנְיַן הַמְדַבֵּר בַּמִּזְמוֹר:


**Behold, with iniquity I was formed** Now how could I not sin when the main part of my creation was through coitus, the source of many iniquities? Another explanation: The main part of my creation is from a male and a female, both of whom are full of iniquity. There are many midrashim to this verse, but they do not fit the context of the psalm.


###### Rashi on Psalms 51:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:7:2)


**יֶחֱמַתְנִי.** לְשׁוֹן חֲמִימוּת, כְּמוֹ (בראשית ל:לח) ״וַיֵּחַמְנָה הַצֹּאן בְּבֹאָן לִשְׁתּוֹת״ (ס״א אינו):


**conceived me** Heb. יחמתני, an expression of heat, as (Gen. 30:38): “And they came into heat (ויחמנה) when they came to drink.”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:8:1)


**הֵן אֱמֶת חָפַצְתָּ בַטֻּחוֹת.** וַהֲרֵינִי מוֹדֶה עַל הָאֱמֶת, כִּי חָטָאתִי:


**Behold, You desired that truth be in the hidden places** and behold, I confess to the truth, that I sinned.


###### Rashi on Psalms 51:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:8:2)


**בַּטֻּחוֹת.** אֵלּוּ כְּלָיוֹת, שֶׁהֵן חֲלָקוֹת. וּמְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ עִם ״כִּמְטַחֲוֵי קֶשֶׁת״ (בראשית כא:טז), וְכֵן ״מִי שָׁת בַּטֻּחוֹת חָכְמָה״ (איוב לח:לו). פִּתְרוֹנוֹ לְשׁוֹן מֶשֶׁךְ: כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר יֵשׁ לַקֶּשֶׁת מֶשֶׁךְ, כֵּן יֵשׁ מֶשֶׁךְ לַדַּעַת (ס״א אינו):


**in the hidden places** Heb. בטחות. These are the reins, which are smooth. Menachem (p. 97), however, associated it with (Gen. 21:16): “as it were a bowshot (כמטחוי קשת)”; and so (Job 38: 36): “Who placed wisdom in the inward parts (בטחות).” And their interpretation is an expression of drawing, for just as a bow is drawn, so is their yearning for knowledge.


###### Rashi on Psalms 51:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:8:3)


**וּבְסָתוּם חָכְמָה תוֹדִיעֵנִי.** וּבַלֵּב שֶׁהוּא סָתוּם, הוֹדַעְתַּנִי חָכְמָה לְהִתְוַדּוֹת:


**and in the concealed part You teach me wisdom** And in the heart, which is concealed, You have taught me wisdom to confess.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:9:1)


**תְּחַטְּאֵנִי בְאֵזוֹב.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּטַהֵר הַמְּצֹרָע וְטָמֵא מֵת (ויקרא יד:ד; במדבר יט:ו):


**Purify me with a hyssop** As one purifies the “mezora” and the one who became unclean through contact with a corpse.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:10:1)


**תַּשְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה.** סְלִיחַת הֶחָטְא:


**Make me hear joy and gladness** The forgiveness of the sin.


###### Rashi on Psalms 51:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:10:2)


**עֲצָמוֹת דִּכִּיתָ.** כְּשֶׁכָּעַסְתָּ עָלַי:


**the bones that You crushed** when You were wroth with me.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:12:1)


**לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא לִי אֱלֹהִים.** שֶׁלֹּא אֶכָּשֵׁל עוֹד:


**Create for me a pure heart, O God** so that I do not stumble again.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:13:1)


**וְרוּחַ קָדְשְׁךָ אַל תִּקַּח מִמֶּנִּי.** שֶׁלֹּא יְהֵא רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ מְרֻחָק מִמֶּנִּי (ס״א אינו):


**and do not take Your holy spirit from me** that the holy spirit should not be withdrawn from me.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:14:1)


**הָשִׁיבָה לִּי שְׂשׂוֹן יִשְׁעֶךָ.** רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ שֶׁנִּסְתַּלְּקָה מֵעָלַי (סנהדרין קז.):


**Restore to me the joy of Your salvation** The holy spirit, which has left me.


###### Rashi on Psalms 51:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:14:2)


**נְדִיבָה.** לְשׁוֹן נְדִיבוּת, קְצִינוּת:


**noble** Heb. נדיבה, an expression of nobility and leadership.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:15:1)


**אֲלַמְּדָה פוֹשְׁעִים דְּרָכֶיךָ.** וּמִמֶּנִּי יִלְמְדוּ וְיָשׁוּבוּ, אִם יִרְאוּ שֶׁתִּסְלַח לִי:


**I will teach transgressors Your ways** and they will learn from me. They will repent if they see that You forgive me.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:16:1)


**הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים.** שֶׁלֹּא אָמוּת בַּחֶרֶב, עַל עָנְשׁוֹ שֶׁל אוּרִיָּה שֶׁהָרַגְתִּי (שמואל ב יא:טו,יז):


**Save me from blood** that I should not die by the sword as a punishment for Uriah, whom I killed.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:17:1)


**אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח.** מְחוֹל לִי, וִיהִי לִי פִּתְחוֹן פֶּה לְהַגִּיד **תְּהִלָּתֶךָ**:


**O Lord, You shall open my lips** Forgive me so that I will be able to open my lips to recite Your praise.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:18:1)


**כִּי לֹא תַחְפֹּץ זֶבַח.** שֶׁאֵין זֶבַח חַטָּאת בָּא עַל הַמֵּזִיד:


**For You do not wish a sacrifice** Because a sacrifice of a sin offering is not brought for a willful transgression.


###### Rashi on Psalms 51:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:18:2)


**וְאֶתֵּנָה.** שֶׁאִם תַּחְפֹּץ אֶתְּנֶנּוּ לְךָ:


**or I should give it** For if You desired it, I would give it to You.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 51:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/51:20:1)


**הֵיטִיבָה.** לִבְנוֹת בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּתוֹכָהּ בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בְּנִי:


**do good** to build Your Temple in its midst in the days of my son, Solomon.



## Chapter 52


### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 52:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:3:1)


**מַה תִּתְהַלֵּל.** וְתִתְפָּאֵר בָּרָעָה שֶׁאַתָּה עוֹשֶׂה, אַתָּה הַגִּבּוֹר בַּתּוֹרָה (סנהדרין קו:):


**Why do you boast of evil, you mighty man?** Why do you boast and brag of the evil that you do, you who are mighty in Torah?


###### Rashi on Psalms 52:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:3:2)


**חֶסֶד אֵל כָּל הַיּוֹם.** לְהַצִּיל אֶת הַנִּרְדָּף עַל יָדְךָ. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **חֶסֶד אֵל כָּל הַיּוֹם**, אִלּוּ לֹא נָתַן לִי אֲחִימֶלֶךְ לֶחֶם, מְדֻמֶּה אַתָּה שֶׁאָמוּת בָּרָעָב? יֵשׁ חֶסֶד בַּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל הַיּוֹם, וְאִם לֹא נָתַן לִי, יִתְּנוּ לִי אֲחֵרִים:


**God’s kindness is constant** to rescue the one whom you pursue. Another explanation: God’s kindness is constant. Had Ahimelech not given me bread, do you think that I would have died of hunger? God always shows kindness toward Israel, and if he had not given me [to eat], others would have given me.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 52:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:4:1)


**מְלֻטָּשׁ.** מְחֻדָּד:


**sharpened** Heb. מְלֻטֳשּׁ.


###### Rashi on Psalms 52:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:4:2)


**עוֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה.** חוֹתֵךְ הַבָּשָׂר עִם הַשֵּׂעָר:


**working deceit** Cutting the flesh with the hair.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 52:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:7:1)


**יִתָּצְךָ.** לְשׁוֹן נְתִיצָה:


**shall tear you down** Heb. יתצך, an expression of demolition (נתיצה).


###### Rashi on Psalms 52:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:7:2)


**יַחְתְּךָ.** לְשׁוֹן שְׁבִירָה:


**He will break you** Heb. יחתך, an expression of breaking.


###### Rashi on Psalms 52:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:7:3)


**וְיִסָּחֲךָ.** וְיַעַקְרְךָ:


**and pluck you** Heb. ויסחך, and shall tear you out.


###### Rashi on Psalms 52:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:7:4)


**וְשָׁרֶשְׁךָ.** יְשָׁרֵשׁ אַחֲרֶיךָ לַעֲקוֹר כָּל הַשָּׁרָשִׁים, דִּירָארִיצִינֶ״ר בְּלַעַ״ז:


**and uproot you** He shall uproot after you, to tear out all the roots; esraciner or esraziner in Old French, to uproot, deraciner in modern French.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 52:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:8:1)


**וְעָלָיו יִשְׂחָקוּ.** וְזֶה הַשְּׂחוֹק שֶׁיֹּאמְרוּ עָלָיו: הִנֵּה זֶה הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׂם מִבְטַחוֹ בַּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, רְאוּ מֶה עָלְתָה בּוֹ!


**and laugh at him** And this is the ridicule they will say about him: “Behold! This is the man who does not place his trust in the Holy One, blessed be He. See what happened to him.”



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 52:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:9:1)


**יָעֹז בְּהַוָּתוֹ.** מִתְגַּבֵּר הָיָה בְּרִשְׁעוֹ:


**he strengthened himself in his wickedness** Heb. יעז בהותו.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 52:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:10:1)


**וַאֲנִי.** הַנִּרְדָּף עַתָּה בְּיָדְךָ אֶהְיֶה **כְּזַיִת רַעֲנָן בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים**, בְּבָנִים וּבִבְנֵי בָנִים בְּבֵית הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא (ברכות נז.):


**But I** who am now being pursued by you, will be like an olive tree, fresh with children and grandchildren, in the house of the Holy One, blessed be He.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 52:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/52:11:1)


**כִּי עָשִׂיתָ.** כְּשֶׁתַּעֲשֶׂה לִי זֹאת, וּכְלַפֵּי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אָמַר מִקְרָא זֶה:


**when You have done [this]** When You do this for me. This verse is addressed to the Holy One, blessed be He.



## Chapter 53


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 53:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:1:1)


**עַל מָחֲלַת.** שֵׁם כְּלִי שִׁיר. דָּבָר אַחֵר: עַל מַחֲלָתָן שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל, כְּשֶׁיַּחֲרִיב הַבַּיִת. וּכְבָר אָמַר מִזְמוֹר אַחֵר דּוּגְמַת זֶה ״אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים וְגוֹ׳״ (תהלים יד:א), הָאֶחָד עַל חֻרְבַּן בַּיִת רִאשׁוֹן, וְזֶה עַל בַּיִת שֵׁנִי:


**on machalath** The name of a musical instrument. Another explanation: concerning the malady (מחלתן) of Israel when the Temple will be destroyed. He already recited another psalm resembling this one (above 14): “The fool said in his heart, ‘there is no God, etc.’ “, One relates to the destruction of the First Temple and this one, to the Second Temple.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 53:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:2:1)


**אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ.** זֶה עַל טִיטוּס, כְּשֶׁגִּדֵּר אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת וְחַרְבּוֹ מְטַפְטֵף דָּם. אָמַר: הָרַג אֶת עַצְמוֹ (גיטין נו:):


**The fool said in his heart** This is Titus; when he cut into the curtain and his sword was dripping with blood, he said that he had killed [God] Himself.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 53:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:4:1)


**כֻּלּוֹ סָג.** לְשׁוֹן ״סִיגִים״ (יחזקאל כב:יח):


**dross** Heb. סג, an expression of סיגים, dross.


###### Rashi on Psalms 53:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:4:2)


**אֵין גַּם אֶחָד.** מִכָּל חֵילָיו שֶׁיִּמְחֶה בְּיָדוֹ:


**not even one** of all his armies will protest against his deeds.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 53:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:5:1)


**הֲלֹא.** יֵשׁ לֵידַע לְאוֹכְלֵי עַמִּי כְּמַאֲכַל לֶחֶם וֵאלֹהִים לֹא קָרָאוּ, שֶׁסּוֹפָם שֶׁיִּפְחֲדוּ שָׁם פַּחַד בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים:


**Did not** Should not those who devour My people like a meal of bread, and who did not call upon the Lord, know that ultimately they will experience there a great fear at the end of days?



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 53:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:6:1)


**לֹא הָיָה פַחַד.** זֶה כַּפַּחַד הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁאֵרַע לְבֵלְשַׁצַּר, כִּי בַּגְּאֻלָּה זוֹ פִּזַּר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עַצְמוֹת חוֹנָךְ הַחוֹנִים עָלַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלַיִם, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״הָמֵק בְּשָׂרוֹ וְגוֹ׳״ (זכריה יד:יב). וְכֵן פְּתָרוֹ מְנַחֵם, וְדוּנַשׁ פָּתַר אוֹתוֹ כְּמוֹ ״חֲנֹךְ לַנַּעַר עַל פִּי דַרְכּוֹ״ (משלי כב:ו), וְכָ״ף שֶׁל חוֹנָךְ הִיא יְסוֹד בַּמִּלָּה כְּכָ״ף שֶׁל חֲנוֹךְ (ס״א אינו):


**there was never such fear** This fear was not like the first fear that came over Belshazzar, for in this redemption the Holy One, blessed be He, scattered the bones of חוֹנָךְ, those who camp around you, Jerusalem, as the matter that is stated (Zech. 14:12): “His flesh will waste away, etc.” Menachem (p. 91) interpreted it that way, but Dunash (pp. 63f.) interpreted it as (Prov. 22:6): “Train (חנך) a child according to his way”; the “chaph” of חוֹנָךְ is a radical as the “chaph” of חֲנֹךְ, train.


###### Rashi on Psalms 53:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/53:6:2)


**הֱבִישׁוֹתָה.** אַתָּה ה׳ אֶת כָּל אוֹיְבַי, כִּי מְאַסְתָּם:


**You have put them to shame** You, O Lord, have put all my enemies to shame, for You have rejected them.



## Chapter 54


### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 54:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/54:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/54:3:1)


**וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ תְדִינֵנִי.** תִּנְקֹם נִקְמָתִי, כְּמוֹ ״כִּי יָדִין ה׳ עַמּוֹ״ (דברים לב:לו):


**and with Your might, avenge me** Heb. תדינני, Wreak my vengeance, as (Deut. 32:36): “When the Lord will avenge (ידין) His people.”



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 54:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/54:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/54:7:1)


**לְשׁוֹרְרָי.** לְעוֹיְנַי, לְשׁוֹן ״אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְלֹא קָרוֹב״ (במדבר כד:יז):


**to those who lie in wait for me** Heb. לשררי, those who eye me, an expression of (Num. 24:17): “I see him (אשורנו), but not near.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 54:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/54:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/54:7:2)


**בַּאֲמִתְּךָ.** מִתּוֹךְ שֶׁאַתָּה אֲמִתִּי, וְאָמַרְתָּ לִיפָּרַע מֵהוֹלְכֵי רָכִיל וְרוֹדְפֵי הֶרֶג (תהלים קא:ה), לְכָךְ **הַצְמִיתֵם**:


**with Your truth** Since You are truthful, and You said that You would wreak vengeance upon talebearers and those who pursue to kill, therefore, cut them off.



## Chapter 55


### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 55:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:3:1)


**אָרִיד בְּשִׂיחִי.** אֶתְאוֹנֵן בְּצַעֲרִי, כְּמוֹ ״זְכֹר עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי״ (איכה ג:יט), ״וְיָרַדְתִּי עַל הֶהָרִים״ (שופטים יא:לז). וּמְנַחֵם פָּתַר לְשׁוֹן מֶמְשָׁלָה, כְּמוֹ ״וּרְדוּ בִדְגַת הַיָּם״, וְשִׂיחִי לְשׁוֹן שִׂיחַ, ״לְמִי שִׂיחַ״ (משלי כג:כט) (ס״א אינו):


**I lament in my speech** Heb. אריד, I will lament of my pain, as (Lam. 3:19): “Remember my affliction and my misery (ומרודי).” Also (Jud. 11:37): “and wail (וירדתי) upon the mountains.” Menachem (p. 162) interpreted אריד as an expression of ruling, as (Gen. 1:28): “and rule (ורדו) over the fish of the sea.” שּׂיחי is an expression of speech (Prov. 23:29): “He who talks too much (שיח).”



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 55:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:4:1)


**עָקַת.** לְשׁוֹן מָצוֹק:


**the distress** Heb. עקת, an expression of distress.


###### Rashi on Psalms 55:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:4:2)


**כִּי יָמִיטוּ עָלַי אָוֶן.** דּוֹאֵג וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל מַכְרִיעִים עָלַי עֲוֹנוֹת לְהוֹרוֹת שֶׁאֲנִי בֶן מָוֶת, וּמַתִּירִים אֶת דָּמִי (שמואל א כב:ט-יט; שמואל ב טו:לא):


**for they accuse me of iniquity** Doeg and Ahithophel accuse me of iniquities that overweigh [the scale] to demonstrate that I am liable to death, and they sanction [the shedding of] my blood.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 55:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:5:1)


**יָחִיל.** דּוֹאֵג:


**shudders** Heb. יחיל, worries.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 55:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:8:1)


**הִנֵּה אַרְחִיק נְדֹד וְגוֹ׳, אָחִישָׁה מִפְלָט לִי.** אִם הָיוּ לִי כְּנָפַיִם הָיִיתִי מַרְחִיק לָנוּד וּמְמַהֵר לְהַצִּיל נַפְשִׁי מִיָּדָם, שֶׁהֵם כְּרוּחַ סוֹעָה רוּחַ סְעָרָה עוֹקֶרֶת אִילָנוֹת כְּמוֹ ״וַיִּסַּע כָּעֵץ״ (איוב יט:י). וּמְנַחֵם חִבֵּר סוֹעָה כְּמוֹ ״וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (שמות יב:לז):


**Behold I would wander far away...** and... **I would quickly find myself a refuge** If I had wings, I would wander far away and hasten to save my soul from their hands, for they are like a sweeping wind, a storm wind, which uproots trees, as (Job 19:10): “He has uprooted (ויסע) like a tree.” But Menachem (p. 127) associated it with (Exod.12: 37): “And the children of Israel traveled (ויסעו).



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 55:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:10:1)


**בָּלַע.** דפא״יי בְּלַעַ״ז, כְּמוֹ ״הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ מִבַּלֵּעַ״ (איכה ב:ח). כֵּן פָּתַר מְנַחֵם (ס״א אינו):


**divide their tongue** Divide it so that no one should pay them heed. And Menachem (p. 142) interpreted פלג as an expression of division.


###### Rashi on Psalms 55:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:10:2)


**פַּלַּג לְשׁוֹנָם.** הַבְדִּילֵהוּ שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁמַע אָדָם לָהֶם. וּמְנַחֵם פָּתַר פַּלַּג לְשׁוֹן חִלּוּק (סא״א):


**Destroy** (Defey or defay in Old French, destroy, defais in modern French,) like (Lam. 2:8): “He did not restrain his hand from destroying (מבלע).” So did Menachem interpret it [p. 46].


###### Rashi on Psalms 55:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/55:10:3)


**כִּי רָאִיתִי חָמָס וָרִיב בָּעִיר.** עַל יָדָם:


**for I have seen violence and strife in the city** through them.
