**Your judgments** the wisdom of Your laws, which You commanded in the Torah.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:1:3)


**וְצִדְקָתְךָ.** לְצַדֵּק אֶת הַדִּין:


**and Your righteousness** to judge justly.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:1:4)


**מֶלֶךְ וּבֶן מֶלֶךְ.** שְׁנֵיהֶם בִּ**שְׁלֹמֹה** אֲמוּרִים. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ תֵּן**, הַיִּסּוּרִין יְהוּ כָּלִים בִּי, וְהַצְּדָקָה עֲשֵׂה לִבְנִי, שֶׁיִּהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם בְּיָמָיו:


**to a king, etc., to a king’s son** Both refer to Solomon. Another explanation: **Give Your judgments to a king** The chastisements should end with me, and the charity You should bestow upon my son; viz. that there be peace in his days.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:3:1)


**יִשְׂאוּ הָרִים.** בְּיָמָיו:


**May the mountains bear** peace for the people in his days.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:3:2)


**שָׁלוֹם לָעָם.** וּמַהוּ הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁהֶהָרִים נוֹשְׂאִין? כְּשֶׁהֵן עוֹשִׂין פֵּרוֹת, אֵין עֵין הַבְּרִיּוֹת צָרָה, וְקוֹרֵא אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ אֶל תַּחַת גֶּפֶן וְאֶל תַּחַת תְּאֵנָה (זכריה ג:י):


**peace for the people.** Now what is the peace that the mountains bear? When they produce fruit, people will not be jealous, and “each man will call his neighbor [to come] under [his] vine and under [his] fig tree.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:3:3)


**וּגְבָעוֹת בִּצְדָקָה.** וּגְבָעוֹת יִשְׂאוּ לָהֶם שָׁלוֹם עַל יְדֵי הַצְּדָקָה שֶׁיַּעֲשׂוּ:


**and the hillsthrough righteousness** And the hills will bear peace for them through the righteousness that they will perform.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:5:1)


**יִירָאוּךָ עִם שָׁמֶשׁ.** מִמֶּנִּי יִלְמְדוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְיִרְאָה אוֹתְךָ כָּל יְמֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְהַיָּרֵחַ, לְדוֹר דּוֹרִים:


**May they fear You in the presence of the sun** All Israel will learn from him to fear You all the days of the sun and moon, generations upon generations.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:5:2)


**וְלִפְנֵי יָרֵחַ.** בְּעוֹד הַיָּרֵחַ קַיָּם וְהֵם לְפָנָיו, וְהַרְבֵּה יֵשׁ בִּלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה (ביכורים ב,ג): בִּפְנֵי הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁלֹּא בִּפְנֵי הַבַּיִת:


**and before the moon** As long as the moon exists for generations, when they are before it [i.e., during its existence]. There are many such expressions in the language of the Mishnah. Before the Temple and not before the Temple [i.e., when the Temple existed and when it no longer exists].



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:6:1)


**יֵרֵד כְּמָטָר עַל גֵּז.** יֵרֵד דְּבָרוֹ בְּתוֹךְ עַמְּךָ וּבְלִבָּם כְּמָטָר הַיּוֹרֵד עַל יֶרֶק הַגָּזוּז, שֶׁהוּא צָרִיךְ לִגְשָׁמִים לְאַחַר שֶׁגְּזָזוּהוּ. כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְהִנֵּה לֶקֶשׁ אַחַר גִּזֵּי הַמֶּלֶךְ״ (עמוס ז:א):


**May it descend as rain upon cut vegetation** May his word descend into the midst of Your people and into their heart as the rain that falls on the cut vegetation, which requires rain after being cut. As the matter is stated (Amos 7:1): “and behold the latter growth after the king’s mowings.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:6:2)


**זַרְזִיף אָרֶץ.** לְשׁוֹן טִיפִּים הוּא בִּלְשׁוֹן אֲרַמִּי; בְּמַסֶּכֶת יוֹמָא (יומא פז.): הֲווֹ מָטוּ זַרְזִיפֵי דְמַיָּא:


**that drip upon the earth** Heb. זרזיף, an expression of drops. In Aramaic, in Tractate Yoma (87a): “Drops (זרזיפי) of water hit him.”



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:7:1)


**יִפְרַח בְּיָמָיו צַדִּיק.** יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**May the righteous flourish in his days** Israel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:7:2)


**וְרֹב שָׁלוֹם.** יִפְרַח בְּיָמָיו, וִיהִי שָׁלוֹם זֶה אָרוֹךְ עַד לְעוֹלָם. וְכָל תְּפִלָּה זוֹ נִתְקַיְּמָה חוּץ מִדָּבָר הַזֶּה; לְפִי שֶׁשְּׁלֹמֹה חָטָא לְפִיכָךְ לֹא נִמְשְׁכָה מַלְכוּתוֹ, שֶׁהַמַּלְכוּת נִמְסְרָה לְדָוִד עַל תְּנַאי ״אִם יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ אֶת דַּרְכָּם״ (מלכים א ב:ד). וְיִשְׂרָאֵל פָּרְחוּ בְיָמָיו, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל רַבִּים כַּחוֹל וְגוֹ׳״ (מלכים א ד:כ), **וְרֹב שָׁלוֹם** הָיָה, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וַיֵּשֶׁב יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לָבֶטַח אִישׁ תַּחַת גַּפְנוֹ כָּל יְמֵי שְׁלֹמֹה״ (מלכים א ה:ה):


**and much peace** will flourish in his days, and this peace will last forever. Now all this prayer was fulfilled except this thing, because Solomon sinned. Therefore his kingdom did not endure, for the kingship was given to David on this condition (I Kings 2: 4): “If your children take heed to their way,” but Israel sinned in his days. As it is said (ibid. 4: 20): “Judah and Israel [were] many, as the sand, etc.” And Israel flourished in his days, as it is said... And there was much peace, as it is said (ibid. 5:5): “And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, etc., all the days of Solomon.”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:8:1)


**וְיֵרְדְּ מִיָּם עַד יָם.** כָּל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, מִיַּם סוּף וְעַד יָם פְּלִשְׁתִּים (שמות כג:לא):


**And may he reign from sea to sea** All of the land of Israel is from the Sea of Reeds to the Sea of the Philistines [the Mediterranean].


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:8:2)


**וּמִנָּהָר עַד אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ.** ״כִּי הוּא רוֹדֶה בְּכָל עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְגוֹמֵר״ (מלכים א ה:ד):


**and from the river to the ends of the land** (I Kings 5:4): “For he had dominion over all [the inhabitants of] this side of the river, etc.”



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:9:1)


**צִיִּים.** כִּתּוֹת שֶׁל שָׂרִים, כְּדִמְתַרְגֵּם ״וְצִים מִיַּד כִּתִּים״ (במדבר כד:כד): ״וְסִיעָן יִסְתַּחְרָן מֵרוֹמָאֵי״:


**nobles** Heb. ציים, companies of nobles, as (Num. 24:24): “and nobles (וצים) from the Kittites,” which the Targum renders: And companies will come around from the Romans.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:10:1)


**מַלְכֵי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְאִיִּים מִנְחָה יָשִׁיבוּ.** ״כִּי אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּם עִם אֳנִי חִירָם אַחַת לְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תָּבֹא אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְגוֹ׳״ (מלכים א י:כב):


**May the kings of Tarshish and the isles return tribute** (I Kings 10:23): “For the king had at sea, ships of Tarshish with Aliram’s ships; once every three years the ships of Tarshish would come, etc.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:10:2)


**מַלְכֵי שְׁבָא.** מַלְכַּת שְׁבָא (מלכים א י:א):


**the kings of Sheba** The queen of Sheba.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:10:3)


**אֶשְׁכָּר.** דּוֹרוֹן:


**a gift** Heb. אֶשְׁכָּר, a gift.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:11:1)


**כָּל גּוֹיִם יַעַבְדוּהוּ.** ״וְכָל הָאָרֶץ״ מְבִיאִים מִנְחָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה (מלכים א י:כד), ״וְהֵמָּה מְבִיאִין אִישׁ מִנְחָתוֹ״ (מלכים א י:כה):


**may all nations serve him** (I Kings 10:24f.): “And all the [inhabitants of] the earth sought Solomon’s presence etc. And each one would bring his gift.”



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:14:1)


**מִתּוֹךְ וּמֵחָמָס.** מִמַּכּוֹת וּמִגָּזֵל. מָצָאתִי **מִתּוֹךְ** לְשׁוֹן תּוֹךְ תּוֹכוֹת, בַּעֲלֵי מְזִמּוֹת חוֹרְשֵׁי אָוֶן, כְּמוֹ ״אִישׁ תְּכָכִים״ (משלי כט:יג):


**From blows and from robbery** Heb. מתוך ומחמס, from blows and from robbery. I found [the following]: מִתּוֹךְ is an expression of “his innermost midst (תּוֹךְ),” men of plots, who plot iniquity, as (Prov. 29:13): “a man of deep thoughts (תככים).”


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:14:2)


**יִגְאַל נַפְשָׁם.** עַל יְדֵי מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה בָּהֶם:


**he will redeem their soul** through the justice and righteousness that he will perform for them.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:15:1)


**וִיחִי.** שְׁלֹמֹה:


**And may he live** Solomon.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:15:2)


**וְיִתֶּן לוֹ.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:


**and He will give him** The Holy One, blessed be He.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:15:3)


**מִזְּהַב שְׁבָא.** וְכֵן הָיְתָה: ״גַּם עֹשֶׁר גַּם כָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיָה כָמוֹךָ וְגוֹמֵר״ (מלכים א ג:יג):


**of the gold of Sheba** And so it was (I Kings 3:13): “both riches and honor, so that there shall not be any among the kings like you.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:15:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:15:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:15:4)


**וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ תָּמִיד וְגוֹ׳.** הִיא הַתְּפִלָּה הִיא הַבְּרָכָה; כְּשֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אוֹמֵר לָאָדָם: בָּרוּךְ תִּהְיֶה, לְשׁוֹן תְּפִלָּה הוּא:


**and may He pray for him constantly, etc.** The prayer and the blessing are identical. When the Holy One, blessed be He, says to a man, “You shall be blessed,” it is an expression of prayer.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:16:1)


**פִּסַּת בַּר.** לְשׁוֹן פִּסְיוֹן, תּוֹסֶפֶת וְרִבּוּי. וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּהוּ (כתובות קיא:; שבת ל:): לְשׁוֹן גְּלוּסְקָאוֹת לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ, וְכָל הַמִּזְמוֹר בְּמֶלֶךְ הַמָּשִׁיחַ. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **פִּסַּת בַּר** לְשׁוֹן רָצוֹן, כְּמוֹ פַּיִיס, שֶׁהַבְּרִיּוֹת מִתְפַּיְּסִין וּמִתְרַצִּין מֵאֵת הַמָּקוֹם כְּשֶׁנּוֹתֵן שׂוֹבַע בָּעוֹלָם:


**May there be an abundance of grain** Heb. פסת, an expression of spreading (פסיון), increase and abundance. Our Sages, however, explained this as an expression of loaves of white bread during the messianic era (Keth. 111b, Shab. 30b), and the entire psalm as referring to the messianic era. Another explanation: פִּסַת is an expression of good will, like פִּיוּס, placating; the people are appeased and accepted by the Holy One, blessed be He, when He gives plenty in the world.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:16:2)


**יִרְעַשׁ כַּלְּבָנוֹן פִּרְיוֹ.** חִטִּין גַּסִּין כְּפֵירוֹת הָאִילָן, כַּכְּלָיוֹת שֶׁל שׁוֹר הַגָּדוֹל, שֶׁהָיָה בִּימֵי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן שָׁטַח (כתובות קיא:):


**may its fruit rustle like Lebanon** May the wheat kernels be as thick as the kidneys of a large ox, as happened in the days of Shimon ben Shatach.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:16:3)


**וְיָצִיצוּ.** יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**and they will blossom forth** Israel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:16:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:16:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:16:4)


**מֵעִיר.** מִתּוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלַיִם **כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ**:


**from the city** From the midst of Jerusalem like the grass of the earth.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:17:1)


**יְהִי שְׁמוֹ.** שֶׁל שְׁלֹמֹה נִזְכָּר לְעוֹלָם בְּעָשְׁרוֹ וּבְחָכְמָתוֹ:


**May his name** [May] Solomon’s name be remembered forever for his riches and his wisdom.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:17:2)


**לִפְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ יִנּוֹן שְׁמוֹ.** כָּל יְמֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יִגְדַּל שְׁמוֹ:


**before the sun, his name will be magnified** All the days of the sun, his name will be magnified.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:17:3)


**יִנּוֹן.** לְשׁוֹן מַלְכוּת וְשָׂרָרָה, כְּמוֹ (משלי כט:כא) ״וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ יִהְיֶה מָנוֹן״, (בראשית כא:כג) ״וּלְנִינִי״ – הַשַּׁלִּיט עַל נְכָסַי אַחֲרַי, (תהלים עד:ח) ״אָמְרוּ בְלִבָּם נִינָם יָחַד״ – מַלְכֵיהֶם יָחַד (מגילה י:):


**will be magnified** Heb. ינון, an expression of kingdom and dominion, as (Prov. 29:21): “he will ultimately be a ruler (מנון) ; (Gen. 21:23), “and to my son (ולניני),” who rules over my property after me; (below 74:8), “They said in their heart, their rulers (נינם) together”; their kings together.


###### Rashi on Psalms 72:17:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:17:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:17:4)


**וְיִתְבָּרְכוּ בוֹ.** אָדָם אוֹמֵר לִבְנוֹ: תְּהִי חָכָם וְעָשִׁיר כִּשְׁלֹמֹה:


**will bless themselves with him** A person will say to his son, “May you be wise and rich like Solomon.”



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:18:1)


**בָּרוּךְ ה׳.** הָעוֹשֶׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת בְּרֶדֶת הָאֵשׁ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם עַל יְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בְּנִי (דברי הימים ב ז:א):


**Blessed is the Lord, etc., Who performs wonders alone** When the fire descended from the heavens through Solomon, his son.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 72:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/72:20:1)


**כָּלּוּ תְפִלּוֹת דָּוִד.** רַבּוֹתֵינוּ דָּרְשׁוּ כָּלּוּ, כָּל אֵלּוּ תְפִלּוֹת דָּוִד לִכְלוֹל כָּל הַסֵּפֶר עַל שֵׁם דָּוִד, וְאַף מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בְּנֵי קֹרַח וַעֲשָׂרָה זְקֵנִים עַל שֵׁם שֶׁהוּא נִקְרָא נְעִים זְמִירוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל (שמואל ב כג:א). וְיֵשׁ לִפְתּוֹר **כָּלּוּ** כְּמוֹ נִסְתַּיְּמוּ, כְּמוֹ ״רוֹמּוּ מְעַט״ (איוב כד:כד), ״שֹׁמּוּ שָׁמַיִם״ (ירמיה ב:יב). וְאִם כֵּן הוּא, לֹא נִכְתַּב הַמִּזְמוֹר בִּמְקוֹמוֹ, וְאֵין מֻקְדָּם וּמְאֻחָר בַּסֵּפֶר. וְנִרְאִין הַדְּבָרִים שֶׁלְּעֵת זִקְנָתוֹ, כְּשֶׁהִמְלִיךְ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹה, אֲמָרוֹ:


**The prayers of David...are completed** Heb. כלו. Our sages expounded on כָּלוּ to mean כָּל אֵלוּ, all these are the prayers of David son of Jesse, to include the entire Book on David’s nameeven what the sons of Korah and the ten elders said because he was known as (II Sam. 23:1) “the sweet singer of Israel.” כָּלוּ may also be interpreted as “were completed.” The construction of כָּלוּ is like (Job 24: 24): “They are taken away (רֹמוּ) in a second”; (Jer. 2:12), “O heavens, be astonished (שֹׁמוּ).” If this is so, this psalm was not written in its place, and there is no chronological order in the Book. The [subject] matter indicates that he said this in his old age, when he enthroned Solomon.



## Chapter 73


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:1:1)


**אַךְ טוֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלֹהִים.** לְפִי שֶׁעִנְיַן הַמִּזְמוֹר מְדַבֵּר בַּצָּרוֹת הַבָּאוֹת עַל עוֹבְדֵי הַמָּקוֹם, לְכָךְ פָּתַח בּוֹ כָּךְ. וְזֶהוּ פֵּרוּשׁוֹ: אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֲנִי צוֹעֵק וּמִתְמֵהַּ עַל צָרוֹתֵיהֶם שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל, יָדַעְתִּי כִּי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא טוֹב לָהֶם, וּלְטוֹבָתָם הוּא מֵבִיא עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת הָרָעָה כְּדֵי לְזַכּוֹתָם לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא:


**A song of Asaph. Truly God is good to Israel, etc.** Since the topic of this psalm deals with the troubles that befall Israel, he commences it in this manner. And this is the meaning: Although I cry out and am dismayed at Israel’s troubles, I knew that the Holy One, blessed be He, is good to them, and that He brings evil upon them for their own good, in order to give them merit in the life of the world to come.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:2:1)


**וַאֲנִי.** מִטֶּרֶם שׂוּמִי זֹאת אֶל לִבִּי:


**But as for me** before I laid this to my heart.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:2:2)


**כִּמְעַט נָטְיוּ רַגְלָי וְשֻׁפְּכוּ אֲשֻׁרַי.** לִנְטוֹת מֵאַחֲרֵי הַמָּקוֹם:


**my feet had almost turned away** and my steps swept away to turn away from following the Omnipresent.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:3:1)


**כִּי קִנֵּאתִי בַּהוֹלְלִים.** בִּמְעַרְבְּבֵי דַרְכֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי רוֹאֶה אֶת שְׁלוֹמָם:


**For I envied the perverse** Those who pervert their ways, whose tranquility I would see.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:3:2)


**בַּהוֹלְלִים.** מְעַרְבְּבִים, כְּמוֹ (ישעיהו א:כב) ״סָבְאֵךְ מָהוּל בַּמָּיִם״ (ס״א אינו):


**the perverse** Heb. בהוללים, mixed, as (Isa. 1:22): “your wine is diluted (מהול) with water.”



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:4:1)


**כִּי אֵין חַרְצֻבּוֹת לְמוֹתָם.** לְשׁוֹן אֲסִירָה, כְּמוֹ ״פַּתֵּחַ חַרְצֻבּוֹת רֶשַׁע״ (ישעיה נח:ו), מַסְגְּרֵי כַּבְלֵי רֶשַׁע שֶׁאוֹסְרִין בָּהֶן הָעֲנִיִּים. אַף כָּאן: אֵין יִסּוּרִין לְמִיתָתָם, הַמֵּתִים בָּהֶם מֵהֶם בְּרִיאִים **כְּאוּלָם**, בְּלֹא יִסּוּרִין. וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּ **חַרְצֻבּוֹת** נוֹטְרִיקוֹן: שֶׁאֵין חֲרֵדִין וְעַצְבִין מִיּוֹם הַמִּיתָה (שבת לא:). דָּבָר אַחֵר: שֶׁאֵין הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְאַחֵר צִבְיוֹנָם (פֵּרוּשׁ רְצוֹנָם):


**For there are no fetters to their death** Heb. חרצבות, an expression of tying, as (Isa. 58:6): “to undo the fetters (חרצבות) of wickedness,” meaning the locks of the fetters with which they bind the poor. Here, too, there are no pains to their death. Those who die among them die healthy, [strong as] a palace, without pains. But our Rabbis explained חַרְצֻבּוֹת as an abbreviation, meaning that they are not (שאין) frightened (חרדין) or saddened (עצבין) by the day of death (Shab. 31b). Another explanation: that the Holy One, blessed be He, does not delay (מאחר) their desire (צביונם).



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:6:1)


**לָכֵן עֲנָקַתְמוֹ גַאֲוָה.** בַּעֲבוּר זֶה שֶׁאֵין יִסּוּרִין בָּאִין עֲלֵיהֶם, הֶעֱנִיקָתַם הַגַּאֲוָה לַעֲלוֹת עַל צַוָּארָם גַּסּוּת הָרוּחַ:


**Therefore, they wear pride as a necklace** Because of this, pride adorns them as a necklace, insofar as it ascends upon his neck.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:6:2)


**יַעֲטֹף שִׁית חָמָס לָמוֹ.** הֶחָמָס שֶׁעוֹשִׂין, עוֹשֶׂה אוֹתָם שְׁמֵנִים וְעוֹטֵף אֶת שְׁתוֹתֵיהֶם וַעֲגָבוֹתֵיהֶם בְּעֹבִי שׁוּמָן וּבָשָׂר:


**the robbery that they commit envelopes their hips** The robbery they commit makes them fat, enveloping their buttocks and hips with thickness of fat and flesh.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:7:1)


**יָצָא מֵחֵלֶב עֵינֵימוֹ.** עֵינֵיהֶם בּוֹלְטוֹת מֵרֹב שׁוּמָן, כָּל אָדָם כָּחוּשׁ עֵינָיו מְשׁוּקָּעוֹת:


**Because of their fat, their eyes bulge** Their eyes bulge because of the abundant fat, for in an emaciated person, the eyes are sunken.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:7:2)


**עָבְרוּ מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת לֵבָב.** יוֹתֵר מִמַּה שֶּׁלִּבָּם מְיַחֵל וּמְצַפֶּה, בָּאָה לָהֶם תַּאֲוָתָם. עָבְרוּ בָּהֶם בְּהַשָּׂגַת יָדָם אֶת תַּאֲוַת לִבָּם:


**they surpassed the imaginings of their heart** More than what their heart hopes for and awaits, came to them. In the attainment of their hand, they surpassed the desire of their heart.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:8:1)


**יָמִיקוּ.** אֶת רֵעֵיהֶם:


**They consume** their neighbors.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:8:2)


**וִידַבְּרוּ בְרָע עֹשֶׁק.** לַעֲשׁוֹק אֶבְיוֹנִים:


**and speak wickedly about oppression** To oppress the needy.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:8:3)


**מִמָּרוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ.** כְּגוֹן פַּרְעֹה וְסַנְחֵרִיב וּנְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר: ״מִי ה׳ אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁמַע בְּקוֹלוֹ״ (שמות ה:ב), ״מִי בְּכָל אֱלֹהֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת״ (מלכים ב יח:לה), ״אֶעֱלֶה עַל בָּמֳתֵי עָב״ (ישעיהו יד:יד). וְזֶהוּ שָׁתוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם:


**they speak about the Most High** e.g. Pharaoh, Sennacherib, and Nebuchadnezzar. [Pharaoh said] (Exod. 5:2): “Who is the Lord that I should obey Him?” [Sennacherib said] (Isa. 36:20), “Who are they among all the gods of the lands...?” [Nebuchadnezzar said] (Isa. 14:14), “I will ascend above the heights of the clouds.” That is the meaning of: “They have set their mouth against Heaven.”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:10:1)


**לָכֵן יָשׁוּב עַמּוֹ הֲלֹם.** לְפִי שֶׁעַמּוֹ רוֹאִים ״דֶּרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים צָלֵחָה״ (ירמיה יב:א), יָשׁוּבוּ עַל דֶּרֶךְ הָרְשָׁעִים לָלֶכֶת בְּדַרְכֵיהֶם:


**Therefore, His people will return here** Since His people sees that the way of the wicked prospers, they will return on the way of the wicked, to adopt their ways.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:10:2)


**הֲלֹם.** כְּמוֹ ״מִי הֲבִיאֲךָ הֲלֹם״ (שופטים יח:ג) – פֹּה:


**here** Heb. הלם, as (Jud. 18: 3): “Who brought you here (הלום)?” [Equivalent to] פֹּה.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:10:3)


**וּמֵי מָלֵא יִמָּצוּ לָמוֹ.** וּמַיִם שֶׁל פֶּלֶג הַמָּלֵא, הֵם דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה, נֶחְשָׁבִים לָמוֹ תַּמְצִית וּמְזֻלְזָלִים בְּעֵינֵיהֶם:


**and the waters of the full are drain water to them** And the waters of the full stream—they are words of Torah—are considered by them as water that drains out, and they despise them.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:11:1)


**וְאָמְרוּ אֵיכָה יָדַע אֵל.** אֵיכָה נוּכַל לוֹמַר שֶׁ**יֵּשׁ דֵּעָה** בְּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וְתוֹרָתוֹ אֱמֶת?


**And they say, “How does God know”** How can we say that there is knowledge in the Holy One, blessed be He, and that His Torah is true?



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:12:1)


**הִנֵּה אֵלֶּה רְשָׁעִים.** הֵם וְעוֹבְרִים עַל תּוֹרָתוֹ, וַהֲרֵי הֵם שְׁלֵוִים בָּעוֹלָם וּמַגְדִּילִים כֹּחַ וְעֹשֶׁר:


**Behold these are wicked** They [are wicked] and transgress His Torah; yet they are tranquil in the world and increase power and wealth.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:12:2)


**וְשַׁלְוֵי עוֹלָם.** לְשׁוֹן שַׁלְוָה:


**they are tranquil in the world** An expression of tranquility.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:12:3)


**הִשְׂגּוּ.** הִגְדִּילוּ, וּמְנַחֵם פֵּירֵשׁ ״יָשׁוּב עַמּוֹ הֲלוֹם״ (תהלים י:י), יָשׁוּב הָרָשָׁע לַהֲלוֹם אֶת עַמּוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא. וְהָרִאשׁוֹן לָמַדְתִּי מִדְּבָרָיו שֶׁל רַבִּי מֵאִיר בַּר יִצְחָק שְׁלִיחַ צִבּוּר זַצַ״ל:


**have increased** Heb. השגו, have increased. Menachem (p. 72) explains: יָשוּב עַמוֹ הֲלוֹם, the wicked will return to crush (להלם) the people of the Holy One, blessed be He. The first interpretation I learned from the words of Rabbi Meir the son of Isaac, the cantor, may the memory of the righteous be for a blessing.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:13:1)


**אַךְ רִיק זִכִּיתִי לְבָבִי.** כָּל זֶה מוּסָב עַל **וְאָמְרוּ אֵיכָה יָדַע אֵל**, וְגַם אוֹמֵר: אַךְ לָרִיק וְעַל חִנָּם אָנוּ שׁוֹמְרִים מִצְווֹתָיו שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וַהֲרֵי אָנוּ נְגוּעִים כָּל הַיּוֹם:


**But for nought I cleansed my heart** All this refers back to: “And they say, ‘How does God know?’” They also say, “But for nothing and in vain we keep the commandments of the Holy One, blessed be He, for behold, we are plagued all the days.”



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:14:1)


**וְתוֹכַחְתִּי.** נִרְאֵית כָּל הַיּוֹם תָּמִיד, מִבֹּקֶר לְבֹקֶר מִתְחַדְּשׁוֹת צָרוֹת חֲדָשׁוֹת:


**and my chastisement** appears all day; constantly, from morning to morning, new troubles are renewed.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:15:1)


**אִם אָמַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כְמוֹ.** אָמַר אָסָף: אִם אָמַרְתִּי בְּלִבִּי לְסַפֵּר אֶת הַכֹּל כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוּא, כָּל מַה שֶּׁעַמּוֹ אוֹמֵר עַל זֹאת:


**If I said, “I shall tell it as it is”** Said Asaph, “If I said in my heart to tell everything as it is, all that His people say about this.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:15:2)


**הִנֵּה דוֹר בָּנֶיךָ בָגָדְתִּי.** כְּלוֹמַר אָשִׂים אוֹתָם בּוֹגְדִים וּרְשָׁעִים:


**behold I have made the generation of Your children into traitors** That is to say that I would make them into traitors and wicked men.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:16:1)


**וָאֲחַשְּׁבָה.** בְּלִבִּי:


**And when I ponder** in my heart.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:16:2)


**לָדַעַת זֹאת.** מַה הִיא מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא. כֵּן **הוּא עָמָל בְּעֵינַי.** נִרְאֵית הָיְתָה מִדָּה זֹאת לִי עָמָל וְלֹא מִשְׁפָּט:


**to know this** what the manner of the Holy One, blessed be He, is. **So it is iniquity in my eyes**. This manner appeared to me as iniquity and not justice.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:17:1)


**עַד.** אֲשֶׁר בָּאתִי **אֶל מִקְדְּשֵׁי אֵל.** אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, וְרָאִיתִי מַה שֶּׁאֵרַע בְּסַנְחֵרִיב (מלכים ב יט:לה-לו), וְאָז הֵבִינוֹתִי לְאַחֲרִית הָרְשָׁעִים שֶׁהוּא לַאֲבַדּוֹן וְאָמַרְתִּי: אַךְ כָּל הַטּוֹבָה הַבָּאָה לָהֶם חֲלָקוֹת הֵם, שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מַחֲלִיק לָהֶם הַדֶּרֶךְ שֶׁלָּהֶם, שֶׁתְּהֵא נוֹחָה וַחֲלָקָה, לְמַעַן לֹא יִתְּנוּ לֵב לָשׁוּב אֵלָיו וְיֹאבְדוּ:


**Until** I came **to the sanctuaries of God**, which are in Jerusalem, and saw what happened to Sennacherib. Then I understood the end of the wicked, that it is to destruction. Then I said, “All the good that comes to them is only slippery places; for the Holy One, blessed be He, makes their way slippery, that it should be easy and smooth, so that they should not put their heart to return to Him, and they should perish.”



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:18:1)


**אַךְ בַּחֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁית לָמוֹ.** כָּל הַטּוֹבָה הַבָּאָה לָהֶם, שֶׁהֲרֵי סוֹפָם **הִפַּלְתָּם לְמַשּׁוּאוֹת**:


**Only in slippery places do You set them** All the goodness that comes to them, for ultimately, You cast them down to ruin.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:19:1)


**מִן בַּלָּהוֹת.** מִן שֵׁדִים:


**by terrors** By demons.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:20:1)


**כַּחֲלוֹם מֵהָקִיץ.** כְּשֵׁינָה שֶׁאֵין לָהּ קֵץ, שֶׁהוּא שֵׁינַת עוֹלָם, כֵּן הָיְתָה לָהֶם: ״וַיֵּצֵא מַלְאַךְ ה׳ וַיַּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה אַשּׁוּר״ (ישעיהו לז:לו; מלכים ב יט:לה):


**As a dream without awakening** As a sleep without end (without awakening), which is an eternal sleep, so did they have (Isa. 37:36): “And an angel of the Lord went forth and slew...of the camp of Assyria.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:20:2)


**אֲדֹנָי בָּעִיר צַלְמָם תִּבְזֶה.** בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, שֶׁהֵרֵעוּ עָלֶיהָ, שָׁם נִתְבַּזָּה צֶלֶם דְּמוּתָם וְנִשְׂרְפוּ כֻּלָּם:


**O Lord, in the city You will despise their form** In Jerusalem, with which they dealt evilly, there the form of their image was despised, and they were all burnt.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:21:1)


**כִּי יִתְחַמֵּץ לְבָבִי.** מִטֶּרֶם שֶׁרָאִיתִי מַפָּלָה זוֹ בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ הָיָה לְבָבִי מִתְחַמֵּץ עַל דֶּרֶךְ הָרְשָׁעִים שֶׁצָּלְחָה (ירמיה יב:א), וּבְכִלְיוֹתַי הָיִיתִי מִשְׁתּוֹנָן, לְשׁוֹן חֶרֶב שָׁנוּן (משלי כה:יח), וּכְשֶׁהוּא מִתְפַּעֵל הַתָּי״ו נִתֶּנֶת בְּאֶמְצַע שֹׁרֶשׁ הַתֵּיבָה כְּדֶרֶךְ כָּל תֵּיבָה שֶׁיְּסוֹד תְּחִלָּתָהּ שִׁי״ן:


**For my heart was in ferment** Before I saw this downfall with the holy spirit, my heart was in ferment because the way of the wicked prospered, and my mind was on edge (אשתונן), an expression of a sharpened sword (שנון). When it is reflexive, the “tav” is placed in the middle of the radical, as is the case of every word whose radical commences with “shin.”



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:22:1)


**וַאֲנִי.** הָיִיתִי **בַעַר** וְלֹא הָיִיתִי יוֹדֵעַ מַה הִיא הַמִּדָּה, **וְכִבְהֵמָה הָיִיתִי עִמָּךְ**:


**But I** was brutish, and I did not know what this manner was, and I was as a beast with You.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:23:1)


**וַאֲנִי.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהָיִיתִי רוֹאֶה כָּל זֶה, **תָּמִיד הָיִיתִי עִמָּךְ.** וְלֹא זַזְתִּי מִיִּרְאָתְךָ:


**Yet I** Although I saw all this constantly, I was with You, and I did not move from fear of You.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:23:2)


**אָחַזְתָּ בְּיַד יְמִינִי.** לְהַחֲזִיקֵנִי בְּיִרְאָתְךָ, כְּשֶׁקָּרְבוּ רַגְלַי לִנְטוֹת מִדַּרְכֶּךָ; כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר לְמַעְלָה **כִּמְעַט נָטָיוּ רַגְלָי**:


**You grasped my right hand** to strengthen me in Your fear when my feet are about to turn from Your way, as it is stated above (verse 2): “my feet had almost turned away.”



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:24:1)


**תַּנְחֵנִי.** נְחִיתַנִי:


**You led me** Heb. תנחני, [like] נחיתני, You led me.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:24:2)


**וְאַחַר כָּבוֹד תִּקָּחֵנִי.** אִלּוּ הָיָה טַעַם עַל כָּבוֹד, הָיָה פִּתְרוֹנוֹ: לְאַחַר שֶׁהִשְׁלַמְתָּ לְסַנְחֵרִיב כָּל הַכָּבוֹד שֶׁפָּסַקְתָּ לוֹ, תִּקָּחֵנוּ אֵלֶיךָ. הִפְלֵאתָ נִסֶּיךָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֶחֱרַבְתָּ אֶת סַנְחֵרִיב. עַכְשָׁיו שֶׁהַטַּעַם עַל וְאַחַרֵי כֵּן, זֶה פִּתְרוֹנוֹ: **וְאַחַר**, לְכָבוֹד תִּקָּחֵנִי – מְשַׁכְתַּנִי אֵלֶיךָ לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאֶרֶת:


**and after[wards], You took me [for] glory** If the cantillation sign were on כָּבוֹד, its interpretation would be: After You bestowed upon Sennacherib all the glory You had allotted to him, You will take me to You. You have performed wondrous miracles for Israel and have destroyed Sennacherib. Now that the cantillation sign is on ואחר, this is its interpretation: (and afterwards,) You took me to glory; You drew me to You for glory and beauty.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:25:1)


**מִי לִי בַשָּׁמָיִם.** שׁוּם מַלְאָךְ שֶׁבָּחַרְתִּי לִי לֶאֱלוֹהַּ? לֹא בָחַרְתִּי אֶלָּא אוֹתְךָ:


**For whom do I have in heaven** [Was there] any angel that I chose for me as a god? I chose only You.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:26:1)


**כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי.** נִתְאַוָּה בְּשָׂרִי וּלְבָבִי לְךָ:


**My flesh...yearn** My flesh and my heart yearn for You.


###### Rashi on Psalms 73:26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:26:2)


**כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי.** לְשׁוֹן תַּאֲוָה, כְּמוֹ ״כָּלְתָה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ נַפְשִׁי״ (תהלים קיט:פא):


**yearn** Heb. כלה, an expression of desire, as (119:81): “My soul yearned (כלתה) for Your salvation.”



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:27:1)


**זוֹנֶה מִמֶּךָּ.** נִפְרָד מִמְּךָ:


**who strays from You** Who separates himself from You.



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Psalms 73:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/73:28:1)


**מַלְאֲכוֹתֶיךָ.** שְׁלִיחוּתֶיךָ, רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ הַבָּא בְּלִבִּי לֵאמֹר:


**Your mission** Your message; the holy spirit that comes into my heart to say it.



## Chapter 74


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:1:1)


**יֶעְשַׁן אַפֶּךָ.** כָּל הַכּוֹעֵס, נְחִירָיו מוֹצִיאִין עָשָׁן:


**is Your wrath kindled** lit. do Your nostrils smoke. Whenever one is angry, the nostrils emit smoke.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:2:1)


**קָנִיתָ קֶדֶם.** לִפְנֵי בְּרִייַת עוֹלָם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ, בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יֻלָּדוּ״ (תהלים צ:א-ב):


**which You acquired from time immemorial** Before the creation of the world, as it is said (below 90: 1,2): “You were a dwelling place for us, etc., before mountains were formed.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:2:2)


**זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ.** תִּקּוּן לָשׁוֹן הוּא, כְּמוֹ ״זוּ חָטָאנוּ לוֹ״ (ישעיהו מב:כד), וְהוּא כְּמוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ:


**on which You dwelt** Heb. זה שכנתבו, this upon which You dwelt. This is an improvement of the language, as (Isa. 42: 24): “against whom (זו) we sinned.” It is like אשר שכנתבו, on which You dwelt.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:3:1)


**הָרִימָה פְעָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת נֶצַח.** הַגְבֵּהַּ פְּעִימוֹת וּבֶהָלוֹת שֶׁלְּךָ שֶׁיְּהוּ לְאוֹיְבֶיךָ **לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת נֶצַח**, עַל כָּל אֲשֶׁר **הֵרַע** הָאוֹיֵב בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ. כֵּן חִבְּרוֹ מְנַחֵם עִם ״וַתִּפָּעֶם רוּחוֹ״ (בראשית מא:ח):


**Raise Your blows to inflict eternal ruin** Raise Your blows and Your terrors that Your enemies will experience as eternal ruin for every evil thing that the enemy did in the Temple. In this manner, Menachem (p. 144) associates it with (Gen. 41:8): “that his spirit was troubled (ותפעם).”


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:3:2)


**לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת.** לְשׁוֹן חֻרְבָּן, כְּמוֹ ״שָׁאִיָּה״ (ישעיהו כד:יב), ״תִּשָּׁאֶה שְׁמָמָה״ (ישעיהו ו:יא) (ס״א אינו):


**to...ruin** Heb. למשאות, an expression of destruction, as (Isa. 24:12): “through desolation (שאיה)”; (Isa. 6:11), “and the ground lies waste (למשאות) and desolate.”



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:4:1)


**מוֹעֲדֶךָ.** הוּא בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, אֲשֶׁר נֶאֱמַר בּוֹ ״וְנוֹעַדְתִּי לְךָ שָׁם״ (שמות כה:כב):


**Your meeting place** That is the Temple about which it is said (Exod. 25:22): וְנוֹעַדְתִּי לְךָ שָׁם, “There I will meet with you at appointed times.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:4:2)


**שָׂמוּ אוֹתוֹתָם.** כְּשֶׁגָּבְרָה יָדָם לְהַחֲרִיבוֹ, אָז שָׂמוּ לָהֶם אֶת אוֹתוֹת קְסָמֵיהֶם שֶׁהֵם אוֹתוֹת אֱמֶת. וּמָה הֵם הַקְּסָמִים? ״קִלְקַל בַּחִצִּים שָׁאַל בַּתְּרָפִים״ (יחזקאל כא:כו):


**they made their signs for signs** When they became powerful enough to destroy it, then they themselves accepted that the signs of their divination were true signs. Now what were their divinations? “He shook the arrows, he consulted the terafim.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:5:1)


**יוֹדַע כְּמֵבִיא לְמַעְלָה בִּסְבָךְ עֵץ קַרְדֻּמּוֹת.** יִוָּדַע הָאוֹיֵב, כְּשֶׁהָיָה מַכֶּה בְּשַׁעֲרֵי פִּתְחֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, שֶׁהוּא כְּמֵבִיא מַכּוֹתָיו לְמַעְלָה בָּרָקִיעַ. וּמִנַּיִן הָיָה יוֹדֵעַ? שֶׁהֲרֵי הָיָה רוֹאֶה שֶׁהָיָה הָעֵץ מְסַבֵּךְ וְאוֹחֵז אֶת הַקַּרְדֻּמּוֹת וּבוֹלְעָן, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ (סנהדרין צו:): כּוּלְּהוּ בְּלַעְתִּינְהוּ חַד תַּרְעָא דִּירוּשָׁלַיִם:


**May he be known as though bringing on high; the hatchets were in the thicket of the trees** The enemy knows that when he strikes the gates of the entrances of the Sanctuary, it was as though he was bringing his blows on high, even into the sky. Now how did he know it? For he would see that the trees would entangle, grasp, and swallow up the hatchets, as our Rabbis said (Sanh. 96b): One gate of Jerusalem swallowed them all up.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:5:2)


**בְּסֹבֶךְ עֵץ קַרְדֻּמּוֹת.** לְשׁוֹן ״נֶאֱחַז בַּסְּבַךְ״ (בראשית כב:יג), הָעֵץ סוֹבֵךְ אוֹתָם וְהֵם נִסְבָּכִין בּוֹ:


**the hatchets were in the thicket of the trees** Heb. בסבך-עץ, an expression of (Gen. 22:13): “caught in the thicket (בסבך).” The tree entangles them, and they become entangled in it.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:6:1)


**וְעַתָּה.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהָיָה רוֹאֶה שֶׁלִּפְנֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא קָשֶׁה, לֹא נִמְנַע מִלְּהַלֹּם כָּל פְּתָּחֶיהָ וְכָל שְׁעָרֶיהָ **יָחַד**:


**And now** although he saw that this troubled the Holy One, blessed be He, he did not refrain from striking all its entrances and all its gates together.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:6:2)


**בְּכַשִּׁיל וְכֵילַפֹּת.** כְּלֵי מַשְׁחִית שֶׁל נַגָּרִים הֵם, ״וּבְקַרְדֻּמּוֹת בָּאוּ לָהּ״ (ירמיהו מו:כב) תַּרְגּוּם יוֹנָתָן ״בְּכַשִׁילַיָּא״. כֵּילַפֹּת לְשׁוֹן עֲרָבִי הוּא, כָּךְ פֵּרֵשׁ דּוֹנָשׁ, וְהוּא מִכְּלֵי הַנַּגָּרִים:


**with hatchets and hammers** They are tools of destruction used by carpenters (Jer. 46:22): “and will come against her with axes (ובקרדמות).” Jonathan renders: בּכשיליא. כֵּילַפּוֹת is Arabic. This is how Dunash (p. 34) explained it, and it is one of the carpenters’ tools.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:6:3)


**יַהֲלֹמוּן.** הָאוֹיְבִים:


**they strike** The enemies [strike].



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:8:1)


**אָמְרוּ בְלִבָּם נִינָם יָחַד.** נִינָם מוֹשְׁלֵיהֶם, וְכֵן (תהלים עב:יז) ״יָנוֹן שְׁמוֹ״, (משלי כט:כא) ״וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ יִהְיֶה מָנוֹן״. כָּל מוֹשְׁלֵיהֶם מַחֲשָׁבָה אַחַת לָהֶם, הָרִאשׁוֹנִים כָּאַחֲרוֹנִים, לְהִזְדַּוֵּג לְפַטְרוֹנָם שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּחִלָּה וְאַחַר כָּךְ יִזְדַּוְּגוּ לָהֶם. וְתֵדַע שֶׁהֲרֵי **שָׂרְפוּ כָל מוֹעֲדֵי אֵל** שֶׁהָיוּ **בָּאָרֶץ**, כָּל בָּתֵּי וַעַד שֶׁלּוֹ: פְּלִשְׁתִּים הֶחֱרִיבוּ שִׁילֹה, נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר הֶחֱרִיב בַּיִת רִאשׁוֹן, וַאֲחֵרִים הֶחֱרִיבוּ בַּיִת שֵׁנִי:


**They said in their heart, their rulers together** Heb. נינם, their rulers, and similarly (above 72: 17): “his name will be magnified (ינון) ; (Prov. 29:21), “he will ultimately be a ruler (מנון).” All their rulers devise one plot, the first as the last: namely, to get at the protector of Israel first and afterwards they would get at them [Israel], You should know this by the fact that they burned all the meeting places of God in the land, all His meeting houses. The Philistines destroyed Shiloh; Nebuchadnezzar destroyed the First Temple; Titus destroyed the Second Temple.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:9:1)


**אוֹתוֹתֵינוּ.** שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּנוּ בְּיַד נְבִיאֶיךָ, אֵין אָנוּ רוֹאִים אוֹתָם בְּיָמִים רַבִּים שֶׁאָנוּ בַּגּוֹלָה. נִתְנַבֵּא אָסָף עַל יְמֵי הַגָּלוּת:


**our signs** which You promised us through Your prophets—we have not seen them in the many days that we have been in exile. Asaph prophesied concerning the days of the (last) exile.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:9:2)


**עַד מָה.** עַד מָתַי נִהְיֶה בַּצָּרָה זוֹ?


**how long** How long we will be in this trouble.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:11:1)


**מִקֶּרֶב חֵיקְךָ כַלֵּה.** הַשְׁלִיכָהּ וְהוֹצֵא אוֹתָהּ מִתּוֹךְ חֵיקְךָ וְהִלָּחֵם בְּאוֹיְבֶיךָ, **כַּלֵּה** לְשׁוֹן גָּרֵשׁ כְּמוֹ ״כָּלָה גָּרֵשׁ יְגָרֵשׁ״ (שמות יא:א):


**Draw it out from within Your bosom** Cast it and draw it out from within Your bosom and wage battle with Your enemies. כַּלֵה is an expression of driving out, as (Exod. 11:1): “he will drive you out completely (כלה).”



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:12:1)


**וֵאלֹהִים מַלְכִּי מִקֶּדֶם.** וַהֲרֵי אַתָּה תְּשׁוּעָתֵנוּ מִקֶּדֶם:


**But God is my King from time immemorial** Behold, You were our salvation from time immemorial.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:13:1)


**רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים.** הֵם מִצְרַיִם שֶׁנִּקְרְאוּ תַנִּינִים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״הַתַּנִּים הַגָּדוֹל וְגוֹ׳״ (יחזקאל כט:ג):


**the beads of the sea monsters** They are the Egyptians, who are called sea monsters, as it is said (Ezek. 29:3): “the great sea monster, etc.”



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:14:1)


**רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן.** פַּרְעֹה נִקְרָא כֵּן, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״יִפְקֹד ה׳ בְּחַרְבּוֹ הַקָּשָׁה עַל לִוְיָתָן וְגוֹ׳״ (ישעיה כז:א):


**the heads of Leviathan** Pharaoh is called [by] this [name], as it is said (Isa. 27:1): “the Lord will visit with His hard...sword on leviathan, etc.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:14:2)


**תִּתְּנֶנּוּ מַאֲכָל לְעָם לְצִיִּים.** נָתַתָּ מָמוֹנוֹ לְעַם יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאָכְלוֹ, לְצִיִּים לְכִתּוֹת וּצְבָאוֹת שֶׁהוֹצֵאתָ:


**You give it as food to the people in companies** You gave his money to the people of Israel to consume. **in companies** Heb. לציים. To the companies and hosts that You took out.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:14:3)


**צִיִּים.** סִיעוֹת, כְּמוֹ (במדבר כד:כד) ״וְצִים מִיַּד כִּתִּים״ כְּתַרְגּוּמוֹ ״וְסִיעָן״:


ציים are companies, as (Num. 24:24): “And companies from the Kittites,” which is translated as וסיען, and companies.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:15:1)


**אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ.** לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הַצּוּר מַעְיָנוֹת (שמות יז:ו):


**You split** for Israel fountains from the rock.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:15:2)


**אַתָּה הוֹבַשְׁתָּ.** יַרְדֵּן, שֶׁהוּא נָהָר אֵיתָן (יהושע ג:טו):


**You dried up** the Jordan, which is a mighty river.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:16:1)


**לְךָ יוֹם.** גְּאֻלָּתָם שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**Day is Yours** The redemption of Israel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:16:2)


**אַף לְךָ לָיְלָה.** וְעַמְּךָ הָיוּ בְּצָרוֹת הַלָּיְלָה:


**even night is Yours** And they were with You in the darkness of the night.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:16:3)


**אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָׁמֶשׁ.** אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ לָהֶם מְאוֹר הַתּוֹרָה:


**You established the luminary and the sun** You established the light of the Torah for them.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:17:1)


**אַתָּה הִצַּבְתָּ.** לָהֶם כָּל גְּבוּלוֹת אַרְצָם בְּכָל טוֹב:


**You set** for them all the boundaries of their land with all good.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:17:2)


**קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם.** הֲרֵי זֶה דּוּגְמַת ״שְׁבֻעוֹת חֻקּוֹת קָצִיר יִשְׁמָר לָנוּ״ (ירמיהו ה:כד), לֹא שִׁנִּיתָ לָנוּ סֵדֶר הַשָּׁנִים:


**summer and winter—You formed them** This is similar to (Jer. 5:24): “the weeks of the laws of harvest He keeps for us.” You did not alter for us the order of the years.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:18:1)


**זְכֹר זֹאת אוֹיֵב וְגוֹ׳.** וְאַחֲרֵי שֶׁכָּל תְּשׁוּעָתֵנוּ בְּךָ, זְכֹר זֹאת, אֲשֶׁר הָאוֹיֵב חֵרֵף אוֹתְךָ בְּהַשְׁמִידוֹ אוֹתָנוּ:


**Remember how the enemy, etc.** And since all our salvation is through You, remember how the enemy reviled You by destroying us.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:19:1)


**אַל תִּתֵּן לְחַיַּת.** לִגְדוּדֵי הָאֻמּוֹת, כְּמוֹ ״וַיֵּאָסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לַחַיָּה״ (שמואל ב כג:יא):


**Do not deliver to the company** To the companies of the nations, as (II Sam. 23:11): “Now the Philistines were gathered together into a troop (לחיה).”


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:19:2)


**נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹרֶךָ.** תּוֹר שֶׁלְּךָ. וְיוֹנָתָן תִּרְגֵּם לְשׁוֹן ״תּוֹרִים״ וּ״בְנֵי יוֹנָה״ (ויקרא א:יד). הַתּוֹר הַזֶּה, מִשֶּׁמֵּת הַזָּכָר, בֶּן זוּגָהּ, אֵינָהּ מִזְדַּוֶּגֶת לְאַחֵר. אַף יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא הֶחֱלִיפוּךָ בְּאֵל אַחֵר, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁרִחַקְתָּ מֵהֶם וְהָיוּ כְּאַלְמָנָה (שיר השירים רבה א:סג):


**the soul of Your turtledove** Heb. תורך, Your turtledove. And Jonathan rendered this as (sic) an expression of turtledoves and young pigeons. This turtledoveas soon as the male recognizes its mate, it does not mate with another. So have Israel not exchanged You for another god, although You have distanced Yourself from them and they were like a widow.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:19:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:19:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:19:3)


**חַיַּת עֲנִיֶּיךָ.** נֶפֶשׁ עֲנִיֶּיךָ:


**the soul of Your poor ones** Heb. חית ענייך, the soul of Your poor ones.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:20:1)


**הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית.** אֲשֶׁר כָּרַתָּ אֶת אֲבוֹתֵינוּ:


**Look to the covenant** which You formed with our forefathers.


###### Rashi on Psalms 74:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:20:2)


**נְאוֹת חָמָס.** נְוֵה חָמָס, לְשׁוֹן מָדוֹר:


**with dwellings of violence** Heb. נאות חמס, a dwelling of violence, an expression of a dwelling place.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:21:1)


**אַל יָשׁוֹב דַּךְ נִכְלָם.** אַל יָשׁוֹב דַּךְ מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, בִּתְפִלָּתוֹ, נִכְלָם:


**Let not the poor turn back in disgrace** Let the poor not turn back from before You disgraced in his prayer.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Psalms 74:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/74:22:1)


**חֶרְפָּתְךָ.** גִּדּוּפֶיךָ, כְּמוֹ **זֹאת אוֹיֵב חֵרֵף**:


**Your disgrace** Your blasphemies, as (verse 18): “Remember how the enemy reviled.”



## Chapter 75


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:1:1)


**אַל תַּשְׁחֵת.** אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל (שו״ט עה:א):


**al tashcheth** [lit. do not destroy] Israel.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:2:1)


**הוֹדִינוּ לְךָ אֱלֹהִים.** עַל הַטּוֹבָה הוֹדִינוּ אַף עַל הָרָעָה, **וְקָרוֹב** בְּפִינוּ שִׁמְךָ תָּמִיד (ברכות נד.):


**We have thanked You, O God** for the good; we have thanked also for the evil. **and...is near** Your name is always near in our mouth.


###### Rashi on Psalms 75:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:2:2)


**סִפְּרוּ.** דּוֹרוֹתֵינוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ תָּמִיד:


**they have told** Our generations [have] constantly [told] Your wonders.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:3:1)


**כִּי אֶקַּח מוֹעֵד.** כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לָנוּ יוֹם טוֹב, אֵין אָנוּ עֲסוּקִים בְּנִבּוּל פֶּה וְקַלּוּת רֹאשׁ:


**When I take a festive day** When we have a festival, we do not engage in obscenity and levity, as [do] all the nations.


###### Rashi on Psalms 75:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:3:2)


**אֲנִי מֵישָׁרִים אֶשְׁפֹּט.** אָנוּ נוֹתְנִין אֶל לִבֵּנוּ לְהַלֶּלְךָ וּלְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ מֵעֵין הַמְּאֹרָע לַיּוֹם:


**I shall judge with fairness** We take it to our heart to praise You and laud You according to the incident of that day.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:4:1)


**נְמוֹגִים אֶרֶץ וְכָל יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ וְגוֹ׳.** בְּיוֹם מַתַּן תּוֹרָה, כְּשֶׁהָיוּ נְמוֹגִים הָאָרֶץ וְכָל יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ מִתְּנַאי שֶׁהִתְנֵיתָ עִם מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית (שבת פח.): אִם לֹא יְקַבְּלוּ וְכוּ׳ תַּחְזְרוּ לְתֹהוּ וָבֹהוּ:


**When the earth and all its inhabitants were melting away, etc.** On the day of the giving of the Torah, when the earth and all its inhabitants were melting away because of the condition You made with the Creation: that if Israel did not accept the Torah, you would return it [the earth] to void and chaos.


###### Rashi on Psalms 75:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:4:2)


**תִּכַּנְתִּי עַמּוּדֶיהָ.** כְּשֶׁאָמַרְתִּי: ״נַעֲשֶׂה וְנִשְׁמַע״ (שמות כד:ז):


**I** Your people, Israel. **established its pillars** when I said, “We will do and we will hear.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:5:1)


**לַהוֹלְלִים.** לָרְשָׁעִים הַמְעַרְבְּבִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**to the perverse** To the wicked, who confuse Israel.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:7:1)


**כִּי לֹא מִמּוֹצָא.** הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וּמִמַּעֲרָבוֹ, וְלֹא מִן הַמִּדְבָּרוֹת שֶׁאַתֶּם מְפָרְשִׂים בְּשַׁיָּרָא לְהַרְבּוֹת מָמוֹן, לֹא בְכָל אֵלֶּה לְהָרִים קֶרֶן:


**For it is not from the east** of the sun or from its setting, and not from the deserts where you embark on a journey by caravan to increase [your] property; there is no power in any of these to raise [your] horn.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:8:1)


**כִּי אֱלֹהִים שׁוֹפֵט.** עַל כָּל הָרָעָה שֶׁעֲשִׂיתֶם:


**But God judges** [you] for all the evil that you have done.


###### Rashi on Psalms 75:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:8:2)


**זֶה יַשְׁפִּיל וְזֶה יָרִים.** הַגְּבוֹהִים יַשְׁפִּיל וְהַנְּמוּכִים יָרִים (תנחומא, מטות ט):


**He humbles this one and elevated that one** The elevated one He lowers, and the lowly He elevates.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:9:1)


**כִּי כוֹס.** הַתַּרְעֵלָה בְּיָדוֹ:


**For a cup** of weakness is in His hand.


###### Rashi on Psalms 75:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:9:2)


**וְיַיִן חָמַר.** חָזָק, וִינוֹ״שׁ בְּלַעַ״ז:


**and strong wine** Heb. חמר, strong. Vinos, or vinose, in Old French.


###### Rashi on Psalms 75:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:9:3)


**מָלֵא מֶסֶךְ.** הַכּוֹס מָלֵא מֶזֶג, לִמְזֹג וּלְהַשְׁקוֹת אֶת כָּל הַגּוֹיִם:


**a full mixture** The cup is full of a mixture, to mix and give all the nations to drink.


###### Rashi on Psalms 75:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:9:4)


**וַיַּגֵּר מִזֶּה.** מִזֶּה הַכּוֹס יָפִיץ וְיִקְלַח אֶת מִשְׁתֵּיהֶם, לְשׁוֹן ״כְּמַיִם מֻגָּרִים״ (מיכה א:ד):


**and He pours out of this** Out of this cup, He will pour and cause to gush forth their drinks, an expression of (Micah 1:4): “as water poured (מגרים) down a steep place.”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:10:1)


**וַאֲנִי אַגִּיד לְעוֹלָם.** מֵאָז וָהָלְאָה, אֶת נִקְמָתוֹ וּגְבוּרָתוֹ:


**And I shall recite forever** From then on, [I will recite] His vengeance and His might.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 75:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:11:1)


**וְכָל קַרְנֵי רְשָׁעִים.** שֶׁל עֲמָלֶק:


**And all the horns of the wicked** of Esau.


###### Rashi on Psalms 75:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/75:11:2)


**אֲגַדֵּעַ.** כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (יחזקאל כה:יד) ״וְנָתַתִּי אֶת נִקְמָתִי בֶאֱדוֹם בְּיַד עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל, יִשְׂרָאֵל יְגַדְּעוּ קֶרֶן עֲמָלֵק וְגוֹ׳״, וְאָז **תְּרוֹמַמְנָה קַרְנוֹת צַדִּיק** שֶׁל עוֹלָם יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהֵם שִׁבְחוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:


**I shall cut off** As the matter that is stated (Ezek. 29: 14): “And I shall lay My vengeance against Edom by the hand of My people, Israel.” They will cut off the horn of Esau (the enemy), and then the horns of the Righteous One of the world—Israel, who are the praise of the Holy One, blessed be Hewill be upraised.



## Chapter 76


### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 76:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:4:1)


**שָׁמָּה שִׁבַּר רִשְׁפֵי קָשֶׁת.** שֶׁל סַנְחֵרִיב וְאוּכְלוּסָיו (מלכים ב יט:לה):


**There He broke the arrows of the bow** of Sennacherib and his hosts.


###### Rashi on Psalms 76:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:4:2)


**רִשְׁפֵי קָשֶׁת.** אֵין רִשְׁפֵי קֶשֶׁת לְשׁוֹן ״רִשְׁפֵּי אֵשׁ״ (שיר השירים ח:ו) שֶׁאֵין לְשׁוֹן רִשְׁפֵּי אֵשׁ נוֹפְלִים בְּקֶשֶׁת, וְזֶה רָפֵי וְרִשְׁפֵּי אֵשׁ דָּגוּשׁ. וְרִשְׁפֵי קֶשֶׁת לְשׁוֹן ״וּלְחוּמֵי רֶשֶׁף״ (דברים לב:כד) דִּמְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״עוֹף״, ״וּבְנֵי רֶשֶׁף יַגְבִּיהוּ עוּף״ (איוב ה:ז). וְכֵן ״וּמִקְנֵיהֶם לָרְשָׁפִים״ (תהלים עח:מח) לְצִפֳּרִים, וְכֵן וּבְנֵי רֶשֶׁף בְּנֵי עֲפִיפָה הֵם שֵׁדִים יַגְבִּיהוּ לָעוּף. אַף זֶה לְשׁוֹן חִצִּים הַמְעוֹפְפִים כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וּמֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם״ (תהלים צא:ה), **שָׁמָּה שִׁבַּר רִשְׁפֵי קָשֶׁת** חִצִּים שֶׁהַקֶּשֶׁת מְעוֹפֵף. וְכָל הַמִּזְמוֹר הַזֶּה מְדַבֵּר בְּמַפֶּלֶת סַנְחֵרִיב שֶׁלֹּא מָצִינוּ אוֹיֵב נוֹפֵל בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם אֶלָּא הוּא:


**the arrows of the bow** Heb. רשפי. רִשְׁפֵי is not an expression of sparks of fire, because sparks of fire are not appropriate to a bow. Moreover, this word has no “dagesh,” yet רִשְׁפֵּי does have a “dagesh.” Rather, רִשְׁפֵי is an expression of (Deut. 32:24): “fought by demons (רשף),” which is translated as עוֹף, flying creatures, as (Job 5:7): “but flying creatures fly (רשף) upward.” Similarly (below 78:48): “and their cattle to the flying creatures (לרשפים). to the birds. Similarly, בְּנֵי רֶשֶׁף are flying creatures, demons, who fly upward. This one too is an expression of arrows, which fly, as the matter that is stated (below 91:5): “from an arrow that flies by day.” There He broke the arrows (רִשְׁפֵי) of the bow, the arrows that the bow lets fly, and this entire psalm speaks of the downfall of Sennacherib, for we find no enemy falling in Jerusalem but he.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 76:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:5:1)


**נָאוֹר אַתָּה אַדִּיר.** לְשׁוֹן ״נִאֵר מִקְדָּשׁוֹ״ (איכה ב:ז), ״נֵאַרְתָּ בְרִית עַבְדֶּךָ״ (תהלים פט:מ) – מְנָאֵר אֶת אוֹיְבֶיךָ וְקָמֶיךָ וּמְטַאטְאָן מִן הָעוֹלָם. **נָאוֹר** עַל שֵׁם מַעֲשָׂיו נִקְרָא, כְּמוֹ ״חַנּוּן״ (שמות כב:כו), וְ״רַחוּם״ (תהלים קיא:ד), וְ״קַנּוֹא״ (יהושע כד:יט) – עַל שֵׁם שֶׁהוּא חוֹנֵן, שֶׁהוּא מְרַחֵם, שֶׁהוּא מְקַנֵּא:


**You are destructive; mightier** Heb. נאור, an expression of (Lam. 2:7): “He destroyed His Sanctuary”; (below 89:40), “You abolished the covenant of Your servant.” You destroy Your enemies and those who rise up against You and sweep them from the world. Because of His deeds, He is called נאור, destructive, like חנוּן, gracious; רחום, merciful; קנוא jealous, because He grants, because He pities, because He acts with zeal.


###### Rashi on Psalms 76:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:5:2)


**אַדִּיר מֵהַרְרֵי טָרֶף.** חָזָק מֵעֲנָקִים טוֹרְפִים הַגְּבוֹהִים כְּהָרִים, וּלְנֶגְדְּךָ אֵין גְּבוּרָתָם נוֹדַעַת:


**mightier than the mountains of prey** Stronger than the predatory giants, who are as tall as mountains, but against You, their might is not known.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 76:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:6:1)


**אֶשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ.** כְּמוֹ הִשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ; כְּמוֹ ״וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן אֶתְחַבַּר אֲחַזְיָה וְגוֹ׳״ (דברי הימים ב כ:לה) – כְּמוֹ הִתְחַבֵּר. וְנִגְזַר אֶשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ מִגִּזְרַת ״מוֹלִיךְ יוֹעֲצִים שׁוֹלָל״ (איוב יב:יז), וְהוּא לְשׁוֹן מִשְׁגֶּה וְ״שָׁלוּ״ (דניאל ג:כט), כְּשׁוֹטִים שׁוֹגִים; וְהַתָּי״ו נוֹפֶלֶת בִּלְשׁוֹן הַמִּתְפַּעֵל בְּאֶמְצַע הַתֵּיבָה, בְּכָל תֵּיבָה שֶׁתְּחִלָּתָהּ שִׁי״ן:


**became mad** Heb. אשתוללו, like השתוללוּ. As (II Chron. 20:35): “And afterwards, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah joined (אתחבר) Ahaziah the king of Israel,” like התחבר. [The word] אשתוללוּ is derived from (Job 12:17): “He leads counselors away with madness (שולל).” It is an expression of error and tranquility, as madmen err, and the “tav” falls into the middle of the word in the reflexive, as in every word beginning with “shin.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 76:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:6:2)


**נָמוּ שְׁנָתָם.** נִרְדְּמוּ בְּשֵׁינָה, לְשׁוֹן ״תְּנוּמָה״ (תהלים קלב:ד):


**slumbered in their sleep** They Heb. נמו. They fell into a deep sleep, an expression of תנוּמה slumber.


###### Rashi on Psalms 76:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:6:3)


**וְלֹא מָצְאוּ יְדֵיהֶם.** וְכֹחָם, כְּשֶׁבָּאתָ לִפָּרַע מֵהֶם:


**and none...found** their hands and their strength when You came to punish them.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 76:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:7:1)


**נִרְדָּם וְרֶכֶב וָסוּס.** וָי״ו שֶׁל וְרֶכֶב טְפֵלָה הִיא, כְּמוֹ ״אֵלֶּה בְנֵי צִבְעוֹן וְאַיָּה וַעֲנָה״ (בראשית לו:כד) – וָי״ו שֶׁל וְאַיָּה טְפֵלָה הִיא:


**chariot and horse were stunned** Heb. ורכב וסוס. The “vav” of ורכב is superfluous, as (Gen. 36: 24): “These are the sons of Ziv’on: Ayyah (ואיה) and Anah.” The “vav” of ואיה is superfluous.

**מֵאָז אַפֶּךָ.** מִשָּׁעָה שֶׁאַתָּה כּוֹעֵס:

###### Rashi on Psalms 76:9:1

**מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּ דִּין.** כְּשֶׁנִּתְנַבֵּא יְשַׁעְיָה עַל פּוּרְעָנוּתוֹ שֶׁל סַנְחֵרִיב, וְנִתְקַיֵּם בּוֹ: אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁיָּרְאָה מִמֶּנּוּ וּמֵאוּכְלוּסָיו, אָז **שָׁקְטָה**:


**From heaven, You let judgment be heard** When Isaiah prophesied concerning the retribution of Sennacherib and it was fulfilled in him, then Eretz Israel, which feared him and his hosts, became calm.

**בְּקוּם לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֱלֹהִים.** לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט מֵאוֹיְבָיו, **לְהוֹשִׁיעַ** חִזְקִיָּהוּ וְסִיעָתוֹ:

### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 76:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/76:11:1)


**כִּי חֲמַת אָדָם תּוֹדֶךָּ.** כַּעֲסָן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים גּוֹרֵם שֶׁהַבְּרִיּוֹת מוֹדִים לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, כְּשֶׁהֵם מַרְאִין כַּעֲסָם וְהַקָּבָּ״ה נִפְרָע מֵהֶם הַכֹּל מְקַלְּסִין לְפָנָיו, וְאַף הֵם עַצְמָם מְקַלְּסִין לְפָנָיו כְּשֶׁרוֹאִין שֶׁאֵין כַּעֲסָן כְּלוּם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בִּנְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר כְּשֶׁהִשְׁלִיךְ חֲנַנְיָה מִישָׁאֵל וַעֲזַרְיָה לְכִבְשַׁן הָאֵשׁ מַה נֶּאֱמַר שָׁם ״יְהֵא שְׁמֵיהּ דֶּאֱלָהָא מְבָרַךְ וְגוֹ׳״ (דניאל ג:כח). וְעַל יְדֵי כֵן **שְׁאֵרִית** הַ**חֵמֹת תַּחְגֹּר** תְּעַכֵּב וְתַחְדֹּל, שְׁאָר הָרְשָׁעִים מְעֻכָּבִים וְנִמְנָעִים מִלְּהַרְאוֹת גַּאֲוָתָם וַחֲמָתָם. **תַּחְגֹּר** לְשׁוֹן עֲכָבָה בִּלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה (בכורות לז:): פְּגִימַת הַסַּכִּין כְּדֵי שֶׁתַּחְגֹּר בּוֹ הַצִּפֹּרֶן. וְשָׁמַעְתִּי מִשְּׁמוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר הַגָּאוֹן בַּר׳ יִצְחָק שֶׁהָיָה מֵבִיא הַמִּקְרָא הַזֶּה עֵדוּת לְאוֹתָהּ מִשְׁנָה. וְיֵשׁ עוֹד לִפְתֹּר חֲגִירָה זוֹ כְּמַשְׁמָעָהּ לְשׁוֹן חֲגוֹרָה, וּפֵרוּשׁוֹ לְךָ נָאֶה לַחֲגֹר חֵמָה וְלַעֲטוֹת קִנְאָה כִּי הַכֹּחַ וְהַיְּכֹלֶת שֶׁלְּךָ, וּלְשׁוֹן **שְׁאֵרִית** זֶה הוּא מֵאַחַר שֶׁחֲמַת אָדָם אֵינוֹ כְּלוּם נִשְׁאֲרוּ כָּל חֲגוֹרוֹת חֵמָה לְךָ:


**For man’s anger will thank you** The anger of the wicked results in the creatures thanking the Holy One, blessed be He. When they show their anger and the Holy One, blessed be He, punishes them, everyone praises Him when they see that their anger is of no avail. As we find (Dan. 3:28) concerning Nebuchadnezzar, when he cast Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah into the fiery furnace, what is said there? “Blessed be the God of Shadrach, etc.” And thereby...**it will prevent the residue of wrath** Heb. תחגר. It will prevent and stop; the remaining wicked men are prevented and restrained from showing their pride and their wrath. תחגר is an expression of restraint in the language of the Mishnah (Chul. 18a): “The nick in a knife must be deep enough to catch (תחגר) the nail to disqualify it from slaughtering].” I heard in the name of Rabbi Eleazar the Gaon, the son of Rabbi Isaac, who brought this verse as testimony to that Mishnah (sic). It is also possible to interpret this according to its usual meaning of an expression of girding, and can be explained as follows: It is fitting for You to gird Yourself with wrath and to enwrap Yourself with zeal, for strength and ability are Yours; the expression of “residue” is that since man’s wrath is of no account, the girding of all wrath is reserved for You.

### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 76:13:1

**יִבְצֹר רוּחַ.** גַּסָּה שֶׁל נְדִיבִים, מְמַעֵט גַּאֲוָתָם. **יִבְצֹר** יְמַעֵט, כְּמוֹ (בראשית יא:ו) ״לֹא יִבָּצֵר מֵהֶם״:


**He will cut down the spirit** the spirit of haughtiness of the princes and lessen their arrogance. יבצֹר means “He will lessen,” as (Gen. 11:6): “will it not be withheld (יבצר) from them?”

### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:3:1

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:3:2
