**לַיְלָה נִגְּרָה.** בַּגָּלוּת זֶה שֶׁהוּא כְּלַיְלָה, הִיא נִגְּרָה לֵחָה וּמָרָה:


**my wound oozes** In this exile, which is like night, it oozes pus and gall.


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:3:3)


**וְלֹא תָפוּג.** וְלֹא תִדְמֶה נִגְּרָתָהּ:


**and does not abate** Its oozing does not abate.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:4:1)


**אֶזְכְּרָה אֱלֹהִים.** הַחֶסֶד שֶׁהָיָה רָגִיל לַעֲשׂוֹת לִי בִּימֵי חִבָּתִי:


**I remember God** The kindness that He used to do for me in the days of my love.


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:4:2)


**אָשִׂיחָה.** בְּאוֹתָן חֲסָדִים וְטוֹבוֹת:


**I speak** about those acts of kindness and the favors.


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:4:3)


**וְתִתְעַטֵּף רוּחִי.** פַּשְׁמִי״ר בְּלַעַ״ז:


**and my spirit becomes faint** Pasmer in Old French, to faint or swoon.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:5:1)


**אָחַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרוֹת עֵינָי.** שְׁמוּרוֹת לְשׁוֹן אַשְׁמוּרוֹת הַלַּיְלָה, שֶׁאָדָם נֵעוֹר מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וְדַעְתּוֹ מְיֻשֶּׁבֶת וְלִבּוֹ חוֹזֵר עָלָיו. וַאֲנִי אֵינִי כֵּן בַּלַּיְלָה זוֹ שֶׁל גָּלוּת: תָּמִיד עֵינַי נִדְבָּקוֹת, כְּאָדָם נִרְדָּם מֵאֹטֶם לֵב. בַּצָּרוֹת שֶׁאֲנִי רוֹאֶה נִפְעֲמָה רוּחִי וְאֵין הַדִּבּוּר בִּי:


**You held fast the awakenings of my eyes** Heb. שמרות, an expression of the watch (אשמרת) of the night, for [when] a person awakens from his sleep his mind is settled and his heart returns to him, but I am not like that. In this night of exile, my eyes are always stuck together, like a man sleeping from a clogged heart, and in the troubles that I see, my spirit throbs and I have no speech within me.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:6:1)


**חִשַּׁבְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם.** לִזְכֹּר הַחֲסָדִים שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ עִם אֲבוֹתֵינוּ:


**I think of the days of yore** to remember the kind acts that You performed for our forefathers.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:7:1)


**אֶזְכְּרָה נְגִינָתִי בַּלָּיְלָה.** בִּימֵי הַגָּלוּת הַזֶּה הַדּוֹמֶה לַלַּיְלָה אֲנִי זוֹכֵר אֶת נְגִינוֹתַי שֶׁהָיִיתִי מְנַגֵּן בִּימֵי קֶדֶם בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ:


**I recall my music at night** In the days of this exile, which is like night, I remember my melodies that I used to play in days of yore in the Temple.


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:7:2)


**עִם לְבָבִי אָשִׂיחָה.** אֲנִי מְחַשֵּׁב וְרוּחִי מְחַפֵּשׂ (פסיקתא רבתי יז), מַה הִיא כֵּן מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וַאֲנִי תָּמֵהַּ: הַלְּעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַח?


**I speak with my heart** I think, and my spirit searches [to ascertain] what is the manner of the Holy One, blessed be He, and I wonder: will He forsake [me] forever?



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:9:1)


**הֶאָפֵס.** שֶׁמָּא כָּלָה חַסְדּוֹ?


**Has...ended forever** Perhaps His kind acts have ended?


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:9:2)


**גָּמַר אֹמֶר.** גְּזֵרַת עוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא יָשׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹנוֹ עוֹד?


**Has He issued a decree** a perpetual decree that He will never again repent of His anger?



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:10:1)


**הֲשָׁכַח חַנּוֹת.** לִהְיוֹת חוֹנֵן, חַנּוֹת כְּמוֹ ״עֲשׂוֹת״ (בראשית ב:ד) ״רְאוֹת״ (שמות י:כח), לָשׁוֹן אַחֵר: **חַנּוֹת** חֲנִינוֹת:


**Has...forgotten to be gracious** Heb. חנות, to be gracious, like עשוֹת, to do; ראוֹת, to see. Another explanation: חנות means gracious acts.


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:10:2)


**אִם קָפַץ בְּאַף רַחֲמָיו סֶלָה.** לְשׁוֹן ״לֹא תִקְפֹּץ יָדְךָ״ (דברים טו:ז), כְּלוֹמַר אִם סָגַר הָרַחֲמִים לְעוֹלָם בִּשְׁבִיל הַחֵמָה:


**Has He, in anger, shut off His mercy forever** Heb. קפץ, an expression of (Deut. 15:7): “and do not close (תקפץ) your hand,” i.e., has He shut off the mercy forever because of the anger?



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:11:1)


**וָאֹמַר חַלּוֹתִי הִיא.** מַחֲשַׁבְתִּי אוֹמֶרֶת כִּי אֵין זֹאת אֶלָּא לְהַחֲלוֹתִי וּלְיָרְאֵנִי לָשׁוּב אֵלָיו:


**And I said, “This is to terrify me”** My thoughts tell me, “This is only to terrify me and frighten me into returning to Him.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:11:2)


**חַלּוֹתִי.** כְּמוֹ לְחַלּוֹתִי, לְשׁוֹן חֹלִי וְחִיל:


**to terrify me** Heb. חלותי, like לחלוֹתי, to terrify me, an expression of sickness and terror.


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:11:3)


**שְׁנוֹת יְמִין עֶלְיוֹן.** אֶת אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁתַּנֵּית יְמִין עֶלְיוֹן, שֶׁהָיְתָה נֶאְדָּרִי בַּכֹּחַ רוֹעֶצֶת אוֹיֵב (שמות טו:ו), וְעַכְשָׁיו הֵשִׁיב אָחוֹר יְמִינוֹ (איכה ב:ג):


**the change of the right hand of the Most High** How the right hand of the Most High changed. It was mighty with strength and now He has withdrawn His right hand.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:13:1)


**וְהָגִיתִי בְכָל פָּעֳלֶךָ.** שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ לָנוּ כְּבָר:


**And I meditate over all Your works** that You have already done for us.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:14:1)


**בַּקֹּדֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּךָ.** דֶּרֶךְ מִדָּתְךָ לְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בָּעוֹלָם, לַעֲשׂוֹת דִּין בָּרְשָׁעִים:


**Your way is in sanctity** Your manner is to sanctify Your name in the world, to execute justice upon the wicked.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:17:1)


**רָאוּךָ מַיִם.** רַבִּים כְּשֶׁנִּגְלֵיתָ עַל הַיָּם (שמות יד:כא):


**The waters perceived You** [The] mighty [waters perceived You] when You were revealed by the sea.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:18:1)


**זֹרְמוּ מַיִם עָבוֹת.** שְׁחָקִים נָטְפוּ זֶרֶם מַיִם עָבִים:


**They poured forth thick waters** The skies poured forth a stream of thick waters.


###### Rashi on Psalms 77:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:18:2)


**חֲצָצֶיךָ.** כְּמוֹ חִצֶּיךָ:


**Your arrows** Heb. חצציך, like חִצֶיךָ.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:19:1)


**בַּגַּלְגַּל.** כְּמוֹ כַּגַּלְגַּל, **קוֹל רַעַמְךָ** כַּגַּלְגַּל עַל הַיָּם לָהוּם אֶת מַחֲנֵה מִצְרַיִם (שמות יד:כד):


**like a wheel** Heb. בגלגל, like כגלגל. The sound of Your thunder [rolled] like a wheel on the sea to confuse the camp of the Egyptians.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 77:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/77:20:1)


**וְעִקְּבוֹתֶיךָ לֹא נוֹדָעוּ.** אֵין הַפְּסִיעוֹת נִכָּרוֹת עַל הַמַּיִם. וְעִקְּבוֹתֶיךָ טְרַצְ״שׁ בְּלַעַ״ז:


**and Your steps were not known** The steps are not recognizable on the water. [The word] ועקבותיךָ means trazes in Old French, footprints.



## Chapter 78


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:2:1)


**בְּמָשָׁל פִּי.** הֵם דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה (שבת קמה.):


**...my mouth with a parable** They are the words of Torah.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:4:1)


**לֹא נְכַחֵד מִבְּנֵיהֶם.** וְגַם אֲנוּ לֹא נְכַחֵד מִבְּנֵיהֶם שֶׁל אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מִלְּהוֹדִיעָם מַה שֶּׁסִּפְּרוּ לָנוּ:


**We shall not hide from their sons** We, too, shall not hide [these words] from our fathers’ sons by not letting them know what they told us.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:7:1)


**כִּסְלָם.** תּוֹחַלְתָּם, וְכֵן ״אִם שַׂמְתִּי זָהָב כִּסְלִי״ (איוב לא:כד):


**their hope** Heb. כסלם, their hope, and so (Job 31:24): “If I made gold my hope (כסלי).”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:8:1)


**כַּאֲבוֹתָם.** שֶׁהָיוּ בְּמִצְרַיִם וּבַמִּדְבָּר:


**as their forefathers** who were in Egypt and in the desert.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:9:1)


**בְּנֵי אֶפְרַיִם.** שֶׁיָּצְאוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם בִּזְרוֹעַ לִפְנֵי הַקֵּץ וּבָטְחוּ בִּגְבוּרָתָם וּבְחִצֵּיהֶם, וְסוֹפָם **הָפְכוּ** לָנוּס **בְּיוֹם קְרָב**, כַּמְפֹרָשׁ בְּדִבְרֵי הַיָּמִים: ״וַיַּהַרְגוּם אַנְשֵׁי גַת הַנּוֹלָדִים בָּאָרֶץ״ (דברי הימים א ז:כא):


**The sons of Ephraim** who left Egypt forcefully before the end [of the exile] and trusted in their might and in their arrows. Ultimately, they retreated and fled on the day of battle, as is delineated (I Chron. 7:21): “and the men of Gath, who were born in the land, slew them.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 78:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:9:2)


**רוֹמֵי.** מַשְׁלִיכִין וְזוֹרְקִין, כְּמוֹ ״רָמָה בַיָּם״ (שמות טו:א):


**archers** Heb. רומי, who cast and shoot, as (Exod. 15:1): “cast (רמה) into the sea.”



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:12:1)


**נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא.** אַחֲרֵי כֵן, כְּשֶׁהִגִּיעַ הַקֵּץ, אַף הֵם וַיּוֹסִיפוּ לַחֲטֹא לוֹ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּסַיֵּם וְהוֹלֵךְ:


**Before their forefathers He wrought wonders** (Nevertheless—Shem Ephraim) Afterwards, when the end arrived, they too “continued to sin against Him,” as he further concludes. (Another explanation—Shem Ephraim)


###### Rashi on Psalms 78:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:12:2)


**נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם.** אַבְרָהָם, יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב בָּאוּ עַל הַיָּם, וְהֶרְאָם הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הֵיאַךְ הוּא גּוֹאֵל אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם (בראשית רבה צב:ב):


**Before their forefathers** Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob came beside the sea, and the Holy One, blessed be He, showed them how He was redeeming their children.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:13:1)


**כְּמוֹ נֵד.** תֵּל גָּבוֹהַּ, כְּדִמְתַרְגְּמִינָן ״נִצְּבוּ כְמוֹ נֵד״ (שמות טו:ח): ״קָמוּ כְשׁוּר״ (תרגום אונקלוס):


**as a heap** Heb. נד, a tall heap, as Onkelos renders (Exod. 15:8): “the flowing water stood up like a נֵד,” stood up like a wall.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:15:1)


**יְבַקַּע צוּרִים.** ״וְהִכִּיתָ בַצּוּר וְגוֹ׳״ (שמות יז:ו):


**He split rocks** (Exod. 17:6): “and you shall strike the rock.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 78:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:15:2)


**וַיַּשְׁקְ כִּתְהוֹמוֹת רַבָּה.** אַף כְּשֶׁהָיוּ הוֹלְכִים בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם שֶׁמֵּימָיו מְלוּחִים, הִמְתִּיק לָהֶם מַעְיָנוֹת בְּתוֹךְ הַתְּהוֹם:


**and He gave them to drink as [from] great deeps** in the great deeps. Even as they went through the midst of the sea, whose waters are salty, He sweetened fountains for them in the midst of the sea.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:16:1)


**וַיּוֹרֶד כַּנְּהָרוֹת מָיִם.** שֶׁהָיוּ נוֹזְלִין מִן הַבְּאֵר, וְהַנְּשִׂיאִים הָיוּ עוֹשִׂין שִׂרְטוּט בְּמַשְׁעֲנוֹתָם, וְהַמַּיִם נִמְשָׁכִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם לְכָל חֲנִיַּת שֵׁבֶט וָשֵׁבֶט, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״בִּמְחֹקֵק בְּמִשְׁעֲנֹתָם״ (במדבר כא:יח); כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּפֹרָשׁ בְּאַרְבָּעִים וְתֵשַׁע מִדּוֹת (תנחומא, חקת כא):


**and brought down water like rivers** [Water] that was flowing from the well. The princes would make a line with their staffs and the water would be drawn after them to the encampment of each tribe, as the matter that is stated (Num. 21:18): “by the order of the lawgiver, with their staffs,” as is explained in tractate Makkoth.

**וְאֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָה בְיַעֲקֹב.** כְּמוֹ ״וּבָעֲרוּ וְהִשִּׂיקוּ״ (יחזקאל לט:ט), שֶׁהוּא לְשׁוֹן הֶסֵּק וּתְבֵעָרָה. כְּדִכְתִיב ״וַתִּבְעַר בָּם אֵשׁ ה׳״ (במדבר יא:א):

**bread of the mighty** Bread of the angels. Another explanation: אַבִּירִים means אֵבָרִים, limbs, for it was absorbed into the limbs, and they did not have to excrete.

### Verse 31

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:31:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:31:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:31:1)


**וּבַחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.** נִבְחָרִים שֶׁבָּהֶם, ״וְהָאֲסַפְסוּף״ (במדבר יא:ד) הֵם הַזְּקֵנִים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בָּהֶם ״אֶסְפָה לִי״ (במדבר יא:טז):


**and...the chosen of Israel** The chosen of them and the men of the assembly, הָאסַפסוּף (Num. 11:4). They are the elders, as it is said (Num. 11:16): “Assemble (אספו) to Me, etc.”

**וְלִבָּם לֹא.** כְּפִיהֶם **נָכוֹן**, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן **וְהוּא רַחוּם** לָהֶם וּמְכַפֵּר עֲוֹנָם תָּמִיד וְלֹא הִשְׁחִיתָם:

### Verse 38

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:38:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:38:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:38:1)


**וְהִרְבָּה.** פְּעָמִים רַבּוֹת:


**But He is merciful** to them and constantly expiates their iniquity, and He did not destroy them.


###### Rashi on Psalms 78:38:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:38:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:38:2)


**לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ.** מֵהֶם, וְאַף אִם נִפְרָע מֵהֶם, לֹא הֵעִיר עֲלֵיהֶם כָּל חֲמָתוֹ, כִּי אִם מְעַט מְעַט. לְפִי שֶׁזָּכַר **כִּי בָשָׂר הֵמָּה**, וְיֵצֶר הָרָע טָמוּן בְּלִבָּם, וְהוּא **רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ** – כְּשֶׁיָּמוּתוּ, **וְלֹא יָשׁוּב** אוֹתוֹ רוּחַ בָּהֶם לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא: כְּשֶׁיִּחְיוּ, אֵין יֵצֶר הָרָע שׁוֹלֵט בָּהֶם. וְלֹא יִתָּכֵן לְפָרֵשׁ **רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב** – רוּחָם שֶׁל חַיִּים בָּהֶם, שֶׁאִם אָמַרְתָּ כֵּן, כָּפַרְתָּ בִּתְחִיַּת הַמֵּתִים. וְכֵן מְפֹרָשׁ בְּאַגָּדַת תְּהִלִּים:


**many times** Many times He withdraws His wrath from them, and even if He punishes them, He does not arouse all His anger but little by little, because He remembers that they are flesh and that the evil inclination is hidden in their heart. That is a spirit that goes away when they die, and that spirit does not return to them in the world to come. When they are resurrected, the evil inclination will have no control over them. “A spirit that goes away and does not return” cannot be explained to mean their spirit of life, because if you say so, you have denied the resurrection of the dead. In this manner, it is explained in Aggadath Tehillim (Mid Ps. 78:8).

**כַּמָּה.** פְּעָמִים **יַמְרוּהוּ** תָּמִיד **בַּמִּדְבָּר**:


**How often** [How many] times **they provoked him** always in the desert.



### Verse 41

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:41:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:41:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:41:1)


**הִתְווּ.** לְשׁוֹן סִימָן, כְּמוֹ ״וְהִתְוִיתָ תָּו״ (יחזקאל ט:ד). וְסִימָן הוּא לְשׁוֹן מוֹפֵת וְנִסָּיוֹן. בִּקְשׁוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אוֹת וְסִימָן: ״הֲיֵשׁ ה׳ בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ אִם אָיִן״ (שמות יז:ז):


**they sought a sign** Heb. התוו, an expression of a sign, as (Ezek. 9:4): “and set a mark (והתוית תו) .” “A mark” is an expression of a wonder and a trial. They asked him for a sign and a mark (Exod. 17: 7): “Is the Lord in our midst or not?”

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:45:1

**וְתַשְׁחִיתֵם.** שׁוֹמְטִין אֶת בֵּיצֵיהֶם (שמות רבה י:ד):


**which mutilated them** They would pull off their testicles.



### Verse 47

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:47:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:47:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:47:1)


**בַּחֲנָמַל.** שֵׁם אַרְבֶּה, וּמִדְרָשׁוֹ : בָּא חָן וּמָל, הָיָה מוֹלֵל אֶת יֶרֶק הָעֵץ וְהָעֵשֶׂב וְאוֹכְלוֹ:


**with locusts** Heb. בחנמל, the name of the locust. According to the Midrash (Mid. Ps. 78:13) [it is composed of the following words]: בָּא חָן מָל, it comes, encamps, and cuts. It cut off the greens of the tree and the grass and ate it.



### Verse 48

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:48:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:48:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:48:1)


**וַיַּסְגֵּר לַבָּרָד בְּעִירָם.** כְּשֶׁהִתְחִיל הַבָּרָד לֵירֵד, הַמִּצְרִי מַבְרִיחַ צֹאנוֹ לַבַּיִת, וְהַבָּרָד נַעֲשָׂה לְמוּלוֹ כְּמִין כּוֹתֶל, וְהַמִּצְרִי שׁוֹחֲטוֹ וְנוֹתְנוֹ עַל כְּתֵיפוֹ לְהוֹלִיכוֹ לַבַּיִת וּלְאָכְלוֹ, וְהָעוֹף בָּא וְנוֹטְלוֹ הֵימֶנּוּ. וְזֶה **וּמִקְנֵיהֶם לָרְשָׁפִים** לָעוֹפוֹת, כְּמוֹ ״וּבְנֵי רֶשֶׁף יַגְבִּיהוּ עוּף״ (איוב ה:ז). זֶה מִדְרָשׁוֹ. וּלְפִי פְשׁוּטוֹ: **לָרְשָׁפִים** רִשְׁפֵּי אֵשׁ, כְּדִכְתִיב ״וְאֵשׁ מִתְלַקַּחַת בְּתוֹךְ הַבָּרָד״ (שמות ט:כד):


**He gave over their animals to hail** When the hail began to fall, the Egyptian drove his sheep (his animal) into the house, and the hail came before him like a wall. The Egyptian slaughtered it [the animal] and put it on his shoulder, to take it to his house to eat it, but the birds came and took it from him. That is [the meaning of] “and their cattle to the birds (לרשפים),” as (Job. 5:7): “but flying creatures (בני רשף) fly upward.” This is its midrashic interpretation (Mid. Ps. 78:14), but according to its simple meaning, רשפים are bolts of fire, as it is written (Exod. 9:24): “and fire flaming within the hail.”



### Verse 50

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:50:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:50:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:50:1)


**יְפַלֵּס נָתִיב לְאַפּוֹ.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁבְּאַף נִשְׁתַּלְּחוּ הַמַּכּוֹת לֹא שִׁמְּשׁוּ אֶלָּא שְׁלִיחוּתָם, מַה שֶּׁנִּצְטַוּוּ לְהָמִית הֵמִיתוּ וְלֹא הַכֹּל, בִּנְתִיבוֹתָם הָלְכוּ. בְּפֵרוּשִׁים אֲחֵרִים מָצָאתִי כֵּן: **יְפַלֵּס נָתִיב לְאַפּוֹ** כְּשֶׁהִכָּה כָל בְּכוֹר בְּמִצְרַיִם (שמות יב:כט), הוֹרָה דֶּרֶךְ לַמַּשְׁחִית בְּאַף לָבוֹא אֶל בָּתֵּי מִצְרַיִם וְלֹא לְבָתֵּי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (שמות יב:כג):


**He leveled a path for His anger** Although the plagues were dispatched in anger, they performed only their orders; what they were commanded to kill, they killed, but nothing else. They went in their paths. In other commentaries I found as follows: **He leveled a path for His anger** When He smote every firstborn in Egypt, He showed the way for [the angel] who was destroying with anger to enter the houses of the Egyptians, but not the houses of the children of Israel.

**וְחַיָּתָם.** גּוּפָם:

### Verse 56

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:56:1

**וַיְנַסּוּ וַיַּמְרוּ.** בִּימֵי הַשּׁוֹפְטִים:


**Yet they tried and provoked** during the days of the judges.



### Verse 57

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:57:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:57:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:57:1)


**כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּה.** שֶׁאֵינָהּ זוֹרֶקֶת חֵץ לְמָקוֹם שֶׁהַמּוֹרֶה חָפֵץ:


**like a deceitful bow** which does not shoot the arrow to the place the archer wishes.



### Verse 61

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:61:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:61:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:61:1)


**וַיִּתֵּן לַשְּׁבִי עֻזּוֹ.** מָסַר הָאָרוֹן וְהַלּוּחוֹת בְּיַד פְּלִשְׁתִּים (שמואל א ד:יא):


**He delivered His might into captivity** He delivered the Ark and the tablets into the hands of the Philistines.



### Verse 63

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:63:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:63:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:63:1)


**בַּחוּרָיו אָכְלָה אֵשׁ.** עֶבְרָתוֹ:


**Fire consumed his youths** [The fire of] His wrath.


###### Rashi on Psalms 78:63:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:63:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:63:2)


**לֹא הוּלָּלוּ.** לֹא נִכְלְלוּ לְאַפִּרְיוֹן וְחוּפָּה, שֶׁמֵּתוּ הַבַּחוּרִים בַּמִּלְחָמָה:


**were not married** Heb. לא הוללו. They were not married by being brought into a litter [under] a canopy because the youths died in battle.


###### Rashi on Psalms 78:63:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:63:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:63:3)


**הוּלָּלוּ.** לְשׁוֹן הִלּוּלָא בַּאֲרָמִית (ברכות לא.), וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ דְּרָשׁוּהוּ עַל נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא, וְאֵין לִבִּי מִתְיַשֵּׁב לְפָרְשׁוֹ כֵּן, שֶׁהֲרֵי כְּבָר הִתְחִיל בְּמִשְׁכַּן שִׁילֹה:


הוּלָלוּ is an expression of nuptials (הִלוּלָא) in Aramaic. Our Sages, however, explained it in reference to Nadab and Abihu (Mid. Ps. 78:18), but I feel uncertain about explaining it that way because he already commenced with the Tabernacle of Shiloh.



### Verse 64

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:64:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:64:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:64:1)


**כֹּהֲנָיו בַּחֶרֶב נָפָלוּ.** חָפְנִי וּפִינְחָס (שמואל א ד:יא):


**His priests fell by the sword** Hophni and Phinehas.


###### Rashi on Psalms 78:64:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:64:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:64:2)


**וְאַלְמְנוֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה.** אַף אַלְמְנָתוֹ לֹא נִיתְּנָה לִבְכּוֹתוֹ, שֶׁאַף הִיא מֵתָה בְּיוֹם הַשְּׁמוּעָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וַתִּכְרַע וַתֵּלֶד כִּי נֶהֶפְכוּ עָלֶיהָ צִירֶיהָ״ (שמואל א ד:יט):


**but his widows did not weep** Even his widow was not allowed to bewail him, for she too died on the day of the tidings, as it is said (I Sam. 4: 19): “And she knelt and gave birth, for her pains had suddenly come upon her.”



### Verse 65

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:65:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:65:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:65:1)


**מִתְרוֹנֵן.** מִתְעוֹרֵר וּמִתְגַּבֵּר בְּדִבּוּר לְהָקִיץ מִיֵּינוֹ, **מִתְרוֹנֵן** לְשׁוֹן רִנָּה הוּא:


**shouting** Heb. מתרונן, awaking and strengthening himself with speech to awaken from his wine. מתרונן is an expression of רנה, shouting.



### Verse 66

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:66:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:66:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:66:1)


**וַיַּךְ צָרָיו אָחוֹר.** מַכּוֹת אֲחוֹרַיִם בָּעֳפוֹלִים וּבַטְּחוֹרִים (שמואל א ה:ו), וְהוּא חֶרְפַּת גִּדּוּף לָהֶם עוֹלָמִית:


**And He smote His adversaries from the rear** Plagues of the rear with hemorrhoids, which is a disgrace of perpetual ridicule for them.



### Verse 67

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:67:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:67:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:67:1)


**וַיִּמְאַס בְּאֹהֶל יוֹסֵף.** הוּא שִׁילֹה שֶׁהוּא בְּחֶלְקוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף (זבחים קיח.):


**He rejected the tent of Joseph** That is Shiloh, which is in Joseph’s territory.



### Verse 69

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:69:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:69:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:69:1)


**וַיִּבֶן כְּמוֹ רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ וְגוֹ׳.** כְּמוֹ שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ שֶׁנֶּאֶמְרוּ בָּהֶם שְׁתֵּי יָדַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״אַף יָדִי יָסְדָה אֶרֶץ וִימִינִי טִפְּחָה שָׁמָיִם״ (ישעיה מח:יג), אַף בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּשְׁתֵּי יָדַיִם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״כּוֹנְנוּ יָדֶיךָ״ (שמות טו:יז). דָּבָר אַחֵר: **כְּמוֹ רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ כְּאֶרֶץ יְסָדָהּ.** מַה שָּׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ אֵין לָהֶם חֲלִיפִין, אַף מִקְדָּשׁ אֵין לוֹ חֲלִיפִין לְהַשְׁרוֹת שָׁם שְׁכִינָה:


**And He built His Sanctuary like the high heavens, etc.** Like the heavens and the earth, about which two hands are mentioned, as it is stated (Isa. 48:13): “Even My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and My right hand measured the heavens with handbreadths.” Also the Temple was with two hands, as it is said (Exod. 15:17): “Your hands established.” (Cf. Mechilta, Shirah 10, Keth. 5a, Rashi to Exod. 15:17.) Another explanation: **And He built His Sanctuary like the high heavens, like the earth He established it** Just as heaven and earth have no substitute, neither does the Temple have a substitute in which to let the Shechinah rest.



### Verse 70

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:70:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:70:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:70:1)


**מִמִּכְלְאוֹת צֹאן.** דִּירֵי צֹאן, כְּמוֹ ״גָּזַר מִמִּכְלָה צֹאן״ (חבקוק ג:יז):


**and took him from the sheepcotes** Heb. ממכלאתצאן, from the stalls of the sheep, as (Hab. 3: 16): “The flock will be cut off from the fold (ממכלה).”



### Verse 71

###### Rashi on Psalms 78:71:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:71:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/78:71:1)


**מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ.** שֶׁהָיָה רוֹעֶה לְאָבִיו הַצֹּאן הַמְּנִיקוֹת, שֶׁהָיָה רַחֲמָנִי וּמוֹצִיא הַגְּדָיִּים תְּחִלָּה וּמַאֲכִילָן רָאשֵׁי עֲשָׂבִים הָעֶלְיוֹנִים שֶׁהֵם רַכִּים, וּמוֹצִיא הַתְּיָשִׁים אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְאוֹכְלִין אֶמְצַע הָעֲשָׂבִים, וְאַחַר כָּךְ מוֹצִיא הַזְּקֵנוֹת וְאוֹכְלוֹת הַשָּׁרָשִׁים. אָמַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: רָאוּי הוּא זֶה לִהְיוֹת רוֹעֶה אֶת עַמִּי:


**From behind the nursing ewes He brought him** For he would shepherd the nursing ewes for his father, because he was merciful and would bring the kids first and feed them the upper tips of the grasses, which are tender. Then after them he would bring out the he-goats, who would eat the middle of the grasses, and afterwards, he would bring out the older ones, who would eat the roots. Said the Holy One, blessed be He, “This one is fit to shepherd My people.”



## Chapter 79


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 79:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:1:1)


**לְעִיִּים.** לְגַלִּים. וּמַהוּ מִזְמוֹר, וַהֲלֹא קִינָה הִיא?! אֶלָּא לְפִי שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״כִּלָּה ה׳ אֶת חֲמָתוֹ״ (איכה ד:יא), וּבַמֶּה כִּלָּה? ״וַיַּצֶּת אֵשׁ בְּצִיּוֹן״ (איכה ד:יא) – מִזְמוֹר וְשִׁיר הוּא, שֶׁשָּׁפַךְ חֲמָתוֹ עַל עֵצִים וְעַל הָאֲבָנִים וְלֹא עָשָׂה כְּלָיָה בְּבָנָיו:


**into heaps** Now what is this song? Is it not a lamentation? But because it says (Lam. 4:11): “The Lord has spent His fury.” With what has He spent it? “He has kindled a fire in Zion.” This is a song and an occasion for singing, for He poured out His fury on the wood and stones and did not utterly destroy His children.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 79:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:2:1)


**בְּשַׂר חֲסִידֶיךָ.** וַהֲלֹא רְשָׁעִים הָיוּ? אֶלָּא מִשֶּׁקִּבְּלוּ פֻּרְעָנוּתָם, הֲרֵי הֵם חֲסִידִים. וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר ״וְנִקְלָה אָחִיךָ״ (דברים כה:ג) – כֵּיוָן שֶׁלָּקָה, אָחִיךָ הוּא. כֵּן מְפֹרָשׁ בָּאַגָּדָה:


**the flesh of Your pious ones** Now were they not wicked? But since they received their punishment, they are accounted as pious men. Similarly, Scripture states (Deut. 25:3): “your brother would be degraded before your eyes.” As soon as he is lashed, he is your brother. It is explained in this manner in the Aggadah (Mid. Ps. 79:4).



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 79:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:4:1)


**וָקֶלֶס.** לְשׁוֹן דִּבָּה, לְדַבֵּר בָּם, כְּמוֹ ״לְמָשָׁל״ (דברים כח:לז):


**and derision** Heb. וקלס, an expression of speech, to speak of them as for a byword.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 79:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:5:1)


**עַד מָה.** עַד מָתַי?


**How long** Heb. עד מה [lit. until what.] Until when?


###### Rashi on Psalms 79:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:5:2)


**תֶּאֱנַף.** תִּקְצֹף:


**Your jealousy** Your wrath,


###### Rashi on Psalms 79:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:5:3)


**קִנְאָתֶךָ.** חֲמָתְךָ שֶׁאַתָּה מְקַנֵּא לְהִנָּקֵם, לְשׁוֹן ״אֵל קַנָּא״ (שמות כ:ה). אִינְפְרִינְמַנְ״ט בְּלַעַ״ז:


**that You are jealous** to wreak vengeance, an expression of (Exod. 20:5): “a jealous (קנא) God,” emportement or enprenemant in Old French, zealous anger.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 79:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:11:1)


**הוֹתֵר.** פַּתַּח אֲסִירִים מִמַּסְגֵּר שֶׁלָּהֶם, כְּמוֹ ״מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים״ (תהלים קמו:ז), ״שָׁלַח מֶלֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ״ (תהלים קה:כ):


**set free** Heb. הותר, release the prisoners from their prison, as (below 105:20): “A king sent and released him (ויתירהו)”; (146:7), “sets loose (מתיר) the bound.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 79:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/79:11:2)


**בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה.** בְּנֵי הַנֶּהֱרֶגֶת עָלֶיךָ, **תְמוּתָה** אִינְמוֹרִינִיד״א בְּלַעַ״ז, וְיֵשׁ דּוּגְמָתוֹ בִּלְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים: מוּטָב שֶׁיֹּאכְלוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשַׂר תְּמוּתָה שְׁחוּטָה וְאַל יֹאכְלוּ בְּשַׂר תְּמוּתָה נְבֵלָה, וּפֵרוּשׁוֹ בְּשַׂר מְסֻכֶּנֶת שֶׁשְּׁחָטָהּ בְּמַסֶּכֶת קִדּוּשִׁין (קדושין כא:-כב.):


**the children of the mother who died** The children of her who was killed because of You; enmorinede in Old French, doomed to die. There is an example in the Sages’ language: “It is better that Jews eat the flesh of slaughtered dying beasts rather than eat the flesh of the carcasses of dying animals.” That means the flesh of a dying animal that was slaughtered, in tractate Kiddushin (21b).



## Chapter 80


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:1:1)


**אֶל שׁוֹשַׁנִּים.** אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל (שיר השירים ב:ב):


**to the roses** To Israel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:1:2)


**עֵדוּת לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר.** מִזְמוֹר שֶׁל עֵדוּת, שֶׁרָמַז לָהֶם בּוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ גָּלֻיּוֹת וְהִתְפַּלֵּל עֲלֵיהֶם, שֶׁהֲרֵי נֶאֱמַר בְּמִזְמוֹר זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים **הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ הָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה**; וְרָמַז לָהֶם בּוֹ צָרוֹת הָעֲתִידוֹת לָבֹא לָהֶם בִּימֵי בֵּית יֵהוּא מִמַּלְכֵי אֲרָם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (מלכים ב יג:ז) בִּימֵי יְהוּא ״כִּי אִבְּדָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיְשִׂימֵם כֶּעָפָר לָדוּשׁ״:


**a testimony, of Asaph, a song** A song of testimony in which he alluded to the three exiles and prayed about them. For it is mentioned in this psalm three times: “Return us, cause Your countenance to shine, and we shall be saved,” and in it, he alluded to the troubles that were destined to befall them in the days of the house of Jehu, from the kings of Aram. For it is stated (II Kings 13:7): “for the king of Aram had destroyed them and made them like dust to trample.”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:2:1)


**רֹעֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל.** מַנְהִיגָם וּפַרְנָס שֶׁלָּהֶם:


**O Shepherd of Israel** Their leader and supporter.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:2:2)


**יוֹסֵף.** וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל נִקְרָאִים עַל שֵׁם יוֹסֵף, לְפִי שֶׁהוּא פִּרְנְסָם וְכִלְכְּלָם בִּימֵי הָרָעָב (בראשית מז:יב):


**Joseph** All Israel are called by the name Joseph because he sustained and supported them in time of famine.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:2:3)


**יוֹשֵׁב הַכְּרוּבִים.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְנוֹעַדְתִּי לְךָ שָׁם וְגוֹ׳״ (שמות כה:כב):


**He Who dwells between the cherubim** As it is said (Exod. 25:22): “There I shall meet with you at appointed times, etc.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:2:4)


**הוֹפִיעָה.** הַרְאֵה גְּבוּרָתְךָ:


**appear** Demonstrate Your might.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:1)


**לִפְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּבִנְיָמִן וּמְנַשֶּׁה.** כְּשֶׁיִּהְיוּ צְרִיכִים לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהֵם רְשָׁעִים וְאֵינָם כְּדַי, **עוֹרְרָה גְבוּרָתְךָ** לָהֶם. וְלָמָּה? כִּי **לְכָה לִישׁוּעָתָה לָּנוּ**, לְךָ נָאֶה וְעָלֶיךָ לְהוֹשִׁיעַ, בֵּין חַיָּבִים וּבֵין זַכָּאִים. כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר לְמֹשֶׁה בְּמִצְרַיִם: (שמות ג:ז) ״רָאֹה רָאִיתִי אֶת עֳנִי עַמִּי״. שְׁתֵּי רְאִיּוֹת הַלָּלוּ לָמָּה? רוֹאֶה אֲנִי שֶׁהֵם עֲתִידִים לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן רָאִיתִי אֶת עָנְיָם, מִפְּנֵי הַשְּׁבוּעָה שֶׁנִּשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם (תנחומא, שמות כ):


**Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh** when they need Your salvation. Although they are wicked and undeserving, arouse Your might for them. But why? Because it is for You to save us. It is fitting for You and it is incumbent upon You to save, whether guilty or innocent, as it was said to Moses in Egypt (Exod. 3:7): “I have seen the affliction of My people.” Why is the word for seeing repeated? I see that they are destined to provoke Me. Nevertheless, I have seen their affliction, because of the oath that I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:2)


**אֶפְרַיִם.** בְּמִלְחֶמֶת אֲרָם, כְּשֶׁצָּר עַל שׁוֹמְרוֹן (מלכים א כ:א) וְשָׁלַח מַלְאָכִים לְאַחְאָב: ״כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ לִי הוּא וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים לִי הֵם״ (מלכים א כ:ג):


**Ephraim** in the war with Aram, when he besieged Samaria and sent emissaries to Ahab (I Kings 20:3): “Your silver and gold are mine; your beautiful wives and children are mine.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:3)


**מְנַשֶּׁה.** בִּימֵי יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָז, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״כִּי רָאָה ה׳ בָּעֳנִי יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (מלכים ב יג:כו), ״כִּי אִבְּדָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיְשִׂימֵם כֶּעָפָר לָדוּשׁ״ (מלכים ב יג:ז), וְהִכּוּ שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּמִּלְחָמָה, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר שָׁם: ״שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הִכָּהוּ יוֹאָשׁ וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (מלכים ב יג:כה). בְּפֵרוּשִׁים אֲחֵרִים מָצָאתִי שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים תַּכֶּה אֶת אֲרָם״ וַאֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיב אֶת עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**Manasseh** in the days of Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz, as it is said (II Kings 13:4, 7): “for He saw Israel’s oppression, etc., for the king of Aram had destroyed them and made them like dust to trample.” And he beat him in war three times, as it is said (II Kings 13: 25): “Joash overcame him three times and recovered the cities of Israel.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:4)


**בִּנְיָמִין.** בִּימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ, שֶׁהָיוּ מָרְדְּכַי וְאֶסְתֵּר בְּסַכָּנָה, וְכָל הַדּוֹר תָּלוּי בָּהֶם (מגילה יב.):


**Benjamin** in the time of Ahasuerus, when Mordechai and Esther were in danger, and all Israel depended on them.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:3:5)


**וּלְכָה לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּנוּ.** אֵין זֶה לְשׁוֹן הֲלִיכָה, אֶלָּא כְּמוֹ ״לְךָ״, וְכֵן הוּא בַּמָּסֹרֶת ״וּלְכָה אֵיפוֹא״ דְּיַעֲקֹב (בראשית כז:לז), ״וּלְכָה אֵין בְּשׂוֹרָה מוֹצֵאת״ (שמואל ב יח:כב), ״שִׂמְלָה לְכָה קָצִין תִּהְיֶה לָּנוּ וְגוֹ׳״ (ישעיהו ג:ו):


**and it is for You to save us** Heb. ולכה. This is not an expression of going, but is like לְךָ, and so it is in the Masorah of (Gen. 27:37): “and for you (ולכה) then,” of Jacob; (II Sam. 18:22) “since for you (ולכה) there is no [reward] given for news”; (Isa. 3:6), “You have (לכה) a garment; be an officer to us, etc.”



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:4:1)


**הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ.** בְּגָלוּת בָּבֶל שֶׁהָיָה מָרְדֳּכַי שָׁם (אסתר ב:ה):


**return us** from the Babylonian exile, where Mordechai was.

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:5:1

**עַד מָתַי עָשַׁנְתָּ.** בַּצָּרוֹת מַלְכֵי יָוָן שֶׁהֵרֵעוּ מְאֹד לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:


**how long have You been wroth** [This refers to] the troubles brought about by the Greek kings, who harmed Israel considerably.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:6:1)


**הֶאֱכַלְתָּם לֶחֶם דִּמְעָה.** בְּמִצְרָיִם:


**You have fed them bread of tears** in Egypt.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:6:2)


**וַתַּשְׁקֵמוֹ בִּדְמָעוֹת שָׁלִישׁ.** בְּבָבֶל, שֶׁהָיוּ שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה, שֶׁהוּא שְׁלִישׁ שֶׁל מָאתַיִם וְעֶשֶׂר שֶׁל מִצְרַיִם. זוֹ לָמַדְתִּי מִיסוֹדוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי מֹשֶׁה הַדַּרְשָׁן. וְיֵשׁ לִפְתּוֹר: עַל שֵׁם שֶׁמַּלְכוּת יָוָן הָיְתָה הַצָּרָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית. וְאִם תֹּאמַר: רְבִיעִית הִיא, שֶׁהֲרֵי פָּרַס וּמָדַי קָדְמוּ? כָּל שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה שֶׁל בָּבֶל אֵינָהּ אֶלָּא גָּלוּת אַחַת. וּמְנַחֵם פֵּרֵשׁ: **שָׁלִישׁ** שֵׁם שֶׁל כְּלִי שֶׁשּׁוֹתִין בּוֹ, וְכֵן פֵּרֵשׁ ״וְכָל בַּשָּׁלִישׁ עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ״ (ישעיהו מ:יב). וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּהוּ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ דְּמָעוֹת שֶׁהוֹרִיד עֵשָׂו, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בּוֹ ״וַיִּצְעַק צְעָקָה״ (בראשית כז:לד) – הֲרֵי אַחַת, ״גְּדֹלָה״ – הֲרֵי שְׁתַּיִם, ״וּמָרָה״ – הֲרֵי שָׁלֹשׁ, וַעֲלֵיהֶם זָכָה לִחְיוֹת עַל חַרְבּוֹ: ״וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תָּרִיד וְגוֹ׳״ (בראשית כז:מ):


**and You have given them to drink tears in large measure** Heb. שליש. In Babylon, where they were for seventy years, a third (שליש) of the two hundred and ten of Egypt. I learned this from the work of Rabbi Moshe Hadarshan. It may also be interpreted as regards the kingdom of Greece, which represents the third trouble. If you ask, is that [not] the fourth, because Persia and Media came before, all the seventy years of the Babylonian exile are only one exile. Menachem (p. 175) interprets שליש as the name of a drinking vessel. So he explained (Isa. 40:12): “and He measured with a ‘shalish’ the dust of the earth.” Our Sages explained it (Mid. Ps. 80: 4) as referring to the three tears that Esau shed, concerning whom it is said (Gen. 27:34): “and he cried a cry.” That is one. “A great one.” That is two. “And a bitter one.” That is three. Because of them, he merited to live by his sword, as it is said (Gen. 27:40): “and it will come to pass when you complain, etc.”

### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:9:1)


**גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ וְגוֹ׳.** חָזַר וְרָמַז עַל גָּלוּת אֲרַמִּיִּים: גֶּפֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הִסַּעְתָּ מִמִּצְרַיִם, עָקַרְתָּ מִשָּׁם (חולין צב.), כְּמוֹ ״וַיַּסַּע כָּעֵץ תִּקְוָתִי״ (איוב יט:י), וְאַחַר כָּךְ גֵּרַשְׁתָּ שִׁבְעָה גוֹיִם וּנְטַעְתָּם בְּאַרְצָם:


**You uprooted a vine from Egypt** He went back and alluded to the exile of the Romans. The vine of Israel, which You uprooted from Egypt. You uprooted them from there, as (Job 19:10): “He has uprooted (ויסע) my hope like a tree.” Afterwards, You drove out the seven nations and planted Israel in their land.

### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:13:1)


**לָמָּה.** עַתָּה:


**Why** now?


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:13:2)


**פָּרַצְתָּ גְדֵרֶיהָ.** שֶׁל אוֹתָהּ הַכֶּרֶם:


**have You breached its fences** of that vineyard?


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:13:3)


**וְאָרוּהָ כָּל עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ.** לִקְּטוּהָ כָּל הַבָּא, כְּמוֹ ״אָרִיתִי מוֹרִי עִם בְּשָׂמִי״ (שיר השירים ה:א), וְכֵן בִּלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה: כִּמְלֹא אוֹרֶה וְסַלּוֹ (שביעית א:ב):


**so that all wayfarers have plucked its fruit** וארוה. All who came plucked it, as (Song 5:1): “I gathered (אריתי) my myrrh with my spices.” Similarly, in the language of the Mishnah (Shevi’ith 1:2): “as much space as is required by a picker (אורה) and his basket.”



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:14:1)


**יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה חֲזִיר מִיָּעַר.** כְּמוֹ שָׂדֶה שֶׁקִּרְסְמוּהָ נְמָלִים (פאה ב:ז) בִּלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה, וְהוּא לְשׁוֹן נְתִיקָה:


**The boar from the forest gnaws at it** Heb. יכרסמנה, as (Peah 2:7): “A field that the ants have nibbled (קרסמוה),” an expression of plucking out.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:14:2)


**מִיָּעַר.** הָעַיִ״ן תְּלוּיָה (וכאלו נכתב באל״ף). זָכוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל, הֲרֵי עֵשָׂו אוֹיְבָם כְּחַיַּת הַיְאוֹר שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם כֹּחַ לַעֲלוֹת בַּיַּבָּשָׁה, וּבִזְמַן שֶׁהַפֻּרְעָנוּת נִגְזַר עֲלֵיהֶם מִתְגַּבֵּר כְּחַיַּת הַיַּעַר שֶׁהִיא מַשְׁחֶתֶת וְהוֹרֶגֶת. וַ**חֲזִיר מִיָּעַר** הוּא עֲמָלֵק, כְּמוֹ דִּכְתִיב (דניאל ז:ז) ״אָכְלָה וּמְדַקָּה וּשְׁאָרָא בְּרַגְלַהּ רָפְסָה״, וְיֵשׁ לוֹ (לֶחָזִיר) מִקְצָת סִימָנֵי טָהֳרָה. אַף עֲמָלֵק יֵשׁ לוֹ זְכוּת אָבוֹת:


**from the forest** Heb. מיער. The “ayin” is suspended (as though it were written with an “aleph”). If Israel is worthy, the enemies are like the beasts of the river, which have no strength to climb out upon the dry land; but when retribution is decreed upon them, he (sic) grows strong as the beast of the forest, which destroys and kills. The boar of the forest is Esau, as is written (Dan. 7:7): “It devoured and broke in pieces and the rest it trampled with its feet.” And it (the swine) has some signs of purity. Esau, too, has the merit of his fathers.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:14:3)


**וְזִיז שָׂדַי.** כָּל רֶמֶשׂ הַשָּׂדֶה, וּלְשׁוֹן זִיז – שֶׁהוּא זָז מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וְהוֹלֵךְ:


**and the creeping things of the field** Heb. זיז, all creeping things of the field. The expression זיז means anything that constantly moves from its place.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:14:4)


**יִרְעֶנָּה.** רוֹעֶה עָלֶיהָ וַעֲנָפֶיהָ וְאוֹכְלָן:


**graze upon it** Graze upon it and its branches and eat them.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:16:1)


**וְכַנָּה אֲשֶׁר נָטְעָה יְמִינֶךָ.** הַמְבֻסֶּסֶת וְהַמְיֻשֶּׁבֶת לְשׁוֹן ״וַהֲשִׁיבְךָ עַל כַּנֶּךָ״ (בראשית מ:יג):


**And of the foundation that Your right hand has planted** Which is founded and established, which Your right hand has planted, an expression of (Gen. 40:13): “and restore you to your office (כנך) .”


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:16:2)


**וְעַל בֵּן אִמַּצְתָּ לָּךְ.** וְעַל עֵשָׂו, שֶׁהָיָה בֵּן חָבִיב לְאָבִיו, שֶׁהָיָה קוֹרֵא אוֹתוֹ בְּנִי (בראשית כז:א), אִמַּצְתָּ גֶּפֶן יַעֲקֹב לָךְ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְאֶת אָחִיךָ תַּעֲבֹד״ (בראשית כז:מ). עַכְשָׁיו:


**and over the son You have strengthened for Yourself** And over Esau, who was a beloved son to this father, who would call him, “my son.” You strengthened the vine of Jacob for Yourself, as it is said (Gen. 27:40): “and You will serve your brother.” Now it is...



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:17:1)


**שְׂרוּפָה בָאֵשׁ.** כְּסוּחָה, לְשׁוֹן ״לֹא תִזְמוֹר״ (ויקרא כה:ד), תִּרְגֵּם אוּנְקְלוֹס ״לָא תִכְסַח״:


**Burned with fire [and] cut off** Heb. כסוחה, an expression of (Lev. 25:4): “You shall not prune (תזמר), which Onkelos renders: לא תכסח.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:17:2)


**יֹאבֵדוּ.** תָּמִיד הֵם הוֹלְכִין וְאוֹבְדִין **מִגַּעֲרַת פָּנֶיךָ** וְזַעְפְּךָ:


**they perish** constantly; they continually perish from the rebuke of Your face and Your anger.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:18:1)


**תְּהִי יָדְךָ עַל אִישׁ יְמִינֶךָ.** תָּשִׁיב מַכּוֹתֶיךָ עַל עֵשָׂו, שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ הָעוֹמֵד לְהִפָּרַע יְמִינְךָ מִמֶּנּוּ:


**May Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand** Deliver Your blows upon the man—viz. Esau—who is destined to receive retribution from Your right hand.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:18:2)


**וְעַל בֶּן אָדָם.** אֲשֶׁר אִמַּצְתָּ לְךָ לִהְיוֹת מוֹשָׁבוֹ ״מִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ״ (בראשית כז:לט):


**upon the son of man** whom You strengthened for Yourself that his habitation should be the fat places of the earth.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:19:1)


**וְלֹא נָסוֹג מִמֶּךָּ.** וְאַל תִּגְרֹם לָנוּ לִהְיוֹת נְסוֹגִים מִמֶּךָּ:


**And let us not withdraw from You** Do not cause us to withdraw from You.


###### Rashi on Psalms 80:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:19:2)


**תְּחַיֵּנוּ.** מִן הַגָּלוּת וְנַזְכִּיר טוֹבָתְךָ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ, וְאָז **נִקְרָא בִּשְׁמֶךָ**:


**grant us life** from the exile, and we shall mention Your goodness and Your might, and then we shall call out in Your name.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 80:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/80:20:1)


**ה׳ אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת.** כָּאן נֶאֶמְרוּ שָׁלֹשׁ אַזְכָּרוֹת (שֶׁל שֵׁמוֹת), וּבָאֶמְצָעִי שְׁתֵּי אַזְכָּרוֹת (תהלים פ:ח), וּבָרִאשׁוֹן אַזְכָּרָה אַחַת (תהלים פ:ד). הַכֹּל לְפִי חֹזֶק הַגָּלֻיּוֹת וְהַצָּרָה וְהַגְּאֻלָּה:


**O Lord God of Hosts** Here are mentioned three holy names, yet in the middle case two names and in the first case one name. All this is according to the intensity of the exile, the trouble, and the redemption (which shall surely come).



## Chapter 81


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:1:1)


**עַל הַגִּתִּית.** כְּלִי שִׁיר הַבָּא מִגַּת:


**on the gittith** A musical instrument that comes from Gath.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:2:1)


**הָרִיעוּ.** בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה (ראש השנה ל:):


**sound the shofar** on Rosh Hashanah.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:3:1)


**כִּנּוֹר נָעִים עִם נָבֶל.** רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא אוֹמֵר: הוּא נֵבֶל הוּא כִּנּוֹר, וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: נִימִין (וִיתֵדוֹת) יְתֵרוֹת שֶׁבֵּין זֶה לָזֶה. לָמָּה נִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ נֵבֶל? שֶׁהוּא מְנַבֵּל כָּל מִינֵי זֶמֶר:


**a pleasant harp with a lyre** Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba says: The “kinnor” and the “nevel” are the same. Rabbi Simon says: The [number of] strings distinguishes one from the other. Why is it called “nevel”? Because it puts all other types of music to shame.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:4:1)


**בַּחֹדֶשׁ.** בְּחִדּוּשׁ הַלְּבָנָה:


**on the New Moon** When the moon renews itself.


###### Rashi on Psalms 81:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:4:2)


**בַּכֵּסֶה.** יוֹם מוֹעֵד קָבוּעַ לְכָךְ, וְכֵן ״לְיוֹם הַכֵּסֶא יָבֹא בֵיתוֹ״ (משלי ז:כ) – לַמּוֹעֵד הַקָּבוּעַ (ביצה טז.):


**on the appointed time** The appointed day for it, and so (Prov. 7:20): “on the appointed day (בכסה) he will come home”; to the appointed time that had been fixed.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:5:1)


**כִּי חֹק.** הוּא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לִתְקֹעַ בְּאוֹתוֹ הַיּוֹם, וְהוּא יוֹם הַ**מִּשְׁפָּט** לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:


**For it is a statute** for Israel from the Holy One, blessed be He, to sound the shofar on that day, the day of the judgment of the Holy One, blessed be He.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:6:1)


**עֵדוּת בִּיהוֹסֵף שָׂמוֹ.** בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יָצָא יוֹסֵף מִבֵּית הָאֲסוּרִים (ראש השנה י:):


**As a testimony for Jehoseph He ordained it** On Rosh Hashanah, Joseph went out of prison.


###### Rashi on Psalms 81:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:6:2)


**שְׂפַת לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֶשְׁמָע.** מְפֹרָשׁ בְּמַסֶּכֶת סוֹטָה (סוטה לו:), שֶׁלִּמְּדוֹ גַבְרִיאֵל שִׁבְעִים לָשׁוֹן:


**[when] I understood a language that I had not known** It is explained in tractate Sotah (36b) that [the angel] Gabriel taught him seventy languages.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:7:1)


**מִדּוּד.** מֵעֲבוֹדַת עַבְדוּת לְבַשֵּׁל קְדֵרוֹת כְּדֶרֶךְ שְׁאָר הָעֲבָדִים:


**from the cauldron** From slave labor to cook the pots in the manner of other slaves.


###### Rashi on Psalms 81:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:7:2)


**מִדּוּד.** קְדֵרָה, כְּמוֹ ״וְהִכָּה בַכִּיּוֹר אוֹ בַדּוּד״ (שמואל א ב:יד):


**from the cauldron** Heb. מדוד, a pot, as (I Sam. 2:14): “And he would thrust into the fire-pot or into the pot (הדוד).”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:8:1)


**בַּצָּרָה קָרָאתָ.** לִי כֻּלְּכֶם קְרָאתֶם מִצָּרַת עֲבוֹדַת סִבְלוֹת מִצְרַיִם, וָאֲחַלֵּץ אֶתְכֶם:


**In distress, you called** to Me, all of you. You called from the distress of the labor of the burdens of Egypt, and I released you.


###### Rashi on Psalms 81:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:8:2)


**אֶעֶנְךָ בְּסֵתֶר רַעַם.** אַתָּה קְרָאתַנִי בְּסֵתֶר, בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ, וַאֲנִי עָנִיתִיךָ בְּקוֹל רַעַם; הוֹדַעְתִּי גְּבוּרוֹת וְנוֹרָאוֹת בְּפַרְהֶסְיָא:


**I answered you in secret with thunder** You called in secret between Me and you, but I answered you with a voice of thunder; I made known My might and My awesome deeds in public.


###### Rashi on Psalms 81:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:8:3)


**אֶבְחָנְךָ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָה סֶלָה.** וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁגָּלוּי וּבָחוּן לְפָנַי, שֶׁאַתֶּם עֲתִידִים לְהַמְרוֹתִי בְּמֵי מְרִיבָה (במדבר כ), כָּךְ שְׁנוּיָה בַּמְּכִילְתָּא (מכילתא יתרו בחדש א):


**I tried you by the waters of Meribah, forever** Although it was revealed and tried before Me that you were destined to provoke Me with the waters of Meribah. So it was taught in Mechilta (Exod. 19:2).



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:9:1)


**שְׁמַע עַמִּי.** אַחֲרֵי שֶׁכָּל זֹאת עָשִׂיתִי לְךָ, כְּדַאי אַתָּה לִשְׁמֹעַ לִי:


**Hearken, My people** Since I did all this for you, it is fitting for you to hearken to Me.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:11:1)


**הַרְחֶב פִּיךָ.** לִשְׁאוֹל מִמֶּנִּי כָּל תַּאֲוַת לִבְּךָ:


**open your mouth wide** to request of Me whatever your heart desires.


###### Rashi on Psalms 81:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:11:2)


**וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ.** כְּכָל אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁאַל אֲמַלֵּא:


**and I shall fill it** According to whatever you ask I will fill.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:13:1)


**בִּשְׁרִירוּת לִבָּם.** בְּמַרְאִית לִבָּם, כְּמוֹ ״לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי״ (תהלים ה:ט):


**after their heart’s fantasies** Heb. בשרירותלבם, after the views of their heart, as (above 5: 9): “because of those who lie in wait for me (שוררי).”



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:14:1)


**לוּ עַמִּי שׁוֹמֵעַ לִי.** עֲדַיִן אִם הָיוּ רוֹצִין לָשׁוּב לִי וְלִשְׁמֹעַ אֵלַי:


**If only My people would hearken to Me** Still, if they desired to return to Me and to hearken to Me...



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:15:1)


**כִּמְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶם אַכְנִיעַ.** בְּשָׁעָה מוּעֶטֶת הָיִיתִי מַכְנִיעַ אוֹיְבֵיהֶם:


**In a short time I would subdue their enemies** In a short time I would subdue their enemies.


###### Rashi on Psalms 81:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:15:2)


**אָשִׁיב יָדִי.** אָשִׁיב מַכָּתִי מֵעֲלֵיכֶם לָתֵת אוֹתָהּ עֲלֵיהֶם, וְאָז:


**I would return My hand** I would return my blow from upon you to lay it upon them, and then...



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:16:1)


**מְשַׂנְאֵי ה׳ יְכַחֲשׁוּ לוֹ וִיהִי עִתָּם.** פּוּרְעָנוּתָם **לְעוֹלָם**:


**The enemies of the Lord would lie to Him, and their time would be** [The time of] their retribution [would be] forever.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 81:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:17:1)


**וַיַּאֲכִילֵהוּ.** לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:


**Then He would feed them** Israel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 81:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/81:17:2)


**וּמִצּוּר.** הִשְׂבִּיעָם דְּבַשׁ כְּשֶׁהָלְכוּ בִדְרָכָיו, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וַיֵּנִקֵהוּ דְבַשׁ מִסֶּלַע״ (דברים לב:יג):


**and...from a rock** He sated them with honey when they went in His ways, as the matter that is stated (Deut. 32:13): “He suckled them with honey from the rock.”



## Chapter 82


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 82:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:1:1)


**אֱלֹהִים נִצָּב בַּעֲדַת אֵל.** לִרְאוֹת אִם אֱמֶת יִשְׁפֹּטוּ. וְאַתֶּם, הַדַּיָּנִים, **עַד מָתַי תִּשְׁפְּטוּ עָוֶל**?!


**God stands in the congregation of God** to see whether they [the judges] judge fairly, and you judges, how long will you judge unjustly?



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 82:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:3:1)


**הַצְדִּיקוּ.** אִם זַכַּאי הוּא בְּדִינוֹ, אַל תַּהַפְּכוּ דִינוֹ לְטוֹבָה בִּשְׁבִיל לָשֵׂאת פְּנֵי רְשָׁעִים:


**justify** If he [the poor man] is right in his cause, do not reverse the verdict to condemn him in order to favor the wicked.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 82:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:5:1)


**לֹא יָדְעוּ.** הַדַּיָּנִין הַמְעַוְּתִים אֶת הַדִּין:


**They did not know** The judges who pervert justice.


###### Rashi on Psalms 82:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:5:2)


**וְלֹא יָבִינוּ.** אֶת אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁבִיל הֶעָוֹן הַזֶּה **יִתְהַלְּכוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָה** (עַל דֶּרֶךְ ״כִּי הַשֹּׁחַד יְעַוֵּר וְגוֹ׳״ (שמות כג:ח)), וְ**יִמּוֹטוּ** עַל כָּךְ **מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ**:


**and they do not understand** that because of this iniquity, they will walk in the dark (on the order of [Exod. 23:8]: “for bribery blinds, etc.”), and all the foundations of the earth will totter because of it.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 82:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:6:1)


**אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם.** מַלְאָכִים; כְּשֶׁנָּתַתִּי לָכֶם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה, נְתַתִּיהָ לָכֶם עַל מְנָת שֶׁאֵין מַלְאַךְ הַמָּוֶת שׁוֹלֵט עוֹד בָּכֶם:


**You are angelic creatures** Angels. When I gave you the Torah, I gave it to you on the condition that the Angel of Death should not rule over you.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 82:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:7:1)


**אָכֵן כְּאָדָם תְּמוּתוּן.** אָכֵן כְּאָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן תְּמוּתוּן, אַחֲרֵי שֶׁחִבַּלְתֶּם מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם כְּמוֹהוּ (עבודה זרה ה,א; מכילתא יתרו בחדש ט):


**Indeed, as man, you will die** Indeed, as Adam, you will die since you corrupted your deeds as he did.


###### Rashi on Psalms 82:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:7:2)


**וּכְאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים.** הָרִאשׁוֹנִים שֶׁמֵּתוּ, כֵּן **תִּפֹּלוּ**. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה : כְּאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים שֶׁל מַעְלָה, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ישעיהו כד:כא): ״יִפְקֹד ה׳ עַל צְבָא הַמָּרוֹם בַּמָּרוֹם״:


**and as one of the princes** the first [princes], who died, so will you fall. The Midrash Aggadah (Mid. Ps. 82:3) [explains]: As one of the celestial princes, for it is said (Isa. 24:21): “the Lord will visit punishment upon the host of heaven on high.”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 82:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:8:1)


**קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים.** אָסָף הִתְחִיל לְהִתְפַּלֵּל שֶׁיָּקוּם וְיַכְרִית אוֹתָם הַדַּיָּנִין הַמְקֻלְקָלִין מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל:


**Arise, O God** Asaph commences to pray that He rise and cut off from Israel those corrupt judges.


###### Rashi on Psalms 82:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/82:8:2)


**כִּי אַתָּה.** הוּא הַנּוֹחֵל הַגּוֹיִם, וְהַכֹּל בְּיָדְךָ לִשְׁפּוֹט:


**for You** are the One Who inherits the nations, and everyone is in Your hands to judge.



## Chapter 83


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 83:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:2:1)


**אַל דֳּמִי לָךְ.** אַל תִּתֵּן שְׁתִיקָה לְעַוּוֹתָתֵינוּ שֶׁאוֹיְבֵינוּ מְרֵיעִים לָנוּ:


**have no silence** Do not give silence to our wrongs, with which our enemies harm us.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 83:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:6:1)


**עָלֶיךָ בְּרִית יִכְרֹתוּ.** בְּרִית זוֹ אֵינָהּ אֶלָּא עָלֶיךָ, לְהַשְׁכִּיחַ אֶת שִׁמְךָ, שֶׁאֵין אַתָּה קָרוּי **אֱלֹהִים** אֶלָּא לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּמֵאַחַר שֶׁ**לֹּא יִזָּכֵר שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל** אַף שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל אֵינוֹ נִזְכָּר. כָּךְ מָצָאתִי:


**against You they form a pact** This pact is only against You, to cause Your name to be forgotten, for You are called the God of Israel, and since Israel will not be remembered, even Your great name is not remembered. I found this.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 83:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:9:1)


**גַּם אַשּׁוּר.** אַף אַשּׁוּר שֶׁהָיָה נִזְהָר עַד הַיּוֹם מִשְּׁאָר עֵצָה סְכָלָה וְלֹא יִתְחַבֵּר עִם מְרֵעִים, כְּמָה דְאַתְּ אָמַר (בראשית י:יא) ״מִן הָאָרֶץ הַהִיא יָצָא אַשּׁוּר״, שֶׁיָּצָא מֵעֲצַת דּוֹר הַפְּלַגָּה, כָּאן **נִלְוָה עִמָּם** וַעֲזָרָם לְרָעָה (בפרושים אחרים מצאתי כן). **גַּם אַשּׁוּר נִלְוָה עִמָּם וְגוֹ׳.** גַּם זֶה שֶׁהָיָה מְחַבֵּב מִתְּחִלָּתוֹ מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים שֶׁפֵּרַשׁ מֵעֲצַת נִמְרוֹד שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר מִן הָאָרֶץ הַהִיא יָצָא אַשּׁוּר, אַף הוּא חָזַר לִהְיוֹת רָשָׁע. לְכָךְ נִשְׁתַּתֵּף לְהַחֲרִיב בֵּיתְךָ (בראשית רבה לז:ד):


**Also Assyria** Even Assyria, which until that day was careful of other foolish counsels and would not join evildoers, as it says (Gen. 10:11): “From that land Asshur went forth,” that he left the counsel of the generation of dispersion [which built the tower], joined them here and assisted them for evil. (In other commentaries I found this:) **Also Assyria joined them, etc.** Also this one, who initially loved good deeds—for he separated from Nimrod’s counsel, as it is said: “From that land Asshur went forth”—he too reverted to wickedness. Therefore, he participated in destroying Your temple. Genesis Rabbah 37:4.


###### Rashi on Psalms 83:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:9:2)


**הָיוּ זְרוֹעַ.** כָּל אֵלֶּה נָתְנוּ כֹּחַ וְעֶזְרָה לְמוֹאָב וְעַמּוֹן שְׁכֵנֵינוּ לָבֹא עָלֵינוּ:


**they were the arm** All these gave strength and aid to Moab and Ammon, our neighbors, to come upon us.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 83:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:10:1)


**עֲשֵׂה לָהֶם כְּמִדְיָן.** עַל יְדֵי גִּדְעוֹן (שופטים ז-ח):


**Do to them as [to] Midian** through Gideon.


###### Rashi on Psalms 83:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:10:2)


**כְּסִיסְרָא.** עַל יְדֵי בָּרָק (שופטים ד:ט):

### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 83:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:11:1)


**נִשְׁמְדוּ בְעֵין דֹּאַר.** אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ אֵיזוֹ מִן הַמִּלְחָמוֹת הָיְתָה בְּעֵין דֹּאַר, שֶׁל גִּדְעוֹן (שופטים ז:א) אוֹ שֶׁל בָּרָק (שופטים ה:יט):


**They were destroyed in En-Dor** I do not know which of the wars took place in En-Dor, that of Gideon or that of Barak.


###### Rashi on Psalms 83:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:11:2)


**הָיוּ דֹמֶן.** ״זֶבֶל מְפֻזָּר״, תִּרְגֵּם יוֹנָתָן:


**dung** Heb. דמן, scattered dung, as translated by Jonathan.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 83:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:13:1)


**אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ.** הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלּוּ הָאֲמוּרִים לְמַעְלָה, אֱדוֹם וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל וְכָל חֲבֵרֵיהֶם:


**Who said** These nations mentioned above: Edom, Ishmael, and all their allies.


###### Rashi on Psalms 83:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:13:2)


**נִירֲשָׁה לָּנוּ אֵת נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים.** אֶת נְוֵה בֵּית אֱלֹהִים:


**“Let us inherit for ourselves the dwellings of God”** The dwelling of the house of God.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 83:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:14:1)


**שִׁיתֵמוֹ כַגַּלְגַּל.** וּ**כְקַשׁ** הַנִּדָּפִים מִפְּנֵי **רוּחַ**, וּמַהוּ גַּלְגַּל? הוּא רָאשֵׁי קוֹצֵי הַשָּׂדֶה הַקְּרוּיִים קרדנ״ש בְּלַעַ״ז, וּכְשֶׁמַּגִּיעִין יְמֵי הַחֹרֶף נִתָּקִים וְנִשְׁחָתִים מֵאֲלֵיהֶם וּפוֹרְחִין מְעַט מְעַט, וְדוֹמֶה אוֹתוֹ הַנִּתָּק מֵהֶם כְּמִין גַּלְגַּלֵּי אוֹפַן עֲגָלָה, וְהָרוּחַ מוֹלִיכָתָן:


**My God, make them like thistles, like stubble** which are driven away by the wind. Now what is גלגל? It is the tips of the thorns of the field, which are called chardons in French, thistles. When winter arrives, they are plucked out and disintegrate, and little by little they fly [away]. The part that is plucked out of them resembles the wheels of a wagon, and the wind carries them.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 83:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/83:16:1)


**וּבְסוּפָתְךָ.** טוֹרְבִּילְיוֹ״ן בְּלַעַ״ז:


**and with Your whirlwind** Tourbillon in French, whirlwind.



## Chapter 84


### Verse 2

**מַה יְּדִידוֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ.** כַּמָּה אֲהוּבוֹת וַחֲבִיבוֹת **מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ**:


**How beloved are Your dwelling places** How beloved and dear are Your dwelling places!



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:3:1)


**נִכְסְפָה.** נֶחְמְדָה:


**yearns** Heb. נכספה Desires.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:3:2)


**כָּלְתָה.** נִתְאַוְּתָה, כְּמוֹ ״וַתְּכַל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ לָצֵאת אֶל אַבְשָׁלוֹם״ (שמואל ב יג:לט):


**pines** Heb. כלתה, desires, as (II Sam. 13:39): “And [the soul of] King David longed (ותכל) to go forth to Absalom.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:3:3)


**לְחַצְרוֹת ה׳.** כִּי חָרְבוּ, וְעַל הַגָּלוּת אָמְרָה:


**for the courts of the Lord** for they have been destroyed, and he says this regarding the exile.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:3:4)


**לִבִּי וּבְשָׂרִי יְרַנְּנוּ.** יִתְפַּלְּלוּ עַל זֹאת:


**my heart and my flesh pray fervently** They pray for this.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:4:1)


**גַּם צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת.** בְּחֻרְבָּנוֹ קִנְּנוּ בוֹ הַצִּפֳּרִים. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה: בְּבִנְיָנוֹ מְדַבֵּר, וְהַצִּפּוֹר הִיא כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**Even a bird found a house** In its ruins, the birds have nested. According to Midrash Aggadah (Mid. Ps. 84:2), it speaks of [the Temple] when it is built, and the bird is the nation of Israel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:4:2)


**אֲשֶׁר שָׁתָה.** שָׂמָה:



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:5:1)


**אַשְׁרֵי.** מִי שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ עוֹד לֵישֵׁב בְּבֵיתֶךָ, **וְעוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ** בְּתוֹכוֹ:


**Fortunate** is he who will yet merit to dwell in Your house, and they will yet praise you in its midst.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:6:1)


**עֹז לוֹ בָךְ.** אֲשֶׁר שָׂם אוֹתְךָ עֹז מִבְטַחוֹ:


**who has strength in You** Who has made You the strength of his trust.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:6:2)


**מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָם.** מְחַשֵּׁב בְּלִבּוֹ מְסִלּוֹת דְּרָכָיו לְיַשֵּׁר אֶת דַּרְכּוֹ:


**in whose heart are the highways** Who thinks in his heart the paving of his ways, to straighten his way.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:7:1)


**עוֹבְרֵי בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא.** אוֹתָם הָעוֹבְרִים עַל דָּתְךָ, וְהִנָּם בְּעוּמְקָהּ שֶׁל גֵּיהִנֹּם בִּבְכִי וִילָלָה:


**Transgressors in the valley of weeping** Those who transgress Your law behold, they are in the depth of Gehinnom with weeping and wailing.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:7:2)


**מַעְיָן יְשִׁיתוּהוּ.** בְּדִמְעוֹת עֵינֵיהֶם:


**make it into a fountain** with the tears of their eyes.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:7:3)


**גַּם בְּרָכוֹת יַעֲטֶה מוֹרֶה.** מְבָרְכִים וּמוֹדִים לִשְׁמוֹ, וְאוֹמְרִים: יָפֶה דָּן אוֹתָנוּ וֶאֱמֶת דִּינוֹ, וּבְרָכוֹת יַעֲטֶה לָנוּ הַמּוֹרִים אוֹתָנוּ לָלֶכֶת בְּדֶרֶךְ הַטּוֹב, וְלֹא שָׁמַעְנוּ לוֹ:


**also with blessings they enwrap [their] Teacher** They bless and thank His name and say, “He judged us fairly, and His judgment is true.” (Another explanation: Shem Ephraim) And the one who taught us to follow the good way enwraps us with blessings, but we did not obey him.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:8:1)


**יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל חָיִל.** אוֹתָם הַנִּזְכָּרִים לְמַעְלָה **יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ** אֲשֶׁר **מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָם**):


**They go from host to host** Those mentioned above, who dwell in Your house, in whose heart are the highways.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:8:2)


**מֵחַיִל אֶל חָיִל.** מִבֵּית הַמִּדְרָשׁ לְבֵית הַכְּנֶסֶת, וְיֵרָאֶה צְבָאָם וְחֵילָם אֶל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּצִיּוֹן:


**from host to host** From the study-hall to the synagogue, and their host and army will appear to the Holy One, blessed be He, in Zion.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:9:1
