**שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי.** לִבְנוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ:


**hearken to my prayer** to build Your house.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:10:1)


**מָגִנֵּנוּ.** הוּא בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הַמֵּגִין עָלֵינוּ:


**our shield** That is the Temple, which protects us.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:10:2)


**וְהַבֵּט פְּנֵי (דָּוִד) מְשִׁיחֶךָ.** וְהִסְתַּכֵּל בְּחֲסָדָיו וּבְטָרְחוֹ אֲשֶׁר טָרַח וְיָגַע עַל בִּנְיָנוֹ:


**look at the face of** David Your anointed, and ponder his acts of kindness and his toil, by which he toiled and wearied himself in its building.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:11:1)


**כִּי טוֹב יוֹם.** אֶחָד בַּחֲצֵרֶיךָ וּלְמָחָר יָמוּת, מִלִּחְיוֹת אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר:


**For a day is better** [To live] one [day] in Your courts and die the next [is better than] to live a thousand years someplace else.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:11:2)


**בָּחַרְתִּי הִסְתּוֹפֵף.** עַל הַסַּף וְעַל הַמְּזוּזוֹת לִשְׁקוֹד:


**I chose to sit on the threshold** Heb. הסתופף, to sit habitually on the threshold and by the doorpost.


###### Rashi on Psalms 84:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:11:3)


**מִדּוּר בְּאָהֳלֵי רֶשַׁע.** מִלִּהְיוֹת דָּר בְּשַׁלְוָה בְּאָהֳלֵי עֵשָׂו הָרָשָׁע לְהִדָּבֵק בָּהֶם:


**rather than dwell in tents of wickedness** rather than dwell tranquilly in the tents of the wicked Esau, to cleave to them.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 84:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/84:12:1)


**כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן.** יֵשׁ לִפְתֹּר שֶׁמֶשׁ כְּמַשְׁמָעוֹ, וּמִדְרַשׁ תְּהִלִּים פּוֹתְרוֹ לְשׁוֹן שִׁנֵּי חוֹמָה:


**For a sun and a shield** שמש may be interpreted according to its apparent meaning, but Midrash Psalms interprets it as an expression of the points of the wall.



## Chapter 85


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 85:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:2:1)


**רָצִיתָ ה׳ אַרְצְךָ וְגוֹ׳.** אִם שַׁבְתָּ שְׁבוּת יַעֲקֹב וְנָשָׂאתָ אֶת עֲוֹנָם וְכִסִּיתָ חַטָּאתָם, וְאָסַפְתָּ עֶבְרָתְךָ מֵהֶם וַהֲשִׁיבוֹתָ עַצְמְךָ מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ, אָז **רָצִיתָ אַרְצֶךָ** וְעוֹלָמְךָ מִתְרַצֶּה. וְכָל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא תַּעֲשֶׂה זֹאת, אֵין אַרְצְךָ וְעוֹלָמְךָ מִתְרַצֶּה:


**O Lord, You have appeased Your land, etc.** If You have returned the captivity of Jacob and forgiven their iniquity, and have concealed their sin and withdrawn Your wrath from them and retreated from Your fierce anger, then You have appeased Your land, and Your world will be appeased. But as long as You do not do this, Your land and Your world will not be appeased.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 85:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:5:1)


**שׁוּבֵנוּ.** שׁוּב אַתָּה וַהֲשִׁיבֵנוּ (שוחר טוב פה:ג):


**Return us** You return and bring us back.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 85:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:7:1)


**הֲלֹא אַתָּה.** סוֹפְךָ שֶׁתָּשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּנוּ, שֶׁהֲרֵי הִבְטַחְתָּנוּ כֵּן עַל יְדֵי נְבִיאֶךָ (יחזקאל לז):


**Will You not** ultimately return and revive us, for [so] You promised us through Your prophet.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 85:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:9:1)


**אֶשְׁמְעָה מַה יְדַבֵּר.** אֶזְכֶּה לִשְׁמֹעַ מַה יְדַבֵּר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא כְּשֶׁיְּדַבֵּר שָׁלוֹם אֶל עַמּוֹ:


**I shall hear what God will speak** I shall merit to hear what the Holy One, blessed be He, will speak when He speaks peace to His people.


###### Rashi on Psalms 85:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:9:2)


**לְכִסְלָה.** לְשִׁטּוּת, לַחֲטֹא לְפָנָיו:


**to folly** Heb. לכסלה, to foolishness, to sin before Him.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 85:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:11:1)


**חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת נִפְגָּשׁוּ.** שֶׁיִּהְיוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל דּוֹבְרֵי אֱמֶת, וּמִן הַשָּׁמַיִם יִפְגֹּשׁ בָּהֶם הַחֶסֶד:


**Kindness and truth have met** That Israel will speak truth, and from heaven kindness will meet them.


###### Rashi on Psalms 85:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:11:2)


**צֶדֶק וְשָׁלוֹם נָשָׁקוּ.** הַצְּדָקָה שֶׁהָיוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹשִׂים, וְהַשָּׁלוֹם מֵאֵת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, יִהְיוּ נוֹשְׁקִין זֶה לָזֶה, כְּלוֹמַר: וְהָיָה מַעֲשֵׂה הַצְּדָקָה שָׁלוֹם (ישעיה לב:יז):


**righteousness and peace have kissed** The righteousness [or charity] that Israel was performing and the peace from the Holy One, blessed be He, will kiss one another, i.e., the act of charity will be peace (Isa. 32:12).



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 85:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:12:1)


**אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח וְגוֹ׳.** כְּשֶׁהָיוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל דּוֹבְרִים אֱמֶת, וְיַשְׁקִיפוּ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם צְדָקָה שֶׁהֵם עוֹשִׂים בָּאָרֶץ:


**Truth will sprout from the earth, etc.** When Israel will speak truth, the charity that they perform on earth will look down from heaven.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 85:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:13:1)


**גַּם ה׳ יִתֵּן הַטּוֹב.** ״יִפְתַּח אוֹצָרוֹ אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם לָתֵת מָטָר״ (דברים כח:יב), כְּדֵי לַעֲשׂוֹת אַרְצוֹ אֶת יְבוּלָהּ:


**God too will give good** He will open His treasury, the heavens, to give rain, in order that His land yield its produce.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 85:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/85:14:1)


**וְיָשֵׂם לְדֶרֶךְ פְּעָמָיו.** וְיָשֵׂם הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת הַצֶּדֶק בְּדַרְכֵי פְּעָמָיו שֶׁיִּתְנַהֵג בָּהֶם אֶת בָּנָיו:


**and He will place it on the way of his steps** And the Holy One, blessed be He, will place the righteousness in the ways of his steps, with which he leads his sons.



## Chapter 86


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:2:1)


**כִּי חָסִיד אָנִי.** שֶׁאֲנִי שׁוֹמֵעַ גִּדּוּפִי וְחֶרְפָּתִי, וִיכֹלֶת בְּיָדִי לְהִנָּקֵם, וַאֲנִי שׁוֹתֵק. כָּךְ הִיא בְּאַגָּדַת תְּהִלִּים. דָּבָר אַחֵר פֵּרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ בִּבְרָכוֹת (ברכות ד.): וְלֹא חָסִיד אֲנִי, שֶׁכָּל מַלְכֵי מִזְרָח וּמַעֲרָב יוֹשְׁבִין בִּכְבוֹדָן, וַאֲנִי יָדַי מְלֻכְלָכוֹת בְּדָם וּבְשָׁפִיר וּבְשִׁלְיָא וְכוּ׳?


**for I am a pious man** that I hear my insults and my disgraces, and I am able to wreak vengeance; yet I remain silent. So it is in Aggadath Tehillim (Mid. Ps. 86:1). Another explanation: Our Sages explained in Berachoth (4a): [David said,] “Am I not a pious man, when all the kings of the Orient and the Occident sit in their glory, and my hands are sullied with blood, with the sac, and with the afterbirth?”



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:3:1)


**כָּל הַיּוֹם.** כָּל הַגָּלוּת, שֶׁהוּא יוֹם לָאֻמּוֹת וְלַיְלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל. כָּךְ מְפֹרָשׁ בְּאַגָּדַת תְּהִלִּים:


**all the days** All the days of the exile, which is day for the wicked and night for the righteous. It is explained in this manner in Aggadath Tehillim (Mid. Ps. 86:2).



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:4:1)


**נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא.** לִבִּי אֲכַוֵּן:


**I lift my soul** I direct my heart.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:8:1)


**וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ.** הַמַּקְדִּים עֶלְיוֹנִים לְתַחְתּוֹנִים:


**like Your works** Who places the heavenly beings before the earthlings.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:10:1)


**וְעֹשֶׂה נִפְלָאוֹת אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ.** עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִבְרְאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים נִבְרְאוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ (שו״ט פו, ג). לְפִיכָךְ יְכַבְּדוּ כָל הַגּוֹיִם לִשְׁמֶךָ:


**and perform wonders, You, O God, alone** Before the angels were created, heaven and earth were created. Therefore, all the nations will glorify Your name.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:13:1)


**מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּיָּה.** דֶּרֶךְ הַמְנַאֲפִים לְהִנָּתֵן בְּעוּמְקָהּ שֶׁל שְׁאוֹל, וּמִשָּׁם הִצַּלְתַּנִי, שֶׁאָמַר לִי נָתָן הַנָּבִיא: ״גַּם ה׳ הֶעֱבִיר חַטָּאתְךָ״ (שמואל ב יב:יג):


**from the lowest depths of the grave** It is customary for adulterers to be put into the depth of the grave, and from there You saved me, for Nathan the prophet said to me (II Sam. 12:13): “Also the Lord has removed your sin.”



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:14:1)


**זֵדִים קָמוּ עָלַי.** דּוֹאֵג וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל:


**willful transgressors have risen against me** Doeg and Ahithophel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 86:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:14:2)


**וְלֹא שָׂמוּךָ לְנֶגְדָּם.** לֹא זָכְרוּ אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ שֶׁמְּשָׁחַנִי שְׁמוּאֵל עַל פִּיךָ (שמואל א טז:יב):


**and they did not place You before themselves** They did not remember what they saw, that Samuel anointed me on Your orders.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:16:1)


**לְבֶן אֲמָתֶךָ.** בֶּן הָאָמָה מַשְׁפִּיל אֶת עַצְמוֹ לִפְנֵי אֲדוֹנָיו יוֹתֵר מִמִּקְנַת כֶּסֶף, שֶׁבֶּן הָאָמָה יְלִיד בַּיִת הוּא וְגָדַל בְּחֵיק אֲדוֹנָיו:


**the son of Your maidservant** The son of the maidservant humbles himself before his master more than the slave purchased with money, because the son of the maidservant was born in the house and was raised in his master’s bosom.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 86:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:17:1)


**עֲשֵׂה עִמִּי אוֹת לְטוֹבָה.** שֶׁיְּהֵא נִכָּר לַאֲחֵרִים שֶׁמָּחַלְתָּ לִי:


**Grant me a sign for good** so it may be apparent to others that You have forgiven me.


###### Rashi on Psalms 86:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/86:17:2)


**וְיִרְאוּ שׂוֹנְאַי.** הָאוֹת **וְיֵבֹשׁוּ**, וְלֹא שָׁמַע לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לִיתֵּן הָאוֹת בְּיָמָיו, אֶלָּא בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בְּנוֹ, כְּשֶׁדָּבְקוּ הַשְּׁעָרִים זֶה בָּזֶה וְלֹא נִפְתְּחוּ עַד שֶׁאָמַר (דברי הימים ב ו:מב): ״אַל תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ זָכְרָה לְחַסְדֵי דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ״:


**and let my enemies see** the sign and be ashamed. But the Holy One, blessed be He, did not listen to him to grant the sign during his lifetime. Instead, [it came] in his son Solomon’s lifetime when the gates clung to each other and did not open until he said (II Chron. 6:42): “Do not turn back the face of Your anointed; remember the kind deeds of David Your servant.”



## Chapter 87


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 87:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:1:1)


**יְסוּדָתוֹ בְּהַרְרֵי קֹדֶשׁ.** יְסוּדַת מִזְמוֹר זֶה; עַל הַר צִיּוֹן וִירוּשָׁלַיִם יְסָדוֹ הַמְשׁוֹרֵר:


**whose foundation is on the mountains of the Sanctuary** The foundation of this psalm; the Psalmist founded it on the mountains of Zion and Jerusalem.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 87:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:3:1)


**נִכְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּר בָּךְ.** אַתְּ, יְרוּשָׁלַיִם, דִּבְרֵי כָבוֹד נִדְבְּרוּ בָּךְ מִפִּי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא. וּמָה הֵן הַנִּכְבָּדוֹת? שֶׁאַתְּ **עִיר הָאֱלֹהִים סֶלָה**:


**Glorious things are said about you** You, Jerusalemwords of glory were spoken about you from the mouth of the Holy One, blessed be He. Now what are the words of glory? That you are the city of God forever.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 87:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:4:1)


**אַזְכִּיר רַהַב וּבָבֶל לְיוֹדְעָי.** עוֹד זֹאת דִּבֵּר עָלֶיךָ: אַזְכִּיר אֶת מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת בָּבֶל עַל יוֹדְעַי, לְהָבִיא מִנְחָה, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ישעיהו סו:כ) ״וְהֵבִיאוּ אֶת כָּל אֲחֵיכֶם וְגוֹ׳ מִנְחָה לַה׳ וְגוֹ׳״:


**I will remind Rahab and Babylon of My beloved ones** This too He spoke of You: I shall remind Egypt and Babylon of My beloved ones, to bring them as a gift, as the matter that is stated (Isa. 66: 20): “And they will bring all your brethren, etc., a tribute to the Lord.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 87:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:4:2)


**הִנֵּה פְלֶשֶׁת וְצוֹר עִם כּוּשׁ.** גַּם הֵם כְּמִצְרַיִם וּבָבֶל יִתְּנוּ לֵב לְבַקֵּשׁ וְלִזְכֹּר אֶת כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד:


**Behold Philistia and Tyre with Cush** They too, like Egypt and Babylon, will direct their attention to seek out and to remember each one.


###### Rashi on Psalms 87:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:4:3)


**זֶה יוּלַּד שָׁם.** זֶה הָיָה מִמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת הַנּוֹלָדִים בְּצִיּוֹן, כְּעִנְיָן שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְאַתֶּם תְּלֻקְּטוּ לְאַחַד אֶחָד״ (ישעיה כז:יב):


**“This one was born there”** This one was of a family of those born in Zion, as the matter that is stated (Isa. 27:12): “and you will be gathered one by one.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 87:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:5:1)


**וּלְצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד בָּהּ.** וּכְשֶׁיְּבִיאוּם מִנְחָה לַה׳ בְּצִיּוֹן, יֵאָמַר לָהֶם עַל כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד: זֶה מֵאוֹתָם שֶׁגָּלוּ מִמֵּךְ וּמִתּוֹלְדוֹתֵיהֶם. עִנְיָן אַחֵר: הַמְשׁוֹרֵר אוֹמֵר אַזְכִּיר לְעַמִּי וּלְיוֹדְעַי אֶת גְּדֻלּוֹת מִצְרַיִם וּבָבֶל, שֶׁהֵם רוֹאִים עַתָּה אֶת גְּדֻלָּתָם. הִנֵּה **פְלֶשֶׁת וְצוֹר עִם כּוּשׁ**, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהֵם סְמוּכִים לְ**רַהַב וּבָבֶל**, מְנַשְּׂאִים אוֹתָם כָּל הָאֻמּוֹת וְאוֹמְרִים עֲלֵיהֶם: **זֶה יֻלַּד שָׁם** – בְּמִצְרַיִם וּבָבֶל:


**And to Zion it will be said, “Man after man was born in her”** And when they bring them as a tribute to the Lord, it will be said to Zion concerning each one, “This is [one] of those who were exiled from you,” or “from their generations.” Another explanation: The Psalmist says, “I will mention to my people and to my beloved ones the greatness of Egypt and Babylon, whose greatness they now see. Behold Philistia and Tyre with Cush, because they are near Rahab and Babylon, all the nations exalt them [the Israelites] and say about them, ‘This one was born there,’ in Egypt or Babylon.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 87:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:5:2)


**וּלְצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר וְגוֹ׳.** וְהַשֶּׁבַח הַזֶּה שֶׁהוּא עַכְשָׁיו לְרַהַב וּבָבֶל, יָסוֹב לְצִיּוֹן, וְעָלֶיהָ יְהוּ אוֹמְרִים: פְּלוֹנִי **יֻלַּד בָּהּ**:


**And to Zion it will be said, “Man, etc.”** And this praise that is now [directed] to Rahab and Babylon will be turned around to Zion, and concerning it they will say, “So-and-so and so-and-so were born in her.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 87:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:5:3)


**וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיוֹן.** וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ לְמַעְלָה מִכָּל הָעֲיָרוֹת:


**and He will establish it on high** And the Holy One, blessed be He, will establish it above all the cities.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 87:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/87:6:1)


**ה׳ יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים וְגוֹ׳.** מִקְרָא מְסֹרָס זֶה, וְסֶלָה הָאָמוּר לְסוֹפוֹ מוּסָב כְּלַפֵּי רֹאשׁוֹ: **ה׳ יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים סֶלָה**, כְּלוֹמַר לֶעָתִיד כְּשֶׁיִּכְתֹּב הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הָעוֹבְדֵי גִּלּוּלִים לְדֵרָאוֹן, יִמְנֶה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּבְלָעִים בְּתוֹכָם וְאֶת הַנֶּאֱנָסִים בֵּינֵיהֶם וְיוֹצִיאֵם מִתּוֹכָם וְיֹאמַר **זֶה יֻלַּד** מֵאוֹתָם שֶׁל צִיּוֹן וְיִבְרוֹר אוֹתָם לוֹ. וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר יְשַׁעְיָה: ״וְגַם מֵהֶם אֶקַּח לַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַלְוִיִּם״ (ישעיהו סו:כא), מִן הַגּוֹיִם הַמְּבִיאִים אוֹתָם מִנְחָה אֶקַּח הַנִּבְלָעִים בְּתוֹכָם, וְיִהְיֶה בָהֶם כֹּהֲנִים וּלְוִיִּם שֶׁאֵינָם נִכָּרִים וּלְפָנַי גְּלוּיִים הֵם אָמַר ה׳. וְהֵיכָן אָמַר? ״הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת לַה׳ אֱלֹהֵינוּ״ (דברים כט:כח):


**The Lord counts in the script of the peoples, “This one, etc.”** This is a transposed verse, and סלה, forever, which is said at the end, refers to the beginning: When the Lord counts in the script of the peoples forever. That means that in the future, when the Holy One, blessed be He, inscribes the nations for an abhorrence, He will count the Israelites who are assimilated among them and those who were coerced [to abandon Judaism] among them and extract them from their midst, and [He shall] say, “This one was born of those of Zion,” and He will choose them for Himself. This is what Isaiah says (66:21): “And from them, too, will I take for priests and for Levites.” From the nations bringing them for tribute, I shall take those assimilated among them. And there will be among them priests and Levites who are unrecognizable, but they are revealed to Me, says the Lord. Now where did He say it? (Deut. 29:28) “The secret things belong to the Lord, our God.”



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 87:7:1

**וְשָׁרִים כְּחוֹלְלִים.** עַל זֹאת, **כְּחוֹלְלִים** לְשׁוֹן ״מְחוֹלְלִים״ (שופטים כא:כג):


**And singers as well as flute players** concerning this.


###### Rashi on Psalms 87:7:2

**כָּל־מַעְיָנַי.** כָּל קְרָבַי:

###### Rashi on Psalms 87:7:3

## Chapter 88


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:1:1)


**עַל מָחֲלַת לְעַנּוֹת.** עַל חוֹלַת אַהֲבָה וְעִנּוּיָהּ, שֶׁהִיא מְעֻנָּה בְּיִסּוּרֵי הַגָּלוּת:


**about the sick and afflicted one** Heb. על-מחלתלענות, concerning the one sick with love and afflicted, for she is afflicted with the pains of the exile.


###### Rashi on Psalms 88:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:1:2)


**מַשְׂכִּיל.** כָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר מַשְׂכִּיל, עַל יְדֵי תּוּרְגְּמָן נֶאֱמַר; שֶׁהָיָה הַנָּבִיא מַעֲמִיד תּוּרְגְּמָן לְפָנָיו, וּכְשֶׁרוּחַ הַנְּבוּאָה בָּאָה לוֹ, אוֹמֵר אֶת הַנְּבוּאָה לַתּוּרְגְּמָן, וְהוּא מַשְׁמִיעָהּ (פסחים קיז.):


**of Heman the Ezrahite** One of the musicians who played a musical instrument, and the sons of Korah established this psalm that Heman should recite it on the “duchan” [the platform].


###### Rashi on Psalms 88:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:1:3)


**לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִי.** אֶחָד מִן הַמְשׁוֹרְרִים בִּכְלֵי שִׁיר, וְיִסְּדוּהוּ בְּנֵי קֹרַח אֶת הַמִּזְמוֹר הַזֶּה שֶׁיֹּאמְרֵהוּ הֵימָן עַל הַדּוּכָן (דברי הימים א ו:לג):


**of Heman the Ezrahite** He was one of the sons of Zerah the son of Judah, for his lineage is delineated in (I Chron. 2:6): “And the sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Chalcol, and Darda [sic].” All five were great sages, as is said in reference to Solomon (I Kings 5: 11): “And he was wiser than all men, than Ethan the Ezraite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol,” and they established the Psalms, which were set down in the Book of Psalms. Therefore, they are called the sons of Mahol. So have I found in exact commentaries.


###### Rashi on Psalms 88:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:1:4)


**לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִי.** מִבְּנֵי זֶרַח בֶּן יְהוּדָה הָיָה, שֶׁהוּא מְיֻחָס (דברי הימים א ב:ו) וּבְנֵי זֶרַח זִמְרִי וְאֵיתָן וְהֵימָן וְכַלְכֹּל וְדַרְדַּע כֻּלָּם חֲמִשָּׁה. הָיוּ חֲכָמִים גְּדוֹלִים, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בִּשְׁלֹמֹה (מלכים א ה:יא) ״וַיֶּחְכַּם מִכָּל הָאָדָם מֵאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי וְהֵימָן וְכַלְכֹּל וְדַרְדַּע בְּנֵי מָחוֹל״. וְיִסְּדוּ מִזְמוֹרִים וְנִקְבְּעוּ בְּסֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים, לְכָךְ נִקְרְאוּ בְּנֵי מָחוֹל. כָּךְ מָצָאתִי בְּפֵרוּשִׁים מְדֻיָּקִים:


**a maskil** Wherever it says “maskil,” it was said through an interpreter. The prophet would set up an interpreter before him, and when he perceived a prophecy coming upon him, he would recite the prophecy to the interpreter, who would make it heard.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:2:1)


**יוֹם צָעַקְתִּי.** וְגַם **בַלַּיְלָה** אֲנִי נָכוֹן **נֶגְדֶּךָ**:


**I cried by day; at night** And also at night I am ready before You.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:4:1)


**כִּי שָׂבְעָה בְרָעוֹת נַפְשִׁי.** עַל כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא אוֹמֵר:


**For my soul is sated with troubles** He says this concerning the people of Israel.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:5:1

**אֵין אַיִל.** אֵין כֹּחַ, כְּמוֹ ״אֱיָלוּתִי לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה״ (תהלים כב:כ):


**without strength** Heb. איל, as (above 22:20): “My strength (אילותי), hasten to my assistance.”



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:6:1)


**בַּמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי.** הִנְנִי בֵּין הַמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי מִן הָעוֹלָם, וְכָל שֶׁהֵם הַמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁים מִן הָעוֹלָם:


**among the dead, who are free** I am among the dead, free from the world, and like the slain, who are free from the world.


###### Rashi on Psalms 88:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:6:2)


**מִיָּדְךָ נִגְזָרוּ.** מִמִּצְווֹתֶיךָ נִגְזְרוּ מִן הָעוֹלָם:


**and who were cut off by Your hand** By Your blows, they were cut off from the world.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:7:1)


**בְּבוֹר תַּחְתִּיּוֹת.** הוּא הַגָּלוּת:

### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:8:1)


**סָמְכָה.** נִשְׁעֲנָה וְתָלָה **עָלַי**:

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:8:2

**וְכָל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ עִנִּיתָ סֶּלָה.** מִשְׁבָּרִים לְשׁוֹן גַּלֵּי הַיָּם הֵם, כָּל סַעֲרַת אַפְּךָ, בְּכֻלָּם עִנִּיתָ אוֹתִי תָּמִיד (עירובין נד.):


**and [with] all Your waves You have afflicted [me] constantly** Heb. משבריך, an expression of the waves of the sea. They are all the storms of Your wrath; with all of them have You constantly afflicted me.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:9:1)


**שַׁתַּנִי תוֹעֵבוֹת לָמוֹ.** הָאֻמּוֹת שֶׁהָיִיתִי חֲשׁוּבָה בְּעֵינֵיהֶם, עַכְשָׁיו אֲנִי נִמְאֶסֶת לָהֶם:


**You have made me an abomination to them** The nations, in whose eyes I was esteemed—now I am repugnant to them.


###### Rashi on Psalms 88:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:9:2)


**כָּלוּא.** נֶחְבַּשׁ בַּכֶּלֶא וְאֵינִי יָכוֹל לָצֵאת:


**[I am] imprisoned** Confined in a prison, and I cannot go out.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:11:1)


**הֲלַמֵּתִים.** הֲלָרְשָׁעִים, שֶׁאַף בְּחַיֵּיהֶם קְרוּיִין מֵתִים (ברכות יח.), הֲלָהֶם אַתָּה עוֹשֶׂה **פֶּלֶא** וְנִסִּים?


**Will You perform a wonder for the dead?** Do You perform a wonder and miracles for the wicked, who are called dead even in their lifetime?


###### Rashi on Psalms 88:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:11:2)


**אִם רְפָאִים יָקוּמוּ יוֹדוּךָ.** שֶׁמָּא אֵלּוּ הָאֻמּוֹת שֶׁרִפּוּ יְדֵיהֶם מֵעֲבוֹדָתְךָ וּמִתּוֹרָתְךָ יָקוּמוּ וְיוֹדוּךָ? בִּתְמִיהָה:


**Will the shades rise and thank You** Heb. רפאים, lit. the weak. Will the nations that weakened their [Israel’s] hands from Your service rise and thank You? This is a wonder.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:12:1)


**הֲיְסֻפַּר בַּקֶּבֶר חַסְדֶּךָ.** אִם נָמוּת בְּיַד אוֹיְבֵינוּ, כְּלוּם נוּכַל לְסַפֵּר שִׁבְחֲךָ בַּקֶּבֶר?


**Will Your kindness be told in the grave** if we die in the hands of our enemies, will we be able to recite Your praise in the grave?



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:16:1)


**וְגוֹעֵעַ מִנֹּעַר.** מֵת מִתּוֹךְ תִּשְׁנוֹק מִיתָה חֲטוּפָה, כְּמוֹ (שמות יד:כז) ״וַיְנַעֵר ה׳״. וַיְנַעֵר פֵּרֵשׁ מְנַחֵם לְשׁוֹן חֲבִיטָה, כְּמוֹ ״נוֹעֵר כַּפָּיו מִתְּמֹךְ בַּשֹּׁחַד״ (ישעיהו לג:טו), ״הִתְנַעֲרִי מֵעָפָר קוּמִי שְׁבִי״ (ישעיהו נב:ב), ״וְהָיָה הֶחָסֹן לִנְעֹרֶת״ (ישעיהו א:לא), ״וְיִנָּעֲרוּ רְשָׁעִים מִמֶּנָּה״ (איוב לח:יג), ״כָּכָה יְהֵא נָעוּר וָרִיק״ (נחמיה ה:יג):


**and close to sudden death** Heb. וגוע מנער, dying from the strangulation of sudden death, as (Exod. 14:27): “and the Lord strangled (וינער).” Menachem (p. 123) defines וינער as an expression of beating, as (Isa. 33:15): “who shakes (נוער) his hands from taking hold of bribe”; (Isa. 52:2), “Shake yourself (התנערי) from the dust, arise”; (Isa. 1:31), “And the[ir] strength will become as tow (לנערת)”; (Job 38: 13), “so that the wicked will be shaken (וינערו) from it”; (Neh. 5:13), “even thus may he be shaken out (נעור) and emptied.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 88:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:16:2)


**אָפוּנָה.** מְיֻשֶּׁבֶת וּמְבֻסֶּסֶת אֵימָתְךָ בְּלִבִּי, **אָפוּנָה** לְשׁוֹן ״דָּבָר דָּבֻר עַל אָפְנָיו״ (משלי כה:יא), עַל מְכוֹנָיו:


**it is well-founded** Heb. אפונה. Your fear is settled and based in my heart. אפוּנה is an expression of (Prov. 25:11): “a word spoken with proper basis (אפניו)”; on its basis.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 88:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/88:19:1)


**מְיֻדָּעַי מַחְשָׁךְ.** נֶחְשַׁכְתִּי וְנֶחְדַּלְתִּי מֵהֶם:


**From my acquaintances, I am withdrawn** Heb. מחשך. I am withdrawn and withheld from them.



## Chapter 89


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:1:1)


**לְאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי.** גַּם הוּא אֶחָד מִן חֲמִשָּׁה אַחִים הַמְשׁוֹרְרִים, וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּהוּ (בבא בתרא טו.) בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עַל שֵׁם ״מִי הֵעִיר מִמִּזְרָח״ (ישעיהו מא:ב):


**of Ethan the Ezrahite** He, too, was one of the five musician brothers. [See above 88:1.] But our Sages (B.B. 15a) explained it as referring to our father Abraham, based on (Isa. 41:2): “Who aroused from the East (ממזרח).”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:2:1)


**אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִי.** אֶת שֶׁיְּדַעְתִּיךָ, שֶׁאַתָּה שׁוֹמֵר הַבְטָחָתְךָ וּמְאַמֵּן דְּבָרֶיךָ:


**I shall make known Your faithfulness, with my mouth** What I know of You: that You keep Your promise and fulfill Your words.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:3:1)


**כִּי אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה.** כִּי אָמַרְתִּי: עַד עוֹלָם יִבָּנֶה בְחֶסֶד כִּסֵּא דָוִד, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְכֹנַנְתִּי כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ וְגוֹ׳״ (שמואל ב ז:יג). דָּבָר אַחֵר: סָבוּר הָיִיתִי שֶׁיְּהֵא הָעוֹלָם בָּנוּי בְּחַסְדְּךָ **וְתָכִין אֱמוּנָתְךָ בַשָּׁמַיִם**, שֶׁתְּהֵא נְכוֹנָה וּמְקֻיֶּמֶת. וּמַה הִיא הָאֱמוּנָה? אוֹתָהּ הַהַבְטָחָה שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּ אֶת דָּוִד עַל יְדֵי נָתָן הַנָּבִיא לֵאמֹר: **כָּרַתִּי בְרִית לִבְחִירִי** לְהָכִין **עַד עוֹלָם** זַרְעוֹ:


**For I said, “Forever will it be built with kindness”** For I said, “Forever the throne of David will be built with kindness,” as it is said (II Sam. 7:13): “and I shall establish the throne of his kingdom, etc.” Another explanation: I thought that the world would be built with Your kindness and that You would establish Your faithfulness in the heavens, to be established and made permanent. Now what is the faithfulness? That promise You promised David through Nathan the prophet, saying, “I formed a covenant with My chosen one to establish his seed until eternity.”



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:6:1)


**וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ.** אִם הָיִיתָ שׁוֹמֵר הַבְטָחָתְךָ:


**And the heavens acknowledge Your wonder** If You had kept Your promise.


###### Rashi on Psalms 89:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:6:2)


**אַף אֱמוּנָתְךָ.** אֱמוּנַת דְּבָרֶיךָ יוֹדוּ **בִּקְהַל קְדוֹשִׁים**:


**and Your faithfulness in the congregation of the holy ones** The realization of Your words they will acknowledge in the congregation of the holy ones.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:7:1)


**יַעֲרֹךְ לַה׳.** יְהֵא נַעֲרָץ כְּמוֹתוֹ:


**is equal to the Lord** Can be evaluated like Him.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:8:1)


**בְּסוֹד קְדוֹשִׁים רַבָּה.** בְּסוֹד רַב שֶׁל מַלְאָכִים:


**in the great council of the holy ones** In the great council of the angels.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:10:1)


**בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו.** בְּהִנָּשֵׂא גַלָּיו:


**when it raises its waves** When its waves are raised.


###### Rashi on Psalms 89:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:10:2)


**אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם.** תַּשְׁפִּילֵם, וְכֵן ״וְחָכָם בְּאָחוֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶנָּה״ (משלי כט:יא), וְכֵן ״מַשְׁבִּיחַ שְׁאוֹן יַמִּים״ (תהלים סה:ח):


**You humble them** Heb. תשבחם, You humble them, and similarly, (Prov. 29:11): “but afterwards a wise man will quiet it (ושבחנה)”; and similarly (above 65:8): “Who humbles (משביח) the roaring of the seas.”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:11:1)


**רָהַב.** מִצְרַיִם (ישעיהו ל:ז):


**Rahab** Egypt.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:16:1)


**יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה.** שֶׁיּוֹדְעִין לְרַצּוֹת אֶת בּוֹרְאָם בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה בִּתְרוּעָה, שֶׁמְּסַדְּרִים עָלֶיהָ מַלְכֻיּוֹת, זִכְרוֹנוֹת וְשׁוֹפָרוֹת (ויקרא רבה כט, ד):


**that know the blasting of the shofar** Who know how to appease their Creator on Rosh Hashanah with the blasts, upon which they arrange the blessings of “malchuyoth” (manifestations of God’s dominion), “zichronoth” (remembrances), and “shofaroth.”



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:18:1)


**וּבִרְצוֹנְךָ.** שֶׁאַתָּה מִתְרַצֶּה לָהֶם, אפימאנ״ט בְּלַעַ״ז:


**and with Your favor** that You are appeased by them (apayement in Old French), propitiation.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:20:1)


**לַחֲסִידֶיךָ.** נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וְגָד הַחוֹזֶה:


**to Your pious ones** Nathan the prophet and Gad the seer.


###### Rashi on Psalms 89:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:20:2)


**שִׁוִּיתִי עֵזֶר.** עַל דָּוִד, לַעֲזוֹר לוֹ **תָּמִיד**:


**“I placed help”** on David, to help him constantly.



### Verse 23

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:23:1)


**לֹא יַשִּׁיא אוֹיֵב בּוֹ.** לֹא יִגְבַּר עָלָיו לִהְיוֹת לוֹ כְּנוֹשֶׁה (שמות כב:כד):


**No enemy will exact from him** No enemy will overwhelm him to become as his creditor.



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:28:1)


**בְּכוֹר אֶתְּנֵהוּ.** גָּדוֹל אֶתְּנֵהוּ:


**shall make him a firstborn** I shall make him great.



### Verse 33

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:33:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:33:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:33:1)


**וּפָקַדְתִּי בְשֵׁבֶט פִּשְׁעָם.** כָּךְ אָמַר לוֹ נָתָן הַנָּבִיא עַל שְׁלֹמֹה (שמואל ב ז:יד): ״אֲשֶׁר בְּהַעֲוֹתוֹ וְהוֹכַחְתִּיו בְּשֵׁבֶט אֲנָשִׁים״, זֶה רְזוֹן בֶּן אֶלְיָדָע שֶׁעָמַד לְשָׂטָן לוֹ, וּבְנִגְעֵי בְנֵי אָדָם זֶה אַשְׁמְדַאי, שֶׁהַשֵּׁדִים בְּנֵי אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן הָיוּ (בראשית רבה כ:יא):


**I shall punish their transgression with a rod** So did Nathan the prophet say to him concerning Solomon (II Sam. 7:14): “so that when he goes astray, I will chasten him with the rod of men.” This refers to Rezon the son of Eliada, who rose up as an adversary to him: “and with the stripes of the sons of Adam.” This refers to Ashmadai, according to the Sages of blessed memory.



### Verse 36

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:36:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:36:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:36:1)


**אִם לְדָוִד אֲכַזֵּב.** לְשׁוֹן ״לֹא יְכַזְּבוּ מֵימָיו״ (ישעיהו נח:יא), פיילנצ״א בְּלַעַ״ז:


**that I will not fail David** Heb. אכזב, an expression of (Isa. 58:11): “whose water does not fail (יכזבו),” faliance in Old French, failure; possibly from the Latin fallera, deception.



### Verse 38

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:38:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:38:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:38:1)


**וְעֵד בַּשָּׁחַק נֶאֱמָן.** הַיָּרֵחַ וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ עֵדִים לוֹ, שֶׁכָּל זְמַן שֶׁהֵם קַיָּמִים, יִתְקַיֵּם מַלְכוּתוֹ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ירמיהו לג:כ-כא): ״אִם תָּפֵרוּ אֶת בְּרִיתִי הַיּוֹם וְאֶת בְּרִיתִי הַלָּיְלָה גַּם בְּרִיתִי תוּפַר אֶת דָּוִד עַבְדִּי״:


**and it is a witness in the sky, true** The moon and the sun are witnesses to him that as long as they exist, his kingdom will exist, as it is written (Jer. 33:20f.): “If you break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, etc. Also My covenant with David will be broken.”



### Verse 39

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:39:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:39:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:39:1)


**וְאַתָּה זָנַחְתָּ.** דִּקְדַּקְתָּ אַחַר בָּנָיו לַחֲשׁוֹב עֲוֹנָם, עַד אֲשֶׁר זְנַחְתָּם וּמְאַסְתָּם בִּימֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ (מלכים ב כה:א):


**But You abandoned** You dealt strictly with his children in counting their iniquity until You abandoned them and You rejected them in the days of Zedekiah.



### Verse 40

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:40:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:40:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:40:1)


**נֵאַרְתָּה.** בִּטַּלְתָּ:


**You abrogated** You nullified.



### Verse 41

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:41:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:41:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:41:1)


**כָּל גְּדֵרוֹתָיו.** שֶׁבָּנָה בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם:


**all his fences** which he built in Jerusalem.


###### Rashi on Psalms 89:41:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:41:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:41:2)


**מִבְצָרָיו.** הַר הַבַּיִת וּמְצוּדַת צִיּוֹן:


**his fortifications** The Temple Mount and the stronghold of Zion.



### Verse 44

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:44:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:44:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:44:1)


**אַף תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ.** הֲשִׁיבוֹתָ אָחוֹר וְהָפַכְתָּ אֶת חִדּוּד חַרְבּוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״חַרְבוֹת צֻרִים״ (יהושע ה:ב), וְכֵן ״כָּל כְּלִי יוּצַר עָלַיִךְ״ (ישעיהו נד:יז):


**You even turned back the sharp edge of his sword** You turned back and reversed the sharp edge of his sword, as (Josh. 5:2): “sharp (צרים) knives,” and likewise (Isa. 54:17): “Any weapon whetted (יוצר) against you.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 89:44:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:44:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:44:2)


**וְלֹא הֲקֵימוֹתוֹ.** וְלֹא הֶעֱמַדְתּוֹ מִלִּפּוֹל:


**and You did not raise him up in battle** And You did not hold him upright so that he should not fall.



### Verse 45

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:45:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:45:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:45:1)


**הִשְׁבַּתָּ מִטְּהָרוֹ.** זְרִיחָתוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״צָהֳרַיִם״ דִּמְתַרְגְּמִינָן: ״טִיהֲרָא״, וּכְמוֹ (שמות כד:י) ״וּכְעֶצֶם הַשָּׁמַיִם לָטֹהַר״:


**You have brought an end to his shining** Heb. מטהרו, his shining, as צהרים, noon, is translated טהרא, and like (Exod. 24:10): “and like the appearance of the heaven for splendor (לטהר).”


###### Rashi on Psalms 89:45:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:45:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:45:2)


**לָאָרֶץ מִגַּרְתָּה.** הִשְׁפַּלְתָּ וְהִשְׁחַתָּ, כָּל לְשׁוֹן שְׁחִיָּה בְּתַרְגּוּם יוֹנָתָן ״מְגַר״:


**You have cast down to the earth** Heb. מגרת. You have humbled and destroyed. Every expression of bending down is, in Targum Jonathan, מגר.



### Verse 48

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:48:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:48:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:48:1)


**זְכֹר אֲנִי מֶה חָלֶד.** מַה זִּקְנָה יֵשׁ לִי? הֲלֹא מְעַט יָמַי, וְדַי לְךָ שֶׁאַתָּה נִפְרָע מִמֶּנִּי בְּמוֹתִי קְצַר יָמִים:


**I am mindful what my old age is** Heb. חלד. What old age do I have? Are not my days few? It should suffice You to punish me with my premature death.


###### Rashi on Psalms 89:48:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:48:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:48:2)


**עַל מַה שָּׁוְא.** לְחִנָּם וְלַהֶבֶל **בָּרָאתָ כָל בְּנֵי אָדָם**:


**for what futility** Heb. שוא. For nothing and for vanity have You created all the sons of man?



### Verse 51

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:51:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:51:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:51:1)


**שְׂאֵתִי בְחֵיקִי כָּל רַבִּים עַמִּים.** בַּגּוֹלָה אֲנִי נוֹשֵׂא סִבְלָם וּמַשָּׂאָם:


**which I bear in my bosom, of all great nations** In exile I bear their burden and their load.



### Verse 52

###### Rashi on Psalms 89:52:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:52:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/89:52:1)


**עִקְּבוֹת מְשִׁיחֶךָ.** סוֹפֵי מֶלֶךְ הַמָּשִׁיחַ, וּלְשׁוֹן מִשְׁנָה הוּא (סוטה ט,טו): בְּעִקְּבוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ חוּצְפָּא יִסְגֵּא:


**the ends of Your anointed** Heb. עקבות, the ends of the King Messiah. This is the language of the Mishnah (Sotah 49b): At the ends of the Messiah, audacity will increase; i.e., at the end of the exile, prior to the advent of the Messiah.

## Chapter 90


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:1:1)


**תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה.** אַחַד עָשָׂר מִזְמוֹרִים מִכָּאן עַד ״לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר״ (תהלים קא:א), כֻּלָּם מֹשֶׁה אֲמָרָם. כְּנֶגְדָּם בֵּרַךְ אַחַד עָשָׂר בְּרָכוֹת לְאַחַד עָשָׂר שְׁבָטִים בְּזֹאת הַבְּרָכָה (דברים לג:א):


**A prayer of Moses** Moses recited all the eleven psalms from here to (ch. 101) “Of David, a song.” Corresponding to them, he [Moses] blessed eleven tribes with eleven blessings, in (Deut. 33): “And this is the blessing.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 90:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:1:2)


**מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ.** מָעוֹן מָדוֹר וּמָנוֹס לָבֹא שָׁם הָיִיתָ לָנוּ:


**You have been our dwelling place** Heb. מעון, an abode and a refuge in which to enter. [That is what] You have been for us.


###### Rashi on Psalms 90:1:3

**בְּדֹר וָדֹר.** מֵעוֹלָם, כִּי אַתָּה מִקֶּדֶם הַכֹּל הָיִיתָ:


**throughout all generations** From time immemorial, for You preceded all.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:2:1)


**בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יוּלָּדוּ.** נִבְרְאוּ, וּבְטֶרֶם חוֹלַלְתָּ **אֶרֶץ וְתֵבֵל. וּמֵעוֹלָם** רִאשׁוֹן **וְעַד עוֹלָם** אַחֲרוֹן **אַתָּה אֵל**:


**Before the mountains were born** [i.e., before they] were created, and before You brought forth the earth and the inhabited world, and from the first world to the last world, You are God.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:3:1)


**תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד דַּכָּא.** מֵבִיא אַתָּה יִסּוּרִין עַל הָאָדָם עַד שֶׁאַתָּה מַחֲזִירוֹ לִהְיוֹת תְּשׁוּשׁ כֹּחַ וְקָרוֹב לַמָּוֶת, **וַתֹּאמֶר** לוֹ בְּיִסּוּרִין **שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי אָדָם** מִדַּרְכֵיכֶם הָרָעִים:


**You bring man to the crushing point** You bring agonies upon man until You reduce him to a weakened state, near death, and You tell him with these agonies, “Return, O sons of men from your evil ways.”



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:4:1)


**כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ.** אֶלֶף שָׁנִים שֶׁל בְּנֵי אָדָם הֵם **כְּיוֹם** אֶחָד שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וְעוֹד מִן הַלַּיְלָה עִמּוֹ, כִּי יוֹם אֶחָד שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וּמְעַט מִן הַלַּיְלָה שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הֵם אֶלֶף שָׁנִים, שֶׁהֲרֵי לֹא אָמַר הַכָּתוּב שֶׁיְּהֵא יוֹמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶחָד כְּאֶלֶף שָׁנִים, אֲבָל כְּשֶׁיָּצָא מְעַט מִן הַלַּיְלָה עִמּוֹ אָז יוֹמוֹ שָׁלֵם וַהֲוֵי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים, וּלְכָךְ מֵת אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן תּוֹךְ אֶלֶף, שֶׁאִם הָיָה חַי אֶלֶף הָיָה יוֹתֵר מִיּוֹמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא. וְשֶׁמָּא שִׁעוּר אוֹתָהּ אַשְׁמוּרָה הוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁיֵּשׁ מִמִּיתַת אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן עַד אֶלֶף שָׁנִים, וַאֲנַן לֹא יָדְעִינָן כַּמָּה הֲוֵי אוֹתָהּ אַשְׁמוּרָה כִּי אִם מִסְּבָרָא (מצאתי). **כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְגוֹ׳.** וּכְשֶׁעָלְתָה תְשׁוּבָה בְּדַעְתְּךָ מִתְּחִלָּה יָפֶה דַּנְתָּ וּבָרָאתָ אוֹתָהּ, וּרְאוּיִין הָיוּ הַשָּׁנִים לְכָךְ לְפִי (שֶׁלֹּא) הָיוּ יְמֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם רַבִּים שֶׁלֹּא הָיוּ אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶלָּא **כְּיוֹם** הוֹלֵךְ שֶׁעָבַר וְחָלַף וּמְעַט מִן הַלַּיְלָה עִמּוֹ, שֶׁהֲרֵי אָמַרְתָּ לְאָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן (בראשית ב:יז) ״כִּי בְּיוֹם אֲכָלְךָ מִמֶּנּוּ מוֹת תָּמוּת״ וְחָיָה תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה, נִמְצְאוּ אֶלֶף שָׁנִים עוֹלִים לְיוֹם שָׁלֵם וּמְעַט מִן הַלַּיְלָה עִמּוֹ:


**For a thousand years are in Your eyes** A thousand years of man are like one day of the Holy One, blessed be He, and part of the night with it; for one day of the Holy One, blessed He, and a little of the night of the Holy One, blessed be He, are a thousand years, for the text does not say that the day of the Holy One, blessed be He, is like a thousand years, but that when a little of the night elapses with it, then His day is complete, and it is a thousand years. Therefore, Adam died within a thousand [years] for had he lived a thousand [years] it would be more than the day of the Holy One, blessed be He. Perhaps the amount of that watch equals the time from the death of Adam until a thousand years, but we do not know how much that watch was, except from conjecture. I found [this]: **For a thousand years are in Your eyes, etc.** And when repentance came into Your thoughts from the beginning, You judged well and created it. Now those years were appropriate for it because people’s days were many, so that a thousand years were in Your eyes like one passing day, which passed and was gone, with a little of the night with it, for You said to Adam (Gen. 2:17): “for on the day you eat of it, you will surely die,” and he lived nine hundred and thirty years. We find that a thousand years equal one whole day and a little of the night with it.

**כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר.** שֶׁכְּבָר עָבַר:


**like yesterday, which passed** Which already passed.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:5:1)


**זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ.** עַכְשָׁיו חֲטַפְתָּם לְאוֹתָם הַשָּׁנִים וַהֲבֵאתָם לְיָמִים מוּעָטִים, שֶׁאֵינָם אֶלָּא כְּשֵׁנַת תְּנוּמָה; שֶׁשְּׁנֵי הַדּוֹרוֹת שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה הֵם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּפֹרָשׁ בְּסוֹף הָעִנְיָן: **יְמֵי שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה**, וְהֵם חֲשׁוּבִים שֵׁנָה אַחַת; כְּעִנְיָן (תהלים קכו:א) ״בְּשׁוּב ה׳ אֶת שִׁיבַת צִיּוֹן הָיִינוּ כְּחֹלְמִים״, וְעַל שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה שֶׁל גָּלוּת בָּבֶל נֶאֱמַר:


**You carry them away as a flood; they are like a sleep** Now you have seized those years and had them become a few days, which are merely like a sleep of slumber, for the years of the generations are seventy years, as is explained at the end of the chapter: “The days of our years because of them are seventy years,” and they are regarded as one sleep. As the matter that is said (below 126:1) “When the Lord returns the returnees to Zion, we shall be like dreamers.” This was stated regarding the Babylonian exile, which lasted seventy years.

**You carry them away as a flood** Heb. זרמתם, an expression of flooding, as (Hab. 3:10): “A stream (זרם) of water.”

**יְמֵי שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה.** שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ אֵלֶּה בַּעֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ אֵלֶּה וּבַעֲלוּמֵינוּ אֵלֶּה **שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה** הֵם:

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:10:3

**וְרָהְבָּם עָמָל וָאָוֶן.** וְכָל הַגְּדֻלָּה וְהַשְּׂרָרָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ לָאָדָם בַּיָּמִים הָאֵלֶּה אֵינָם אֶלָּא עָמָל וָאָוֶן, וְלָמָּה? שֶׁהֲרֵי **כִּי גָז חִישׁ וַנָּעֻפָה.** בְּתוֹךְ עֶבְרָה מַהֵר אָנוּ עָפִים וּמֵתִים:


**but their pride is toil and pain** But all the greatness and the dominion that a person enjoys in these days are only toil and pain. Why? Because it passes quickly and we fly away. During its swift passing, we fly away and die.

**it passes** Heb. גז, an expression of passing, as (Nahum 1:12): “they have crossed (נגוזו)”; (Num. 11: 31), “and drove (ויגז) quails up from the sea.”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:11:1)


**מִי יוֹדֵעַ עֹז אַפֶּךָ.** בְּיָמִים מוּעָטִים כָּאֵלֶּה מִי יִקְנֶה לוֹ לֵב לָדַעַת אֶת עֹז אַפְּךָ לְיִרְאָה אוֹתְךָ, וְאַתָּה **כְיִרְאָתְךָ עֶבְרָתֶךָ.** כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאַתָּה יָרָאוּי כֵּן עֶבְרָתְךָ קָשָׁה, וְנִפְרָע מִן הַחוֹטְאִים:


**Who knows the might of Your wrath** In these few days, who can acquire intelligence to know the might of Your wrath and to fear You, and as for You—Your fear is Your anger. Just as You are feared, so is Your anger harsh, and You exact retribution from the sinners.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:12:1)


**לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע.** כַּאֲשֶׁר בַּתְּחִלָּה, הוֹדַע בָּעוֹלָם אֶת מִנְיַן יָמֵינוּ אֲרֻכִּים, וְכֵיוָן שֶׁנַּאֲרִיךְ יָמִים, נוּכַל לִקְנוֹת לֵב **וְנָבִיא** בְּתוֹכָם **לְבַב חָכְמָה. וְנָבִיא** לְשׁוֹן הֲבָאָה (בבא בתרא יב.). (וְיֵשׁ אוֹמְרִים לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן, כִּמְנִין כ״ן – שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה, וְנָמוּת לְפִי שִׁעוּר יָמֵינוּ שֶׁהֵן מְעַט, כֵּן תְּיַסֵּר אוֹתָנוּ וְכֵן ״וַיֹּדֵעַ בָּהֶם אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת״ (שופטים ח:טז) (ס״א אינו)):


**So teach the number of our days** And just as in the beginning, make known in the world the number of our long days, and since we enjoy longevity, we will be able to acquire intelligence, and we will acquire in them a heart of wisdom. The word נביא is an expression of bringing [rather than of a prophet. Cf. B.B. 12a, Targum ad. loc, Redak below]. (Some say: According to the number of our days כן, according to the numerical value of כן, seventy years. He says: According to the number of our years, which are few, so shall You chastise us, as [Jud. 8:16]: “and with them he chastised (ויודע) the men of Succoth.” This does not appear in all editions.)



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:13:1)


**שׁוּבָה ה׳.** מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ:


**Return, O Lord** from Your burning wrath.


###### Rashi on Psalms 90:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:13:2)


**וְהִנָּחֵם.** חֲשׁוֹב מַחֲשָׁבָה טוֹבָה **עַל עֲבָדֶיךָ**:


**And repent** Think well about Your servants.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:14:1)


**שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ.** בְּיוֹם הַגְּאֻלָּה וְהַתְּשׁוּעָה, שֶׁהוּא בֹּקֶר לְלֵיל הַצָּרָה וְהָאֲנָחָה וְהַחֲשֵׁכָה:


**Satiate us in the morning** On the day of the redemption and the salvation, which is the morning of the night of the trouble, the sighing, and the darkness.


###### Rashi on Psalms 90:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:14:2)


**וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל יָמֵינוּ.** כְּלוֹמַר בְּכָל הַצָּרוֹת שֶׁעָבְרוּ עָלֵינוּ בְּיָמֵינוּ אֵלֶּה:


**and let us sing praises and rejoice with all our days** i.e., with all the troubles that passed over us in these days of ours.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:15:1)


**שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ.** שַׂמְּחֵנוּ לִימוֹת מְשִׁיחֵנוּ כְּמִנְיַן יָמוֹת שֶׁעִנִּיתָנוּ בַּגָּלֻיּוֹת, וּכְמִנְיַן **שְׁנוֹת** אֲשֶׁר **רָאִינוּ רָעָה**:


**Cause us to rejoice according to the days that You afflicted us** Cause us to rejoice in the days of our Messiah according to the number of days that You afflicted us in the exiles and according to the number of years that we experienced evil.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 90:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:17:1)


**וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹ׳ אֱלֹהֵינוּ.** שְׁכִינָתוֹ וְתַנְחוּמָיו:


**And may the pleasantness of the Lord our God be upon us** His presence and His consolations.


###### Rashi on Psalms 90:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:17:2)


**וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ.** לְשׁוֹן תְּחִנָּה הוּא, **כּוֹנְנָה** כְּמוֹ ״שָׁמְרָה״ (תהלים כה:כ) ״שָׁפְטָה״ (תהלים פב:ח):


**and the work of our hands establish for us** Heb. כוננה. This is an expression of supplication. כוֹננה is like שמרה, watch, שפטה, judge.


###### Rashi on Psalms 90:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/90:17:3)


**כּוֹנְנֵהוּ.** כּוֹנֵן אוֹתוֹ, וּשְׁנֵי פְּעָמִים **וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ**: אֶחָד עַל מְלֶאכֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן, שֶׁבֵּרְכָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִתְפַּלֵּל שֶׁתִּשְׁרֶה שְׁכִינָה בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם בַּמִּשְׁכָּן, וְאַחַת שֶׁתְּהֵא בְּרָכָה בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם:


**establish it** Establish it. The two times “and the work of our hands establish” [are mentioned are for the following purposes]: One is for the work of the Tabernacle, when he blessed Israel and prayed that the Shechinah should rest on the work of their hands in the Tabernacle, and one is that there should be a blessing in the work of their hands.



## Chapter 91


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 91:1:1

**He who dwells in the covert of the Most High** He who takes shelter in the covert of the wings of the Shechinah.


###### Rashi on Psalms 91:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/91:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/91:1:2)


**יוֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן.** כְּמוֹ ״בְּצִלּוֹ חָמַדְתִּי וְיָשַׁבְתִּי״ (שיר השירים ב:ג):


**he will lodge in His shadow**, for the Holy One, blessed be He, protects him. Moses, our teacher, hereby persuades people to take shelter in the wings of the Shechinah.


###### Rashi on Psalms 91:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/91:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/91:1:3)


**שַׁדַּי.** לְשׁוֹן חוֹזֶק:


**the Almighty** Heb. שדי, an expression of strength. “He who dwells in the covert of the Most High” is like (Song 2:3): “in His shadow I desired and sat.”



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 91:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/91:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/91:2:1)

**I shall say of the Lord [that He is] my shelter and my fortress** and all will learn from me. Now why do I say this?

**For He will save you from the snare that traps, etc.** To everyone he says, “He who dwells in the covert of the Most High.”

### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:1:2)


**לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת.** שֶׁאוֹמְרִים אוֹתוֹ בְּשַׁבָּתוֹת, וְהוּא מְדַבֵּר בְּעִנְיַן הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא שֶׁכֻּלּוֹ שַׁבָּת (ראש השנה לא.):


**for the Sabbath day** that they would recite on Sabbaths, and it deals with the world to come, which is entirely Sabbath.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:3:1)


**לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ.** בְּעֵת הַגְּאֻלָּה:


**To declare in the morning Your kindness** At the time of the Redemption.


###### Rashi on Psalms 92:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:3:2)


**וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת.** וּבְעוֹד צָרַת הַגָּלוּת לְהַאֲמִין בְּךָ שֶׁתִּשְׁמֹר הַבְטָחָתְךָ, כָּל זֶה נָאֶה וְטוֹב:


**and Your faith at night** And during the distress of the exile, to believe in You that You will keep Your promise, all this is splendid and good.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:4:1)


**עֲלֵי עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי נָבֶל.** כִּנּוֹר שֶׁל עֲשָׂרָה נִימִין (ערכין יג:):


**Upon a ten-stringed harp and upon a psaltery** Heb. עשור, a harp of ten strings.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:7:1)


**אִישׁ בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע.** אֶת הָאָמוּר לְמַטָּה:


**A boorish man does not know** What is stated below.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:8:1)


**בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב.** אֵינָם יוֹדְעִים שֶׁהַפְרָחָתָם אֵינָהּ אֶלָּא לְהַשְׁמִידָם **עֲדֵי עַד**, שֶׁמְּשַׁלֵּם לְשׂוֹנְאָיו עַל פְּנֵיהֶם לְהַאֲבִידָם (דברים ז:י):


**When the wicked flourish like grass** they do not know that their flourishing is only to destroy them to eternity, for He recompenses His enemies to their face to destroy them.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:9:1)


**וְאַתָּה מָרוֹם.** בְּכָל מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יָדְךָ עַל הָעֶלְיוֹנָה, שֶׁהַכֹּל מַצְדִּיקִים עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת דִּינְךָ:


**But You remain on high** In all Your judgments, You have the upper hand, for all justify Your judgments.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:11:1)


**בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן.** לְבַלּוֹתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן שֶׁל שְׂרָרָה, **בַּלֹּתִי** כְּמוֹ (במדבר טו:ט) ״בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן״:


**to soak me with fresh oil** Heb. בלתי. To soak me with the oil of dominion. בַלֹתִי is like (Num. 15: 9): “mingled (בלולה) with oil.”



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:12:1)


**בְּשׁוּרָי.** בְּעוֹיְינַי, כְּמוֹ ״בְּשׁוֹרְרַי״ (תהלים ה:ט):


**upon those who stare at me** Heb. בשורי, at those who stare at me, as (5:9): “those who lie in wait for me (בשוררי).”


###### Rashi on Psalms 92:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:12:2)


**בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים.** עַל הָרְשָׁעִים הַקָּמִים עָלַי שָׁמְעוּ אָזְנַי מֵאֲחוֹרֵי הַפַּרְגּוֹד (סנהדרין פט:) שֶׁלֹּא יוֹעִילוּ לְכַלּוֹת אוֹתָנוּ, כָּךְ שָׁמַעְתִּי:


**when evildoers rise up against me** About the wicked who rise up against me, my ears heard from behind the “veil” that they will not succeed in destroying us [perhaps, David and his men]. So I heard.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:13:1)


**צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח וְגוֹ׳.** כַּתָּמָר – לַעֲשׂוֹת פֵּרוֹת, וּ<b>כְאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן<b> – לְהַחֲלִיף גִּזְעוֹ:


**The righteous one flourishes like the palm, etc.** Like the palm that produces fruit, and like the cedar insofar as its trunk renews itself.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:14:1)


**שְׁתוּלִים.** יִהְיוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים **בְּבֵית ה׳**:


**Planted** The righteous will be [planted] in the house of the Lord.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 92:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:15:1)


**יְנוּבוּן.** יִצְמְחוּן:


**will...grow** Heb. ישגה, will grow.


###### Rashi on Psalms 92:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/92:15:2)


**דְּשֵׁנִים.** שְׁמֵנִים **וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ**, וְאָז יַגִּידוּ **כִּי יָשָׁר ה׳**:


**fat** Heb. דשנים, They will be fat and fresh, and then they will declare that the Lord is upright.



## Chapter 93


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 93:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:1:1)


**ה׳ מָלַךְ.** יֹאמְרוּ לֶעָתִיד:


**The Lord has reigned** They will say in the future.


###### Rashi on Psalms 93:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:1:2)


**אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל.** בְּמָלְכוֹ תִּשְׂמַח הָאָרֶץ:


**The world also is established** When He reigns, the earth will rejoice.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 93:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:3:1)


**נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת ה׳.** לְשׁוֹן צְעָקָה וְקוֹבְלָן הוּא זֶה: אֲהָהּ ה׳, הִנֵּה הָאֻמּוֹת הַשּׁוֹטְפִים כַּנְּהָרוֹת **נָשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם** יֶהֱמָיוּן, וְאֶת דּוּךְ עָמְקֵי נִבְכֵיהֶם **יִשְׂאוּ** וְיַגְבִּיהוּ תָּמִיד לְהִתְגָּאוֹת נֶגְדֶּךָ. כָּל לְשׁוֹן דָּכָא לְשׁוֹן עֹמֶק וְשִׁפְלוּת:


**The rivers have raised, O Lord** This is an expression of a cry and a plaint: Woe, O Lord, behold! Your enemies, who flood like rivers, have raised their voice and roar, and the lowness of the depths of their locks they will raise and lift on high constantly to be haughty against You. Every expression of דכא is an expression of depth and lowness.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 93:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:4:1)


**מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים וְגוֹ׳.** יָדַעְתִּי אֲנִי, כִּי יוֹתֵר מִקּוֹלוֹת הַמַּיִם הָרַבִּים אֲשֶׁר יֶהֱמָיוּן עָלֵינוּ (ישעיה יז:יב), וּמֵאַדִּירֵי **מִשְׁבְּרֵי הַיָּם** הַזֶּה, **אַתָּה אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם ה׳**, וְיָדְךָ תַּקִּיפָה עֲלֵיהֶם:


**More than the voices of great waters, etc.** I know that more than the voices of great waters, which roar over us, and more than the mightiest breakers of this sea, You are mighty, O Lord, and Your hand is powerful over them.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 93:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:5:1)


**עֵדֹתֶיךָ.** שֶׁהֵעִידוּ וְהִבְטִיחוּ נְבִיאֶיךָ **לְבֵיתְךָ**, שֶׁהוּא **נָאוָה קֹדֶשׁ**:


**Your testimonies** which Your prophets prophesied and promised concerning Your house, which is the dwelling of holiness.


###### Rashi on Psalms 93:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:5:2)


**נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ.** וּ**לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים** הוּא מְצַפֶּה לָהֶם, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאָרְכוּ הַיָּמִים, נֶאֱמָנִים הֵם לַה׳ מְאֹד:


**are very faithful to Your house** and to the length of days He looks forward to them, and although it has been a long time, they are very faithful to God.


###### Rashi on Psalms 93:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/93:5:3)


**נָאֲוָה.** כְּמוֹ ״נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים״ (תהלים פג:יג), לְשׁוֹן נָוֶה. וְתֵדַע שֶׁכָּל נָאוֶה שֶׁבַּמִּקְרָא אֵינָן מְפִיקִין אָלֶ״ף, לְפִי שֶׁהֵם לְשׁוֹן נוֹי, וְזֶה מֵפִיק אָלֶ״ף:


**dwelling** Heb. נאוה, like (83:13): “the dwellings נְאוֹת of God,” an expression of נָוֶה. You should know [that this is so] because no instance of נָאוָה has a pronounced “aleph,” for they are an expression of נוֹי beauty, but this one has an “aleph” which is pronounced.



## Chapter 94


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:1:1)


**הוֹפִיעַ.** הֶרְאָה וְגַלֵּה לָנוּ אֶת נִקְמָתְךָ:


**show** Heb. הופיע, show and reveal to us Your vengeance.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:4:1)


**יִתְאַמְּרוּ.** יִשְׁתַּבְּחוּ, כְּמוֹ ״הֶאֱמַרְתָּ״ וְ״הֶאֱמִירְךָ״ (דברים כו:יז-יח):


**boast** Heb. יתאמרו. They praise themselves, as (Deut. 26:17f.): “you praised (האמרת),” and “praised you (האמירך).”



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:8:1)


**בִּינוּ בּוֹעֲרִים בָּעָם.** קְצָת שׁוֹטִים שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם:


**Understand, [you] most boorish of the people** the most foolish peoples in the world.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:9:1)


**הֲנוֹטֵעַ אֹזֶן.** שֶׁמָּא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, שֶׁנָּטַע אֹזֶן, **לֹא יִשְׁמַע** צַעֲקַת עַמּוֹ וְעָנְיוֹ?


**Will He Who implants the ear** Is it possible that the Holy One, blessed be He, Who implanted the ear, should not hear the cry of His people and their affliction?



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:10:1)


**הֲלֹא יוֹכִיחַ.** יְיַסֵּר אֶתְכֶם עַל כָּךְ:


**will He...not reprove** and chastise you for that?



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:11:1)


**ה׳ יוֹדֵעַ.** מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם שֶׁאַתֶּם סְבוּרִין לְהִתְגָּאוֹת בְּנֵזֶר הַמְּלוּכָה, וְתֵדְעוּ **כִּי הֶבֶל הֵם**:


**The Lord knows** your thoughts, that you are thinking to be haughty with the crown of the kingdom, and you should know that they [your thoughts] are vanity.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:12:1)


**אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר.** אַשְׁרֵיהֶם הַצַּדִּיקִים הַמְעֻנִּים תַּחַת יְדֵיכֶם, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁיִּהְיוּ עוֹסְקִין בַּתּוֹרָה וּבַמִּצְווֹת (תנחומא, מקץ טז):


**Fortunate is the man** Fortunate are the righteous who are afflicted under Your hands, provided that they engage in Torah and mitzvoth.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:13:1)


**לְהַשְׁקִיט לוֹ מִימֵי רָע.** כִּי הַיִּסּוּרִין גּוֹרְמִין לוֹ לְהַשְׁקִיט לָהֶם מִימֵי דִּין גֵּיהִנֹּם, עַד שֶׁיִּרְאֶה שֶׁ**יִּכָּרֶה לָרָשָׁע שַׁחַת**:


**To grant him peace from days of evil** For the chastisements cause him to have peace from the days of the judgment of Gehinnom. **while** he sees that a pit is dug for the wicked man.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:15:1)


**כִּי עַד צֶדֶק יָשׁוּב מִשְׁפָּט.** הַיִּסּוּרִין שֶׁלָּהֶם, עַד שֶׁיִּצְדְּקוּ בִּשְׁבִילָם. וְאַחַר הַמִּשְׁפָּט **כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵב** יִתְקַבְּצוּ, כִּי יִטְּלוּ שְׂכָרָם:


**For until righteousness will judgment return** [i.e., the judgment of] their chastisements [will persist] until they become righteous because of them. And after the judgment, all those upright in heart will gather, for they will receive their reward.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 94:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/94:16:1)

**and the heights** An expression of height, like a bird that flies [up high].

###### Rashi on Psalms 95:6:1

**let us kneel** Heb. נברכה, an expression of (Gen. 24:11): “He made the camels kneel (ויברך).”

###### Rashi on Psalms 95:7:1

**today** In this world.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 95:9:1

**גַּם רָאוּ פָעֳלִי.** בְּמִצְרָיִם (שמות ז:ג-יב:לו):


**even though they had seen My work** in Egypt.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 95:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/95:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/95:10:1)


**אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה.** קַטְתִּי בָהֶם, רַבְתִּי עִמָּהֶם, לְשׁוֹן ״נָקְטָה נַפְשִׁי בְּחַיָּי״ (איוב י:א). נִלְחַמְתִּי בָם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה לַהֲמִיתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר, כִּי אָמַרְתִּי **תֹּעֵי לֵבָב הֵם**:


**Forty years** I quarreled with them and contended with them. [אקוט is] an expression of (Job 10: 1): “My soul quarrels (נקטה) with my life.” I strove with them for forty years to kill them in the desert, because I said, “They are of erring heart.”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 95:11:1

**אֶל מְנוּחָתִי.** לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם אֲשֶׁר קְרָאתִים מְנוּחָה, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (תהלים קלב:יד) ״זֹאת מְנוּחָתִי עֲדֵי עַד״:


**My resting place** [In]to the land of Israel and Jerusalem, which I called “resting place,” as it says (below 132:14): “This is my resting place forever.”



## Chapter 96


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 96:1:1

**a new song** This song deals with the future, as is proven by the final verse, “for He has come to judge the earth.” Any reference to a “new song” deals with the future.

**Ascribe to the Lord, families of peoples** And what shall you ascribe to Him? Ascribe to the Lord glory and might.

**Fire will go before Him** in the war of Gog and Magog, for it is written concerning his war (Ezek. 38:22): “And I shall plead against him with pestilence and with blood, and rain bringing floods and great hailstones, fire and brimstone.”
