###### Rashi on Psalms 99:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:3:1)


**יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ.** יוֹדוּ אֶת עֹז מֶלֶךְ הָאוֹהֵב מִשְׁפָּט (תהלים עג:ב):


**They will acknowledge Your name** They will acknowledge the might of the King Who loves judgment.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 99:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:4:1)


**וְעֹז מֶלֶךְ.** מוּסָב עַל מִקְרָא הָעֶלְיוֹן:


**and the might of the King Who loves judgment** This refers back to the preceding verse.


###### Rashi on Psalms 99:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:4:2)


**אַתָּה כּוֹנַנְתָּ מֵישָׁרִים.** פְּשָׁרָה וְשִׂימַת שָׁלוֹם בֵּין אֲנָשִׁים כּוֹנַנְתָּ, בְּאָמְרְךָ (שמות כג:ה) ״כִּי תִרְאֶה חֲמוֹר שׂוֹנַאֲךָ רוֹבֵץ וְגוֹ׳״, (שמות כג:ד) ״כִּי תִפְגַּע שׁוֹר אוֹיִבְךָ״ וּמִי הוּא שֶׁיִּרְאֶה אֶת שׂוֹנְאוֹ גּוֹמֵל לוֹ חֶסֶד שֶׁלֹּא יִדְּבֶנּוּ לִבּוֹ לְחַבְּקוֹ וּלְנַשְּׁקוֹ, תַּנְחוּמָא (תנחומא, משפטים א):


**You founded equity** You founded compromise and peacemaking between persons, by Your statement (Exod. 23:5): “Should you see your enemy’s donkey lying etc.”; (ibid. verse 4), “Should you come upon Your enemy’s ox, etc.” Now who is it who sees his enemy being kind to him, whose heart will not be inspired to embrace him and kiss him? (Tanchuma).



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 99:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:7:1)


**בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם.** אַף עִם שְׁמוּאֵל, וְזֶה הוּא שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (שמואל א ט:יא-יב) ״הֲיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הָרֹאֶה וַתַּעֲנֶינָה אוֹתָם וַתֹּאמַרְנָה יֵשׁ״, רָאוּ הֶעָנָן קָשׁוּר עַל פִּתְחוֹ, כְּמָה דְאַתְּ אָמַר ״וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הֶעָנָן״ (במדבר ט:כ):


**In a pillar of cloud He would speak to them** Even with Samuel. This is what is stated (I Sam. 9: 11f.): “and they said to them, Is the seer here? and they answered them and said, He is (יֵש).” You will see a cloud attached to his doorway, as Scripture says (Num. 9:20): “And sometimes the cloud would be...”


###### Rashi on Psalms 99:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:7:2)


**שָׁמְרוּ עֵדֹתָיו וְחֹק נָתַן לָמוֹ.** וְחֹק אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָמוֹ:


**they kept His testimonies and the statute He gave them** The statute that He gave them.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 99:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:8:1)


**אֵל נוֹשֵׂא.** עֲוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**a forgiving God** [Forgiving] the iniquity of Israel.


###### Rashi on Psalms 99:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:8:2)


**הָיִיתָ לָהֶם.** בִּשְׁבִילָם:


**for them** Heb. להם, for their sake.


###### Rashi on Psalms 99:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:8:3)


**וְנוֹקֵם.** הָיִיתָ **עַל עֲלִילוֹתָם**, מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן ״שִׁמְעוּ נָא הַמּוֹרִים״ (במדבר כ:י), שְׁמוּאֵל עַל שֶׁלֹּא הִדְרִיךְ בָּנָיו בְּדֶרֶךְ טוֹבָה (שמואל א ח:ג), מֵת בָּחוּר (אגדת בראשית מא:א):


**but vengeful** You were vengeful for their misdeeds: Moses and Aaron for “Hear now, you rebels!” As for Samuel, because he did not direct his sons in the good way, he died young.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 99:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/99:9:1)


**כִּי קָדוֹשׁ ה׳ אֱלֹהֵינוּ.** עַל אֲשֶׁר הוּא מְדַקְדֵּק עִם הַצַּדִּיקִים הוּא מְקֻדָּשׁ בָּעוֹלָם, וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר ״וְנִקְדַּשׁ בִּכְבוֹדִי״ (שמות כט:מג), בִּמְכֻבָּדַי (זבחים קטו:):


**for the Lord our God is holy** because He is strict with the righteous, He is sanctified in the world, and so He says (Exod. 29:43): “and it will be sanctified with My glory,” meaning “with those glorified by Me.”



## Chapter 100


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 100:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:1:1)


**מִזְמוֹר לְתוֹדָה.** לְהוֹדָיָה, לְאָמְרוֹ עַל זִבְחֵי תּוֹדָה:


**A song for a thanksgiving offering** For thanksgiving, to recite it over thanksgiving offerings.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 100:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:2:1)


**עִבְדוּ אֶת ה׳ בְּשִׂמְחָה.** וְכָל כָּךְ לָמָּה? **דְּעוּ כִּי ה׳ הוּא** הָאֱלֹהִים כְּשֶׁמְּשַׁלֵּם שְׂכַר פְּעֻלַּתְכֶם, אֲבָל עוֹבְדֵי עֲבוֹדַת גִּלוּלִים אֵין לָהֶם לַעֲבֹד בְּשִׂמְחָה שֶׁאֵין מְשַׁלְּמִין שָׂכָר:


**Serve the Lord with joy** Now why so much? You should know the Lord is God, Who recompenses you with reward for your work, but the heathens need not worship with joy because their deities do not give them any reward.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 100:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:3:1)


**הוּא עָשָׂנוּ וְלֹא.** כְּשֶׁלֹּא הָיִינוּ בָּעוֹלָם:


**He made us and we are His** When we were not in the world.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 100:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:4:1)


**בְּתוֹדָה.** בְּהוֹדָיָה:



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 100:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/100:5:1)


**וְעַד דֹּר וָדֹר.** קַיֶּמֶת **אֱמוּנָתוֹ**. כָּל לְשׁוֹן אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנָה, אֲמָנַת הַבְטָחָה, שֶׁמַּאֲמִין וּמַבְטִיחַ הַבְטָחָתוֹ:


**and until generation after generation** His faith will endure. Every expression of truth (אמת) and faith (אמונה) means the realization of a promise, that He makes true and assures His promise.



## Chapter 101


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 101:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:1:1)


**חֶסֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט אָשִׁירָה.** כְּשֶׁאַתָּה עוֹשֶׂה עִמִּי חֶסֶד, אֲקַלֶּסְךָ: בָּרוּךְ הַטּוֹב וְהַמֵּטִיב, וּכְשֶׁאַתָּה עוֹשֶׂה בִּי מִשְׁפָּט, אֲנִי אָשִׁיר: בָּרוּךְ דַּיַּן הָאֱמֶת, בֵּין כָּךְ וּבֵין כָּךְ **לְךָ ה׳ אֲזַמֵּרָה**:


**I shall sing of kindness and judgment** when You bestow kindness upon me, I will praise you [with the blessing:] “Blessed be He Who is good and does good,” and when You perform judgment upon me, I will sing, “Blessed be the true Judge.” In either case, to You, O Lord, I shall sing.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 101:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:2:1)


**אַשְׂכִּילָה.** אֶתֵּן לֵב עַל דֶּרֶךְ הַתָּמִים:


**I shall concern myself** I shall direct my thoughts to the way of integrity.


###### Rashi on Psalms 101:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:2:2)


**מָתַי תָּבוֹא אֵלַי.** הַדֶּרֶךְ הַיְשָׁרָה לְהִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּהּ, **וְאֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתָם לְבָבִי אַף בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי.** בְּהַצְנֵעַ כְּמוֹ בְּפַרְהֶסְיָא:


**When will it come to me** The straight path, to walk upon it, and I shall walk with the integrity of my heart even within my house, in private as well as in public.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 101:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:3:1)


**סֵטִים.** לְשׁוֹן ״כִּי תִשְׂטֶה אִשְׁתּוֹ״ (במדבר ה:יב), לָסוּר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ. דִּישְׁטוֹלְ״מַנְט בְּלַעַ״ז:


**wayward** Heb. סטים, an expression of (Num. 5:12): “whose wife strays (תשטה) from the right path,” to turn away from the road, destolemant in Old French, to swerve.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 101:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:4:1)


**רַע לֹא אֵדָע.** לֹא אֹהַב, לֹא אַכִּיר בְּדָבָר רָע:


**I know no evil** I love no [evil] (Another explanation: [Shem Ephraim]) I recognize no evil thing.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 101:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:5:1)


**אוֹתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל.** שֶׁיְּהֵא חֲבֵרִי, שֶׁלֹּא אֶלְמַד מִמַּעֲשָׂיו:


**I cannot tolerate him** that he should be my friend, lest I learn from his deeds.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 101:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/101:8:1)


**לַבְּקָרִים אַצְמִית.** מִדֵּי יוֹם יוֹם אַכְרִית מְעַט מְעַט **רִשְׁעֵי** יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמְחֻיָּבִין מִיתָה:


**Betimes I cut down** Every day, I cut down the wicked of Israel little by little, those who are condemned to death.



## Chapter 102


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:1:1)


**תְּפִלָּה לְעָנִי.** יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם עַם עָנִי:


**A prayer for a poor man** Israel, who is a poor people.


###### Rashi on Psalms 102:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:1:2)


**כִּי יַעֲטֹף.** בְּהִתְעַטֵּף נַפְשָׁם בְּצָרָה (יונה ב:ח):


**when he enwraps himself** when their soul is enwrapped in distress.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:4:1)


**נִחָרוּ.** הַנּוּ״ן מְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת, כְּמוֹ ״נַעֲשׂוּ״ (תהלים לג:ו), ״נִקְבּוּ״ (במדבר א:יז), וְהוּא לְשׁוֹן יֹבֶשׁ, כְּמוֹ ״וְעַצְמִי חָרָה מִנִּי חֹרֶב״ (איוב ל:ל), ״נָחַר מַפֻּחַ״ (ירמיה ו:כט):


**are dried up** Heb. נחרו. The “nun” serves as a prefix, as: נַעֲשׂוּ, they were made, נִקְנוּ, they were acquired; and it is an expression of dryness, as (Job 30:30): “and my bones dried out (חרה) from the heat”; (Jer. 6:29), “the bellows is heated (נחר).”



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:7:1)


**דָּמִיתִי לִקְאַת מִדְבָּר.** לִקְאַת שֵׁם עוֹף הוּא:


**Like a bird of** Heb. לקאת. It is the name of a bird.


###### Rashi on Psalms 102:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:7:2)


**כְּכוֹס חֳרָבוֹת.** שֵׁם עוֹף, כְּמוֹ ״אֶת הַכּוֹס וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָךְ וְאֶת הַיַּנְשׁוּף״ (ויקרא יא:יז):


**Like an owl of the wasteland** Heb. ככוס, the name of a bird, as (Lev. 11:17): “The owl (הכוס), the cormorant, and the night owl.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 102:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:7:3)


**חֳרָבוֹת.** מִדְבָּרוֹת. **דָּמִיתִי לִקְאַת מִדְבָּר.** כָּךְ אָנוּ נְדוּדִים מִמְּקוֹמֵנוּ לָלֶכֶת בַּגּוֹלָה:


**wasteland** deserts. I was like a bird of the desert. So do we wander from our place to go into exile.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:8:1)


**שָׁקַדְתִּי.** הִתְבּוֹנַנְתִּי בְּעַצְמִי וְהִנְּנִי **כְּצִפּוֹר הַבּוֹדֵד עַל גָּג**, יוֹשֵׁב לְבַדּוֹ בְּאֵין זוּג:


**I pondered** I pondered about myself, and behold I am like a lonely bird on a roof, sitting alone without a mate.


###### Rashi on Psalms 102:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:8:2)


**בּוֹדֵד.** יוֹשֵׁב בָּדָד:


**lonely** Heb. בודד, sitting alone.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:9:1)


**מְהוֹלָלַי.** הַמִּתְלוֹצְצִים בִּי, לְשׁוֹן ״הוֹלְלוּת״ (קהלת א:יז):


**those who scorn me** Heb. מהוללי, those who scorn me, an expression of mockery.


###### Rashi on Psalms 102:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:9:2)


**בִּי נִשְׁבָּעוּ.** רָאוּ בְרָעָתִי וְנִשְׁבָּעִים בִּי וְאוֹמְרִים: אִם לֹא יֶאֱרַע בִּי כְּמוֹ שֶׁאֵרַע לְיִשְׂרָאֵל, כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה לִי כְּמוֹ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:


**swear by me** They saw my misfortune and they swear by me and say, “If it is not so, what happened to Israel should happen to me.” “So may the Lord do to me as to Israel.”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:10:1)


**בִּבְכִי מָסָכְתִּי.** בְּדִמְעָה מָזַגְתִּי:


**I mixed with weeping.** I mixed with tears.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:11:1)


**כִּי נְשָׂאתַנִי.** תְּחִלָּה וְהִגְבַּהְתַּנִי, וְעַתָּה הִשְׁלַכְתַּנִי מִשָּׁמַיִם אָרֶץ (איכה ב:א); וְאִם לֹא נְשָׂאתַנִי תְּחִלָּה, לֹא הָיְתָה חֶרְפָּתִי רַבָּה כָּל כָּךְ:


**for You picked me up** First You picked me up and now You cast me down from heaven to the earth, and if You had not picked me up first, my disgrace would not be so great.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:12:1)


**כְּצֵל נָטוּי.** לְעֵת עֶרֶב, כְּשֶׁהַצְּלָלִים נוֹטִים, וּכְשֶׁחֲשֵׁכָה, אֵין נִכָּרִים אֶלָּא כָּלִים וְהוֹלְכִים:


**Like a lengthening shadow** At eventide, when the shadows lengthen, and when it becomes dark, they are not recognizable, but progressively disappear.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:13:1)


**וְאַתָּה.** אֲשֶׁר לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב, וְנִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לָנוּ בְּךָ (שמות לב:יג) – כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאַתָּה קַיָּם, יֵשׁ עָלֶיךָ לְקַיְּמֵנוּ. לְפִיכָךְ:


**But You** Who will be enthroned forever, and Who swore to us by Yourself, just as You exist, it is incumbent upon You to fulfill it. Therefore...



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:14:1)


**אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כִּי עֵת לְחֶנְנָהּ.** כִּי בְךָ הִבְטַחְתָּ (דברים לב:לו) ״כִּי יִרְאֶה כִּי אָזְלַת יָד״, וַהֲרֵי אָזְלַת יָד:


**You will rise, You will have mercy on Zion for it is time to favor it** For so You promised (Deut. 32:36): “When He sees that their power is gone,” and it is indeed gone.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:15:1)


**כִּי רָצוּ.** אָהֲבוּ אַף **אֶת אֲבָנֶיהָ וְאֶת עֲפָרָהּ**. וּמִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה: כְּשֶׁיָּצָא יְכָנְיָה וְגָלוּתוֹ, נָשְׂאוּ עִמָּהֶם מֵאַבְנֵי יְרוּשָׁלַיִם וַעֲפָרָהּ לִבְנוֹת לָהֶם בְּבָבֶל בֵּית הַכְּנֶסֶת:


**For Your servants desired** They loved even its stones and its earth. [According to] Midrash Aggadah, when Jeconiah and his exile left, they carried with them some of the stones and the earth of Jerusalem to build a synagogue for themselves there in Babylon.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:16:1)


**וְיִירְאוּ גוֹיִם אֶת.** שִׁמְךָ כְּשֶׁתּוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת עַמְּךָ:


**And the nations will fear** Your name when You save Your people.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:18:1)


**הֶעָרְעָר.** הַצּוֹעֵק, כְּמוֹ (ישעיהו טו:ה) ״זַעֲקַת שֶׁבֶר יְעֹעֵרוּ״. דָּבָר אַחֵר: עַרְעָר, הָרוּס וְנִשְׁחָת, כְּמוֹ (תהלים קלז:ז) ״עָרוּ עָרוּ״:


**He has turned to the prayer of those who cried out** Heb. הערער, who cries out, as (Isa. 15:5): “a cry of destruction they will raise (יעוערו).” Another explanation: ערער means devastated and destroyed, as (below 137:7) “who say, ‘Raze it, raze it.’ “



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:19:1)


**תִּכָּתֵב זֹאת.** כָּךְ יֹאמְרוּ רוֹאֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה: תִּכָּתֵב הַיְשׁוּעָה הַזֹּאת לְסַפֵּר אוֹתָהּ **לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן**:


**Let this be inscribed** So will those who see the salvation say, “let this salvation be inscribed for the latest generation.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 102:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:19:2)


**וְעַם נִבְרָא.** שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה בְּרִיָּה חֲדָשָׁה, לָצֵאת מֵעַבְדוּת לְחֵרוּת, מֵאֹפֶל לְאוֹר גָּדוֹל:


**and a created people** that became a new creature to emerge from slavery to freedom and from darkness to a great light.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:20:1)


**אֶל אֶרֶץ הִבִּיט.** לִרְאוֹת בָּעֳנִי עַמּוֹ:


**looked...to earth** to see the affliction of His people.



### Verse 21

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:21:1)


**תְּמוּתָה.** חוֹלֶה לָמוּת, אינמורינד״א בְּלַעַ״ז):


**the dying** Heb. תמותה, mortally ill, enmorindes in Old French (as above 79:11).



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:24:1)


**עִנָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ כֹּחִי.** חוֹזֵר לְקוֹבְלוֹ הָרִאשׁוֹן: **כִּי נְשָׂאתַנִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי, יָמַי כְּצֵל נָטוּי**, עִנָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ אוֹיְבִי כֹּחִי:


**He has afflicted my strength on the way** He returns to his original complaint, “for You picked me up and cast me down. My days are like a lengthening shadow.” My enemy afflicted my strength on the way.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:25:1)


**אוֹמַר.** לַה׳ **אֵלִי.** אַתָּה:


**I say** to the Lord, “You are my God.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 102:25:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:25:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:25:2)


**אַל תַּעֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִי יָמַי.** אַל תְּסַלֵּק אוֹתָנוּ לְהַשְׁמִידֵנוּ מִן הָאֲדָמָה בְּיַד אוֹיְבֵינוּ בַּחֲצִי יָמֵינוּ. וּמַה הֵם יָמֵינוּ? כָּל יְמוֹת **דוֹר דּוֹרִים שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ**, הִבְטַחְתָּ לְקַיְּמֵנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר בְּסוֹף הַמִּזְמוֹר **וּשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ לֹא יִתָּמּוּ**, וְזֶרַע עֲבָדֶיךָ **לְפָנֶיךָ יִכּוֹן**:


**do not take me away in the middle of my days** Do not take us away to destroy us from the earth in the hands of our enemies in the middle of our days. And what are our days? All the days of all generations, of Your years, You promised to keep us alive before You, as he says at the end of the psalm, “and Your years do not end...and their seed will be established before You.”



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:26:1)


**לְפָנִים.** מִתְּחִלָּה:


**In the beginning** Heb. לפנים, from the beginning.



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:27:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:27:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:27:1)


**כַּלְּבוּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵם.** כְּאָדָם הַהוֹפֵךְ לְבוּשׁוֹ לְפוֹשְׁטוֹ:


**like raiment You will turn them over** like a person who turns his garment inside out to take it off.



### Verse 28

###### Rashi on Psalms 102:28:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:28:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/102:28:1)


**וְאַתָּה הוּא.** הָעוֹמֵד וְקַיָּם:


**But You are He** Who stands and exists.



## Chapter 103


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 103:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:1:1)


**בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי.** חֲמִשָּׁה בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי יֵשׁ כָּאן, כְּנֶגֶד חֲמִשָּׁה עוֹלָמוֹת שֶׁאָדָם דָּר בָּהֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ בְּמַסֶּכֶת בְּרָכוֹת (ברכות י.): דָּר בִּמְעֵי אִמּוֹ, יָנַק מִשְּׁדֵי אִמּוֹ, וְכֵן כֻּלָּם:


**My soul, bless** There are five mentions of “My soul, bless” here, corresponding to the five worlds in which man lives, as our Sages said in Tractate Berachoth (10a): “He lived in his mother’s womb, he sucked his mother’s breasts, and so all of them.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 103:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:5:1)


**תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ כַּנֶּשֶׁר נְעוּרָיְכִי.** כַּנֶּשֶׁר הַזֶּה שֶׁמְּחַדֵּשׁ כְּנָפָיו וְנוֹצָה מִשָּׁנָה לְשָׁנָה. וְיֵשׁ מִדְרַשׁ אַגָּדָה (בראשית רבה יט, ה) עַל מִין נֶשֶׁר, שֶׁכְּשֶׁמַּזְקִין חוֹזֵר לְנַעֲרוּתוֹ:


**that your youth renews itself like the eagle** Like this eagle, which renews its wings and feathers from year to year. There is a Midrash Aggadah about a kind of eagle that returns to its youth when it becomes old.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 103:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:7:1)


**יוֹדִיעַ דְּרָכָיו.** מוֹדִיעַ דְּרָכָיו לְמֹשֶׁה:


**He makes His ways known** He makes His ways known to Moses.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 103:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:14:1)


**זָכוּר כִּי עָפָר אֲנַחְנוּ.** זָכוּר הוּא וְלֹא שָׁכַח שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ עָפָר, וְיוֹדֵעַ שֶׁ**אֱנוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִיר יָמָיו וְגוֹ׳**:


**He remembers that we are dust** He remembers and has not forgotten that we are dust and He knows that: “As for manhis days, etc.”



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 103:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:16:1)


**רוּחַ עָבְרָה בּוֹ.** אִם עָבְרָה חֳלִי שֶׁל מִיתָה:


**For a wind passes over him** If mortal illness passes over him.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 103:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:19:1)


**מָשָׁלָה.** מוֹשֶׁלֶת:



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Psalms 103:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/103:22:1)


**בָּרֲכוּ ה׳ כָּל מַעֲשָׂיו.** אֲשֶׁר הֵם בְּכָל מְקוֹמוֹת שֶׁמֶּמְשַׁלְתּוֹ שָׁם:


**Bless the Lord, all His works** who are in all the places of His dominion.



## Chapter 104


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:2:1)


**עוֹטֶה אוֹר.** בָּרָקִיעַ **כַּשַּׂלְמָה**:


**[You] enwrap Yourself with light** in the sky like a garment.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:4:1)


**עוֹשֶׂה מַלְאָכָיו רוּחוֹת.** עוֹשֶׂה אֶת הָרוּחוֹת שְׁלוּחָיו:


**He makes winds His messengers** lit. He makes His messengers winds. He makes the wind His messengers.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:6:1)


**תְּהוֹם כַּלְּבוּשׁ כִּסִּיתוֹ.** זֶה דּוּגְמַת הָאָמוּר בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר: ״בְּשׂוּמִי עָנָן לְבוּשׁוֹ וְגוֹ׳״ (איוב לח:ט):


**You covered the deep as [with] a garment** This is similar to what is said elsewhere (Job 38: 9): “When I made the cloud its raiment, etc.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 104:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:6:2)


**תְּהוֹם.** הוּא הַיָּם:


**the deep** That is the sea.


###### Rashi on Psalms 104:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:6:3)


**עַל הָרִים יַעַמְדוּ.** מֵי אוֹקְיָינוֹס גָּבוֹהַּ מִכָּל הָעוֹלָם עוֹמֵד עַל הֶהָרִים, וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר (עמוס ה:ח, ט:ו) ״הַקּוֹרֵא לְמֵי הַיָּם וַיִּשְׁפְּכֵם עַל פְּנֵי הָאָרֶץ״. אֵין שְׁפִיכָה אֶלָּא מִלְמַעְלָה לְמַטָּה:


**the waters stand on the mountains** The waters of the ocean are higher than the whole world. They stand on the mountains, and so Scripture states (Amos 5:8, 9:6): “He who calls the water of the sea and pours it upon the face of the earth.” Pouring denotes only [pouring] from above downward.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:7:1)


**מִן גַּעֲרָתְךָ יְנוּסוּן.** כְּשֶׁאָמַרְתָּ (בראשית א:ט) ״יִקָּווּ הַמַּיִם״, וּמֵאוֹתוֹ הַקּוֹל **יֵחָפֵזוּן** וְנִקְווּ אֶל מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִסַּדְתָּ לָהֶם:


**From Your rebuke they fled** When You said (Gen. 1:9): “Let the waters gather.” And from that voice they hastened away and gathered in the place that You founded for them.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:9:1)


**גְּבוּל שַׂמְתָּ.** לָהֶם הַחוֹל אֲשֶׁר סָבִיב שְׂפָתוֹ:


**You set a boundary** for them, viz. the sand that is around its shore.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:12:1)


**עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁכּוֹן.** עַל הַמַּעְיָנוֹת:


**Beside them the fowl of the heavens dwell** Beside the springs.


###### Rashi on Psalms 104:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:12:2)


**מִבֵּין עֳפָאיִם.** עַנְפֵי אִילָנוֹת, וְכֵן ״עָפְיֵּהּ שַׁפִּיר״ (דניאל ד:ט):


**from between the branches** Heb. עפאים, the branches of the trees, and so (Dan. 4:11): “its branches were (עפיה) beautiful.”



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:15:1)


**מַצְמִיחַ חָצִיר וְגוֹ׳. וְיַיִן** אֲשֶׁר **יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ** גַּם אוֹתוֹ יוֹצִיא **מִן הָאָרֶץ**, וְשֶׁמֶן **לְהַצְהִיל** בּוֹ **פָּנִים**:


**And wine** which cheers man’s heart, that too He brings forth from the earth, and oil to cause the face to radiate.


###### Rashi on Psalms 104:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:15:2)


**וְלֶחֶם.** אֲשֶׁר לֵב **אֱנוֹשׁ יִסְעָד**:


**and bread** which sustains man’s heart.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:16:1)


**עֲצֵי ה׳.** בְּגַן עֵדֶן (בראשית רבה טו, א):


**The Lord’s trees** in the Garden of Eden.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:17:1)


**צִפֳּרִים יְקַנֵּנוּ.** יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁכְּנוּ שָׁם:


**birds nest** Israel will dwell there.


###### Rashi on Psalms 104:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:17:2)


**יְקַנֵּנוּ.** לְשׁוֹן ״קַן צִפּוֹר״ (דברים כב:ו):


יְקַנֵנוּ is an expression of a bird’s nest (קן צפור).



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:18:1)


**הָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים.** בָּרָא **לַיְּעֵלִים**:


**The lofty mountains** He created for the ibexes.


###### Rashi on Psalms 104:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:18:2)


**מַחְסֶה.** כָּל לְשׁוֹן מַחְסֶה לְשׁוֹן צֵל וּמַחְבָּא, שֶׁאָדָם מִתְכַּסֶּה שָׁם מִן הַזֶּרֶם וּמִן הַמָּטָר (ישעיהו כה:ד). אַבְרִ״י בְּלַעַ״ז:


**shelter** Every expression of מַחְסֶה is an expression of a shadow and a hiding place, where a person covers himself from flood and rain.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:19:1)


**לְמוֹעֲדִים.** לִמְנוֹת בּוֹ זְמַנִּים וּרְגָלִים (ראש השנה כה.):


**He made the moon for the appointed seasons** To count with it the times and the festivals.


###### Rashi on Psalms 104:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:19:2)


**שֶׁמֶשׁ יָדַע מְבוֹאוֹ.** אֲבָל יָרֵחַ לֹא יָדַע מְבוֹאוֹ, פְּעָמִים שֶׁבָּא בַּאֲרֻכָּה, פְּעָמִים שֶׁבָּא בַּקְּצָרָה (ראש השנה כה.):


**the sun knows its setting** But the moon does not know its setting, because sometimes it comes through a long way and sometimes it comes through a short way.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:20:1)


**תָּשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ וִיהִי לָיְלָה.** בְּכָל יוֹם אַתָּה מַחְשִׁיךְ וּמַעֲרִיב אֶת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְהָיָה לָיְלָה, וּ**בּוֹ תִּרְמֹשׂ כָּל חַיְתוֹ יָעַר**:


**You make darkness and it is night** Every day You darken and block out the sun and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest move about.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:22:1)


**תִּזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפוּן.** בַּמִּסְתָּרִים וְנֶחְבָּאִים שָׁם מִבְּנֵי אָדָם, וְאָז כָּל אָדָם יוֹצֵא לְפָעֳלוֹ:


**When the sun rises they gather in** into the secret places and hide there from the sons of men; then every man goes forth to his work.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:24:1)


**קִנְיָנֶךָ.** מִקְנֵה קִנְיָן שֶׁלְּךָ, כְּמוֹ ״קוֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ״ (בראשית יד:יט). הַכֹּל קָנוּי לְךָ:


**Your possessions** Heb. קנינך, the acquisition that you have acquired, like (Gen. 14:19): “Owner (קנה) of heaven and earth.” All is acquired by You.



### Verse 25

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:25:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:25:1)


**וּרְחַב יָדָיִם.** רָחָב מָקוֹם, לְרֵיי״שׁ בְּלַעַ״ז:


**and wide** Heb. ורחב ידים. Wide of place, large in French, broad.



### Verse 26

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:26:1)


**לְשַׂחֶק בּוֹ.** שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁעוֹת בַּיּוֹם, כָּךְ אָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ בְּמַסֶּכֶת עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה (עבודה זרה ג:), וְכָךְ מְפֹרָשׁ בְּסֵפֶר אִיּוֹב: ״הֲתְשַׂחֶק בּוֹ כַּצִּפּוֹר״ (איוב מ:כט):


**with which to sport** three hours during the day. So did our Sages say in tractate Avodah Zarah (3b), and so it is written explicitly in the Book of Job (40:29): “Will you play with him like a bird?”



### Verse 29

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:29:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:29:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:29:1)


**תּוֹסֵף רוּחָם.** לְשׁוֹן כִּלָּיוֹן, כְּמוֹ ״סָפוּ תַמּוּ״ (תהלים עג:יט):


**You gather in their spirit** Heb. תסף, an expression of destruction, as (above 73:19): “They were completely consumed (ספו).”



### Verse 30

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:30:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:30:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:30:1)


**תְּשַׁלַּח רוּחֲךָ.** בִּתְחִיַּת הַמֵּתִים:


**You will send forth Your spirit** with the resurrection of the dead.



### Verse 32

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:32:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:32:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:32:1)


**יִגַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּפֹרָשׁ בְּסִינַי: ״וְהַר סִינַי עָשַׁן כֻּלּוֹ״ (שמות יט:יח):


**He touches the mountains and they emit smoke** as is depicted of Sinai (Exod. 19:18): “And Mount Sinai was all in smoke.”



### Verse 33

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:33:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:33:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:33:1)


**בְּעוֹדִי.** כְּמוֹ ״בְּעוֹדֶנִּי חַי״ (דברים לא:כז):


**as long as I exist** Heb. בעדי, like (Deut. 31:27): “When I am still (בעודני) alive.”



### Verse 35

###### Rashi on Psalms 104:35:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:35:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/104:35:1)


**יִתַּמּוּ חַטָּאִים.** חוֹטְאִים (ברכות י.):


**Sinners will be destroyed** Heb. חטאים, sinners [rather than sins, but see Tal. Ber. 10a].



## Chapter 105


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:1:1)


**עֲלִילוֹתָיו.** מַעֲלָלָיו:


**His deeds** Heb. עלילותיו, His deeds.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:3:1)


**הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ.** הִתְפָּאֲרוּ בְּמָעוֹז שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ, שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָכֶם פַּטְרוֹן כָּמוֹהוּ. **הִתְהַלְלוּ** פוֹרְוַונְטִי״ץ וו״ש בְּלַעַ״ז:


**Boast of His holy name** Boast of the stronghold of His holy name that you have a patron like Him. התהללוּ is “porvontez vous” in Old French, [vantez vous in modern French, boast].



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:8:1)


**דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר.** הַתּוֹרָה, אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה לְהוֹדִיעָהּ בָּעוֹלָם לְאַחַר אֶלֶף דּוֹר; וְרָאָה שֶׁאֵין הָעוֹלָם מִתְקַיֵּם בְּלֹא תּוֹרָה, וְהֶעֱבִיר מֵהֶם תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת וְשִׁבְעִים וְאַרְבָּעָה דּוֹרוֹת. וְיֵשׁ לִפְתֹּר כִּפְשׁוּטוֹ: **זָכַר** לְיִשְׂרָאֵל **בְּרִיתוֹ** אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה, וְהִבְטִיחַ לִשְׁמֹר לָהֶם לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר, כְּעִנְיָן ״שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וְהַחֶסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֹתָיו לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר״ (דברים ז:ט):


**the word He had commanded to the thousandth generation** The Torah, which He commanded to make known in the world after a thousand generations, but He saw that the world could not exist without Torah, so he skipped 974 generations of them. It may also be interpreted according to its simple meaning: He remembered for Israel His covenant, which He commanded and promised to keep for them for a thousand generations, as the matter of (Deut. 7:9): “Who keeps the covenant and the kindness for those who love Him and who keep His commandments, to a thousand generations.”



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:11:1)


**לֵאמֹר לְךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְגוֹ׳.** הוּא הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת לָהֶם (בראשית טו:יח):


**Saying, “To you I shall give, etc.”** That is the covenant that He made for them.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:13:1)


**וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּוֹי אֶל גּוֹי.** אַבְרָהָם גָּר בְּאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְמִצְרַיִם וּבְאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן (בראשית כא:לד; יב:י; יג:יב), וְכֵן יִצְחָק (בראשית כו:א-לה), וְכֵן יַעֲקֹב (בראשית מב:א-לח; מו:א-לד). כֻּלָּם גָּלוּ מִגֵּרוּת לְגֵרוּת:


**And they walked from nation to nation** Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines, in Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, and so Isaac, and so Jacobthey all were exiled from one strange place to another strange place.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:14:1)


**וַיּוֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶם מְלָכִים.** ״וַיְנַגַּע ה׳ אֶת פַּרְעֹה״ (בראשית יב:יז), ״כִּי עָצוֹר עָצַר ה׳ בְּעַד כָּל רֶחֶם לְבֵית אֲבִימֶלֶךְ״ (בראשית כ:יח):


**and He reproved kings on their account** (Gen. 12:17): “And the Lord plagued Pharaoh”; (ibid. 20:18), “For the Lord had closed up every womb of the house of Abimelech.”



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:15:1)


**אַל תִּגְּעוּ בִמְשִׁיחָי.** בִּגְדוֹלַי, כָּל מְשִׁיחָה לְשׁוֹן שְׂרָרָה וּגְדֻלָּה:


**My anointed ones** My great ones. Every [expression of] anointing is an expression of rulership and greatness.



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:16:1)


**וַיִּקְרָא רָעָב.** כְּדֵי לְהַגְלוֹתָם לְמִצְרַיִם (בראשית מב:א-ב) (מצאתי):


**He called a famine** in order to exile them to Egypt (I found).



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:17:1)


**שָׁלַח לִפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ.** וַיִּשְׁלָחֵנִי אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵיכֶם (בראשית מה:ה), וְאֵיזֶה אִישׁ? יוֹסֵף שֶׁנִּמְכַּר:


**He sent a man before them** (Gen. 45:5): “And God sent me before you.” Now who was the man? Joseph, who was sold.



### Verse 18

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:18:1)


**בַּרְזֶל בָּאָה נַפְשׁוֹ.** אָמַר רַבִּי הוּנָא בַּר אִידִי (תנחומא, וישב ח): שַׁרְתּוֹעַ עָשְׂתָה לוֹ תַּחַת זְקָנוֹ, שֶׁאִם יַרְכִּין פָּנָיו הַשַּׁרְתּוֹעַ מַכֵּהוּ. שַׁרְתּוֹעַ פֵּרוּשׁ שַׁפּוּד:


**his soul was placed in irons** Said Rav Huna the son of Idi: She [Potiphar’s wife] made him a “shirtua” under his beard, so that if he bent his face over, the “shirtua” would wound him. שרתוע means a forked, suspended spear.



### Verse 19

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:19:1)


**עַד עֵת בֹּא דְבָרוֹ.** שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְקַיֵּם גְּזֵרָתוֹ, שֶׁיִּתְגַּלְגֵּל הַדָּבָר וְיֵרְדוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִצְרַיִם:


**Until His word came** [The word] of the Holy One, blessed be He, to fulfill His decree that the matter should “roll” and Israel should descend to Egypt.


###### Rashi on Psalms 105:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:19:2)


**אִמְרַת ה׳ צְרָפָתְהוּ.** בְּחָנַתְהוּ לְיוֹסֵף, שֶׁנִּתְנַסָּה וְכָבַשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ בְּאֵשֶׁת אֲדוֹנָיו (בראשית לט:ז-יב), וְעָלֶיהָ נִתְיַיסֵּר וְנִצְרַף בְּיִסּוּרִין לְתִתּוֹ אֶל בֵּית הַסֹּהַר (בראשית לט:כ):


**the saying of the Lord purified him** It tried Joseph, for he was tested and he overcame the temptation [to sin] with his master’s wife, and he was tortured because of her and purified with tortures to place him in the dungeon.



### Verse 20

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:20:1)


**שָׁלַח מֶלֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ.** שָׁלַח פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם שְׁלוּחָיו וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ, שָׁלַח **מוֹשֵׁל עַמִּים** הוּא פַּרְעֹה **וַיְפַתְּחֵהוּ**:


**A king sent and released him** Pharaoh, king of Egypt, sent his messengers and released him. A ruler of peoples, viz. Pharaoh, [sent] and loosed his bonds.



### Verse 22

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/105:22:1)


**לֶאֱסֹר שָׂרָיו בְּנַפְשׁוֹ.** לְשׁוֹן חִבָּה הוּא זֶה, כְּמוֹ ״וְנֶפֶשׁ יְהוֹנָתָן נִקְשְׁרָה בְּנֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד״ (שמואל א יח:א). כְּשֶׁפָּתַר הַחֲלוֹם חִבְּבוּהוּ כֻּלָּם. אָמַר רַבִּי אִידִי: שָׂרוֹ כְּתִיב, זֶה הָיָה פּוֹטִיפַר:


**To bind up his princes with his soul** This is an expression of endearment, as (I Sam. 18:1): “that Jonathan’s soul had become attached to David’s soul.” When he interpreted the dream, they all loved him. Said Rabbi Idi: It is written שָׂרוֹ, his prince. This was Potiphar.



### Verse 24

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:24:1

**וַיֶּפֶר.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא **אֶת עַמּוֹ**, הִפְרָה וְהִרְבָּה אוֹתָם:


**And He made...fruitful** The Holy One, blessed be He, [made] His people [fruitful]. He made them fruitful and caused them to multiply.

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:28:1

**וְלֹא מָרוּ אֶת דְּבָרוֹ.** הַמַּכּוֹת שֶׁצִּוָּה עֲלֵיהֶם בָּאוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְלֹא שִׁנּוּ אֶת דְּבָרוֹ (תנחומא, בא א):


**And they did not disobey His word** The plagues, that He commanded upon them, came according to His commandments and did not deviate from His word.

**שָׁרַץ אַרְצָם צְפַרְדְּעִים.** אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן (שמות רבה י:ד): בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁהָיוּ רוֹבְצִים מַיִם, הָיוּ רוֹבְצִים צְפַרְדְּעִים:


**Their land swarmed with frogs** Said Rabbi Johanan: Wherever water would lie, frogs would lie.

**They asked, and He brought quails** Israel asked for meat, and the Holy One, blessed be He, brought them quails.

**in the deserts ran rivers** Rivers flowed from the well in an arid land.

###### Rashi on Psalms 105:42:1

**כִּי זָכַר.** הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא **אֶת דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ** אֲשֶׁר עִם **אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ**, שֶׁהִבְטִיחוֹ (בראשית טו:יד,טז) ״וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יֵצְאוּ בִּרְכֻשׁ גָּדוֹל״, ״וְדוֹר רְבִיעִי יָשׁוּבוּ הֵנָּה״:


**For He remembered** The Holy One, blessed be He, [remembered] His holy word, which was with Abraham His servant, which He promised him (Gen. 15:14, 17): “and afterwards they will go out with many possessions...and a fourth generation will return here.”

**when You favor Your people** When You show goodwill to Your people.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 106:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/106:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/106:7:1)


**וַיַּמְרוּ עַל יָם.** הָיוּ מִקְּטַנֵּי אֲמָנָה; אָמְרוּ: כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאָנוּ עוֹלִים מִכָּאן מִצַּד זֶה, אַף הַמִּצְרִיִּים עוֹלִים מִצַּד אַחֵר, וְיָבוֹאוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ; עַד שֶׁרָמַז הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לַיָּם וְהֵקִיאָם לַיַּבָּשָׁה. אָז ״וַיַּרְא יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מִצְרַיִם מֵת עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם״ (שמות יד:ל), לְפִיכָךְ ״וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בַּה׳״ (שמות יד:לא); אֲבָל מִתְּחִלָּה לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ (פסחים קיח:) (מצאתי):


**and they were rebellious by the sea** They had little faith; they said, “Just as we ascend from here, from this side, the Egyptians also are ascending from another side, and they will come after us,” until the Holy One, blessed be He, hinted to the sea, and it vomited them out onto the dry land. Then (Exod. 14:30) “Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.” Therefore (ibid. verse 31) “they believed in the Lord,” but in the beginning, they did not believe. I found this.

###### Rashi on Psalms 106:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/106:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/106:9:1)


**וַיּוֹלִיכֵם בַּתְּהוֹמוֹת כַּמִּדְבָּר.** יַם סוּף הָיָה בַמִּדְבָּר, דִּכְתִיב ״סָגַר עֲלֵיהֶם הַמִּדְבָּר וְגוֹ׳״ (שמות יד:ג). ״דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וְגוֹ׳״ (במדבר י:לג):


**and He led them in the depths in the desert** The Sea of Reeds was in the desert, for it is written (Exod. 14:13): “the desert has closed upon them, etc.”; (Exod. 3:18): “three days’ journey in the desert.”

**אוֹכֵל עֵשֶׂב.** אֵין לְךָ מְתֹעָב וּמְשֻׁקָּץ מִן הַשּׁוֹר, בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁהוּא **אוֹכֵל עֵשֶׂב** (מכילתא בשלח ויהי ו), שֶׁהוּא מוֹצִיא פֶּרֶשׁ רַבָּה וְהוּא מְלֻכְלָךְ בָּהּ. ס״א: רִירוֹ:


**eating grass** There is nothing as disgusting and repugnant as an ox. When it eats grass, it emits much dung, with which it sullies itself. Other books read: its saliva.

**the peoples whom the Lord had told them** (Deut. 20:16): “You shall not allow a soul to remain alive”; (Exod. 23:33), “They shall not remain as residents in your land,” but they allowed them to dwell in their midst, paying tribute.

**And He delivered them into the hands of nations** in the days of the Judges between one judge and another, e.g. Eglon, Cushan-rishathaim, Sisera, the Philistines, and Midian. (I found.)

### Verse 1

**And He led them** And He led them; therefore, they shall give thanks to the Lord for His kindness.

###### Rashi on Psalms 107:10:1

###### Rashi on Psalms 107:16:1

**For He broke copper doors** that were shut before them.



### Verse 17

###### Rashi on Psalms 107:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/107:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/107:17:1)


**אֱוִילִים מִדֶּרֶךְ פִּשְׁעָם.** אֲשֶׁר מֵעֲוֹנוֹתֵיהֶם יִתְעַנּוּ בְּיִסּוּרֵי חֳלָאִים, אַף הֵם מִן הַצְּרִיכִין לְהוֹדוֹת. יֵשׁ סִמָּנִיּוֹת בְּפָרָשָׁה זוֹ (כְּלוֹמַר כְּתוּבוֹת שֵׁשׁ נוני״ן הֲפוּכִין) וּבָאִין לִדְרֹשׁ בִּמְקוֹם אַכִּין וְרַקִּין לְמַעֵט, לוֹמַר צָעֲקוּ קֹדֶם גְּזַר דִּין נַעֲנִין, לְאַחַר גְּזַר דִּין אֵינָם נַעֲנִין:


**Fools, because of the way of their transgression and because of their iniquities, are afflicted** with the agonies of illnesses. They too are among those who are required to give thanks. There are markers in this chapter (i.e., six inverted “nuns” are written) and they come to be expounded upon instead of “buts” and “onlys” to limit [the power of the verse] meaning that if they [the prisoners] cry out before the verdict has been promulgated, they are answered; after the verdict has been promulgated, they are not answered.



### Verse 27

###### Rashi on Psalms 107:27:1

**יָחוֹגּוּ.** לְשׁוֹן שֶׁבֶר הוּא, וְכֵן ״בְּחַגְוֵי הַסֶּלַע״ (שיר השירים ב:יד), וְכֵן ״וְהָיְתָה אַדְמַת יְהוּדָה לְמִצְרַיִם לְחָגָּא״ (ישעיהו יט:יז):


**They were frightened** Heb. יחוגו. This is an expression of breaking. Similarly (Song 2:14): “in the clefts of (בחגוי) the rock”; and similarly (Isa. l9:17), “And the land of Judah will be to Egypt for a dread (לחגא).”

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/107:30:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/107:30:2)


**וַיְנַחֵם.** וַיְנַהֲגֵם:


###### Rashi on Psalms 107:30:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/107:30:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/107:30:3)


**מָחוֹז.** לְשׁוֹן גְּבוּל, וּמְנַחֵם חִבְּרוֹ עִם ״וַחֲזוּתְכֶם אֶת שְׁאוֹל״ (ישעיה כח:יח) – גְּבוּלֵינוּ, שֶׁלֹּא יִכָּנֵס בִּגְבוּלֵינוּ. וְכֵן ״מַחֲזֶה אֶל מַחֲזֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים״ (מלכים א ז:ד). בְּתַנְחוּמָא מָצָאתִי:

Similarly (I Kings 7:4): “an edge (מחזה מול מחזה) opposite an edge,” three times. In Tanchuma, I found [this].

## Chapter 108


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 108:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:2:1)


**נָכוֹן לִבִּי.** נֶאֱמָן עִמְּךָ:


**My heart is steadfast** faithful with You.


###### Rashi on Psalms 108:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:2:2)


**אַף כְּבוֹדִי.** הוּא מַה שֶּׁאֲנִי מְשׁוֹרֵר לְךָ. דָּבָר אַחֵר: **אַף כְּבוֹדִי.** אַף לְפִי כְבוֹדִי לֹא אֶמָּנַע לְשׁוֹרֵר לוֹ, וְלֹא אֲחַלֵּק לְעַצְמִי כָּבוֹד:


**even my glory** Even my glory is what I sing to You. Another explanation: **Even my glory** Even according to my honor, I shall not hesitate to sing to Him, and I shall not take glory for myself.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 108:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:3:1)


**אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר.** דֶּרֶךְ שְׁאָר מְלָכִים, הַשַּׁחַר מְעוֹרְרָם, וַאֲנִי מְעוֹרֵר אֶת הַשַּׁחַר; שֶׁאֲנִי קָם חֲצוֹת לַיְלָה (תהלים קיט:סב), שֶׁהַנֵּבֶל וְהַכִּנּוֹר מְעוֹרְרֵנִי; כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ (ברכות ג:): כִּנּוֹר הָיָה תָּלוּי לְמַעְלָה מִמִּטָּתוֹ שֶׁל דָּוִד; כֵּיוָן שֶׁהִגִּיעַ חֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה, רוּחַ צְפוֹנִית מְנַשֶּׁבֶת בּוֹ, וְהוּא מְנַגֵּן מֵאֵלָיו:


**I shall awaken the dawn** It is the custom of other kings that the dawn awakens them, but I awaken the dawn, for I rise at midnight, when the psaltery and the harp awaken me, as our Rabbis said (Ber. 3b): A harp was suspended above David’s bed. As soon as midnight arrived, the north wind would blow on it and it would play by itself.



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 108:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:5:1)


**מֵעַל שָׁמַיִם.** וְכָתוּב אֶחָד אוֹמֵר **עַד שָׁמַיִם** (תהלים נז:יא)? פֵּרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ (פסחים נ:): כָּאן בְּעוֹשִׂין לִשְׁמָהּ, כָּאן בְּעוֹשִׂין שֶׁלֹּא לִשְׁמָהּ:


**above the heavens** and one verse says (above 57:11): “is up to the heavens.” Our Rabbis explained: This one speaks of those who perform [a commandment] for its sake [i.e., for the sole purpose of obeying the Torah], and that one deals with those who perform [the commandments] with ulterior motives.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 108:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:7:1)


**וַעֲנֵנִי.** שֶׁכָּל עַמְּךָ וִידִידֶיךָ תְּלוּיִין בִּי:


**and answer me** for all Your people and Your beloved ones are dependent upon me.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 108:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:8:1)


**אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ.** שֶׁאֶמְלֹךְ וְיָבֹא הָעֵת וְאֶעֱלֹז בִּדְבָרוֹ (תהלים ס:ח):


**God spoke with His holiness** that I would reign and that the time would come that I would rejoice in His word.


###### Rashi on Psalms 108:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:8:2)


**אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם.** אֲחַלְּקָה אֶרֶץ אוֹיְבִי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל, שְׁכֶם חֵלֶק כְּמוֹ (בראשית מח:כב) ״שְׁכֶם אַחַד עַל אַחֶיךָ״ (**וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד**):


**that I would allot a portion** I shall divide the land of my enemies to Israel, like (Gen. 48: 22): “one portion (שכם) more than your brethren.”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 108:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:10:1)


**מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי.** כְּלוֹמַר: עַבְדִּי וְשַׁמָּשִׁי, כִּכְלִי תַשְׁמִישׁ שֶׁמִּשְׁתַּמְּשִׁין בּוֹ:


**Moab is my washbasin** i.e., my slaves and my servants, like a utensil that people use.


###### Rashi on Psalms 108:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:10:2)


**עַל אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ.** עֲבוֹדָתִי, שֶׁיִּהְיוּ מַלְכֵיהֶם נוֹטְלִין מִנְעָלַי בְּרַגְלִי:


**on Edom I shall cast** my servitude, that their kings should put my shoes on my feet.


###### Rashi on Psalms 108:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:10:3)


**אֶתְרוֹעָע.** אָרִיעַ לָהֶם קוֹל לְיָרְאָם מִפָּנַי:


**I shall shout** I shall raise my voice to them to frighten them.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 108:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/108:11:1)


**מִי יֹבִילֵנִי.** לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ לִפְשׁוֹט יָד בְּעֵשָׂו בְּעָרֵי מִבְצָרִים, **מִי שֶׁנָּחַנִי** כְּבָר עַל **אֱדוֹם** שֶׁהִכִּיתִי בָהֶם ״בְּגֵיא מֶלַח שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף״ (שמואל ב ח:יג):


**Who will bring me** in the time of the Messiah, to stretch forth my hand upon Esau in his fortified cities? **He Who** Who led us already upon Edom, that I smote them in the Valley of Salt, eighteen thousand.



## Chapter 109


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:1:1)


**אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי אַל תֶּחֱרַשׁ.** עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶאֱמַר:


**O God of my praise, be not silent** This was said regarding all Israel.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:2:1)


**כִּי פִי רָשָׁע.** עֵשָׂו:


**For the mouth of a wicked man** Ishmael.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:4:1)


**תַּחַת אַהֲבָתִי** אוֹתְךָ **יִשְׂטְנוּנִי**:


**Instead of my love** for You, they hinder me.


###### Rashi on Psalms 109:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:4:2)


**וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּה.** וַאֲנִי מִתְפַּלֵּל אֵלֶיךָ תָּמִיד (מצאתי):


**but I am at prayer** But I pray to You constantly. I found:



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:5:1)


**רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה.** שִׁבְעִים פָּרִים אֲנִי מַקְרִיב בְּכָל שָׁנָה בִּשְׁבִיל שִׁבְעִים אֻמּוֹת, וּמְבַקֵּשׁ לִגְשָׁמִים, וְהֵם מְרֵיעִים לִי:


**evil instead of good** I sacrifice seventy bulls every year for the seventy nations, and we request rain, yet they harm us. Shocher Tov (109:4).



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:7:1)


**בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ.** לְפָנֶיךָ **יֵצֵא** מִדִּינְךָ מְחֻיָּב וְ**רָשָׁע**:


**When he is judged** before You, may he emerge from Your judgment guilty and wicked.



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:8:1)


**פְּקֻדָּתוֹ.** גְּדֻלָּתוֹ, פְּרוֹבוֹשְׁטִיאָ״ה בְּלַעַ״ז, כְּמוֹ ״וְיַפְקֵד הַמֶּלֶךְ פְּקִידִים״ (אסתר ב:ג):


**his office of dignity** Heb. פקדתו, his greatness, provostie or pruvote in Old French, like (Esther 2: 3): “And let the king appoint officers (פקידים).”



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:10:1)


**וְשָׁאֲלוּ וְדָרְשׁוּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶם.** הַכֹּל יִשְׁאֲלוּ עֲלֵיהֶם: מַה נִּהְיְתָה בִּפְלוֹנִי וּפְלוֹנִי? מִתּוֹךְ קוֹל חוּרְבָּה שֶׁיָּצָא עֲלֵיהֶם:


**and [people] should ask and search from their ruins** Everyone will ask about them, what happened to So-and-so and So-and-so, because of the rumor of ruin that emerged about them.


###### Rashi on Psalms 109:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:10:2)


**וְדָרְשׁוּ.** מַשְׁמָע: מֵאֵת אֲחֵרִים, שֶׁהֲרֵי נָקוּד חֲטַף קָמַץ, וְכֵן **וְשִׁאֵלוּ.** מִפִּי אֲחֵרִים הוּא מַשְׁמָע, שֶׁיִּשְׁאֲלוּ אֲחֵרִים עֲלֵיהֶם. וְיֵשׁ לִפְתּוֹר **וְשִׁאֵלוּ**, מִמִּשְׁקַל חָזָק: יִהְיוּ מְשַׁאֲלִים עַל הַפְּתָחִים:


And “search” (וְדָרְשוּ) means from others, because it is vowelized with a short “kamatz,” and וְשִׁאֵלוּ also means from others, that others should ask about them. This can also be interpreted as וְשִׁאֵלוּ, of the intensive conjugation, meaning that they will go around by the doors [to beg for alms].



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:11:1)


**יְנַקֵּשׁ נוֹשֶׁה לְכָל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ.** אָדָם הַטּוֹרֵחַ מְחַזֵּר וְלָהוּט לַעֲשׂוֹת דָּבָר, נוֹפֵל בּוֹ לָשׁוֹן מִתְנַקֵּשׁ, כְּלוֹמַר: מֻטְרָף וּמִתְלַבֵּט, כְּמוֹ ״וְאַרְכֻּבָּתֵהּ דָּא לְדָא נָקְשָׁן״ (דניאל ה:ו), וְכֵן ״פֶּן תִּנָּקֵשׁ אַחֲרֵיהֶם״ (דברים יב:ל). אַף כָּאן יִהְיֶה הַנּוֹשֶׁה בְּעֵשָׂו אֶת עֲבוֹדָתוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְרַב יַעֲבֹד צָעִיר״ (בראשית כה:כג). לָשׁוֹן אַחֵר: יִהְיֶה הַנּוֹשֶׁה נוֹגֵעַ וְנִקְרָב **לְכָל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ**, יְנַקֵּשׁ שייטאצופי״ץ בְּלַעַ״ז. יְהִי מִשְׁפַּט הַנּוֹשֶׁה נוֹקֵשׁ וְנִשְׁעָן עַל כָּל מָמוֹנוֹ, וְזֶהוּ יַעֲקֹב הַנּוֹשֶׁה בְּעֵשָׂו אֶת עֲבוֹדָתוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״וְרַב יַעֲבֹד צָעִיר״ (בראשית כה:כג) מָצָאתִי:


**May a creditor search out all he has** Heb. ינקש. A person who toils and searches, and longs passionately to do something is described by the expression מִתְנַקֵשׁ, i.e., shaken and going from place to place, like (Dan. 5:6): “and his knees knocked (נקשן) against each other.”



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:13:1)


**בְּדוֹר אַחֵר.** שֶׁיָּבֹא אַחַר כּוֹרְתוֹ, יִמַּח שְׁמוֹ וְטִבְעוֹ, שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ זִכָּרוֹן לֹא יִפֹּל עָלָיו בְּפִי הַדּוֹר הַנּוֹלָד בָּעוֹלָם לְאַחַר שֶׁנִּשְׁחַת שְׁמוֹ. שארטרמיר״א בְּלַעַ״ז:


**in another generation** that will come after his being cut off, his name and his fame will be blotted out so that not even a remembrance will remain of him in the mouth of the generation that is born in the world after his name will be destroyed, sa retremure in Old French, its extirpation.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:14:1)


**עֲוֹן אֲבוֹתָיו.** עָוֹן שֶׁהֶעֱוָה עַל אֲבוֹתָיו, לְאַבְרָהָם שֶׁגָּרַע חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים מֵחַיָּיו (בראשית רבה סג,יב), וּלְאָבִיו גָּרַם כִּהְיוֹן עֵינַיִם (בראשית רבה סה,ד-ה):


**the iniquity against his forefathers** The iniquity that he sinned against his forebears, to Abraham, whose life he shortened by five years, and to his father he caused blindness.


###### Rashi on Psalms 109:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/109:14:2)


**וְחַטַּאת אִמּוֹ.** שֶׁהִשְׁחִית רַחְמָהּ וְשֶׁגָּרַם לְהַעֲלִים יוֹם קְבוּרָתָהּ מִן הַבְּרִיּוֹת, שֶׁלֹּא יְקַלְלוּהָ שֶׁיָּצָא מִכְּרֵסָהּ עֵשָׂו, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (בראשית לה:ח) ״וַתָּמָת דְּבוֹרָה מֵינֶקֶת רִבְקָה וְגוֹמֵר אַלּוֹן בָּכוּת״, בִּלְשׁוֹן יְוָנִי קוֹרִין לְאַחֵר אַלּוֹן, שֶׁאֵבֶל אַחֵר הָיָה לְיַעֲקֹב עִם שֶׁל דְּבוֹרָה, שֶׁמֵּתָה אִמּוֹ וְהֶעֱלִימוּ מִיתָתָהּ:


**and the sin against his mother** that he destroyed her womb, and that he caused the day of her burial to be concealed from the people, lest they curse her for Esau emerged from her womb, as it is said (Gen. 35:8): “Deborah, Rebecca’s nurse, died...the Plain of Weeping.” In Greek, another is called “allon,” for Jacob had another mourning along with that of Deborah, for his mother died and they concealed her death.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 109:15:1

## Chapter 110


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 110:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:1:1)


**נְאֻם ה׳ לַאדֹנִי.** רַבּוֹתֵינוּ דְּרָשׁוּהוּ בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ, וַאֲנִי אֲפָרְשֶׁנּוּ כְּדִבְרֵיהֶם: נְאֻם ה׳ לְאַבְרָהָם, שֶׁקְּרָאוּהוּ הָעוֹלָם אֲדֹנִי ״שְׁמָעֵנִי אֲדֹנִי״ (בראשית כג:יא):


**The word of the Lord to my master** Our Rabbis interpreted it as referring to Abraham our father, and I shall explain it according to their words (Mid. Ps. 110:1): The word of the Lord to Abraham, whom the world called “my master,” as it is written (Gen. 23:6): “Hearken to us, my master.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:1:2)


**שֵׁב לִימִינִי.** הִתְעַכֵּב לִתְשׁוּעָתִי וְהִתְחוֹלֵל לַה׳, אֵין יְשִׁיבָה אֶלָּא עַכָּבָה, וְכֵן הוּא אוֹמֵר: ״וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בְקָדֵשׁ״ (דברים א:מו):


**“Wait for My right hand”** Wait for My salvation and hope for the Lord. [The root] ישיבה means only waiting, as Scripture states (Deut. 1:46): “And you stayed (ותשבו) in Kadesh for many days.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:1:3)


**לִימִינִי.** לִתְשׁוּעַת יְמִינִי:


**for My right hand** For the salvation of My right hand.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:1:4)


**עַד אָשִׁית אוֹיְבֶיךָ.** אַמְרָפֶל וַחֲבֵרָיו (בראשית יד:א):


**until I make your enemies** Amraphel and his allies.



### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 110:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:2:1)


**מַטֵּה.** לְשׁוֹן מִשְׁעָן, כְּמוֹ ״כָּל מַטֵּה לֶחֶם״ (תהלים קה:טז):


**The staff of** [This is] an expression of support, as (above 105:16): “every staff of bread.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:2:2)


**מַטֵּה עֻזְּךָ יִשְׁלַח ה׳ מִצִּיּוֹן.** כְּשֶׁתָּשׁוּב מִן הַמִּלְחָמָה וַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ עֲיֵפִים וְרוֹדְפִים, יִשְׁלַח לְךָ ה׳ אֶת מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ שָׁלֵם לְהוֹצִיא לֶחֶם וָיַיִן (בראשית יד:יז-יח):


**The staff of your might the Lord will send from Zion** When you return from the war and your men are weary and in pursuit, the Lord will send you Malchizedek, king of Salem, to bring out bread and wine (Gen. 14:14).


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:2:3)


**רְדֵה.** בַּמִּלְחָמָה:


**rule** in the war.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:2:4)


**בְּקֶרֶב אוֹיְבֶיךָ.** לָבֶטַח:


**in the midst of your enemies** safely.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 110:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:3:1)


**עַמְּךָ נְדָבוֹת בְּיוֹם חֵילֶךָ.** כְּשֶׁתֶּאֱסֹף חַיִל לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם, יִתְנַדְּבוּ עַמְּךָ וְאוֹהֲבֶיךָ לָצֵאת עִמְּךָ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ (בראשית יד:יד) ״וַיָּרֶק אֶת חֲנִיכָיו יְלִידֵי בֵיתוֹ״ וְלֹא יוֹתֵר, וְעָנֵר וְאֶשְׁכֹּל וּמַמְרֵא הִתְנַדְּבוּ מֵאֲלֵיהֶם לָצֵאת לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרָיו בְּעֶזְרָתוֹ:


**Your people will volunteer on the day of your host** When you gather an army to pursue them, your people and your friends will volunteer to go out with you, as we find (Gen. 14:14): “and he armed his trained men, those born in his house,” and no more; and Aner, Eshkol, and Mamre volunteered by themselves to go out to his aid.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:3:2)


**בְּהַדְרֵי קֹדֶשׁ מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר.** זֹאת תִּהְיֶה לְךָ בִּזְכוּת הַדְרַת קְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהָיָה בְּךָ מִבֶּטֶן אִמֶּךָ, שֶׁהִכִּיר בּוֹרְאוֹ בֶּן שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים (נדרים לב.):


**because of the beauty of holiness when you fell from the womb** And this will be to you in the merit of the beauty of holiness that was in you from your mother’s womb, for he recognized his Creator at the age of three.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:3:3)


**מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר.** מִשֶּׁנָּפַלְתָּ מִן הָרֶחֶם, כְּמוֹ מְשִׁילִין פֵּרוֹת דֶּרֶךְ אֲרֻבָּה בְּיוֹם טוֹב (ביצה לה:), וְאִיכָּא דְּתָנֵי מַשְׁחִירִין:


**when you fell from the womb** Heb. משחר, when you fell from the womb, like (Beizah 35b): “We may let fruit down (משילין) through a skylight on a festival,” and some learn משחירין.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:3:4)


**לְךָ טַל יַלְדוּתֶיךָ.** לְךָ יֵחָשֵׁב יַלְדוּתֶיךָ. דַּרְכֵי יֹשֶׁר שֶׁהִנְהַגְתָּ בָּהֶם בְּיַלְדוּתֶיךָ יִהְיֶה לְךָ לְנֹעַם, כַּטַּל זֶה שֶׁהוּא נָעִים וְנוֹחַ:


**for you, your youth is like dew** For you will be considered your youth, the ways of uprightness with which you conducted yourself in your youth will be for you as pleasantness, like this dew, which is pleasant and comforting.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 110:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:4:1)


**נִשְׁבַּע ה׳ וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם.** לְפִי שֶׁהָיָה מִתְיָרֵא שֶׁלֹּא יֵעָנֵשׁ עַל הָאוּכְלוֹסִין שֶׁהָרַג, נֶאֱמַר לוֹ (בראשית טו:א) ״אַל תִּירָא אַבְרָם וְגוֹ׳״. **לֹא יִנָּחֵם** עַל הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר עָלֶיךָ:


**The Lord swore and will not repent** Since Abraham was afraid lest he be punished for the troops that he had killed, it was said to him (Gen. 15:1): “Fear not, Abraham, etc.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:4:2)


**אַתָּה כֹהֵן לְעוֹלָם עַל דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק.** מִמְּךָ תֵּצֵא הַכְּהֻנָּה וּמַלְכוּת, לִהְיוֹת בָּנֶיךָ יוֹרְשִׁין אֶת שֵׁם אֲבִי אָבִיךָ הַכְּהֻנָּה וְהַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁנִּתְּנוּ לוֹ:


**and will not repent** over the good that He spoke about you.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:4:3)


**דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק.** יוֹ״ד יְתֵרָה, כְּמוֹ ״רַבָּתִי עָם״ (איכה א:א). עַל דִּבְרַת מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק – עַל פְּקֻדַּת מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק. **אַתָּה כֹהֵן.** יֵשׁ בְּמַשְׁמָע כֹּהֵן – כְּהֻנָּה וּשְׂרָרָה, כְּמוֹ ״וּבְנֵי דָוִד כֹּהֲנִים הָיוּ״ (שמואל ב ח:יח):


**you are a priest forever because of the speech of Malchizedek** From you will emerge the priesthood and the kingship that your children will inherit from Shem your progenitor, the priesthood and the kingship, which were given to him. דִבְרָתִי מלכי-צדק. The “yud” is superfluous, like (Lam. 1:1): “the city that was once so populous (רבתי).” Because of the speech of Malchizedek, because of the command of Malchizedek. You are a priest, Heb. כהן. The word כהן bears the connotation of priesthood and rulership, as (II Sam. 8:18): “and David’s sons were chief officers.”



### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 110:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:5:1)


**אֲדֹנָי.** אֲשֶׁר הָיָה **עַל יְמִינְךָ** בַּמִּלְחָמָה:


**The Lord** Who was on your right hand in battle.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:5:2)


**מָחַץ בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ מְלָכִים.** אֶת אַרְבָּעָה מְלָכִים הוּא **יָדִין בַּגּוֹיִם מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת**, זוֹ הִיא בְּשׂוֹרַת בְּרִית בֵּין הַבְּתָרִים שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר לוֹ עַל מִצְרַיִם: ״וְגַם אֶת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹדוּ דָּן אָנֹכִי״ (בראשית טו:יד):


**has crushed kings on the day of His wrath** The four kings. He... **will execute justice upon the nations [into] a heap of corpses** This is the tidings of the ‘covenant between the segments,’ [in] which was stated to him concerning Egypt (Gen. 15:14): “But also that nation whom they will serve do I judge.”



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 110:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:6:1)


**מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת.** אֲסִיפַת פְּגָרִים, מָלֵא לְשׁוֹן אֲסִיפָה כְּמוֹ ״קָרְאוּ אַחֲרֶיךָ מָלֵא״ (ירמיהו יב:ו), ״אֲשֶׁר יִקָּרֵא עָלָיו מְלֹא רֹעִים״ (ישעיהו לא:ד). וְהֵיכָן דָּן מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת? ״אֶת מִצְרַיִם מֵת עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם״ (שמות יד:ל):


**a heap of corpses** Heb. מלא, a heap of corpses. מלא is an expression of gathering, as (Jer. 12:6): “have called a gang (מלא) after you”; (Isa. 31:4), “although a band (מלא) of shepherds gather against him.” Now where did He execute justice, making them a heap of corpses? (Exod. 14:30), “the Egyptians dead on the seashore.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:6:2)


**מָחַץ רֹאשׁ עַל אֶרֶץ רַבָּה.** זוֹ הִיא דֻּגְמַת נְבוּאַת ״מָחַצְתָּ רֹּאשׁ מִבֵּית רָשָׁע״ (חבקוק ג:יג) – רֹאשׁ פַּרְעֹה, שֶׁהָיָה רֹאשׁ וְשַׂר עַל אֶרֶץ גְּדוֹלָה וַחֲשׁוּבָה עַל כָּל הָאֲרָצוֹת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״מוֹשֵׁל עַמִּים וַיְפַתְּחֵהוּ״ (תהלים קה:כ) – שֶׁהָיוּ כָּל הָאֻמּוֹת תַּחַת מֶמְשֶׁלֶת מִצְרָיִם:


**He crushed the head on a great land** This resembles the prophecy of Habakkuk (3:12): “You have crushed the head of the house of the wicked.” [This refers to] the head of Pharaoh, who was the head and the prince of a land greater and more esteemed than all the lands, as is said (above 102:20): “a ruler of peoples [sent] and loosed his bonds,” for all the nations were under the rule of Egypt.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:1)


**מִנַּחַל בַּדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּה וְגוֹ׳.** מִנִּילוּס הַנָּהָר בְּדֶרֶךְ הֲלִיכָתוֹ הָיְתָה אַרְצוֹ שׁוֹתָה וְלֹא הָיְתָה צְרִיכָה לְמֵי גְשָׁמִים, עַל כֵּן הָיָה מֵרִים רֹאשׁ וּמִתְפָּאֵר ״לִי יְאוֹרִי וַאֲנִי עֲשִׂיתִנִי״ (יחזקאל כט:ג). עִנְיָן אַחֵר יֵשׁ לְפָרֵשׁ הַמִּזְמוֹר הַזֶּה בְּדָוִד:


**From the stream on the way he would drink, etc.** From the Nile River, on the way of its course, his land would drink, and it was not in need of rain water. Therefore, he would raise his head and boast (Ezek. 29:3): “My river is my own, and I made myself.” In another manner, this psalm can be explained regarding David:


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:2)


(א) **נְאֻם ה׳ לַאדֹנִי.** עַל עִסְקֵי אֲדוֹנִי שָׁאוּל, כְּשֶׁהָיִיתִי נִרְדָּף מִפָּנָיו:


[1] **The word of the Lord about my master** Concerning my master, Saul, when I was pursued by him.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:3)


**לַאדֹנִי.** עַל אֲדוֹנִי, כְּמוֹ ״וְאָמַר פַּרְעֹה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (שמות יד:ג), ״וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם לְאִשְׁתּוֹ״ (בראשית כו:ז):


**about my master** Heb. לאדני, about my master, as (Exod. 14:3): “Then Pharaoh will say concerning the children of (לבני) Israel”; (Gen. 26:7), “The people of the place asked him about his wife (לאשתו).”


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:4)


**שֵׁב לִימִינִי.** הִתְעַכֵּב וְהַמְתֵּן לִישׁוּעָתִי:


**“Wait for My right hand”** Stay and wait for My salvation.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:5)


(ב) **מַטֵּה עֻזְּךָ יִשְׁלַח ה׳ מִצִּיּוֹן.** מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים הַמְצֻיָּנִין בְּיָדְךָ. דָּבָר אַחֵר: עוֹד תִּמְלֹךְ בְּצִיּוֹן, וְשָׁם יְשֻׁלַּח לְךָ מַטֵּה עֹז, וְאָז תִּרְדֶּה **בְּקֶרֶב אוֹיְבֶיךָ**:


[2] **The staff of your might the Lord will send from Zion** The exceptional good deeds in your hand. Another explanation: You will yet reign in Zion, and there a staff of might will be sent to you, and then you will rule in the midst of your enemies.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:6)


(ג) **עַמְּךָ נְדָבוֹת בְּיוֹם חֵילֶךָ.** עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתְנַדְּבוּ לְעֶזְרָתְךָ בְּיוֹם שֶׁתַּעֲשֶׂה חַיִל, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּפֹרָשׁ (דברי הימים א יב:כא) שֶׁהָיוּ נִקְבָּצִים עָלָיו מִכָּל שֵׁבֶט וָשֵׁבֶט ״בְּלֶכְתּוֹ אֶל צִקְלַג נָפְלוּ עָלָיו מִמְּנַשֶּׁה וְגוֹמֵר״ ״וּמִן הַגָּדִי נִבְדְּלוּ אֶל דָּוִד וְגוֹמֵר״ (שם;ט):


[3] **Your people will volunteer on the day of your host** The people of Israel will volunteer to your aid on the day that you form an army, as it is delineated in (I) Chronicles (12:21); that they were joining him from every tribe: “When he went to Ziklag, there deserted to him of Manasseh, etc.”; (ibid. verse 8): “And from the Gadites there separated themselves to David, etc.”


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/110:7:7)


**בְּהַדְרֵי קֹדֶשׁ מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר.** בִּשְׁבִיל הַדְרַת קְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהָיֳה בְךָ מִנְּעוּרֶיךָ:


**because of the beauty of holiness when you fell from the womb** Because of the beauty of holiness that was in you from your youth.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:8

**לְךָ טַל יַלְדוּתֶךָ.** יַלְדוּת טוֹבָה וּפֶרֶק נָאֶה שֶׁהָיָה בְּךָ, תִּהְיֶה לְךָ כַּטַּל שֶׁהוּא נָעִים וְעָרֵב, וְתַעֲשֶׂה לְךָ פֵּרוֹת לְהַצְלִיחֲךָ:


**your youth is like dew** A good youth and a good period of maturity that you had will be to you like dew, which is pleasant and sweet, and will produce fruit for you to make you prosper.

(ד) **נִשְׁבַּע ה׳ וְגוֹ׳.** שֶׁהַמַּלְכוּת תְּהֵא שֶׁלְּךָ עוֹלָמִית:


[4] **The Lord has sworn, etc.** that the kingdom will be yours forever.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:10

**אַתָּה כֹהֵן לְעוֹלָם.** וְאֵיזוֹ מִן הַכְּהֻנּוֹת? כְּהֻנָּה שֶׁהִיא לְמַעְלָה מִכְּהֻנַּת מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק, וְזֶהוּ הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁהִיא לְמַעְלָה מִכְּהֻנָּה גְּדוֹלָה בִּשְׁלֹשִׁים מַעֲלוֹת (אבות ו:ה):


**You are a priest forever** And which of the priesthoods? A priesthood that is above the priesthood of Malchizedek, and that is the kingdom, which is above the high priesthood in thirty steps.


###### Rashi on Psalms 110:7:11

**עַל דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק.** לְמַעְלָה מִכְּהֻנַּת מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק שֶׁהָיָה ״כֹּהֵן לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן״ (בראשית יד:יח), וְאִם תֹּאמַר: אַף הוּא מֶלֶךְ הָיָה, מְלוּכַת מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק אֵינָהּ מְלוּכָה חֲשׁוּבָה כְּנֶגֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל:


**above the charge of Malchizedek** above the priesthood (Some mss. read: above the charge) of Malchizedek, who was a priest to the Most High God. Now if you challenge that he too was a king, [we answer that] the kingdom over the nations was not an esteemed kingdom when compared to Israel.

**אֲשֶׁר מָחַץ בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ מְלָכִים.** שֶׁנִּלְחֲמוּ עִם אַבְרָהָם (בראשית יד:טו) וְעִם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ (יהושע י-יב) וְעִם בָּרָק (שופטים ד-ה):


**crushed kings on the day of His wrath** Those who fought with Abraham and with Joshua and with Barak.

(ו) **יָדִין בַּגּוֹיִם מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת.** וְעוֹד בִּימֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ בִּנְךָ יָדִין בְּאוּכְלוּסֵי סַנְחֵרִיב קִבּוּץ פְּגָרִים מֵתִים, וְיִמְחַץ בְּסַנְחֵרִיב שֶׁהוּא רֹאשָׁהּ שֶׁל נִינְוֵה וְאַשּׁוּר שֶׁהִיא אֶרֶץ רַבָּה, אֲשֶׁר **מִנַּחַל בַּדֶּרֶךְ** הָיָה שׁוֹתֶה, שֶׁנִּתְפָּאֵר שֶׁשָּׁתוּ אוּכְלוּסָיו מִימֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (ישעיהו לז:כה) ״אֲנִי קַרְתִּי וְשָׁתִיתִי מַיִם וְאַחֲרִיב וְגוֹ׳״:


[6] **He will execute justice upon the nations [into] a heap of corpses** And further, in the days of Hezekiah your son, He will execute justice upon the armies of Sennacherib [making them] a heap of dead corpses, and He will crush Sennacherib, who is the head of Nineveh and Assyria, which is a great land, who... [7] **From the stream on the way** he was drinking, for he boasted that his armies drank from the waters of the Jordan, as it is said (Isa. 37:25): “I dug and drank water, and I dry up, etc.”

**therefore, he raised his head** He praised himself and boasted of his greatness.



## Chapter 111


### Verse 1

###### Rashi on Psalms 111:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/111:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/111:1:1)


**הַלְלוּיָהּ וְגוֹ׳.** מִזְמוֹר זֶה הוּסַד בְּאָלֶף בֵּית, אוֹת אֶחָד בְּרֹאשׁ הַפָּסוּק וְאֶחָד בְּאֶמְצָעוּתָיו, וְכֵן כֻּלָּם מֵאָלֶ״ף וְעַד תָּי״ו, וּכְמוֹ כֵן מִזְמוֹר הַשֵּׁנִי. הָרִאשׁוֹן מְדַבֵּר בְּשִׁבְחוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וְהַשֵּׁנִי מְסַפֵּר בְּשִׁבְחוֹ שֶׁל צַדִּיק:


**Hallelujah, I shall thank, etc.** This psalm was based on the alphabet, one letter at the beginning of the verse and one in the middle of it, and so all of them [this psalm’s verses are] from “aleph” to “tav,” and so too is the second psalm. The first one speaks in praises of the Holy One, blessed be He, and the second one speaks in praise of a righteous, God-fearing person.



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 111:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/111:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/111:4:1)


**זֵכֶר עָשָׂה.** קָבַע לְיִשְׂרָאֵל שַׁבָּתוֹת וּמוֹעֲדִים וּמִצְווֹת שֶׁנֶּאֶמְרוּ בָּהֶם ״וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי הָיִיתָ בְּמִצְרָיִם״ (דברים טו:טו), לְפִי שֶׁהוּא **חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם** עַל בָּנָיו וְחָפֵץ לְהַצְדִּיקָם:


**He made a memorial** He set down for Israel Sabbaths and festivals and commandments, of which was stated (Deut. 5:15): “And remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt,” because He is gracious and merciful to His children, and He wishes to make them righteous.
