###### Rashi on Psalms 143:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/143:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/143:8:2)


**הוֹדִיעֵנִי דֶרֶךְ זוּ.** נָשָׂאתִי נַפְשִׁי אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁתְּקַבֵּל שְׁאֵלָתִי (ס״א אינו):


**let me know the way in which I am to go; I lift up my soul** that You accept my request.



### Verse 9

###### Rashi on Psalms 143:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/143:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/143:9:1)


**אֵלֶיךָ כִסִּיתִי.** תְּלָאוֹתַי, אֲנִי מְכַסֶּה מִכָּל אָדָם לְהַגִּידָם אֵלֶיךָ:


**to You I have hidden** My tribulations I conceal from all men to tell them to You.



## Chapter 144


### Verse 2

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:2:1)


**הָרוֹדֵד עַמִּי תַחְתָּי.** הָרוֹקֵעַ וְשׁוֹטֵחַ אֶת עַמִּי לִרְבֹּץ בִּמְקוֹמוֹ, כְּמוֹ ״שׁוֹטֵחַ לַגּוֹיִם״ (איוב יב:כג) מַגְדִּיל אוֹתָם. רוֹדֵד תַּרְגּוּם שֶׁל רוֹקֵעַ, כְּדִמְתַרְגֵּם ״וַיְרַקְּעוּ״ (שמות לט:ג): ״וְרַדִּידוּ״. וְיֵשׁ פּוֹתְרִים: **הָרוֹדֵד עַמִּים תַּחְתִּי**, הַמַּחֲלִישׁ עַמִּים תַּחְתִּי. אַךְ בְּסֵפֶר מְדֻיָּק מֻגֶּה עַמִּי, וּמְסוֹרָה עָלָיו: שְׁלֹשָׁה סְבִירִין עַמִּים וְקוֹרִין עַמִּי. וְעַל תַּחְתִּי יֵשׁ מְסוֹרָה עָלָיו: תַּחְתָּיו קְרִי:


**Who flattens peoples beneath me** Who flattens and spreads out my people to rest in its place, as (Job 12:23): He spreads out (שוטח) the nations.” He makes them great. רוֹדֵד is the Aramaic translation of רוֹקַע, as the Targum renders (Exod. 39:3): וַיְרַקְעוּ, and they spread out; וְרַדִּידוּ. Others interpret הרודד, Who weakens peoples under me. But in an accurate revised version, [the reading is]: עמי, upon which the Masorah states: In three cases, the meaning is עמים, peoples, but the reading is עמי, and on תחתי, it says: the reading is תחתיו, under Him.



### Verse 3

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:3:1)


**מָה אָדָם.** מַה פָּרַס וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל לְפָנֶיךָ, כִּי יְדַעְתָּם לְהַרְבּוֹת לָהֶם גְּדֻלָּה?


**what is man** What are Persia [Esau, acc. to mss.] and Ishmael before You that You know them to lavish greatness upon them?



### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:4:1)


**יָמָיו כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר.** שְׁלֹמֹה אָמַר ״וַיַּעֲשֵׂם כַּצֵּל״ (קהלת ו:יב), וְלֹא פֵּרַשׁ אִם צֵל דֶּקֶל אוֹ צֵל כּוֹתֶל שֶׁהֵם קְבוּעִים. כְּבָר פֵּרַשׁ אָבִיו: **כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר.** צִלּוֹ שֶׁל עוֹף הַפּוֹרֵחַ (קהלת רבה א:ב):


**his days are as a fleeting shadow** Solomon said (Ecc. 6:12): “that he do them like a shadow,” but he did not explain whether [this refers to] the shadow of a palm or the shadow of a wall, which are permanent. His father already explained, “as a fleeting shadow,” the shadow of a flying bird.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:7:1)


**פְּצֵנִי.** הוֹצִיאֵנִי, וּלְשׁוֹן הַצָּלָה הוּא, וְכֵן ״הַפּוֹצֶה אֶת דָּוִד עַבְדּוֹ״ (תהלים קמד:י) (מצאתי):


**deliver me** פצני, take me out. That is an expression of saving, and so is (verse 10): “Who delivers (הפוצה) David His servant.” (I found.)



### Verse 8

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:8:1)


**פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר שָׁוְא וְגוֹ׳.** תָּלָה הַכָּתוּב שָׁוְא בַּפֶּה וְשֶׁקֶר בַּיָּמִין, בָּאוּ לְסַפֵּר בַּפֶּה בּוֹדִים גּוּזְמָא עַל שָׁוְא אַף לְשַׁנּוֹת אֶת הַיָּדוּעַ, בָּאוּ לִפְשֹׁט יְמִינָם לִשְׁבוּעָה חָדְלוּ מִשָּׁוְא שֶׁנִּתְפַּס עָלָיו כְּגַנָּב אֲבָל בְּשֶׁקֶר נִשְׁבָּעִין שֶׁכָּךְ גּוֹרָלָם:


**Whose mouth speaks vanity, etc.** Scripture connects vanity with the mouth and falsehood with the right hand. When they come to tell with their mouth, they invent exaggerations of vanity, even to misrepresent what is known. If they come to stretch forth their right hand to swear, they refrain from vanity, lest they be caught as thieves, but they do swear falsely, for so is their lot.



### Verse 10

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:10:1)


**הַנּוֹתֵן תְּשׁוּעָה לַמְּלָכִים.** מְדַבֵּר עַל ״סֶלַע הַמַּחְלְקוֹת״ (שמואל א כג:כח) שֶׁהָיָה דָּוִד קָרוֹב לִיתָּפֵשׂ בְּיַד שָׁאוּל, וּבָא מַלְאָךְ אֶל שָׁאוּל: ״מַהֲרָה וְלֵכָה וְגוֹ׳״ (שמואל א כג:כז). הִצִּיל אֶת שָׁאוּל מִהְיוֹת שׁוֹפֵךְ דָּם נָקִי, וְאֶת דָּוִד מִהְיוֹת נֶהֱרָג:


**Who gives salvation to kings** This speaks about the Rock of the Divisions, when David was close to being seized by Saul (I Sam. 23:27): “A messenger came to Saul, saying, ‘Make haste and go, etc.’” He saved Saul from shedding innocent blood, and David from being killed.



### Verse 11

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:11:1)


**פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי.** כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּצִיתָ אָז, כֵּן פְּצֵנִי עַתָּה:


**Deliver me and rescue me** As You delivered me then, so shall You deliver me now.



### Verse 12

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:1)


**אֲשֶׁר בָּנֵינוּ וְגוֹ׳.** כְּלוֹמַר: גַּם עַתָּה דּוֹר זֶה כָּשֵׁר הוּא:


**For our sons are, etc.** That is to say that now too this generation is righteous.


###### Rashi on Psalms 144:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:2)


**בָּנֵינוּ כִּנְטִעִים.** שֶׁאֵין בָּהֶם מוּם, כָּל כָּךְ הֵם מְנֻקִּים מֵעֲבֵירָה (מצאתי):


**our sons are like saplings** which have no blemish, so pure are they from sin. (I found.)


###### Rashi on Psalms 144:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:3)


**מְגֻדָּלִים בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶם.** בְּשֵׁם טוֹב זֶה, שֶׁהֵם כִּנְטִיעִים בְּנַעֲרוּתָם, גְּדֵלִים כָּל יְמֵיהֶם. וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְקַיֵּם כָּל שֶׁבַח זֶה אֶלָּא בְּדוֹרוֹ שֶׁל חִזְקִיָּהוּ:


**grown up in their youth** with this good name, that they are like saplings in their youth, growing all their lives; and this praise cannot be substantiated except in the generation of Hezekiah.


###### Rashi on Psalms 144:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:4)


**בְּנוֹתֵינוּ.** גְּבוֹהוֹת קוֹמָה נָאָה **כְזָוִיֹּת** שֶׁל בַּיִת אֲבָנִים, שֶׁזָּוִיּוֹת אֶבֶן מְכֻוָּנוֹת כְּנֶגֶד חֲבֶרְתָּהּ וְעוֹלָה לְמַעְלָה עַד שֶׁהַזָּוִיּוֹת מְיֻשָּׁרוֹת:


**our daughters** are of tall, beautiful stature like the cornerstones of a stone house, in which the cornerstones are placed exactly one opposite the other, and it ascends upward until the corners are even.


###### Rashi on Psalms 144:12:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:12:5)


**מְחֻטָּבוֹת תַּבְנִית הֵיכָל.** מְהֻלָּלוֹת בְּפִי רוֹאֵיהֶן, וּמְדַמִּין אוֹתָם לְתַבְנִית קוֹמַת הַהֵיכָל. וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּ (פסחים פז.) **בְּנוֹתֵינוּ כְזָוִיֹּת.** מִתְמַלְּאוֹת תַּאֲוָה כְּזָוִיּוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ הַמְּלֵאוֹת דָּם, וְאֵינָן נִבְעָלוֹת אֶלָּא לְבַעֲלֵיהֶן:


**praised as the form of the Temple** Praised by those who see them and compare them to the form of the height of the Temple. Our Rabbis, however, explained: **Our daughters are like corners** Full of desire as the corners of the altar are full of blood, but they are intimate only with their husbands.



### Verse 13

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:13:1)


**מְזָוֵינוּ מְלֵאִים.** זָוִיּוֹת אוֹצְרוֹתֵינוּ מְלֵאִים טוֹב:


**Our corners are full** The corners of our storehouses are full of goodness.


###### Rashi on Psalms 144:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:13:2)


**מְפִיקִים מִזַּן אֶל זָן.** מַסְפִּיקִים מָזוֹן מִשָּׁנָה לְשָׁנָה, **מִזַּן אֶל זָן** מִשְּׁעַת אָסִיף מָזוֹן לְשָׁנָה זוֹ עַד זְמַן אָסִיף לְשָׁנָה אַחֶרֶת, **זָן** גוֹבִירְנִיי״ל בְּלַעַ״ז:


**supplying from harvest to harvest** Supplying food from year to year. **from harvest to harvest** Heb. מזן אל זן, from the time of the ingathering of this year’s food until the time of the ingathering of next year’s food. זַן is gouvernayl in Old French, food, provisions.


###### Rashi on Psalms 144:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:13:3)


**מַאֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּבוֹת.** לַאֲלָפִים וְלִרְבָבוֹת עוֹשׂוֹת פְּרִי:


**produce thousands, yea, ten thousands** They produce offspring of thousands and ten thousands.



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:14:1)


**אַלּוּפֵינוּ מְסֻבָּלִים.** אַלּוּפִים גְּדוֹלִים שֶׁבָּנוּ נִסְבָּלִים עַל קְטַנֵּיהֶם, שֶׁהַקְּטַנִּים נִשְׁמָעִים לַגְּדוֹלִים, וּמִתּוֹךְ כָּךְ **אֵין פֶּרֶץ** בָּנוּ:


**Our princes are borne** The great princes among us are borne by those smaller than they, for the small ones obey the greater ones, the result being that there is no breach among us.


###### Rashi on Psalms 144:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:14:2)


**וְאֵין יוֹצֵאת.** אֵין שְׁמוּעָה רָעָה יוֹצֵאת לְמֵרָחוֹק:


**nor rumor going out** No bad news goes far away.


###### Rashi on Psalms 144:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:14:3)


**וְאֵין צְוָחָה.** וְאֵין קוֹל מְהוּמוֹת מִלְחָמָה:


**nor is there a cry** There is no sound of the confusion of war.



### Verse 15

###### Rashi on Psalms 144:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/144:15:1)


**שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ.** שֶׁכָּל טוֹבָה הַזֹּאת שֶׁלּוֹ:


**Praiseworthy is the people that has this** That has all this good.



## Chapter 145


### Verse 4

###### Rashi on Psalms 145:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:4:1)


**דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ.** וְגַם אֲנִי **הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדְךָ אָשִׂיחָה**:


**Generation to generation will praise Your works** And I, too, shall speak of the majesty of the glory of Your splendor.



### Verse 6

###### Rashi on Psalms 145:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:6:1)


**וְעֱזוּז נוֹרְאוֹתֶיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ.** וְגַם אֲנִי **גְּדֻלָּתְךָ אֲסַפְּרֶנָּה**:


**And the strength of Your awesome deeds they will tell** And I, too, shall recite Your greatness.



### Verse 7

###### Rashi on Psalms 145:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:7:1)


**זֵכֶר רַב טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ.** דּוֹר לְדוֹר גְּבוּרָתְךָ יְדַבֵּרוּ זֶה לָזֶה לֵאמֹר: טוֹב לָנוּ **לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרוֹתָיו וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ** שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא (מצאתי):


**Of the remembrance of Your abundant goodness they will speak** i.e., one generation to another generation. **and they will speak of Your might** to each other, saying, “It is good for us to make known to the children of men His mighty deeds and the glory of the majesty of the kingdom of the Holy One, blessed be He.” (I found.)



### Verse 14

###### Rashi on Psalms 145:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:14:1)


**נוּ״ן** חֲסֵרָה מֵאָלְפָ״א בֵּיתָ״א, לְפִי שֶׁרָאָה דָּוִד בָּהּ מַפָּלָה קָשָׁה: ״נָפְלָה וְלֹא תוֹסִיף קוּם בְּתוּלַת יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (עמוס ה:ב), וְחָזַר וּסְמָכָהּ בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ: **סוֹמֵךְ ה׳ לְכָל הַנּוֹפְלִים** (ברכות ד:):


**supports** (The “nun” is missing from the “aleph-beth” because David saw in it a serious downfall [Amos 5:2]: “The virgin of Israel has fallen and shall not continue to rise.” And he returned and supported her with the holy spirit: The Lord supports all those who fall.)



### Verse 16

###### Rashi on Psalms 145:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/145:16:1)

### Verse 5

###### Rashi on Psalms 146:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/146:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/146:5:1)


**אַשְׁרֵי.** מִי **שֶׁאֵל יַעֲקֹב בְּעֶזְרוֹ**, שֶׁהִבְטִיחוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא ״הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּיךָ וַהֲשִׁיבֹתִיךָ״ (בראשית כח:טו). וְלָמָּה אַשְׁרָיו? לְפִי שֶׁהוּא **עוֹשֶׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ** וְ**אֶת הַיָּם**, וְכֵיוָן שֶׁהַכֹּל שֶׁלּוֹ, יֵשׁ בְּיָדוֹ לְשָׁמְרוֹ בַּיָּם וּבַיַּבָּשָׁה. אֲבָל מֶלֶךְ עוֹבֵד גִּלּוּלִים, אִם שׁוֹמְרוֹ בַּיַּבָּשָׁה אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְשָׁמְרוֹ בַּיָּם:


**Praiseworthy** is he in whose help is the God of Jacob, for the Holy One, blessed be He, promised him (Gen. 28:15): “Behold I am with you, and I shall guard You, etc., and I shall return you.” Now why is He praiseworthy? Because He made heaven and earth and the sea, and since all is His, He has the power to guard him on the sea and on dry land; but a mortal king, although he watches him on dry land, cannot watch him on the sea.

###### Rashi on Psalms 150:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/150:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/150:5:1)


**בְּצִלְצְלֵי שָׁמַע.** מְצִלְתַּיִם הַמַּשְׁמִיעִים קוֹל:

###### Rashi on Psalms 150:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/150:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Rashi%20on%20Psalms/r/150:5:2)


**שָׁמַע.** שֵׁם דָּבָר הוּא, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמַע בְּסֶגוֹל, וּמִפְּנֵי הָאֶתְנַחְתָּא הוּא נָקוּד קָמַץ גָּדוֹל, וּלְכָךְ טַעֲמוֹ לְמַעְלָה תַּחַת הַשִּׁי״ן. סְלִיק סֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים:


שָׁמַע is a noun, like שֶׁמַע, with a “segol,” but because of the “ethnactha” [which denotes a pause], it is vowelized with a long “kamatz,” and therefore, its accent is above, under the “shin.”
